`Music/PUT YOUR SONGS HERE.txt`:

```txt
Drop .mp3, .wav or .wma files in this folder, then open the Oracle menu (F3) > MUSIC.
Songs play in alphabetical order; rename them with numbers (01 ..., 02 ...) to choose the order.

```

`README.md`:

```md
# Oracle: Trinity Edition

An in-game cheat and tweak menu for **Batman: Arkham Knight** (PC), built on [BmSDK-AK](https://github.com/Team-BmSDK/BmSDK-AK).
Press **F3** in game to open it, or hold **BACK (View)** on an Xbox controller.

This is a fork of **Oracle by ZeidCeZeY**. It started from his mod and has since been rebuilt and expanded a lot.

## Credits

| | |
|---|---|
| **ZeidCeZeY** | Created Oracle: the original idea, the menu and the first set of features (versions 1.0 to 2.0). Original release on Nexus Mods: <https://www.nexusmods.com/batmanarkhamknight/mods/3597> |
| **XeTrinityz** | Trinity Edition: the ground-up rebuild (3.0) and everything added since. Details below. |

Both are credited in game too, under **SYSTEM > CREDITS**.

ZeidCeZeY released Oracle under the MIT licence and did not put it on GitHub. This repository keeps his copyright notice
in [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt), as the licence requires. If you only want the original, get it from his Nexus page.

## What came from the original

Oracle 1.0 to 2.0 by ZeidCeZeY gave the mod its name, the F3 menu, and the first features: player, combat and
takedown cheats, freeze enemies, sky and fog looks, weather (including real NO RAIN and wet streets), the camera page
(FOV, distance, height and shoulder for walking, gliding and the Batmobile, plus presets), infinite glide, playing as
the other characters (who can all drive the Batmobile), live Batmobile cheats, a music player for your own songs,
NEW GAME ++, counter icons in NG+, menu colours, hotkeys, cheats remembered across loads, controller support, and
teleport to waypoint.

## What Trinity Edition adds

**A rebuilt mod (3.0).** Oracle was rewritten from the ground up as modules on a small kernel. Every game hook is
guarded, so a failing feature logs an error instead of closing the game. Unloading the mod puts back every value it
changed. Settings moved to their own `settings.toml`, so updating the mod can't overwrite them.

**Favourites radial.** Put any feature on a wheel of your own: press HOME on a row (Y on a controller) and place it in
any slot on any page. In game, hold the radial key (mouse 4 by default, R3 on a controller), point at a slot with
the mouse, a stick or WASD, and let go to use it. Number keys use a slot at once. Q / E (LB / RB) turn the page, up
to 9 pages of 4 to 12 slots. Set the key, HOLD or TAP mode, size and slots per page under SYSTEM > RADIAL, where
ARRANGE RADIAL lets you move favourites around. A used slot does what its hotkey would. Rows that change your save
can't go on it.

**The menu.** A fixed-size panelled menu with an ACTIVE page for everything switched on. Type anywhere in the menu to
search every feature on every page. The key strip underneath changes with the selected row, and the footer shows its
help, hotkey and default value. PREVIEW PAGES shows each page's rows as you browse the page list. SYSTEM > ASSETS browses the game's own loaded textures and fonts, and MENU FONT draws the menu in any of them. Hotkeys are bound from the menu (INSERT on a row; one key can hold several features),
and each page remembers the row you were on.

**Combat.** AUTO FIGHT: Batman fights by himself with his whole moveset, countering and dodging every attack. It is a
learning brain that ships trained (`fight_brain.txt`) and keeps learning from your fights. Also AUTO COUNTER, AUTO
DODGE GUNFIRE, COMBO MULTIPLIER, COMBO NEVER RESETS, ONE HIT KO, ragdoll hits, knocking off helmets, disarm on first
hit and more.

**Teleport, six tabs.** Long teleports fade to black and fly you there above the rooftops, so the city streams in
district by district as it does when you glide, then land you on ground that belongs to a loaded level. Teleport to waypoint or objective, GO BACK through your last 16 teleports, the game's whole world map
by category (landmarks, Riddler trophies, riddles, AR challenges, Most Wanted sites), 8 saved spots, blink and sky
drop, and teleports to the Batmobile, enemies and trophies.

**World: enemies and friendlies.** Freeze (now for friendlies too), resize, heal, disarm, revive, pull and launch NPCs. Pacify enemies, turn
them on each other, arm them with weapons, hack militia tanks to your side, clear street thugs, flip every car, and an
on-screen NPC count.

**World: weather, atmosphere and city.** Rain from none to storm, toxin rain in any colour, puddles, mist and distant
rain. Lightning strikes on demand or at your crosshair, storm frequency and brightness. Wind
strength, direction and gusts. Sky and fog looks plus exposure, bloom, motion blur, film grain, depth of field, and
where the fog starts and how high it hangs. In the city: EMPTY STREETS, spawn an APC, a thug mob on the Batmobile or a
getaway car to chase, Jokerfy every billboard, Joker thugs, how often the Joker hallucinations come, and a
readout of the militia left on your island.

**World editor.** Mark enemies, friendlies, vehicles, turrets, props, movable scenery and pickups through walls,
with boxes, names, health and tracers. Select what you're aiming at, or pick from a list of everything nearby, then
grab it and carry it around (and throw it), place it at your crosshair, nudge, turn and resize it, freeze it, switch
off its collision, or remove it. REMOVE only hides, so missions can't break, and RESTORE puts anything you changed back.

**Camera, five tabs.** FREE CAMERA flies the view anywhere (Batman holds still, or the whole world freezes), with
smooth moves, tilt and zoom, and puts Batman down under the camera when you're done. TRIPOD leaves the camera on the
spot and gives you Batman back, turning to follow him. FIRST PERSON on foot, camera tilt, camera through walls,
hide the game HUD, cinematic bars, swap shoulder, and a default Batmobile view including the bonnet camera. Field
of view now changes the finished picture, so it can no longer creep wider after aiming.

**Batmobile, five tabs.** Autopilot to a waypoint or objective along the roads, remote control without the gadget,
repair, EMP-proofing and self-righting, engine power and tyre grip, a jump with floaty air gravity, auto combat that
fights for you while you drive, shooting down incoming missiles, every weapon armed, no reload or overheat, a
speedometer with driving stats, and Showcase skins.

**Player status.** CAN'T DIE (hits still hurt but leave you on 1 health), DAMAGE TAKEN from a tenth to five times,
health regeneration, unbreakable armour, no hit reactions, no stuns, invisible to thugs as well as drones, and a
status readout with health, armour, XP and upgrade points. PROGRESS adds an XP multiplier and +5000 XP, and
CHARACTER sets Batman's suit battle damage.

**Player.** Movement sliders for glide speed, grapple speed and boost power, line launcher speed, fall gravity and
low tunnel speed. Gadget cheats (no cooldown, use anywhere, unlimited disruptor, auto password hacks), Showcase suits applied on the spot,
upgrade points and unlocks, SAVE GAME NOW, and a Riddler page: reveal every trophy on the map, or SKIP TO RIDDLER
FINALE. Several Riddler and GCPD soft-locks are fixed along the way.

**Saves.** SYSTEM > SAVES lists every save on disk, newest first, with date, slot, location, difficulty and completion:
each slot's three rotating files, the backups the game quietly keeps in `Documents\WB Games`, and Oracle's own kept
copies. LOAD THIS SAVE restarts from any of them in game, in the main story or its New Game + run (keeping the save you're
leaving first), KEEP A COPY puts one
where the game will never rotate it away, and SAVE NOW AND KEEP A COPY gives you a save to come back to. START NEW
GAME + NOW starts a fresh New Game + run straight from your game, wiping an NG+ run already under way (your save is
kept first), and the NEW GAME ++ main-menu button lives here too.

Removed from the original: the FUN page (stamina and fall damage).

## Install

1. Install [BmSDK-AK](https://github.com/Team-BmSDK/BmSDK-AK) (Oracle targets v0.21.0).
2. Put this folder in `Batman Arkham Knight/BmGame/Mods/` so you have `BmGame/Mods/Oracle/mod.toml`.
3. Start the game and press **F3**.

The mod writes these itself the first time it needs them, so they are not in the repository: `settings.toml` (your
choices), `saved_spots.txt` (teleport slots), `saves/` (kept save copies), `Oracle.log` (for bug reports). Drop `.mp3`, `.wav` or `.wma` files
in `Music/` for the music player.

**Updating** replaces `fight_brain.txt`, so AUTO FIGHT goes back to the training that ships with that version. Your
settings and saved spots are kept.

## Licence

MIT. See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). Original work copyright ZeidCeZeY; Trinity Edition changes copyright XeTrinityz.

```

`scripts/Core/App.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.Engine;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>The kernel: owns the module list and turns SDK callbacks into one ordered, isolated update.</summary>
internal static class App
{
    public const string Version = "3.0.0";
    private const float MaxStep = 0.25f;

    /// <summary>Update order, and through registration the order of rows within each menu page.</summary>
    public static readonly Module[] Modules =
    {
        Player.I, Status.I, GlideMod.I, Movement.I, Combat.I, Gadgets.I, Npcs.I, WorldEditor.I, Screen.I, Atmosphere.I, PostFx.I, Cosmetics.I, Rain.I, Lightning.I, Wind.I, Population.I, JokerVisions.I, JammedGuns.I, CameraRig.I, FreeCam.I, Batmobile.I,
        BatmobileSkin.I, CharacterSuit.I, Teleport.I, TeleportTools.I, TimeControl.I, Characters.I, Music.I, NewGamePlus.I, Progress.I, Riddler.I, Saves.I, SystemPage.I, AssetBrowser.I, DebugKeys.I,
    };

    private static FrameTimer _tick;
    private static bool _started;
    private static bool _inWorld;

    public static string Dir { get; private set; } = "";

    public static void Start(string dir)
    {
        if (_started)
            return;
        _started = true;

        Dir = dir;
        Log.Open(dir);
        Catalog.Clear();
        Each("build", m => m.Build());
        Catalog.Seal();
        Layout.Apply();
        Settings.Load(first: true);
        Each("start", m => m.Started());
        Catalog.Arm();
        Log.Info("Loaded " + Catalog.All.Count + " features across " + Modules.Length + " modules, menu key " + Settings.MenuKey + ".");
    }

    public static void Stop()
    {
        if (!_started)
            return;
        _started = false;

        Radial.Shutdown();
        Menu.Close();
        Pad.Shutdown();
        Shapes.Release();
        Settings.Flush();
        Each("shutdown", m => m.Shutdown());
        Catalog.RestoreConsoleProps();
        World.Forget();
    }

    public static void EnterWorld()
    {
        Radial.Close();
        Menu.Close();
        Safe.Run("editor mode", () => WorldEditor.I.LeaveMode(true));
        World.Forget();
        if (!Characters.I.Busy)
            Fader.Clear();
        Each("world change", m => m.WorldChanged());
        Catalog.Arm();
    }

    public static void EnterMenu()
    {
        Radial.Close();
        Menu.Close();
        Safe.Run("editor mode", () => WorldEditor.I.LeaveMode(true));
        World.Forget();
    }

    public static void SdkTick()
    {
        Fallback.NoteSdkTick();
        Tick();
    }

    public static void SdkKey(Keys key)
    {
        if (_started && !Fallback.Active)
            KeyInput.Pressed(key);
    }

    /// <summary>One game update. Runs from OnTick, or from the render hook when the game stops ticking mods.</summary>
    public static void Tick()
    {
        if (!_started)
            return;

        float dt = _tick.Step(MaxStep);

        World.Refresh();
        Settings.Tick(dt);

        if (World.InGame)
        {
            _inWorld = true;
            if (!Characters.I.GuardLoadedCharacter() && Catalog.Tick(dt))
            {
                TickModules(dt);
                Catalog.Maintain(dt);
            }
        }
        else if (World.InFrontend && _inWorld)
        {
            _inWorld = false;
            Each("leave game", m => m.LeftGame());
            Catalog.Arm();
        }

        Pad.GameTick();
        Menu.Tick(dt);
    }

    /// <summary>One rendered frame. Runs inside the PostRender redirect, so nothing here may throw.</summary>
    public static void Frame(Canvas canvas)
    {
        if (!_started)
            return;

        World.Refresh();
        foreach (Module m in Modules)
        {
            try
            {
                m.Frame();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Throttled("frame " + m.Name, m.Name + " frame failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
            }
        }

        Safe.Run("controller", Pad.Frame);
        Safe.Run("radial", Radial.Frame);
        Safe.Run("fallback", Fallback.Frame);
        Safe.Run("overlay", () => Overlay.Draw(canvas));
    }

    private static void TickModules(float dt)
    {
        foreach (Module m in Modules)
        {
            try
            {
                m.Tick(dt);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Throttled("tick " + m.Name, m.Name + " tick failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void Each(string what, Action<Module> call)
    {
        foreach (Module m in Modules)
        {
            try
            {
                call(m);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Info(m.Name + " " + what + " failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
            }
        }
    }
}

```

`scripts/Core/Cvars.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The UE3 console's get and set, which reach every instance and the class default at once. Used for config
/// properties that must also apply to objects which haven't spawned yet.
/// </summary>
internal static class Cvars
{
    private const int MaxOriginalLength = 200;

    // Same key as Oracle 2.x, so a hot reload over the old version still knows the real vanilla values.
    private static Dictionary<string, string> Originals =>
        Shared.Keep("Originals", () => new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    public static string Exec(string command)
    {
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (pc == null)
            return "";

        string result = pc.ConsoleCommand(new FString(command), false).ToString() ?? "";
        Log.Detail("exec " + command + " => " + result.Trim());
        return result;
    }

    public static string Get(string cls, string prop) => Exec("get " + cls + " " + prop).Trim();

    public static void Set(string cls, string prop, string value) => Exec("set " + cls + " " + prop + " " + value);

    /// <summary>Sets a value, remembering the vanilla one the first time so it can be put back.</summary>
    public static void Override(string cls, string prop, string value)
    {
        string key = cls + " " + prop;
        if (!Originals.ContainsKey(key))
        {
            string original = Get(cls, prop);
            if (original.Length > 0 && original.Length < MaxOriginalLength && !original.Contains("Unrecognized", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                Originals[key] = original;
        }

        Set(cls, prop, value);
    }

    /// <summary>Puts back a value only if this mod changed it, for properties the game may have set itself.</summary>
    public static void RestoreIfChanged(string cls, string prop)
    {
        if (Originals.TryGetValue(cls + " " + prop, out string? original))
            Set(cls, prop, original);
    }

    public static void Restore(string cls, string prop, string fallback)
    {
        if (Originals.TryGetValue(cls + " " + prop, out string? original))
            Set(cls, prop, original);
        else if (Get(cls, prop) != fallback)
            Set(cls, prop, fallback);
    }
}

```

`scripts/Core/Entry.cs`:

```cs
namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The only type BmSDK talks to. An exception escaping any of these callbacks exits the game
/// (Loader.RunGuarded calls Environment.Exit), so each one goes straight through <see cref="Safe"/>.
/// </summary>
[Script]
public sealed class OracleMod : Script
{
    public override void Main() => Start();

    public override void OnLoad() => Start();

    public override void OnEnterGame() => Safe.Run("enter game", App.EnterWorld);

    public override void OnEnterMenu() => Safe.Run("enter menu", App.EnterMenu);

    public override void OnTick() => Safe.Run("tick", App.SdkTick);

    public override void OnKeyDown(Keys key) => Safe.Run("key", () => App.SdkKey(key));

    public override void OnUnload() => Safe.Run("unload", App.Stop);

    private void Start()
    {
        string dir = Mod.DirectoryPath;
        Safe.Run("start", () => App.Start(dir));
    }
}

```

`scripts/Core/Geo.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>World-space helpers. Unreal units are centimetres and rotations are in degrees.</summary>
internal static class Geo
{
    /// <summary>Distance on the ground plane, ignoring height.</summary>
    public static float DistXY(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => MathF.Sqrt(DistXYSq(a, b));

    public static float DistXYSq(Vector3 a, Vector3 b)
    {
        float dx = a.X - b.X;
        float dy = a.Y - b.Y;
        return dx * dx + dy * dy;
    }

    /// <summary>The flat unit direction a yaw faces.</summary>
    public static Vector3 Facing(float yawDegrees)
    {
        float r = yawDegrees * MathF.PI / 180f;
        return new Vector3(MathF.Cos(r), MathF.Sin(r), 0f);
    }
}

```

`scripts/Core/Held.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// One game value Oracle overrides on one object. The first override remembers what the game had, moving to
/// another object puts the last one back, and <see cref="Restore"/> leaves the game exactly as it was found.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Held<TObj, TVal> where TObj : GameObject
{
    private readonly string _what;
    private readonly Func<TObj, TVal> _get;
    private readonly Action<TObj, TVal> _set;
    private TObj? _obj;
    private TVal _original = default!;

    public Held(string what, Func<TObj, TVal> get, Action<TObj, TVal> set)
    {
        _what = what;
        _get = get;
        _set = set;
    }

    /// <summary>Sets the value, worked out from the game's own one (a scale, say).</summary>
    public void Set(TObj obj, Func<TVal, TVal> fromOriginal)
    {
        if (_obj is not { IsValid: true } held || held.Ptr != obj.Ptr)
        {
            Restore();
            _obj = obj;
            _original = _get(obj);
        }

        TVal want = fromOriginal(_original);
        if (!EqualityComparer<TVal>.Default.Equals(_get(obj), want))
            _set(obj, want);
    }

    public void Set(TObj obj, TVal value) => Set(obj, _ => value);

    public void Restore()
    {
        TObj? obj = _obj;
        _obj = null;
        if (obj is { IsValid: true })
            Safe.Run(_what + " restore", () => _set(obj, _original));
    }
}

```

`scripts/Core/Log.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal static class Log
{
    private const double ThrottleSeconds = 5.0;

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, double> _next = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private static string _path = "";

    public static bool Diagnostics;

    public static void Open(string dir)
    {
        try
        {
            _path = Path.Combine(dir, "Oracle.log");
            // A hot reload opens the log again: the one before is kept, so a fight logged just before an update survives.
            var old = new FileInfo(_path);
            if (old.Exists && old.Length > 200)
                File.Copy(_path, Path.Combine(dir, "Oracle.prev.log"), true);
            File.WriteAllText(_path, "Oracle " + App.Version + " " + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + Environment.NewLine);
        }
        catch
        {
            _path = "";
        }
    }

    public static void Info(string text)
    {
        Debug.Log("[Oracle] " + text);
        if (_path.Length == 0)
            return;

        try
        {
            File.AppendAllText(_path, DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss.fff", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " | " + text + Environment.NewLine);
        }
        catch
        {
            // A locked log file must never cost a frame or a feature.
        }
    }

    public static void Detail(string text)
    {
        if (Diagnostics)
            Info(text);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// An exception's message and where in Oracle it was thrown: the innermost Oracle frame of its stack, with the
    /// line when the build has one. A message alone ("Object reference not set...") says nothing about where.
    /// </summary>
    public static string Why(Exception ex)
    {
        try
        {
            return Where(ex);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // Reading the stack can fail on frames that pass through native code. The message still helps.
            return ex.Message + " (" + ex.GetType().Name + ")";
        }
    }

    private static string Where(Exception ex)
    {
        var trace = new System.Diagnostics.StackTrace(ex, true);
        foreach (System.Diagnostics.StackFrame frame in trace.GetFrames())
        {
            System.Reflection.MethodBase? m = frame.GetMethod();
            if (m?.DeclaringType?.Namespace?.StartsWith("CeZeY", StringComparison.Ordinal) != true)
                continue;

            string type = m.DeclaringType!.Name;
            int line = frame.GetFileLineNumber();
            return ex.Message + " (" + ex.GetType().Name + " in " + type + "." + m.Name + (line > 0 ? " line " + line : "") + ")";
        }

        return ex.Message + " (" + ex.GetType().Name + ")";
    }

    /// <summary>Logs at most once every few seconds per key, so one failing tick can't flood the log or hide another error.</summary>
    public static void Throttled(string key, string text)
    {
        double now = Clock.Now;
        if (_next.TryGetValue(key, out double due) && now < due)
            return;

        _next[key] = now + ThrottleSeconds;
        Info(text);
    }
}
```

`scripts/Core/Module.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.Engine;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// One self-contained area of Oracle. To add one: subclass this, register features in <see cref="Build"/>, and
/// list the instance in <see cref="App.Modules"/>. App isolates every callback, so a failing module logs and
/// the rest keep running. [Redirect] methods are entry points of their own and must guard themselves.
/// </summary>
internal abstract class Module
{
    public virtual string Name => GetType().Name;

    /// <summary>True while <see cref="Draw"/> has something to show.</summary>
    public virtual bool HasHud => false;

    /// <summary>Keeps <see cref="Draw"/> running under the open menu, for HUDs the menu works on (the world editor).</summary>
    public virtual bool HudWithMenu => false;

    /// <summary>Registers this module's features. Runs once per load, before settings are read.</summary>
    public virtual void Build() { }

    /// <summary>Settings have been read for the first time.</summary>
    public virtual void Started() { }

    /// <summary>A new world began loading. Every cached object is about to go stale.</summary>
    public virtual void WorldChanged() { }

    /// <summary>The player went back to the main menu.</summary>
    public virtual void LeftGame() { }

    /// <summary>Runs every game tick once saved cheats have been applied.</summary>
    public virtual void Tick(float dt) { }

    /// <summary>Runs every rendered frame, including while paused and when game ticks stop.</summary>
    public virtual void Frame() { }

    /// <summary>Draws always-on HUD elements, beneath the menu.</summary>
    public virtual void Draw(Canvas c) { }

    /// <summary>The menu is about to open, so lists it shows should be refreshed.</summary>
    public virtual void MenuOpening() { }

    /// <summary>The mod is unloading. Put the game back exactly as it was found.</summary>
    public virtual void Shutdown() { }
}
```

`scripts/Core/Safe.cs`:

```cs
namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Boundary guards. Nothing may throw past these into BmSDK.</summary>
internal static class Safe
{
    public static void Run(string what, Action action)
    {
        try
        {
            action();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled(what, what + " failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
        }
    }

    public static bool Try(string what, Func<bool> check, bool fallback = false)
    {
        try
        {
            return check();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled(what, what + " failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
            return fallback;
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Core/Shared.cs`:

```cs
namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// State that outlives a hot reload. A reload loads a new assembly, so statics reset and Oracle's own types
/// change identity: store only BCL and BmSDK types here, or the cast silently fails after a reload.
/// </summary>
internal static class Shared
{
    private const string Prefix = "CeZeY.Oracle.";

    // Claimed by whichever mod's overlay menu is open, so two menus never fight over the screen.
    private const string MenuOwnerKey = "CeZeY.ModMenuOwner";

    public static T? Get<T>(string key) where T : class => AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData(Prefix + key) as T;

    public static T GetValue<T>(string key, T fallback) where T : struct =>
        AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData(Prefix + key) is T value ? value : fallback;

    public static void Set(string key, object? value) => AppDomain.CurrentDomain.SetData(Prefix + key, value);

    public static T Keep<T>(string key, Func<T> make) where T : class
    {
        T? held = Get<T>(key);
        if (held != null)
            return held;

        T made = make();
        Set(key, made);
        return made;
    }

    public static string? MenuOwner
    {
        get => AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData(MenuOwnerKey) as string;
        set => AppDomain.CurrentDomain.SetData(MenuOwnerKey, value);
    }
}
```

`scripts/Core/Timing.cs`:

```cs
using Stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal static class Clock
{
    private static readonly long Origin = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();

    /// <summary>Seconds since the mod loaded, unaffected by game speed and pause.</summary>
    public static double Now => Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(Origin).TotalSeconds;
}

/// <summary>A repeating interval measured in real time.</summary>
internal struct Every
{
    private double _due;

    public bool Elapsed(double seconds)
    {
        double now = Clock.Now;
        if (now < _due)
            return false;

        _due = now + seconds;
        return true;
    }

    public void Force() => _due = 0.0;
}

/// <summary>Real time between calls, clamped so a stall never becomes one huge step.</summary>
internal struct FrameTimer
{
    private long _last;

    public float Step(float max)
    {
        long now = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        float dt = _last == 0 ? 0f : Math.Min((float)Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(_last, now).TotalSeconds, max);
        _last = now;
        return dt;
    }
}

internal static class Ease
{
    /// <summary>How much of a gap to close this step to approach a target at a steady rate, whatever the frame rate.</summary>
    public static float Follow(float rate, float dt) => 1f - MathF.Exp(-rate * dt);

    public static float Smooth(float t)
    {
        t = Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f);
        return t * t * (3f - 2f * t);
    }

    public static float In(float t)
    {
        t = Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f);
        return t * t;
    }

    public static float Out(float t) => 1f - MathF.Pow(1f - Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f), 3f);
}
```

`scripts/Core/World.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Validated view of the player and game objects. Game.Get* throw when an object is missing and each runs
/// UnrealScript, so everything reads the cached references here instead. Getters re-check IsValid because
/// touching a destroyed wrapper dereferences a null pointer, which no try/catch can recover from.
/// </summary>
internal static class World
{
    private const double RefindSeconds = 0.25;

    private static RPlayerController? _pc;
    private static RGameInfo? _info;
    private static Every _refind;
    private static nint _checkedPawn;
    private static bool _frontend;

    public static RPlayerController? Pc => _pc is { IsValid: true } ? _pc : null;

    public static RGameInfo? Info => _info is { IsValid: true } ? _info : null;

    public static Pawn? Pawn
    {
        get
        {
            Pawn? pawn = Pc?.Pawn;
            return pawn is { IsValid: true } ? pawn : null;
        }
    }

    public static nint PawnPtr => Pawn?.Ptr ?? 0;

    /// <summary>The player's character, including while it is not the possessed pawn (driving, for example).</summary>
    public static RPawnPlayer? Player
    {
        get
        {
            RPlayerController? pc = Pc;
            if (pc == null)
                return null;
            if (pc.Pawn is RPawnPlayer owned && owned.IsValid)
                return owned;

            RPawnPlayer combat = pc.CombatPawn;
            return combat is { IsValid: true } ? combat : null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>True in a playable world, false in the main menu or while nothing is possessed.</summary>
    public static bool InGame { get; private set; }

    public static bool InFrontend => _frontend;

    public static bool Paused => Safe.Try("pause check", () => Pc is { } pc && pc.IsPaused());

    public static void Refresh()
    {
        if (Pc == null || Info == null || _refind.Elapsed(RefindSeconds))
            Refind();

        Pawn? pawn = Pawn;
        if (pawn == null)
        {
            InGame = false;
            return;
        }

        if (pawn.Ptr != _checkedPawn)
        {
            _checkedPawn = pawn.Ptr;
            _frontend = pawn.GetPathName(null).StartsWith("frontend.", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        InGame = !_frontend;
    }

    public static void Forget()
    {
        _pc = null;
        _info = null;
        _checkedPawn = 0;
        _refind.Force();
        InGame = false;
    }

    private static void Refind()
    {
        try
        {
            _pc = Game.GetPlayerController(0);
        }
        catch
        {
            _pc = null;
        }

        try
        {
            _info = _pc == null ? null : Game.GetGameInfo();
        }
        catch
        {
            _info = null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The game's replication info: streaming, flags and the loaded player data. Null when unavailable.</summary>
    public static RGameRI? Ri => Fetch(Game.GetGameRI);

    public static WorldInfo? WorldInfo => Fetch(Game.GetWorldInfo);

    public static RCheatManager? Cheats => Fetch(Game.GetCheatManager);

    /// <summary>The cheat manager, or a refusal a command can show.</summary>
    public static RCheatManager RequireCheats() => Cheats ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("cheat manager unavailable");

    /// <summary>The possessed pawn, or a refusal a command can show.</summary>
    public static Pawn RequirePawn() => Pawn ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");

    /// <summary>A Game.Get* singleton, valid or null: those calls throw instead of returning null when it's missing.</summary>
    private static T? Fetch<T>(Func<T> get) where T : GameObject
    {
        try
        {
            T found = get();
            return found is { IsValid: true } ? found : null;
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Enumerates live objects of a type. FindObjects is a per-type list, so this is cheap for rare types.</summary>
    public static IEnumerable<T> All<T>() where T : GameObject
    {
        foreach (T obj in Game.FindObjects<T>())
        {
            if (obj is { IsValid: true } && !obj.IsClassDefaultObject)
                yield return obj;
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Features/Catalog.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal readonly record struct ConsoleProp(string Cls, string Name, string On, string Off);

internal sealed class MenuRow
{
    public string? Header;
    public Feature? Item;

    /// <summary>Where the row lives, like "PLAYER / GADGETS". Shown on pages that gather rows from elsewhere.</summary>
    public string? Path;
}

internal sealed class MenuPage
{
    public string Title = "";
    public readonly List<MenuRow> Rows = new();
    public readonly List<MenuPage> Children = new();

    public bool HasSub => Children.Count > 0;

    public int ActiveCount
    {
        get
        {
            int n = 0;
            foreach (MenuRow r in Rows)
            {
                if (r.Item is { Active: true })
                    n++;
            }

            foreach (MenuPage child in Children)
                n += child.ActiveCount;

            return n;
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// The registry of every feature, the builder modules register them with, and the engine that switches them
/// on after a load and keeps them applied.
/// </summary>
internal static class Catalog
{
    private const float MaintainGap = 0.25f;

    public static readonly List<Feature> All = new();
    public static readonly Dictionary<string, Feature> ById = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    public static readonly List<MenuPage> Pages = new();

    private static readonly List<Feature> _ticking = new();
    private static readonly List<Feature> _maintained = new();
    private static readonly List<ConsoleProp> _consoleProps = new();
    private static readonly Queue<Feature> _applyQueue = new();

    private static bool _applied;
    private static float _applyLeft;
    private static float _maintainLeft;
    private static nint _lastPawn;

    /// <summary>True once saved cheats have been switched back on in this world.</summary>
    public static bool Ready => _applied && World.InGame;

    public static int ActiveCount
    {
        get
        {
            int n = 0;
            foreach (Feature f in All)
            {
                if (f.Active)
                    n++;
            }

            return n;
        }
    }

    public static void Clear()
    {
        All.Clear();
        ById.Clear();
        Pages.Clear();
        _ticking.Clear();
        _maintained.Clear();
        _consoleProps.Clear();
        _applyQueue.Clear();
    }

    // ---- building


    private static T Add<T>(T f, string id, string label, string help) where T : Feature
    {
        f.Id = id;
        f.Key = id;
        f.Label = label;
        f.Help = help;

        All.Add(f);
        ById[id] = f;
        return f;
    }

    public static Toggle AddToggle(string id, string label, string help, Action<bool>? changed = null, bool on = false) =>
        Add(new Toggle { On = on, Default = on, Changed = changed }, id, label, help);

    public static Slider AddSlider(string id, string label, string help, float def, float min, float max, float step, float hot, Func<float, string> format, Action<float>? changed = null) =>
        Add(new Slider { Value = def, Default = def, Min = min, Max = max, Stride = step, HotValue = hot, Format = format, Changed = changed }, id, label, help);

    public static Choice AddChoice(string id, string label, string help, string[] keys, string[] labels, Action<int>? changed = null) =>
        Add(new Choice { Keys = keys, Labels = labels, Saved = keys.Length == 0 ? "" : keys[0], Changed = changed }, id, label, help);

    public static Command AddCommand(string id, string label, string help, Action run) =>
        Add(new Command { Run = run }, id, label, help);

    /// <summary>A save-changing command: always confirmed, never bound to a key.</summary>
    public static Command AddSaveCommand(string id, string label, string help, Action run)
    {
        Command c = AddCommand(id, label, help, run);
        c.ChangesSave = true;
        return c;
    }

    /// <summary>A toggle that flips config properties through the console.</summary>
    public static Toggle AddConsoleToggle(string id, string label, string help, params ConsoleProp[] props)
    {
        _consoleProps.AddRange(props);
        return AddToggle(id, label, help, on =>
        {
            foreach (ConsoleProp p in props)
            {
                if (on)
                    Cvars.Override(p.Cls, p.Name, p.On);
                else
                    Cvars.Restore(p.Cls, p.Name, p.Off);
            }
        });
    }

    /// <summary>A slider that writes one config property through the console.</summary>
    public static Slider AddConsoleSlider(string id, string label, string help, string cls, string prop, float def, float min, float max, float step, float hot, Func<float, string> format)
    {
        string off = def.ToString("0.0#####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        _consoleProps.Add(new ConsoleProp(cls, prop, "", off));
        return AddSlider(id, label, help, def, min, max, step, hot, format, v =>
        {
            if (MathF.Abs(v - def) < 0.0001f)
                Cvars.Restore(cls, prop, off);
            else
                Cvars.Override(cls, prop, v.ToString("0.0#####", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        });
    }

    /// <summary>Call after every module has built, so the update lists hold exactly the features that need them.</summary>
    public static void Seal()
    {
        _ticking.Clear();
        _maintained.Clear();
        foreach (Feature f in All)
        {
            if (f.TickStep != null)
                _ticking.Add(f);
            if (f.MaintainStep != null)
                _maintained.Add(f);
        }
    }

    // ---- running

    /// <summary>Starts the wait before saved cheats switch back on. Called after any load.</summary>
    public static void Arm()
    {
        _applied = false;
        _applyLeft = Settings.ApplyDelay;
        _applyQueue.Clear();
        _lastPawn = 0;
    }

    /// <summary>Advances the startup queue and runs per-tick features. Returns false until the world has settled.</summary>
    public static bool Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (!_applied)
        {
            _applyLeft -= dt;
            if (_applyLeft > 0f)
                return false;

            _applied = true;
            foreach (Feature f in All)
            {
                if (f.Active)
                    _applyQueue.Enqueue(f);
            }

            _lastPawn = World.PawnPtr;
            if (_applyQueue.Count > 0)
                Log.Info("Switching " + _applyQueue.Count + " saved cheats back on.");
            return false;
        }

        // One per tick: console commands are slow enough that a whole batch shows up as a hitch after loading.
        if (_applyQueue.TryDequeue(out Feature? next) && next.Active)
            ApplyLogged(next, "load");

        foreach (Feature f in _ticking)
        {
            if (f.Active)
                Guarded(f, f.TickStep!, "tick");
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static void Maintain(float dt)
    {
        nint pawn = World.PawnPtr;
        bool newPawn = pawn != _lastPawn;
        _lastPawn = pawn;

        _maintainLeft -= dt;
        if (_maintainLeft > 0f && !newPawn)
            return;

        _maintainLeft = MaintainGap;
        foreach (Feature f in _maintained)
        {
            if (f.Active)
                Guarded(f, f.MaintainStep!, "maintain");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Records a user change: applies it, or leaves it for the next load, and schedules a save.</summary>
    public static void Commit(Feature f, string reason = "menu")
    {
        if (f.IsSetting)
            Guarded(f, f.Apply, "apply");
        else if (Ready)
            ApplyLogged(f, reason);
        else
            Log.Info(f.Label + " -> " + f.State + " (waits for the game)");

        Settings.MarkDirty();
    }

    /// <summary>Applies a value that changed in settings.toml while the game is running.</summary>
    public static void ApplyExternal(Feature f)
    {
        if (f.IsSetting)
            Guarded(f, f.Apply, "apply");
        else if (Ready)
            ApplyLogged(f, "settings.toml");
    }

    /// <summary>Runs a command. Returns false, without throwing, if it failed.</summary>
    public static bool Run(Command c)
    {
        if (!c.IsSetting && !World.InGame)
        {
            Log.Info(c.Label + " skipped: not in game.");
            return false;
        }

        try
        {
            c.Run?.Invoke();
            Log.Info(c.Label + " done.");
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info(c.Label + " failed: " + ex.Message);
            // The menu's FAILED flash can't say why, so put the reason on screen too.
            Overlay.Notice(c.Label, ex.Message.ToUpperInvariant(), false);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A key press for everything on that key. Toggles, sliders and choices all change, and every command runs in
    /// menu order. Commands that move the player are the exception: only one move can happen, so they are tried
    /// until one works. TELEPORT TO WAYPOINT and TELEPORT TO OBJECTIVE on one key go to the waypoint when there is
    /// one and the objective otherwise; only the last move's failure shows.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Hotkey(IReadOnlyList<Feature> features)
    {
        if (features.Count == 1)
        {
            Hotkey(features[0]);
            return;
        }

        var commands = new List<Command>();
        foreach (Feature f in features)
        {
            if (!f.Bindable)
                continue;
            if (f is Command c)
                commands.Add(c);
            else
                Hotkey(f);
        }

        if (commands.Count == 0)
            return;

        int lastMove = commands.FindLastIndex(c => c.MovesPlayer);
        bool moved = false;
        Command? firstDone = null;
        Command? failed = null;
        int done = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < commands.Count; i++)
        {
            Command c = commands[i];
            if (c.MovesPlayer && moved)
                continue;

            // A move with another move after it may fail quietly: the next one is the fallback.
            bool fallback = c.MovesPlayer && i < lastMove;
            Overlay.Muted = fallback;
            bool ok;
            try
            {
                ok = Run(c);
            }
            finally
            {
                Overlay.Muted = false;
            }

            if (ok)
            {
                done++;
                firstDone ??= c;
                moved |= c.MovesPlayer;
            }
            else if (!fallback)
            {
                failed = c;
            }
        }

        if (failed != null)
            Overlay.Toast(failed.Label, "FAILED", false);
        else if (firstDone != null)
            Overlay.Toast(done == 1 ? firstDone.Label : firstDone.Label + " +" + (done - 1), "DONE", true);
    }

    public static void Hotkey(Feature f)
    {
        if (!f.Bindable)
            return;

        if (f is Command c)
        {
            bool ok = Run(c);
            Overlay.Toast(f.Label, ok ? "DONE" : "FAILED", ok);
            return;
        }

        f.Hotkey();
        Commit(f, "hotkey");
        Overlay.Toast(f.Label, f.State, !f.IsDefault);
    }

    public static void TurnAllOff()
    {
        foreach (Feature f in All)
        {
            if (f.Active)
            {
                f.ResetValue();
                Commit(f);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Puts every console-driven value back. They live on class defaults, so unlike edits to live objects
    /// they would otherwise outlast the mod.
    /// </summary>
    public static void RestoreConsoleProps()
    {
        foreach (ConsoleProp p in _consoleProps)
            Safe.Run("restore " + p.Name, () => Cvars.RestoreIfChanged(p.Cls, p.Name));
    }

    private static void ApplyLogged(Feature f, string reason)
    {
        Guarded(f, f.Apply, "apply");
        Log.Info(f.Label + " -> " + f.State + " (" + reason + ")");
    }

    private static void Guarded(Feature f, Action step, string what)
    {
        try
        {
            step();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled(f.Id + what, f.Label + " " + what + " failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Features/DebugFlags.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Access to the game's own debug switches, which live on a single persistent object.</summary>
internal static class DebugFlags
{
    private static RPersistentDebugData? _data;

    public static RPersistentDebugData? Data
    {
        get
        {
            if (_data is { IsValid: true })
                return _data;

            _data = World.All<RPersistentDebugData>().FirstOrDefault();
            return _data;
        }
    }

    public static void Forget() => _data = null;

    /// <summary>A toggle for one debug switch. The game clears these on some transitions, so it's kept applied.</summary>
    public static Toggle AddFlag(string id, string label, string help, Func<RPersistentDebugData, bool> get, Action<RPersistentDebugData, bool> set)
    {
        void Write(bool on)
        {
            if (Data is { } d && get(d) != on)
                set(d, on);
        }

        return AddToggle(id, label, help, Write).Maintain(() => Write(true));
    }
}
```

`scripts/Features/Favourites.cs`:

```cs
namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// What's on the favourites radial: one flat list of feature ids, read in pages of <see cref="PerPage"/> slots.
/// An empty string is an empty slot, so a layout keeps its gaps. Changing the slots per page re-flows the same
/// list, in the same order, into the new page size.
/// </summary>
internal static class Favourites
{
    public const int MaxPages = 9;
    public const int MinPerPage = 4;
    public const int MaxPerPage = 12;

    /// <summary>SLOTS PER PAGE.</summary>
    public static int PerPage = 8;

    public static readonly List<string> Slots = new();

    public static int Capacity => MaxPages * PerPage;

    /// <summary>The same rule as a hotkey: anything but a row that changes the save, which always asks first.</summary>
    public static bool CanHold(Feature f) => f.Bindable;

    /// <summary>Pages that hold something, at least one.</summary>
    public static int UsedPages
    {
        get
        {
            int last = LastFilled();
            return last < 0 ? 1 : Math.Min(MaxPages, last / PerPage + 1);
        }
    }

    public static int Count
    {
        get
        {
            int n = 0;
            foreach (string s in Slots)
            {
                if (s.Length > 0)
                    n++;
            }

            return n;
        }
    }

    public static int IndexOf(string id) => Slots.FindIndex(s => s.Equals(id, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    public static bool Contains(Feature f) => IndexOf(f.Id) >= 0;

    public static Feature? At(int page, int slot) => slot < 0 || slot >= PerPage ? null : At(page * PerPage + slot);

    public static Feature? At(int index) =>
        index >= 0 && index < Slots.Count && Slots[index].Length > 0 && Catalog.ById.TryGetValue(Slots[index], out Feature? f) ? f : null;

    /// <summary>The first empty slot, or -1 when every page is full.</summary>
    public static int FirstFree()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < Capacity; i++)
        {
            if (i >= Slots.Count || Slots[i].Length == 0)
                return i;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    /// <summary>Puts a feature in a slot, replacing whatever was there.</summary>
    public static void Put(int index, string id)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= Capacity)
            return;

        while (Slots.Count <= index)
            Slots.Add("");
        Slots[index] = id;
        Changed();
    }

    public static void Empty(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= Slots.Count)
            return;

        Slots[index] = "";
        Changed();
    }

    /// <summary>Swaps two slots, either of which may be empty.</summary>
    public static void Swap(int a, int b)
    {
        if (a == b || a < 0 || b < 0 || a >= Capacity || b >= Capacity)
            return;

        while (Slots.Count <= Math.Max(a, b))
            Slots.Add("");
        (Slots[a], Slots[b]) = (Slots[b], Slots[a]);
        Changed();
    }

    public static void ClearAll()
    {
        Slots.Clear();
        Changed();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Reads the saved list. Unknown ids (a feature that was removed) and repeats become empty slots, so the
    /// rest of the layout stays where it was.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Load(TomlArray? list)
    {
        Slots.Clear();
        if (list == null)
            return;

        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (object? item in list)
        {
            if (Slots.Count >= MaxPages * MaxPerPage)
                break;

            bool keep = item is string id && id.Length > 0 && Catalog.ById.TryGetValue(id, out Feature? f) && CanHold(f) && seen.Add(id);
            Slots.Add(keep ? (string)item! : "");
        }

        Trim();
    }

    /// <summary>Takes the old PINNED page's rows, in order, the first time settings are read after the update.</summary>
    public static void FromPins(IEnumerable<string> pins)
    {
        Slots.Clear();
        foreach (string id in pins)
        {
            if (Slots.Count >= Capacity)
                break;
            if (Catalog.ById.TryGetValue(id, out Feature? f) && CanHold(f) && IndexOf(id) < 0)
                Slots.Add(f.Id);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The list as a TOML array, without trailing empty slots.</summary>
    public static string Toml()
    {
        int last = LastFilled();
        return "[" + string.Join(", ", Slots.Take(last + 1).Select(id => "\"" + id + "\"")) + "]";
    }

    private static int LastFilled() => Slots.FindLastIndex(s => s.Length > 0);

    private static void Trim()
    {
        int last = LastFilled();
        if (last + 1 < Slots.Count)
            Slots.RemoveRange(last + 1, Slots.Count - last - 1);
    }

    private static void Changed()
    {
        Trim();
        Settings.MarkDirty();
    }
}
```

`scripts/Features/Feature.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// One row of the menu and one line of settings.toml. Modules hold typed references (Slider.Value, Toggle.On)
/// and read them directly; the row itself only knows how to change, describe and persist its value.
/// </summary>
internal abstract class Feature
{
    public string Id = "";
    public string Label = "";
    public string Help = "";
    public string Section = "cheats";
    public string Key = "";

    /// <summary>A preference, not a cheat: it never counts as running and isn't switched on by a load.</summary>
    public bool IsPref;

    /// <summary>A menu setting, which applies at once even outside a game.</summary>
    public bool IsSetting;

    /// <summary>Changes the save file. Always confirmed, can't be bound to a key.</summary>
    public bool ChangesSave;

    public bool NeedsConfirm;

    /// <summary>Never written to or read from settings.toml: a row that describes something live, like the editor's selection.</summary>
    public bool NotSaved;

    /// <summary>Replaces the generic confirmation question.</summary>
    public Func<string>? ConfirmPrompt;

    /// <summary>Re-applied every 0.25 s, and at once on a new pawn.</summary>
    public Action? MaintainStep;

    /// <summary>Re-applied every tick.</summary>
    public Action? TickStep;

    public abstract bool IsDefault { get; }

    public abstract string State { get; }

    public virtual bool Bindable => !ChangesSave;

    public bool Active => !IsPref && !IsSetting && !IsDefault;

    public abstract void Apply();

    public abstract void ResetValue();

    /// <summary>Moves the value one step; returns false when it can't move.</summary>
    public abstract bool Step(int dir);

    /// <summary>What a hotkey does: flips, cycles or jumps to the preset value.</summary>
    public abstract void Hotkey();

    public abstract void Read(TomlTable table);

    /// <summary>The TOML literal for this value, or null if it isn't saved.</summary>
    public abstract string? Toml { get; }
}

internal sealed class Toggle : Feature
{
    public bool On;
    public bool Default;
    public Action<bool>? Changed;

    public override bool IsDefault => On == Default;

    public override string State => On ? "ON" : "OFF";

    public override void Apply() => Changed?.Invoke(On);

    public override void ResetValue() => On = Default;

    public override bool Step(int dir)
    {
        On = !On;
        return true;
    }

    public override void Hotkey() => On = !On;

    public override void Read(TomlTable table) => On = table.TryGetValue(Key, out object? v) && v is bool b ? b : Default;

    public override string Toml => On ? "true" : "false";
}

internal sealed class Slider : Feature
{
    public float Value;
    public float Default;
    public float Min;
    public float Max;
    public float Stride;
    public float HotValue;
    public Func<float, string> Format = v => v.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    public Action<float>? Changed;

    public override bool IsDefault => MathF.Abs(Value - Default) <= 0.0001f;

    public override string State => Format(Value);

    public override void Apply() => Changed?.Invoke(Value);

    public override void ResetValue() => Value = Default;

    public override bool Step(int dir)
    {
        float next = MathF.Round(Math.Clamp(Value + dir * Stride, Min, Max) / Stride) * Stride;
        next = MathF.Round(next, 3);
        if (MathF.Abs(next - Value) < 0.0001f)
            return false;

        Value = next;
        return true;
    }

    public override void Hotkey() => Value = IsDefault ? HotValue : Default;

    public override void Read(TomlTable table)
    {
        Value = Default;
        if (table.TryGetValue(Key, out object? v))
        {
            if (v is double d)
                Value = (float)d;
            else if (v is long l)
                Value = l;
        }

        Value = Math.Clamp(Value, Min, Max);
    }

    public override string Toml => Value.ToString("0.0##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
}

internal sealed class Choice : Feature
{
    public int Index;
    public string[] Keys = Array.Empty<string>();
    public string[] Labels = Array.Empty<string>();
    public Action<int>? Changed;

    /// <summary>Raw saved key, kept for lists that fill in later (songs, skins) so the pick survives until they do.</summary>
    public string Saved = "";

    /// <summary>Optional colour chip for each option.</summary>
    public Func<int, Rgba>? Swatch;

    /// <summary>A long list: holding left or right keeps moving through it.</summary>
    public bool HoldToScroll;

    public override bool IsDefault => Index == 0;

    public override string State => Labels.Length == 0 ? "" : Labels[Math.Clamp(Index, 0, Labels.Length - 1)];

    public string CurrentKey => Keys.Length == 0 ? "" : Keys[Math.Clamp(Index, 0, Keys.Length - 1)];

    public override void Apply() => Changed?.Invoke(Index);

    public override void ResetValue()
    {
        Index = 0;
        Saved = CurrentKey;
    }

    public override bool Step(int dir)
    {
        if (Labels.Length < 2)
            return false;

        Index = (Index + dir + Labels.Length) % Labels.Length;
        Saved = CurrentKey;
        return true;
    }

    public override void Hotkey() => Step(1);

    public override void Read(TomlTable table)
    {
        Saved = table.TryGetValue(Key, out object? v) && v is string s ? s : Keys.Length == 0 ? "" : Keys[0];
        Index = Math.Max(0, Array.FindIndex(Keys, k => k.Equals(Saved, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));
    }

    /// <summary>Replaces the options, keeping the saved pick when it's still among them.</summary>
    public void SetOptions(string[] keys, string[] labels, int fallback = 0)
    {
        Keys = keys;
        Labels = labels;
        int found = Array.FindIndex(keys, k => k.Equals(Saved, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        Index = found >= 0 ? found : Math.Clamp(fallback, 0, Math.Max(0, keys.Length - 1));
    }

    public override string Toml => "\"" + (Saved.Length > 0 ? Saved : CurrentKey) + "\"";
}

internal sealed class Command : Feature
{
    public Action? Run;

    /// <summary>
    /// Moves the player somewhere. On a shared key these are alternatives: they are tried in menu order until one
    /// works, while every other command on the key runs.
    /// </summary>
    public bool MovesPlayer;

    public override bool IsDefault => true;

    public override string State => "";

    public override void Apply() { }

    public override void ResetValue() { }

    public override bool Step(int dir) => false;

    public override void Hotkey() { }

    public override void Read(TomlTable table) { }

    public override string? Toml => null;
}

internal static class FeatureSetup
{
    public static T Pref<T>(this T f) where T : Feature
    {
        f.IsPref = true;
        return f;
    }

    public static T Setting<T>(this T f) where T : Feature
    {
        f.IsSetting = true;
        f.Section = "general";
        return f;
    }

    public static T Maintain<T>(this T f, Action step) where T : Feature
    {
        f.MaintainStep = step;
        return f;
    }

    public static T EveryTick<T>(this T f, Action step) where T : Feature
    {
        f.TickStep = step;
        return f;
    }

    public static T Unsaved<T>(this T f) where T : Feature
    {
        f.NotSaved = true;
        return f;
    }

    public static T Confirmed<T>(this T f) where T : Feature
    {
        f.NeedsConfirm = true;
        return f;
    }

    public static Command Moves(this Command c)
    {
        c.MovesPlayer = true;
        return c;
    }

    public static T Stored<T>(this T f, string section, string key) where T : Feature
    {
        f.Section = section;
        f.Key = key;
        return f;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Features/Fmt.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Value formats shared by menu rows, notices and the log.</summary>
internal static class Fmt
{
    private static readonly CultureInfo Inv = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

    public static string Times(float v) => v.ToString("0.00", Inv) + "x";

    public static string Multiplier(float v) => Whole(v) + "x";

    public static string Percent(float v) => Whole(v * 100f) + "%";

    public static string Count(float v) => Whole(v);

    public static string Secs(float v) => Whole(v) + " s";

    public static string Tenths(float v) => v.ToString("0.0", Inv) + " s";

    public static string Degrees(float v) => Whole(v) + " DEG";

    public static string Metres(float v) => Whole(v) + " M";

    public static string MetresOrOff(float v) => v <= 0f ? "OFF" : Metres(v);

    public static string Signed(float v) => MathF.Abs(v) < 0.01f ? "DEFAULT" : (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + Whole(v);

    public static string Side(float v)
    {
        if (MathF.Abs(v) < 0.01f)
            return "CENTRED";

        string pct = Percent(MathF.Abs(v));
        return v < 0f ? "LEFT " + pct : "RIGHT " + pct;
    }

    /// <summary>"1 TANK", "3 TANKS".</summary>
    public static string Plural(int n, string one) => n + " " + one + (n == 1 ? "" : "S");

    /// <summary>A world position in whole units: "1200, -350, 80".</summary>
    public static string Position(Vector3 v) => string.Format(Inv, "{0:0}, {1:0}, {2:0}", v.X, v.Y, v.Z);

    private static string Whole(float v) => v.ToString("0", Inv);
}
```

```cs
            new("TRINITY EDITION", "credit_trinity"),
        }),

    /// <summary>Creates a page. A path like "WORLD/ENEMIES" makes it a sub-tab of WORLD.</summary>
    private static MenuPage Place(string path)
    {
        int slash = path.IndexOf('/');
        if (slash < 0)
        {
            var top = new MenuPage { Title = path };
            Catalog.Pages.Add(top);
            return top;
        }

        string parentTitle = path.Substring(0, slash);
        MenuPage? parent = Catalog.Pages.Find(p => p.Title == parentTitle);
        if (parent == null)
        {
            parent = new MenuPage { Title = parentTitle };
            Catalog.Pages.Add(parent);
        }

        var child = new MenuPage { Title = path.Substring(slash + 1) };
        parent.Children.Add(child);
        return child;
    }

    /// <summary>Builds the menu pages from the registered features.</summary>
    public static void Apply()
    {
        Catalog.Pages.Clear();
        var placed = new HashSet<Feature>();
        foreach ((string title, Section[] sections) in Map)
        {
            MenuPage page = Place(title);
            foreach (Section section in sections)
            {
                page.Rows.Add(new MenuRow { Header = section.Group });

                foreach (string entry in section.Ids)
                {
                    // "+id" shows a row already placed on an earlier page here too, for a setting two pages share.
                    bool again = entry.StartsWith('+');
                    string id = again ? entry.Substring(1) : entry;
                    if (Catalog.ById.TryGetValue(id, out Feature? f) && (again ? placed.Contains(f) : placed.Add(f)))
                        page.Rows.Add(new MenuRow { Item = f });
                    else
                        Log.Info("Menu layout: " + id + (again ? " isn't placed on an earlier page." : " is unknown or listed twice."));
                }
            }
        }

        List<Feature> unplaced = Catalog.All.FindAll(f => !placed.Contains(f));
        if (unplaced.Count == 0)
            return;

        var other = new MenuPage { Title = "OTHER" };
        foreach (Feature f in unplaced)
            other.Rows.Add(new MenuRow { Item = f });
        Catalog.Pages.Add(other);
        Log.Info("Menu layout: " + unplaced.Count + " features aren't listed, showing them under OTHER.");
    }
}
```

`scripts/Features/Settings.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// settings.toml: everything the player chooses. mod.toml stays a read-only manifest, so an update can replace
/// it without touching anyone's settings. Writes are debounced and atomic; hand edits apply while playing.
/// </summary>
internal static class Settings
{
    private const string FileName = "settings.toml";
    private const float SaveDelay = 0.75f;
    private const double PollSeconds = 1.0;
    private static readonly string[] OwnSections = { "general", "hotkeys", "gamepad", "cheats" };

    public static Keys MenuKey = Keys.F3;
    public static bool Remember = true;
    public static float ApplyDelay = 4f;
    public static string PadOpenButton = "back";

    /// <summary>Hotkeys by feature id. Menu rebinding and hand edits share this one source.</summary>
    public static readonly Dictionary<string, Keys> Hotkeys = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private static readonly Dictionary<Keys, List<Feature>> _byKey = new();
    private static DateTime _stamp = DateTime.MinValue;
    private static bool _dirty;
    private static float _saveLeft;
    private static Every _poll;
    private static string _lastError = "";

    private static string SettingsPath => Path.Combine(App.Dir, FileName);

    private static string ManifestPath => Path.Combine(App.Dir, "mod.toml");

    /// <summary>Every feature on a key, in menu order. A key can be shared, so one press can do several things.</summary>
    public static bool TryKey(Keys key, out IReadOnlyList<Feature> features)
    {
        bool found = _byKey.TryGetValue(key, out List<Feature>? list);
        features = list ?? (IReadOnlyList<Feature>)Array.Empty<Feature>();
        return found;
    }

    public static IEnumerable<Keys> BoundKeys => _byKey.Keys;

    public static string KeyFor(Feature f) => Hotkeys.TryGetValue(f.Id, out Keys k) ? k.ToString().ToUpperInvariant() : "";

    /// <summary>The other features already on a key, by label.</summary>
    public static IEnumerable<string> SharingKey(Feature f, Keys key) =>
        _byKey.TryGetValue(key, out List<Feature>? list) ? list.Where(o => o != f).Select(o => o.Label) : Enumerable.Empty<string>();

    /// <summary>Puts a feature on a key. Whatever is already on that key keeps it, so they share it.</summary>
    public static void Bind(Feature f, Keys key)
    {
        Hotkeys[f.Id] = key;
        RebuildKeys();
        MarkDirty();
    }

    public static void Unbind(Feature f)
    {
        if (Hotkeys.Remove(f.Id))
        {
            RebuildKeys();
            MarkDirty();
        }
    }

    public static void MarkDirty()
    {
        _dirty = true;
        _saveLeft = SaveDelay;
    }

    public static void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (_dirty)
        {
            _saveLeft -= dt;
            if (_saveLeft <= 0f)
                Flush();
            return;
        }

        if (_poll.Elapsed(PollSeconds))
            Load(first: false);
    }

    public static void Flush()
    {
        if (!_dirty)
            return;

        _dirty = false;
        try
        {
            string temp = SettingsPath + ".tmp";
            File.WriteAllText(temp, Compose());
            File.Move(temp, SettingsPath, overwrite: true);
            _stamp = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(SettingsPath);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Could not save " + FileName + ": " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    public static void Load(bool first)
    {
        string path = SettingsPath;
        bool migrate = first && !File.Exists(path);
        string source = migrate ? ManifestPath : path;
        if (!File.Exists(source))
            return;

        DateTime stamp = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source);
        if (!first && stamp == _stamp)
            return;

        TomlTable root;
        try
        {
            root = Tomlyn.TomlSerializer.Deserialize<TomlTable>(File.ReadAllText(source))!;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            if (ex.Message != _lastError)
            {
                _lastError = ex.Message;
                Log.Info(FileName + " could not be read, keeping the current settings: " + ex.Message);
            }

            return;
        }

        _lastError = "";
        _stamp = stamp;
        Take(root, first);

        if (migrate)
            MigrateFromManifest(root);
        else if (!first)
            Log.Info("Settings reloaded from " + FileName + ".");
    }

    private static void Take(TomlTable root, bool first)
    {
        TomlTable general = Section(root, "general");
        MenuKey = System.Enum.TryParse(Text(general, "menu_key", "F3"), true, out Keys menuKey) ? menuKey : Keys.F3;
        Log.Diagnostics = general.TryGetValue("diagnostics", out object? diag) && diag is bool on && on;
        PadOpenButton = Text(Section(root, "gamepad"), "open_button", "back");
        Remember = !general.TryGetValue("remember_cheats", out object? keep) || keep is not bool remember || remember;

        // The favourites radial replaced the PINNED page: a settings file from before it starts the radial with the pins.
        if (general.TryGetValue("radial", out object? radial) && radial is TomlArray slots)
            Favourites.Load(slots);
        else if (general.TryGetValue("pinned", out object? pins) && pins is TomlArray pinned)
        {
            Favourites.FromPins(pinned.OfType<string>());
            if (Favourites.Count > 0)
            {
                Log.Info("Moved " + Favourites.Count + " pinned rows onto the favourites radial.");
                MarkDirty();
            }
        }
        else
            Favourites.Load(null);

        foreach (Feature f in Catalog.All)
        {
            if (f is Command || f.NotSaved)
                continue;

            bool wasActive = f.Active;
            string before = f.State;

            // With remembering off, a fresh start ignores saved cheats. Menu settings always load.
            if (first && !Remember && !f.IsSetting)
                f.ResetValue();
            else
                f.Read(Section(root, f.Section));

            if (first)
            {
                if (f.IsSetting)
                    f.Apply();
            }
            else if (f.State != before && (wasActive || f.Active || f.IsSetting))
                Catalog.ApplyExternal(f);
        }

        Hotkeys.Clear();
        foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> kv in Section(root, "hotkeys"))
        {
            if (kv.Value is not string name || name.Length == 0 || !Catalog.ById.ContainsKey(kv.Key) || !System.Enum.TryParse(name, true, out Keys key))
                continue;

            if (Menu.IsReserved(key))
                Log.Info("Hotkey " + kv.Key + " ignored: the menu uses " + key + ".");
            else
                Hotkeys[kv.Key] = key;
        }

        RebuildKeys();
    }

    /// <summary>Oracle 2.x kept settings inside mod.toml. Moves them out, once, and leaves a clean manifest.</summary>
    private static void MigrateFromManifest(TomlTable root)
    {
        _dirty = true;
        Flush();
        if (!root.ContainsKey("cheats"))
            return;

        try
        {
            var kept = new List<string>();
            foreach (string line in File.ReadAllLines(ManifestPath))
            {
                if (Array.Exists(OwnSections, s => line.Trim() == "[" + s + "]"))
                    break;
                kept.Add(line);
            }

            while (kept.Count > 0 && kept[^1].Trim().Length == 0)
                kept.RemoveAt(kept.Count - 1);

            File.WriteAllLines(ManifestPath, kept);
            Log.Info("Moved your settings from mod.toml to " + FileName + ".");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Settings copied to " + FileName + ", but mod.toml could not be tidied: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private static void RebuildKeys()
    {
        _byKey.Clear();
        foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Keys> kv in Hotkeys)
        {
            if (!Catalog.ById.TryGetValue(kv.Key, out Feature? f))
                continue;
            if (!_byKey.TryGetValue(kv.Value, out List<Feature>? list))
                _byKey[kv.Value] = list = new List<Feature>();
            list.Add(f);
        }

        // Menu order decides which shared command is tried first.
        foreach (List<Feature> list in _byKey.Values)
            list.Sort((a, b) => Catalog.All.IndexOf(a).CompareTo(Catalog.All.IndexOf(b)));
    }

    private static string Compose()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine("# Oracle settings. The menu keeps this file up to date, and edits made here apply while you play.");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("[general]");
        sb.AppendLine("# key that opens and closes the menu");
        sb.AppendLine("menu_key = \"" + MenuKey + "\"");
        sb.AppendLine("# true = writes every console command to Oracle.log, for bug reports");
        sb.AppendLine("diagnostics = " + (Log.Diagnostics ? "true" : "false"));
        sb.AppendLine("# the favourites radial, slot by slot and page by page; \"\" is an empty slot. Easiest to arrange in the menu:");
        sb.AppendLine("# HOME on any row, or SYSTEM > RADIAL > ARRANGE RADIAL.");
        sb.AppendLine("radial = " + Favourites.Toml());
        WriteValues(sb, "general");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("[gamepad]");
        sb.AppendLine("# hold this to open the menu: back, start, a, b, x, y, lb, rb, ls, rs, up, down, left, right. Combine with +, like \"lb+rb\"");
        sb.AppendLine("open_button = \"" + PadOpenButton + "\"");
        WriteValues(sb, "gamepad");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("[hotkeys]");
        sb.AppendLine("# feature_id = \"KeyName\". Toggles flip, sliders jump to a preset, choices cycle, commands run.");
        sb.AppendLine("# Easiest way to bind: press INSERT on a row in the menu.");
        foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Keys> kv in Hotkeys.OrderBy(k => k.Key, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            sb.AppendLine(kv.Key + " = \"" + kv.Value + "\"");
        sb.AppendLine();
        sb.AppendLine("[cheats]");
        sb.AppendLine("# true/false for switches, numbers for sliders, names for choices.");
        WriteValues(sb, "cheats");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static void WriteValues(StringBuilder sb, string section)
    {
        foreach (Feature f in Catalog.All)
        {
            if (f.Section == section && !f.NotSaved && f.Toml is { } value)
                sb.AppendLine(f.Key + " = " + value);
        }
    }

    private static string Text(TomlTable table, string key, string fallback) =>
        table.TryGetValue(key, out object? value) && value is string text ? text : fallback;

    private static TomlTable Section(TomlTable root, string name) =>
        root.TryGetValue(name, out object? raw) && raw is TomlTable table ? table : new TomlTable();
}
```

```cs
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The game ships its developers' key bindings (BmInput.ini): B spawns the Batmobile, H speeds the game up, T
/// teleports, K kills every enemy (story ones too), U unlocks every upgrade in the save, F5 reloads the level, CTRL+S
/// saves, ALT+L loads, BACKSPACE starts the debug camera. They call the game's cheat manager, which a normal game
/// doesn't have, so normally they do nothing. Oracle needs that cheat manager, so with Oracle loaded each of them
/// works on any key the player's own controls leave free. This switches off every binding whose commands are all
/// developer commands, and leaves bindings that also carry a real action (the pad's A, for one) alone.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class DebugKeys : Module
{

        "viewself", "walk", "warningmessagetest", "weaponconfigwtf",

    private Toggle _allow = null!;
    private Every _scan;
    private bool _reported;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _allow = AddToggle("game_debug_keys", "GAME DEBUG KEYS",
            "The game ships its developers' keys: B spawns the Batmobile, H speeds the game up, T teleports, K kills every enemy, U unlocks every upgrade, F5 reloads the level, and more. They only work because Oracle needs the game's cheat manager, so Oracle keeps them switched off. Turn this on to let them through.",
            _ => Scan()).Setting();
    }

    public static bool IsDebugCommand(string command) =>
        Commands.Contains(command) || command.StartsWith("debug", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    /// <summary>Runs from the render hook, so the keys stay off even while the game stops ticking mods.</summary>
    public override void Frame()
    {
        // The game rebuilds its bindings when the controls change, so the table is checked again every so often.
        if (_scan.Elapsed(ScanSeconds))
            Scan();
    }

    private void Scan()
    {
        PlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (_allow.On)
        {
            // Not while the menu or radial has the keys muted: H typed into the search would speed the game up.
            if (!GameKeys.IsMuted)
                GameKeys.UnblockDebug(pc);
            return;
        }

        if (pc == null)
            return;

        int blocked = GameKeys.BlockDebug(pc, IsDebugCommand);
        if (blocked > 0 && !_reported)
        {
            _reported = true;
            Log.Info("Game debug keys: switched off " + blocked + " developer bindings.");
        }
    }

    public override void Shutdown() => Safe.Run("debug keys", () => GameKeys.UnblockDebug(World.Pc));
}
```
