`scripts/Input/GameKeys.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.Engine;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Keeps the game from acting on the keys the open menu uses (letters for search, ENTER, the arrows and so on).
/// The game ignores IgnoreButtonInput, so this renames those keys in the player's binding table while the menu is
/// open and puts back exactly what it renamed when it closes. Only the 8-byte key name of each binding is touched,
/// never its command string, so no game-owned memory changes hands.
/// </summary>
internal static unsafe class GameKeys
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Bytes per binding to try, smallest first. Each starts with the FName (8) and the command FString (16). In
    /// game it measured 28 (packed, matching BmSDK's FKeyBind), but the size is still confirmed at run time rather
    /// than trusted: the first size at which every entry reads as a binding and enough names are key names.
    /// Smallest first keeps every read inside the array.
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly int[] Strides = { 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48, 52, 56, 64, 72, 80 };

    private const int MaxBindings = 4096;
    private const int MaxCommand = 4096;
    private const int MinKeyHits = 8;

    /// <summary>The game's names for the keys the menu uses. Escape stays live so the pause menu still opens.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] KeyNames = BuildNames();

    /// <summary>
    /// What the radial mutes on top of the menu's keys: the mouse axes, so pointing doesn't turn the camera, and the
    /// buttons, so clicking a slot doesn't throw a punch.
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly string[] PointerNames =
    {
        "MouseX", "MouseY", "LeftMouseButton", "RightMouseButton", "MiddleMouseButton", "ThumbMouseButton", "ThumbMouseButton2", "MouseScrollUp", "MouseScrollDown",
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// What editor mode mutes on top of the menu's keys: the mouse buttons and modifier keys it uses, but not the
    /// mouse axes, so the mouse still turns the camera while clicks select and grab.
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly string[] EditorNames =
    {
        "LeftMouseButton", "RightMouseButton", "MiddleMouseButton", "ThumbMouseButton", "ThumbMouseButton2", "MouseScrollUp", "MouseScrollDown",
        "LeftShift", "RightShift", "LeftControl", "RightControl", "LeftAlt", "RightAlt",
    };

    private static readonly List<(int Slot, int Index, int Number)> _muted = new();
    private static HashSet<int>? _keys;
    private static HashSet<int>? _pointerKeys;
    private static HashSet<int>? _editorKeys;
    private static int _mark = -1;
    private static readonly List<(int Slot, int Index, int Number, string Command)> _blocked = new();
    private static nint _blockedInput;
    private static int _blockMark = -1;
    private static int _stride;
    private static nint _input;
    private static bool _warned;
    private static bool _reported;

    private static HashSet<int> Keys => _keys ??= KeyNames.Select(n => new FName(n).Index).ToHashSet();

    private static HashSet<int> PointerKeys => _pointerKeys ??= KeyNames.Concat(PointerNames).Select(n => new FName(n).Index).ToHashSet();

    private static HashSet<int> EditorKeys => _editorKeys ??= KeyNames.Concat(EditorNames).Select(n => new FName(n).Index).ToHashSet();

    /// <summary>True while some game keys are renamed away. Whoever muted last owns them; the menu closing unmutes all.</summary>
    public static bool IsMuted => _muted.Count > 0;

    /// <summary>
    /// Mutes the menu's keys, with <paramref name="pointer"/> the mouse as well, with <paramref name="editor"/> the
    /// mouse buttons and modifiers but not the mouse axes (editor mode), and with <paramref name="escape"/>
    /// ESCAPE too, for the radial, where ESC closes it rather than pausing the game.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Mute(PlayerController pc, bool pointer = false, bool escape = false, bool editor = false)
    {
        Unmute(pc);
        PlayerInput? input = pc.PlayerInput;
        if (input == null)
            return;

        if (!Read(input.Bindings.Ptr, out byte* data, out int count))
            return;

        if (_mark < 0)
            _mark = new FName("OracleMenuMuted").Index;

        HashSet<int> keys = pointer ? PointerKeys : editor ? EditorKeys : Keys;
        if (escape)
            keys = new HashSet<int>(keys) { new FName("Escape").Index };
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            int* name = (int*)(data + i * _stride);
            if (name[1] != 0 || !keys.Contains(name[0]))
                continue;

            _muted.Add((i, name[0], name[1]));
            name[0] = _mark;
        }

        _input = input.Ptr;
        if (!_reported)
        {
            _reported = true;
            Log.Info("Menu keys: " + count + " game bindings at " + _stride + " bytes each, " + _muted.Count + " switched off while the menu is open.");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Puts the renamed keys back, only on the same live input object and only where a binding still carries the
    /// mark. If the game re-bound a key meanwhile, its new binding wins and the old one stays muted.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Unmute(PlayerController? pc)
    {
        if (_muted.Count == 0)
            return;

        try
        {
            if (pc?.PlayerInput is not { } input || input.Ptr != _input || !Read(input.Bindings.Ptr, out byte* data, out int count))
                return;

            var live = new HashSet<int>();
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                live.Add(((int*)(data + i * _stride))[0]);

            foreach ((int slot, int index, int number) in _muted)
            {
                if (slot >= count)
                    continue;

                int* name = (int*)(data + slot * _stride);
                if (name[0] == _mark && name[1] == 0 && !live.Contains(index))
                {
                    name[0] = index;
                    name[1] = number;
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _muted.Clear();
            _input = 0;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Renames, until <see cref="UnblockDebug"/>, every binding whose commands all pass <paramref name="isDebug"/>
    /// (see <see cref="DebugKeys"/>). It uses its own mark, so the menu's muting never touches these. Safe to call
    /// again: bindings already switched off are skipped. Returns how many were switched off by this call.
    /// </summary>
    public static int BlockDebug(PlayerController pc, Func<string, bool> isDebug)
    {
        if (pc.PlayerInput is not { } input || !Read(input.Bindings.Ptr, out byte* data, out int count))
            return 0;

        if (_blockMark < 0)
            _blockMark = new FName("OracleDebugKeyOff").Index;
        if (_mark < 0)
            _mark = new FName("OracleMenuMuted").Index;
        if (input.Ptr != _blockedInput)
        {
            _blocked.Clear();
            _blockedInput = input.Ptr;
        }

        int added = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            byte* e = data + i * _stride;
            int* name = (int*)e;
            if (name[0] == _blockMark || Command(e) is not { } command || !AllDebug(command, isDebug))
                continue;

            int index = name[0], number = name[1];
            if (index == _mark)
            {
                // The open menu has this one muted. Take it over, or the menu gives it back when it closes.
                int held = input.Ptr == _input ? _muted.FindIndex(m => m.Slot == i) : -1;
                if (held < 0)
                    continue;

                (index, number) = (_muted[held].Index, _muted[held].Number);
                _muted.RemoveAt(held);
            }

            _blocked.Add((i, index, number, command));
            name[0] = _blockMark;
            name[1] = 0;
            added++;
        }

        return added;
    }

    /// <summary>Puts back what <see cref="BlockDebug"/> switched off, where a binding still carries its mark and command.</summary>
    public static void UnblockDebug(PlayerController? pc)
    {
        if (_blocked.Count == 0)
            return;

        try
        {
            if (pc?.PlayerInput is not { } input || input.Ptr != _blockedInput || !Read(input.Bindings.Ptr, out byte* data, out int count))
                return;

            foreach ((int slot, int index, int number, string command) in _blocked)
            {
                if (slot >= count)
                    continue;

                byte* e = data + slot * _stride;
                int* name = (int*)e;
                if (name[0] == _blockMark && Command(e) == command)
                {
                    name[0] = index;
                    name[1] = number;
                }
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _blocked.Clear();
            _blockedInput = 0;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A binding's command string, or null when it has none.</summary>
    private static string? Command(byte* entry)
    {
        char* text = *(char**)(entry + 8);
        int len = *(int*)(entry + 16);
        return text == null || len <= 1 ? null : new string(text, 0, len - 1);
    }

    /// <summary>True when every command in "A | OnRelease B | C x" passes the check.</summary>
    private static bool AllDebug(string command, Func<string, bool> isDebug)
    {
        int seen = 0;
        foreach (string raw in command.Split('|'))
        {
            string part = raw.Trim();
            if (part.StartsWith("OnRelease ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                part = part[10..].TrimStart();
            if (part.Length == 0)
                continue;

            int space = part.IndexOf(' ');
            if (!isDebug(space < 0 ? part : part[..space]))
                return false;
            seen++;
        }

        return seen > 0;
    }

    /// <summary>Reads the array header and checks every entry looks like a key binding before anything is written.</summary>
    private static bool Read(nint array, out byte* data, out int count)
    {
        data = null;
        count = 0;
        if (array == 0)
            return Fail("no binding array");

        byte* items = *(byte**)array;
        int n = *(int*)(array + 8);
        int max = *(int*)(array + 12);
        if (items == null || n <= 0 || n > max || n > MaxBindings)
            return Fail("array header " + n + "/" + max);

        if (_stride == 0)
        {
            foreach (int s in Strides)
            {
                if (Valid(items, n, s) && KeyHits(items, n, s) >= MinKeyHits)
                {
                    _stride = s;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (_stride == 0)
                return Fail(n + " entries, no entry size fits");
        }
        else if (!Valid(items, n, _stride))
            return Fail("entries changed shape at " + _stride + " bytes");

        data = items;
        count = n;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Every entry has a sane name and a well-formed command string at this size. Stops at the first bad one.</summary>
    private static bool Valid(byte* items, int n, int stride)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            byte* e = items + i * stride;
            int index = *(int*)e;
            int number = *(int*)(e + 4);
            nint text = *(nint*)(e + 8);
            int len = *(int*)(e + 16);
            int cap = *(int*)(e + 20);
            if (index <= 0 || number < 0 || number > 0xFFFF || len < 0 || len > cap || cap > MaxCommand || (cap > 0) != (text != 0))
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static int KeyHits(byte* items, int n, int stride)
    {
        HashSet<int> keys = Keys;
        int hits = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (keys.Contains(*(int*)(items + i * stride)))
                hits++;
        }

        return hits;
    }

    private static bool Fail(string why)
    {
        if (!_warned)
        {
            _warned = true;
            Log.Info("Couldn't read the game's key bindings (" + why + "), so game keys stay live while the menu is open.");
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static string[] BuildNames()
    {
        var names = new List<string>
        {
            "Enter", "SpaceBar", "BackSpace", "Tab", "Home", "Delete", "Insert", "PageUp", "PageDown", "Up", "Down", "Left", "Right",
            "zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine",
            "NumPadZero", "NumPadOne", "NumPadTwo", "NumPadThree", "NumPadFour", "NumPadFive", "NumPadSix", "NumPadSeven", "NumPadEight", "NumPadNine",
        };
        for (char c = 'A'; c <= 'Z'; c++)
            names.Add(c.ToString());
        return names.ToArray();
    }
}
```

`scripts/Input/KeyInput.cs`:

```cs
using Stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Routes a key press: the game's own use first, then the radial, the menu, then hotkeys.</summary>
internal static class KeyInput
{
    public static void Pressed(Keys key)
    {
        Pad.KeyboardUsed();
        if (Menu.Binding == null && Characters.I.EntryKey(key))
            return;

        // The open radial takes every key, so a number picks a slot instead of running a hotkey. The menu key
        // swaps the radial for the menu.
        if (Radial.IsLive)
        {
            if (key == Settings.MenuKey)
            {
                Radial.Close();
                Menu.Open();
            }
            else
                Radial.Press(key);
            return;
        }

        if (key == Settings.MenuKey && Menu.Binding == null)
        {
            Menu.Toggle();
            return;
        }

        if (Menu.IsOpen)
        {
            Menu.Press(key, false);
            return;
        }

        // A hotkey saved on a key that later became the radial key gives way to the radial.
        if (key == Radial.Key && Radial.Enabled)
            return;

        if (Settings.TryKey(key, out IReadOnlyList<Feature> features) && !WorldEditor.I.Claims(key, features) && !FreeCam.I.Claims(key, features))
            Catalog.Hotkey(features);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// In some states the game stops ticking mods but keeps rendering. When ticks go quiet this reads the keyboard
/// directly and drives the update from the render hook, so the menu and hotkeys never go dead.
/// </summary>
internal static class Fallback
{
    private const double QuietSeconds = 0.5;

    private static readonly bool[] _down = new bool[256];
    private static readonly List<Keys> _watch = new();

    private static long _lastSdkTick = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
    private static bool _logged;

    public static bool Active => Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(_lastSdkTick).TotalSeconds > QuietSeconds;

    public static void NoteSdkTick() => _lastSdkTick = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();

    public static void Frame()
    {
        if (!Active || World.Paused)
            return;

        if (!_logged)
        {
            _logged = true;
            Log.Info("The game stopped ticking mods here, Oracle now reads the keyboard itself.");
        }

        _watch.Clear();
        _watch.Add(Settings.MenuKey);
        _watch.AddRange(Menu.ControlKeys);
        if (Menu.IsOpen)
            _watch.AddRange(Menu.TypingKeys);
        if (Radial.IsLive)
            _watch.AddRange(Radial.WatchKeys);
        _watch.AddRange(Settings.BoundKeys);
        if (Characters.I.PlayingOther)
            _watch.Add(Keys.E);

        bool front = Native.GameInFront();
        foreach (Keys k in _watch)
        {
            int vk = (int)k & 0xFF;
            bool down = front && (Native.GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) != 0;
            if (down && !_down[vk])
                KeyInput.Pressed(k);
            _down[vk] = down;
        }

        App.Tick();
    }
}
```

`scripts/Input/Native.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal static class Native
{
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct Point
    {
        public int X;
        public int Y;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct Bounds
    {
        public int Left;
        public int Top;
        public int Right;
        public int Bottom;
    }

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    public static extern short GetAsyncKeyState(int vKey);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern nint GetForegroundWindow();

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(nint hWnd, out uint processId);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern bool GetCursorPos(out Point point);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern bool SetCursorPos(int x, int y);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern bool GetClientRect(nint hWnd, out Bounds rect);

    [DllImport("user32.dll")]
    private static extern bool ClientToScreen(nint hWnd, ref Point point);

    public static bool GameInFront()
    {
        GetWindowThreadProcessId(GetForegroundWindow(), out uint pid);
        return pid == (uint)Environment.ProcessId;
    }

    /// <summary>Whether a key or mouse button is held right now. Mouse buttons work too: they have key codes of their own.</summary>
    public static bool Down(Keys key) => (GetAsyncKeyState((int)key & 0xFF) & 0x8000) != 0;

    /// <summary>The centre of the game window's drawing area in screen pixels, when the game is the window in front.</summary>
    public static bool GameCentre(out int x, out int y)
    {
        x = 0;
        y = 0;
        nint window = GetForegroundWindow();
        GetWindowThreadProcessId(window, out uint pid);
        if (pid != (uint)Environment.ProcessId || !GetClientRect(window, out Bounds r))
            return false;

        var centre = new Point { X = (r.Right - r.Left) / 2, Y = (r.Bottom - r.Top) / 2 };
        if (!ClientToScreen(window, ref centre))
            return false;

        x = centre.X;
        y = centre.Y;
        return true;
    }

    public static bool CursorAt(out int x, out int y)
    {
        bool ok = GetCursorPos(out Point p);
        x = p.X;
        y = p.Y;
        return ok;
    }

    public static void MoveCursor(int x, int y) => SetCursorPos(x, y);
}
```

`scripts/Input/Pad.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using Stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// XInput controller support. The game keeps reading the same pad, so its bindings are parked while the menu or
/// radial is open. A single-button RADIAL BUTTON (R3 or L3) is Oracle's for good: its game binding stays parked.
/// </summary>
internal static class Pad
{
    private const ushort Up = 0x0001;
    private const ushort Down = 0x0002;
    private const ushort Left = 0x0004;
    private const ushort Right = 0x0008;
    private const ushort Start = 0x0010;
    private const ushort Back = 0x0020;
    private const ushort LS = 0x0040;
    private const ushort RS = 0x0080;
    private const ushort LB = 0x0100;
    private const ushort RB = 0x0200;
    private const ushort A = 0x1000;
    private const ushort B = 0x2000;
    private const ushort X = 0x4000;
    private const ushort Y = 0x8000;

    private const short StickPush = 16000;
    private const short StickNoise = 9000;
    private const byte TriggerNoise = 40;
    private const double ScanSeconds = 2.0;
    private const int RescanFrames = 30;

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, ushort> Names = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        ["a"] = A, ["b"] = B, ["x"] = X, ["y"] = Y,
        ["lb"] = LB, ["rb"] = RB, ["ls"] = LS, ["rs"] = RS, ["l3"] = LS, ["r3"] = RS,
        ["back"] = Back, ["view"] = Back, ["select"] = Back, ["start"] = Start, ["menu"] = Start,
        ["up"] = Up, ["down"] = Down, ["left"] = Left, ["right"] = Right,
    };

    private static readonly ushort[] Dirs = { Up, Down, Left, Right };
    private static readonly Keys[] DirKeys = { Keys.Up, Keys.Down, Keys.Left, Keys.Right };

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct XInputGamepad
    {
        public ushort Buttons;
        public byte LeftTrigger;
        public byte RightTrigger;
        public short ThumbLX;
        public short ThumbLY;
        public short ThumbRX;
        public short ThumbRY;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct XInputState
    {
        public uint PacketNumber;
        public XInputGamepad Gamepad;
    }

    [DllImport("xinput1_4.dll", EntryPoint = "XInputGetState")]
    private static extern int XInputGetState14(int userIndex, out XInputState state);

    [DllImport("xinput9_1_0.dll", EntryPoint = "XInputGetState")]
    private static extern int XInputGetState910(int userIndex, out XInputState state);

    public static bool Enabled = true;
    public static float OpenHold = 0.5f;

    private static string _openText = "";
    private static ushort _openMask = Back;
    private static string _radialText = "";
    private static ushort _radialMask;
    private static string? _ownedBind;
    private static string? _parkedOwned;
    private static nint _ownedInput;
    private static int _ownedFrames;

    private static bool _legacy;
    private static bool _missing;
    private static int _index = -1;
    private static double _nextScan;
    private static uint _packet;
    private static ushort _now;
    private static ushort _prev;

    /// <summary>The buttons alone, without the left stick standing in for the D-pad.</summary>
    private static ushort _raw;
    private static ushort _rawPrev;
    private static short _lx;
    private static short _ly;
    private static short _rx;
    private static short _ry;
    private static FrameTimer _frame;
    private static long _padUsedAt;
    private static long _keyUsedAt;

    private static float _held = -1f;
    private static bool _waitRelease;
    private static bool _mapDeferred;
    private static bool _replayMap;
    private static bool _replaying;
    private static bool _enterCar;
    private static readonly float[] _repeat = { -1f, -1f, -1f, -1f };

    private static nint _blockedInput;
    private static nint _repairedInput;
    private static int _blockFrames;
    private static bool _restorePending;

    private static bool Connected => _index >= 0;

    /// <summary>True when the controller was touched more recently than the keyboard, for on-screen button hints.</summary>
    public static bool InUse => Connected && _padUsedAt > _keyUsedAt;

    public static void KeyboardUsed() => _keyUsedAt = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();

    private static bool Held(ushort mask) => mask != 0 && (_now & mask) == mask;

    private static bool Pressed(ushort mask) => mask != 0 && (_now & mask) == mask && (_prev & mask) != mask;

    private static bool RawHeld(ushort mask) => mask != 0 && (_raw & mask) == mask;

    private static bool RawPressed(ushort mask) => mask != 0 && (_raw & mask) == mask && (_rawPrev & mask) != mask;

    /// <summary>
    /// RADIAL BUTTON: "rs", "ls", "lb+rb" or "off". A single stick click becomes Oracle's, so its game binding is
    /// kept parked (see <see cref="SyncOwned"/>). It can't share the menu's open button.
    /// </summary>
    private static void ReadRadialButton()
    {
        string text = Radial.Enabled ? Radial.PadButton : "off";
        if (_radialText == text)
            return;

        _radialText = text;
        ushort mask = 0;
        if (!text.Equals("off", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            foreach (string part in text.Split('+', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries))
                mask |= Names.TryGetValue(part, out ushort bit) ? bit : (ushort)0;
        }

        if (mask != 0 && (mask & _openMask) != 0)
        {
            Log.Info("[gamepad] the radial button shares a button with the menu's open button, so the radial is keyboard only.");
            mask = 0;
        }

        _radialMask = mask;
        _ownedBind = mask == RS ? "XboxTypeS_RightThumbstick" : mask == LS ? "XboxTypeS_LeftThumbstick" : null;
        _ownedFrames = RescanFrames;
    }

    private static void ReadOpenButton()
    {
        if (_openText == Settings.PadOpenButton)
            return;

        _openText = Settings.PadOpenButton;
        ushort mask = 0;
        foreach (string part in _openText.Split('+', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries))
        {
            if (!Names.TryGetValue(part, out ushort bit))
            {
                mask = 0;
                break;
            }

            mask |= bit;
        }

        if (mask == 0)
            Log.Info("[gamepad] open_button \"" + _openText + "\" is not a button name, using back.");
        _openMask = mask == 0 ? Back : mask;
    }

    private static bool Read(int index, out XInputState state)
    {
        state = default;
        if (_missing)
            return false;

        try
        {
            return (_legacy ? XInputGetState910(index, out state) : XInputGetState14(index, out state)) == 0;
        }
        catch (DllNotFoundException) when (!_legacy)
        {
            _legacy = true;
            Log.Info("Pad: xinput1_4.dll not found, using xinput9_1_0.dll.");
            return Read(index, out state);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _missing = true;
            Log.Info("Pad: XInput is not available, controller support is off: " + ex.Message);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static void Poll()
    {
        _prev = _now;
        _rawPrev = _raw;
        if (_index >= 0)
        {
            if (Read(_index, out XInputState state))
            {
                Take(state);
                return;
            }

            Log.Info("Pad: controller " + _index + " disconnected.");
            _index = -1;
            _now = 0;
            _raw = 0;
            _nextScan = 0.0;
        }

        // Probing an empty XInput slot can stall for milliseconds, so scan rarely.
        double time = Clock.Now;
        if (time < _nextScan)
            return;

        _nextScan = time + ScanSeconds;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            if (!Read(i, out XInputState state))
                continue;

            _index = i;
            _packet = state.PacketNumber;
            _now = state.Gamepad.Buttons;
            _prev = _now;
            _raw = _now;
            _rawPrev = _raw;
            Log.Info("Pad: controller " + i + " connected.");
            return;
        }
    }

    private static void Take(XInputState state)
    {
        XInputGamepad g = state.Gamepad;
        ushort b = g.Buttons;
        _raw = b;
        _lx = g.ThumbLX;
        _ly = g.ThumbLY;
        _rx = g.ThumbRX;
        _ry = g.ThumbRY;
        if (g.ThumbLY > StickPush)
            b |= Up;
        else if (g.ThumbLY < -StickPush)
            b |= Down;
        if (g.ThumbLX < -StickPush)
            b |= Left;
        else if (g.ThumbLX > StickPush)
            b |= Right;
        _now = b;

        if (state.PacketNumber == _packet)
            return;

        _packet = state.PacketNumber;
        if (g.Buttons != 0 || g.LeftTrigger > TriggerNoise || g.RightTrigger > TriggerNoise ||
            Math.Abs((int)g.ThumbLX) > StickNoise || Math.Abs((int)g.ThumbLY) > StickNoise ||
            Math.Abs((int)g.ThumbRX) > StickNoise || Math.Abs((int)g.ThumbRY) > StickNoise)
            _padUsedAt = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
    }

    public static void Frame()
    {
        float dt = _frame.Step(0.1f);

        if (!Enabled)
        {
            if (_blockedInput != 0 || _restorePending)
                Unblock("controller support off");
            ReleaseOwned();
            _now = 0;
            _prev = 0;
            _raw = 0;
            _rawPrev = 0;
            return;
        }

        ReadOpenButton();
        ReadRadialButton();
        Poll();
        if (!Connected)
        {
            _held = -1f;
            _mapDeferred = false;
            if (_blockedInput != 0 || _restorePending)
                Unblock("controller disconnected");
            if (Radial.IsLive && Radial.OpenedBy == Radial.Source.Pad)
                Radial.Close();
            return;
        }

        if (Radial.IsLive)
        {
            Block();
            RadialFrame();
            return;
        }

        if (!Menu.IsOpen)
        {
            if (_restorePending && (_now & ~Start) == 0)
                Unblock("menu closed");
            RepairBindings();
            SyncOwned();
            ClosedFrame(dt);
            return;
        }

        Block();
        MenuFrame(dt);
    }

    private static void ClosedFrame(float dt)
    {
        Array.Fill(_repeat, -1f);

        if (Pressed(LB) && (_openMask & LB) == 0 && (_radialMask & LB) == 0 && Characters.I.PlayingOther && !Characters.I.Busy)
            _enterCar = true;

        if (RawPressed(_radialMask) && !_waitRelease && Radial.CanOpen())
        {
            _padUsedAt = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
            Radial.Open(Radial.Source.Pad);
            return;
        }

        if (_waitRelease)
        {
            if (!Held(_openMask))
                _waitRelease = false;
            _held = -1f;
            return;
        }

        if (!Held(_openMask))
        {
            if (_mapDeferred)
            {
                _mapDeferred = false;
                _replayMap = true;
            }

            _held = -1f;
            return;
        }

        if (_held < 0f)
        {
            if (!Pressed(_openMask) && !_mapDeferred)
                return;
            _held = 0f;
        }

        _held += dt;
        if (_held < OpenHold)
            return;

        _held = -1f;
        _waitRelease = true;
        bool deferred = _mapDeferred;
        _mapDeferred = false;

        if (World.Paused || !World.InGame || Transition.Busy)
        {
            if (deferred)
                _replayMap = true;
            return;
        }

        _padUsedAt = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
        Menu.Open();
    }

    private static void MenuFrame(float dt)
    {
        _mapDeferred = false;

        if (_waitRelease)
        {
            if (!Held(_openMask))
                _waitRelease = false;
        }
        else if (Pressed(_openMask))
        {
            _waitRelease = true;
            Menu.Close();
            return;
        }

        bool arranging = Radial.Arranging;
        if (Pressed(A))
            Menu.Press(Keys.Enter, false);
        else if (Pressed(B))
            Menu.Press(Menu.Binding != null || arranging ? Keys.Escape : Keys.Back, false);
        else if (Pressed(LB))
            Menu.Press(Keys.PageUp, false);
        else if (Pressed(RB))
            Menu.Press(Keys.PageDown, false);
        else if (Pressed(X))
            Menu.Press(Menu.Confirming != null ? Keys.Escape : Keys.Delete, false);
        else if (Pressed(Y))
            Menu.Press(Menu.Confirming != null ? Keys.Escape : Menu.FavouriteKey, false);

        if (!Menu.IsOpen)
            return;

        // In the radial editor a stick points straight at a slot, so only the D-pad steps from slot to slot.
        ushort dirs = _now;
        if (Radial.Arranging)
        {
            PointWithSticks();
            dirs = _raw;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < Dirs.Length; i++)
        {
            if ((dirs & Dirs[i]) == 0 || ((_openMask & Dirs[i]) != 0 && _waitRelease))
            {
                _repeat[i] = -1f;
                continue;
            }

            if (_repeat[i] < 0f)
            {
                _repeat[i] = 0f;
                Menu.Press(DirKeys[i], false);
                continue;
            }

            _repeat[i] += dt;
            if (_repeat[i] >= Menu.RepeatDelay)
            {
                _repeat[i] -= Menu.RepeatRate;
                Menu.Press(DirKeys[i], true);
            }

            if (!Menu.IsOpen)
                return;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The live radial. Held open: letting go of the radial button uses the slot under the pointer. Tapped open
    /// (RADIAL MODE TAP): the button closes it again. Either stick points, A uses a slot and stays open, B closes,
    /// LB / RB or the D-pad's left and right turn the page.
    /// </summary>
    private static void RadialFrame()
    {
        if (Radial.OpenedBy == Radial.Source.Pad)
        {
            if (Radial.HoldMode && !RawHeld(_radialMask))
            {
                Radial.Release();
                return;
            }

            if (!Radial.HoldMode && RawPressed(_radialMask) && Gfx.Time - Radial.OpenedAt > 0.05)
            {
                Radial.Close();
                return;
            }
        }

        PointWithSticks();

        if (Pressed(A))
            Radial.Use();
        else if (Pressed(B))
            Radial.Close();
        else if (RawPressed(Left) || ((_radialMask & LB) == 0 && RawPressed(LB)))
            Radial.TurnPage(-1);
        else if (RawPressed(Right) || ((_radialMask & RB) == 0 && RawPressed(RB)))
            Radial.TurnPage(1);
    }

    /// <summary>Whichever stick leans further points the radial. XInput's Y runs up, the screen's runs down.</summary>
    private static void PointWithSticks()
    {
        float lx = _lx / 32767f;
        float ly = _ly / 32767f;
        float rx = _rx / 32767f;
        float ry = _ry / 32767f;
        if (lx * lx + ly * ly >= rx * rx + ry * ry)
            Radial.PointStick(lx, -ly);
        else
            Radial.PointStick(rx, -ry);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Keeps the RADIAL BUTTON's own game binding parked, so pressing it opens the radial and nothing else. Checked
    /// every so often, as the game rebuilds its bindings on a new pawn or an options change.
    /// </summary>
    private static void SyncOwned()
    {
        if (++_ownedFrames < RescanFrames && _ownedBind == _parkedOwned)
            return;

        _ownedFrames = 0;
        try
        {
            PlayerInput? input = CurrentInput();
            if (input == null)
                return;

            if (_parkedOwned != null && (_parkedOwned != _ownedBind || input.Ptr != _ownedInput))
            {
                if (input.Ptr == _ownedInput)
                    ParkNamed(input, _parkedOwned, false);
                _parkedOwned = null;
            }

            if (_ownedBind != null)
            {
                int parked = ParkNamed(input, _ownedBind, true);
                if (parked > 0)
                    Log.Detail("Pad: " + _ownedBind + " belongs to the radial now (" + parked + " bindings parked).");
                _parkedOwned = _ownedBind;
                _ownedInput = input.Ptr;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled("pad owned", "Pad: could not reserve the radial button: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Gives the radial button's game binding back, when controller support is switched off or the mod unloads.</summary>
    private static void ReleaseOwned()
    {
        if (_parkedOwned == null)
            return;

        string name = _parkedOwned;
        _parkedOwned = null;
        try
        {
            if (CurrentInput() is { } input && input.Ptr == _ownedInput)
                ParkNamed(input, name, false);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Pad: could not give " + name + " back to the game: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private static int ParkNamed(PlayerInput input, string name, bool park)
    {
        int changed = 0;
        Span<Input.FKeyBind> binds = input.Bindings.AsSpan();
        for (int i = 0; i < binds.Length; i++)
        {
            ref Input.FKeyBind b = ref binds[i];
            if ((b.Control && b.Shift && b.Alt) == park || !string.Equals(b.Name.ToString(), name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                continue;

            b.Control = park;
            b.Shift = park;
            b.Alt = park;
            changed++;
        }

        return changed;
    }

    /// <summary>Holds back the map on BACK until we know it's a tap, not the start of opening the menu.</summary>
    private static bool DefersMap()
    {
        if (_replaying || !Enabled || _openMask != Back || _index < 0 || Menu.IsOpen)
            return false;

        if (!Read(_index, out XInputState state) || (state.Gamepad.Buttons & Back) == 0)
            return false;

        _mapDeferred = true;
        return true;
    }

    public static void GameTick()
    {
        if (_enterCar)
        {
            _enterCar = false;
            if (!Menu.IsOpen && !World.Paused)
                Characters.I.EnterNearby();
        }

        if (!_replayMap)
            return;

        _replayMap = false;
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (pc == null || Menu.IsOpen || World.Paused)
            return;

        _replaying = true;
        try
        {
            pc.OpenLevelUpOrMap();
        }
        finally
        {
            _replaying = false;
        }
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RPlayerController), nameof(RPlayerController.OpenLevelUpOrMap))]
    private static void OpenLevelUpOrMapRedirect(RPlayerController self)
    {
        if (Menu.IsOpen || Safe.Try("map check", DefersMap))
            return;

        self.OpenLevelUpOrMap();
    }

    private static bool IsPadBind(string name) =>
        (name.StartsWith("XboxTypeS_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || name.StartsWith("Gamepad_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) &&
        !name.Equals("XboxTypeS_Start", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private static PlayerInput? CurrentInput()
    {
        PlayerInput? input = World.Pc?.PlayerInput;
        return input is { IsValid: true } ? input : null;
    }

    // A binding that requires Ctrl+Shift+Alt can never match a pad button, which parks it without losing it.
    private static void Block()
    {
        try
        {
            PlayerInput? input = CurrentInput();
            if (input == null)
                return;

            if (input.Ptr == _blockedInput && ++_blockFrames < RescanFrames)
                return;

            _blockFrames = 0;
            _restorePending = false;
            Park(input, true);
            _blockedInput = input.Ptr;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled("pad block", "Pad: could not pause the game's controller buttons: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Waits for held buttons to come up first, so their release doesn't leak into the game.</summary>
    public static void MenuClosed()
    {
        Array.Fill(_repeat, -1f);
        if (_blockedInput == 0)
            return;

        if (Connected && (_now & ~Start) != 0)
            _restorePending = true;
        else
            Unblock("menu closed");
    }

    public static void Shutdown()
    {
        Unblock("mod unloaded");
        ReleaseOwned();
    }

    private static void Unblock(string why)
    {
        _restorePending = false;
        _blockedInput = 0;
        _blockFrames = 0;

        try
        {
            PlayerInput? input = CurrentInput();
            if (input == null)
                return;

            int restored = Park(input, false);
            _repairedInput = input.Ptr;
            Log.Detail("Pad: " + restored + " controller bindings back on (" + why + ").");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Pad: could not give the controller buttons back to the game: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Clears bindings left parked if an earlier session ended with the menu open.</summary>
    private static void RepairBindings()
    {
        if (_blockedInput != 0 || _restorePending)
            return;

        PlayerInput? input = CurrentInput();
        if (input == null || input.Ptr == _repairedInput)
            return;

        _repairedInput = input.Ptr;
        int restored = Park(input, false);
        if (restored > 0)
            Log.Info("Pad: repaired " + restored + " controller bindings left paused by an earlier session.");
    }

    /// <summary>Parks or un-parks every controller binding not already that way. Returns how many changed.</summary>
    private static int Park(PlayerInput input, bool park)
    {
        int changed = 0;
        Span<Input.FKeyBind> binds = input.Bindings.AsSpan();
        for (int i = 0; i < binds.Length; i++)
        {
            ref Input.FKeyBind b = ref binds[i];
            string name = b.Name.ToString() ?? "";
            if ((b.Control && b.Shift && b.Alt) == park || !IsPadBind(name))
                continue;

            // The radial button stays parked while the radial owns it.
            if (!park && _parkedOwned != null && name.Equals(_parkedOwned, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                continue;

            b.Control = park;
            b.Shift = park;
            b.Alt = park;
            changed++;
        }

        return changed;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/AssetBrowser.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// SYSTEM > ASSETS: a browser for the game's own textures and fonts. It lists what is loaded right now, saves the
/// whole list to assets.txt, and previews a texture beside the menu. Also owns the MENU FONT setting, which picks
/// from the fonts it finds. Textures the menu uses from the game (like the fade spinner) were found with it.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class AssetBrowser : Module
{
    public static readonly AssetBrowser I = new();

    public const string TabTitle = "ASSETS";
    private const string ListFile = "assets.txt";

    private static readonly (string Key, string Label, string[] Words)[] Filters =
    {
        ("ui", "UI AND HUD", new[] { "UI", "HUD", "GFX", "MENU", "FRONTEND", "SCALEFORM", "ICON", "MAP", "RETICLE", "CROSSHAIR" }),
        ("icons", "ICONS", new[] { "ICON", "BUTTON", "PROMPT", "GLYPH" }),
        ("fonts", "FONT PAGES", new[] { "FONT" }),
        ("all", "EVERYTHING", Array.Empty<string>()),
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// Generated textures that are never menu art and flood the list: reflection cubemap faces (thousands, and
    /// they draw as plain white), baked lightmaps and shadowmaps. Left out of the browser, kept in the saved file.
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly string[] Junk = { "CUBEMAPFACE", "TEXTURECUBE_", "LIGHTMAPTEXTURE2D", "SHADOWMAPTEXTURE2D" };

    private readonly List<(string Path, int W, int H)> _textures = new();
    private Choice _filter = null!;
    private Choice _texture = null!;
    private Choice _font = null!;
    private Toggle _preview = null!;
    private bool _fontsListed;
    private Texture2D? _shown;
    private string _shownPath = "";
    private double _shownSince;
    private const double SettleSeconds = 0.35;

    public override void Build()
    {
        AddCommand("asset_refresh", "REFRESH LISTS", "Lists every texture and font the game has loaded right now. What's loaded changes with where you are, so refresh after moving somewhere new.", Refresh).Setting();
        AddCommand("asset_dump", "SAVE LIST TO FILE", "Writes every loaded texture (with its size) and font to assets.txt in the Oracle folder.", Dump).Setting();
        _filter = AddChoice("asset_filter", "SHOW", "Which textures to list: names that look like interface art, icons, font pages, or everything.",
            Filters.Select(f => f.Key).ToArray(), Filters.Select(f => f.Label).ToArray(), _ => ListTextures()).Setting();
        _texture = AddChoice("asset_texture", "TEXTURE", "Hold left or right to scroll. The selected texture is drawn beside the menu.", new[] { "" }, new[] { "PRESS REFRESH LISTS" }).Pref();
        _texture.HoldToScroll = true;
        _preview = AddToggle("asset_preview", "PREVIEW", "Draws the selected texture beside the menu while this tab is open, over a checkerboard so see-through parts show.", on: true).Pref();

        _font = AddChoice("menu_font", "MENU FONT", "The font the Oracle menu is drawn in, from the fonts the game has loaded. Each is sized to match. A font that isn't loaded yet uses the default until it is.",
            new[] { Gfx.DefaultFont }, new[] { "ENGINE (DEFAULT)" }, _ => Gfx.UseFont(_font.Saved.Length > 0 ? _font.Saved : _font.CurrentKey)).Setting();
        _font.HoldToScroll = true;
    }

    public override void MenuOpening()
    {
        if (!_fontsListed)
            ListFonts();
    }

    private void Refresh()
    {
        ListFonts();
        ListTextures();
        Overlay.Notice("ASSETS", _textures.Count + " TEXTURES, " + (_font.Labels.Length - 1) + " FONTS", true);
    }

    private void ListFonts()
    {
        _fontsListed = true;
        var paths = new List<string> { Gfx.DefaultFont };
        foreach (Font f in World.All<Font>())
        {
            string path = f.GetPathName(null!);
            if (!paths.Contains(path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                paths.Add(path);
        }

        string[] labels = paths.Select((p, i) => i == 0 ? "ENGINE (DEFAULT)" : Short(p)).ToArray();
        _font.SetOptions(paths.ToArray(), labels);
    }

    private void ListTextures()
    {
        _textures.Clear();
        string[] words = Filters[Math.Clamp(_filter.Index, 0, Filters.Length - 1)].Words;
        foreach (Texture2D t in World.All<Texture2D>())
        {
            string path = t.GetPathName(null!);
            string upper = path.ToUpperInvariant();
            if (Junk.Any(j => upper.Contains(j, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
                continue;
            if (words.Length == 0 || words.Any(w => upper.Contains(w, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
                _textures.Add((path, t.SizeX, t.SizeY));
        }

        _textures.Sort((a, b) => string.Compare(a.Path, b.Path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        if (_textures.Count == 0)
            _texture.SetOptions(new[] { "" }, new[] { "NONE LOADED" });
        else
            _texture.SetOptions(_textures.Select(t => t.Path).ToArray(), _textures.Select(t => Short(t.Path)).ToArray());
    }

    private void Dump()
    {
        var lines = new List<string> { "# Oracle asset list, " + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), "", "[fonts]" };
        lines.AddRange(World.All<Font>().Select(f => f.GetPathName(null!)).OrderBy(p => p, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        lines.Add("");
        lines.Add("[textures] path  width x height");
        int count = 0;
        foreach (Texture2D t in World.All<Texture2D>().OrderBy(t => t.GetPathName(null!), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            lines.Add(t.GetPathName(null!) + "  " + t.SizeX + "x" + t.SizeY);
            count++;
        }

        File.WriteAllLines(Path.Combine(App.Dir, ListFile), lines);
        Log.Info("Assets: saved " + count + " textures and the loaded fonts to " + ListFile + ".");
        Overlay.Notice("SAVED " + ListFile.ToUpperInvariant(), count + " TEXTURES", true);
    }

    private static string Short(string path)
    {
        int dot = path.LastIndexOf('.');
        return (dot >= 0 ? path.Substring(dot + 1) : path).ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    /// <summary>True while the ASSETS tab is open with PREVIEW on and a texture picked.</summary>
    public bool Previewing => _preview.On && Menu.IsOpen && Menu.InRows && !Menu.Searching && Menu.Current.Title == TabTitle && _texture.CurrentKey.Length > 0;

    /// <summary>
    /// Only a texture whose GPU side is settled goes to the render thread: a resource exists, a mip is loaded, it
    /// isn't being released, no streaming change is in flight, and the pick has stayed put for a moment. Drawing
    /// whatever was picked, frame by frame while scrolling, crashed the render thread on 2026-11-05 ("Rendering
    /// thread exception", scrolling through Scarecrow textures that stream in and out with their cutscene).
    /// </summary>
    private bool Drawable(Texture2D t) =>
        Clock.Now - _shownSince >= SettleSeconds
        && t.Resource != 0
        && t.ResidentMips > 0
        && !t.bAsyncResourceReleaseHasBeenStarted
        && t.PendingMipChangeRequestStatus.Value == 0;

    /// <summary>Draws the selected texture's details and image inside a panel the menu has already drawn.</summary>
    public void DrawPreview(float x, float y, float maxW, float maxH, Rgba accent)
    {
        string path = _texture.CurrentKey;
        if (path != _shownPath || _shown is not { IsValid: true })
        {
            if (path != _shownPath)
                _shownSince = Clock.Now;
            _shownPath = path;
            try
            {
                _shown = Game.FindObject<Texture2D>(path);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _shown = null;
                Log.Throttled("asset preview", "Asset preview: " + path + " failed: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }

        float pad = Gfx.S(14);
        float w = maxW;

        var entry = _textures.Find(t => t.Path == path);
        float textY = y + pad;
        Gfx.Text(x + pad, textY, Short(path), Theme.Hi, 0.7f);
        textY += Gfx.TextH(0.7f) + Gfx.S(3);
        Gfx.Text(x + pad, textY, path, Theme.Low, 0.5f);
        textY += Gfx.TextH(0.5f) + Gfx.S(3);
        Gfx.Text(x + pad, textY, entry.W + " x " + entry.H + "   " + (_texture.Index + 1) + " OF " + _texture.Labels.Length, accent, 0.5f);
        textY += Gfx.TextH(0.5f) + Gfx.S(10);

        // Checkerboard behind the image, so transparent parts read as transparent.
        float boxW = w - pad * 2f;
        float boxH = maxH - (textY - y) - pad;
        if (boxH < Gfx.S(40))
            return;

        float cell = Gfx.S(16);
        for (float cy = 0; cy < boxH; cy += cell)
        {
            for (float cx = 0; cx < boxW; cx += cell)
            {
                bool dark = ((int)(cx / cell) + (int)(cy / cell)) % 2 == 0;
                Gfx.Rect(x + pad + cx, textY + cy, Math.Min(cell, boxW - cx), Math.Min(cell, boxH - cy), dark ? Theme.Off : Theme.Low, 0.5f);
            }
        }

        if (_shown is not { IsValid: true } shown)
        {
            Gfx.Text(x + pad, textY + Gfx.S(6), "NOT LOADED ANY MORE, REFRESH", Theme.Warn, 0.6f);
            return;
        }

        if (!Drawable(shown))
        {
            // The game's own spinning bat, the one on Oracle's fade screens, while the texture settles.
            Overlay.DrawSpinner(x + pad + boxW * 0.5f, textY + boxH * 0.5f, 1f, 56f);
            return;
        }

        float tw = Math.Max(1, shown.SizeX);
        float th = Math.Max(1, shown.SizeY);
        float fit = Math.Min(boxW / tw, boxH / th);
        float iw = tw * fit;
        float ih = th * fit;
        Gfx.Image(shown, x + pad + (boxW - iw) * 0.5f, textY + (boxH - ih) * 0.5f, iw, ih);
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Batmobile/Batmobile.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>The BATMOBILE page. Handling and stunts are in BatmobileDrive.cs, weapon extras in BatmobileArsenal.cs.</summary>
internal sealed partial class Batmobile : Module
{
    public static readonly Batmobile I = new();

    private const double RefreshSeconds = 1.0;

    // Unreal units are centimetres.
    private const float UnitsToMph = 0.022369363f;
    private const float UnitsToKmh = 0.036f;
    private const float GaugeMaxMph = 140f;

    private sealed class BoostOriginals
    {
        public readonly RVehicleBatmobileBase Vehicle;
        public readonly bool Infinite;
        public RVehicleSimBatmobile? Sim;
        public bool SimInfinite;

        public BoostOriginals(RVehicleBatmobileBase vehicle)
        {
            Vehicle = vehicle;
            Infinite = vehicle.InfiniteBoost;
        }
    }

    private readonly List<RVehicleWeapon> _weapons = new();
    private BoostOriginals? _boost;
    private RVehicleBatmobileBase? _car;
    private RBatmobileCannon? _cannon;
    private Every _refresh;
    private int _maxHealth;
    private Toggle _speedometer = null!;
    private Toggle _stats = null!;
    private Choice _units = null!;

    private readonly Held<RPlayerController, bool> _radar = new("vehicle radar", pc => pc.bAlwaysShowVehicleRadar, (pc, v) => pc.bAlwaysShowVehicleRadar = v);

    // DRIVING STATS, for this session: best speed, and the longest time and distance off the ground.
    private const float MinJumpSeconds = 0.4f;
    private float _bestSpeed;
    private float _bestAir;
    private float _bestAirDistance;
    private float _airFor = -1f;
    private Vector3 _airFrom;

    public override bool HasHud => _speedometer.On && World.Pawn is RVehicleBatmobileBase;

    public override void Build()
    {
        BuildDrive();
        BuildArsenal();
        BuildAutopilot();
        BuildRemote();
        BuildAutoCombat();

        AddToggle("batmobile_invincible", "INVINCIBLE BATMOBILE", "The Batmobile's armour stays full, so it can't be destroyed.").EveryTick(ArmourTick);

        AddToggle("infinite_power", "INFINITE MISSILE POWER", "The weapon generator stays full, so the missile barrage is always ready.").EveryTick(PowerTick);
        AddToggle("no_cooldowns", "NO WEAPON COOLDOWNS", "Missiles, EMP, 60mm cannon and the other special weapons are ready again straight after firing.").EveryTick(CooldownTick);
        AddToggle("perfect_aim", "PERFECT ACCURACY", "The Vulcan gun never loses accuracy while firing.").EveryTick(AccuracyTick);

        AddToggle("infinite_vehicle_boost", "UNLIMITED VEHICLE BOOST", "The Batmobile's boost does not run out or need to recharge.", on => { if (!on) RestoreBoost(); }).EveryTick(BoostTick);

        _speedometer = AddToggle("batmobile_speedometer", "SPEEDOMETER", "Shows the Batmobile's current speed while you are driving.");
        _units = AddChoice("batmobile_speed_units", "SPEEDOMETER UNITS", "Chooses the unit shown on the Batmobile speedometer.", new[] { "mph", "kmh" }, new[] { "MPH", "KM/H" }).Pref();
        _stats = AddToggle("batmobile_trip_stats", "DRIVING STATS", "Adds your best speed and longest jump of this session to the speedometer.").Pref();
        AddCommand("batmobile_trip_reset", "RESET DRIVING STATS", "Starts the best speed and longest jump on the speedometer again from zero.", ResetStats);
        AddToggle("vehicle_radar_on_foot", "VEHICLE RADAR ON FOOT", "The minimap keeps showing militia drones and tanks while you are on foot, not only the heavy tanks.",
            on => { if (!on) _radar.Restore(); }).Maintain(() => { if (World.Pc is { } pc) _radar.Set(pc, true); });

        AddCommand("rescue_batmobile", "RESCUE BATMOBILE", "Puts a stuck or flipped Batmobile back on its wheels.", () => World.RequireCheats().RescueBatmobile());
        AddCommand("force_exit_batmobile", "FORCE EXIT BATMOBILE", "Gets you out of the Batmobile when the game won't let you, such as a mission insisting you deliver a prisoner first.", ForceExit);
    }

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        StopAutopilot(null);
        RestoreBoost();
        RestoreDrive();
        _missileCap.Restore();
        RestoreRemoteAndPursuit();
        _radar.Restore();
        _airFor = -1f;
        _foes.Clear();
        _barrage.Clear();
        Forget();
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        StopAutopilot(null);
        RestoreBoost();
        RestoreDrive();
        RestoreGrip();
        _missileCap.Restore();
        RestoreRemoteAndPursuit();
        _radar.Restore();
    }

    private void RestoreRemoteAndPursuit()
    {
        _remoteKeeps.Restore();
        _lockFor.Restore();
        _civilianLockFor.Restore();
        _angleShare.Restore();
        _fullAngle.Restore();
        _scaledMissiles.Clear();
    }

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        AutopilotTick(dt);
        DriveTick(dt);
        StatsTick(dt);
    }

    private void StatsTick(float dt)
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RVehicleBatmobileBase car)
        {
            _airFor = -1f;
            return;
        }

        _bestSpeed = MathF.Max(_bestSpeed, car.Velocity.Length());
        if (!car.HasWheelsOnGround())
        {
            if (_airFor < 0f)
            {
                _airFor = 0f;
                _airFrom = car.Location;
            }

            _airFor += dt;
            return;
        }

        if (_airFor >= MinJumpSeconds && _airFor > _bestAir)
        {
            _bestAir = _airFor;
            _bestAirDistance = Geo.DistXY(_airFrom, car.Location);
        }

        _airFor = -1f;
    }

    private void ResetStats()
    {
        _bestSpeed = 0f;
        _bestAir = 0f;
        _bestAirDistance = 0f;
        _airFor = -1f;
    }

    /// <summary>Vehicle.DriverLeave with bForceLeave skips the game's CanLeaveVehicle check, which mission script can hold shut.</summary>
    private static void ForceExit()
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RVehicleBatmobileBase car)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("you are not driving the Batmobile");

        car.bPreventBatmbileExit = false;
        if (World.Pc is { } pc)
            pc.bPreventBatmbileExit = false;

        bool left = car.DriverLeave(true, false);
        Log.Info("Force exit Batmobile: DriverLeave returned " + left + ", now controlling " + (World.Pawn?.GetPathName(null) ?? "nothing") + ".");
        if (!left)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game refused even a forced exit");
    }

    public void Forget()
    {
        _car = null;
        _weapons.Clear();
        _cannon = null;
        _refresh.Force();
        _maxHealth = 0;
    }

    /// <summary>The player's Batmobile. Hits and misses are both cached, so having none doesn't scan every call.</summary>
    public RVehicleBatmobileBase? Car()
    {
        bool due = _refresh.Elapsed(RefreshSeconds);
        if (World.Pawn is RVehicleBatmobileBase driving)
        {
            if (_car is not { IsValid: true } || _car.Ptr != driving.Ptr)
                Track(driving);
            else if (due && WeaponsStale())
                FindWeapons(driving);
            return _car;
        }

        bool usable = _car == null || (_car.IsValid && !_car.bDeleteMe);
        if (!due && usable)
            return _car;

        RVehicleBatmobileBase? found = LocateParked();
        if (found == null || _car is not { IsValid: true } || found.Ptr != _car.Ptr)
            Track(found);
        else if (WeaponsStale())
            FindWeapons(found);

        return _car;
    }

    private static RVehicleBatmobileBase? LocateParked()
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase? known = World.Info?.GetBatmobile();
        if (known is { IsValid: true, IsClassDefaultObject: false, bDeleteMe: false })
            return known;

        foreach (RVehicleBatmobileBase b in World.All<RVehicleBatmobileBase>())
        {
            if (!b.bDeleteMe && b.GetPathName(null).Contains("PersistentLevel", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                return b;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private void Track(RVehicleBatmobileBase? found)
    {
        if (found == null || _car is not { IsValid: true } || found.Ptr != _car.Ptr)
            _maxHealth = 0;
        _car = found;
        FindWeapons(found);
    }

    private bool WeaponsStale()
    {
        if (_weapons.Count == 0)
            return true;

        foreach (RVehicleWeapon w in _weapons)
        {
            if (!w.IsValid)
                return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void FindWeapons(RVehicleBatmobileBase? owner)
    {
        _weapons.Clear();
        _cannon = null;
        if (owner == null)
            return;

        foreach (RVehicleWeapon w in World.All<RVehicleWeapon>())
        {
            if (w.Owner == null || w.Owner.Ptr != owner.Ptr)
                continue;

            _weapons.Add(w);
            if (w is RBatmobileCannon c)
                _cannon = c;
        }
    }

    private static int ArmourBonus(RVehicleBatmobileBase b)
    {
        var armour = b.ArmourLevels;
        return armour.Count == 0 ? 0 : armour[Math.Clamp(b.CurrentArmourLevel, 0, armour.Count - 1)];
    }

    private static float MaxPower(RVehicleBatmobileBase b)
    {
        var levels = b.MaxWeaponGeneratorPower;
        return levels.Count == 0 ? 0f : levels[Math.Clamp(b.CurrentGeneratorLevel, 0, levels.Count - 1)];
    }

    private void ArmourTick()
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase? b = Car();
        if (b == null || b.Health <= 0)
            return;

        _maxHealth = Math.Max(_maxHealth, Math.Max(b.Health, b.HealthMax + ArmourBonus(b)));
        if (b.Health < _maxHealth)
            b.Health = _maxHealth;
    }

    private void PowerTick()
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase? b = Car();
        if (b == null)
            return;

        float max = MaxPower(b);
        if (max > 0f && b.WeaponGeneratorPower < max)
            b.WeaponGeneratorPower = max;
    }

    private void CooldownTick()
    {
        if (Car() == null)
            return;

        foreach (RVehicleWeapon w in _weapons)
        {
            if (!w.IsValid || w is RBatmobileCannon)
                continue;
            if (w.CoolDown > 0f)
                w.CoolDown = 0f;
            if (w.CurrentRechargeTime > 0f)
                w.CurrentRechargeTime = 0f;
        }
    }

    private void AccuracyTick()
    {
        if (Car() == null || _cannon is not { IsValid: true } c)
            return;

        if (c.CurrentInaccuracyTime > 0f)
            c.CurrentInaccuracyTime = 0f;
        if (c.CurrentAccuracyZeroToOne < 1f)
            c.CurrentAccuracyZeroToOne = 1f;
        if (!c.bPerfectShot)
            c.bPerfectShot = true;
    }

    private void BoostTick()
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase? vehicle = Car();
        if (vehicle == null)
        {
            RestoreBoost();
            return;
        }

        if (_boost == null || !_boost.Vehicle.IsValid || _boost.Vehicle.Ptr != vehicle.Ptr)
        {
            RestoreBoost();
            _boost = new BoostOriginals(vehicle);
        }

        RVehicleSimBatmobile? sim = vehicle.SimObj is RVehicleSimBatmobile { IsValid: true } found ? found : null;
        if (_boost.Sim != null && (sim == null || !_boost.Sim.IsValid || _boost.Sim.Ptr != sim.Ptr))
        {
            if (_boost.Sim.IsValid)
                _boost.Sim.bInfiniteBoost = _boost.SimInfinite;
            _boost.Sim = null;
        }

        if (sim != null && _boost.Sim == null)
        {
            _boost.Sim = sim;
            _boost.SimInfinite = sim.bInfiniteBoost;
        }

        if (!vehicle.InfiniteBoost)
            vehicle.InfiniteBoost = true;
        if (_boost.Sim is { IsValid: true } active && !active.bInfiniteBoost)
            active.bInfiniteBoost = true;
    }

    private void RestoreBoost()
    {
        if (_boost is not { } saved)
            return;

        _boost = null;
        Safe.Run("boost restore", () =>
        {
            if (saved.Vehicle.IsValid)
                saved.Vehicle.InfiniteBoost = saved.Infinite;
            if (saved.Sim is { IsValid: true } sim)
                sim.bInfiniteBoost = saved.SimInfinite;
        });
    }

    public override void Draw(Canvas c)
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RVehicleBatmobileBase vehicle)
            return;

        float speed = vehicle.Velocity.Length();
        float mph = speed * UnitsToMph;
        string value = Speed(speed);
        bool boosting = Safe.Try("boost state", vehicle.IsBoosting);

        const float width = 196f;
        float height = _stats.On ? 118f : 100f;
        float x = Gfx.W - Gfx.S(width) - Gfx.S(28f);
        float y = Gfx.H - Gfx.S(height) - Gfx.S(48f);
        Gfx.Panel(x, y, Gfx.S(width), Gfx.S(height));

        float cx = x + Gfx.S(width * 0.5f);
        string title = Piloting ? AutopilotTitle(vehicle) : boosting ? "BOOST" : "BATMOBILE";
        Gfx.TextCentre(cx, y + Gfx.S(9f), title, Piloting || boosting ? Theme.Accent : Theme.Mid, 0.66f);
        Gfx.TextCentre(cx, y + Gfx.S(28f), value, Theme.Hi, 1.15f);

        float barX = x + Gfx.S(14f);
        float barW = Gfx.S(width - 28f);
        Bar(barX, y + Gfx.S(60f), barW, Gfx.S(3f), mph / GaugeMaxMph, null);
        float maxHealth = MathF.Max(_maxHealth, vehicle.HealthMax + ArmourBonus(vehicle));
        float maxPower = MaxPower(vehicle);
        Bar(barX, y + Gfx.S(72f), barW, Gfx.S(5f), maxHealth > 0f ? vehicle.Health / maxHealth : 0f, "HP");
        Bar(barX, y + Gfx.S(86f), barW, Gfx.S(5f), maxPower > 0f ? vehicle.WeaponGeneratorPower / maxPower : 0f, "PWR");

        if (_stats.On)
        {
            string jump = _bestAir <= 0f ? "-" : _bestAir.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " S " + MathF.Round(_bestAirDistance / 100f).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " M";
            Gfx.TextCentre(cx, y + Gfx.S(100f), "BEST " + Speed(_bestSpeed) + "   JUMP " + jump, Theme.Mid, 0.56f);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A speed in units per second, in the chosen speedometer unit.</summary>
    private string Speed(float unitsPerSecond)
    {
        bool kmh = _units.Index == 1;
        return MathF.Round(unitsPerSecond * (kmh ? UnitsToKmh : UnitsToMph)).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + (kmh ? " KM/H" : " MPH");
    }

    private static void Bar(float x, float y, float w, float h, float fraction, string? label)
    {
        if (label != null)
        {
            Gfx.TextMid(x, y + h * 0.5f, label, Theme.Mid, 0.56f);
            x += Gfx.S(30f);
            w -= Gfx.S(30f);
        }

        Gfx.Rect(x, y, w, h, Theme.Mid, 0.25f);
        fraction = float.IsNaN(fraction) ? 0f : Math.Clamp(fraction, 0f, 1f);
        Gfx.Rect(x, y, w * fraction, h, Theme.Accent, 0.95f);
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Batmobile/BatmobileArsenal.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Weapon extras beyond power and cooldowns: the cannon's ammo and heat, the full arsenal, the missile barrage and the assisted takedown.</summary>
internal sealed partial class Batmobile
{
    private const float MaxMissileTargets = 40f;

    private readonly Held<RBatmobileMissileLauncher, int> _missileCap = new("missile targets", m => m.MaxTargets, (m, v) => m.MaxTargets = v);

    private Slider _missileTargets = null!;

    // The pursuit missile (RBatmobileEMPMissile), the lock-on shot for car chases and APCs. Its lock builds over
    // MissileLockOnDuration (CivilianMissileLockOnDuration for civilian cars); 0 locks at once. Its hit strength is
    // CalculateDamageFactor: AngleDamageFactor x (angle to the target's tail / MaxDamageAngle, capped at 1) plus the
    // rest as a wobbling random part, so a factor of 1 with a near-zero angle always gives a full hit.
    private readonly Held<RBatmobileEMPMissile, float> _lockFor = new("missile lock", m => m.MissileLockOnDuration, (m, v) => m.MissileLockOnDuration = v);
    private readonly Held<RBatmobileEMPMissile, float> _civilianLockFor = new("civilian missile lock", m => m.CivilianMissileLockOnDuration, (m, v) => m.CivilianMissileLockOnDuration = v);
    private readonly Held<RBatmobileEMPMissile, float> _angleShare = new("missile angle share", m => m.AngleDamageFactor, (m, v) => m.AngleDamageFactor = v);
    private readonly Held<RBatmobileEMPMissile, float> _fullAngle = new("missile full angle", m => m.MaxDamageAngle, (m, v) => m.MaxDamageAngle = v);
    // Missiles already scaled, by address and firing time. Addresses get reused by later missiles, so entries expire.
    private const double MissileMemory = 6.0;
    private readonly Dictionary<nint, double> _scaledMissiles = new();
    private Slider _pursuitDamage = null!;

    private void BuildArsenal()
    {
        AddToggle("batmobile_no_overheat", "NO RELOAD OR OVERHEAT", "The Batmobile's cannon never runs out of shells, never stops to reload and never overheats.").EveryTick(CannonTick);

        // RemoveBatmobileWeapon clears the weapon's unlock flag in the save, so this can't be undone from here and is a command, not a toggle.
        AddCommand("batmobile_all_weapons", "ARM EVERY WEAPON", "Fits the Batmobile with every weapon it has, unlocked or not. Nothing is written to your save: they stay until the Batmobile is next rebuilt, by a reload or a skin change.", ArmEverything);

        _missileTargets = AddSlider("batmobile_missile_targets", "MISSILE BARRAGE TARGETS", "How many targets the missile barrage can lock on to at once. GAME keeps your upgrade's own number.",
            0f, 0f, MaxMissileTargets, 1f, 20f, v => v <= 0f ? "GAME" : Fmt.Count(v), v => { if (v <= 0f) _missileCap.Restore(); }).EveryTick(MissileTick);

        AddToggle("pursuit_instant_lock", "INSTANT MISSILE LOCK", "The pursuit missile locks on to cars, APCs and anything else it can target the moment they are in your sights.",
            on => { if (!on) { _lockFor.Restore(); _civilianLockFor.Restore(); } }).EveryTick(LockTick);
        AddToggle("pursuit_full_hits", "FULL-STRENGTH MISSILE HITS", "Every pursuit missile hits as hard as a perfect shot from right behind, whatever the angle.",
            on => { if (!on) { _angleShare.Restore(); _fullAngle.Restore(); } }).EveryTick(FullHitTick);
        _pursuitDamage = AddSlider("pursuit_damage", "PURSUIT MISSILE DAMAGE", "Multiplies the damage of each pursuit missile, so APCs and fleeing cars go down in fewer hits.",
            1f, 1f, 10f, 1f, 5f, Fmt.Multiplier);

        AddToggle("batmobile_takedown_ready", "BATMOBILE TAKEDOWN READY", "In a fight on foot, the Batmobile's assisted takedown is always charged, so it's ready whenever the car is close enough to help.").EveryTick(TakedownTick);
    }

    private void CannonTick()
    {
        if (Car() == null || _cannon is not { IsValid: true } c)
            return;

        // It only reloads below a full magazine, and only overheats once its heat builds up.
        if (c.AmmoPerMagazine > 0 && c.CurrentAmmo < c.AmmoPerMagazine)
            c.CurrentAmmo = c.AmmoPerMagazine;
        if (c.CurrentHeatLevel > 0f)
            c.CurrentHeatLevel = 0f;
        if (c.bOverheating)
            c.StopOverHeat();
    }

    private void ArmEverything()
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase car = Car() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("there's no Batmobile in this area");
        int before = _weapons.Count;
        car.AddBatmobileWeapons(true);
        FindWeapons(car);
        int added = _weapons.Count - before;
        Log.Info("ARM EVERY WEAPON: the Batmobile had " + before + " weapons and now has " + _weapons.Count + ".");
        if (added <= 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the Batmobile already has every weapon");

        Overlay.Notice("ARM EVERY WEAPON", Fmt.Plural(added, "WEAPON") + " ADDED", true);
    }

    private void MissileTick()
    {
        if (Car() == null)
            return;

        foreach (RVehicleWeapon w in _weapons)
        {
            if (w is RBatmobileMissileLauncher { IsValid: true } launcher)
            {
                _missileCap.Set(launcher, (int)_missileTargets.Value);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private RBatmobileEMPMissile? PursuitLauncher()
    {
        if (Car() == null)
            return null;

        foreach (RVehicleWeapon w in _weapons)
        {
            if (w is RBatmobileEMPMissile { IsValid: true } launcher)
                return launcher;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private void LockTick()
    {
        if (PursuitLauncher() is { } m)
        {
            _lockFor.Set(m, 0f);
            _civilianLockFor.Set(m, 0f);
        }
    }

    private void FullHitTick()
    {
        if (PursuitLauncher() is { } m)
        {
            _angleShare.Set(m, 1f);
            _fullAngle.Set(m, 0.001f);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Where the pursuit missile's damage is set, right after it is fired. RBatmobileEMPMissile has no subclasses, so
    /// calling the original here can't land in another override. A retarget calls it again on the same missile,
    /// so each one is scaled once.
    /// </summary>
    [Redirect(typeof(RBatmobileEMPMissile), nameof(RBatmobileEMPMissile.OnProjectileSpawned))]
    private static void PursuitMissileFiredRedirect(RBatmobileEMPMissile self, RProjectile projectile, Actor target)
    {
        self.OnProjectileSpawned(projectile, target);
        Safe.Run("pursuit missile damage", () =>
        {
            if (I._pursuitDamage is not { } slider || slider.Value <= 1f || projectile is not { IsValid: true })
                return;
            double now = Clock.Now;
            Dictionary<nint, double> seen = I._scaledMissiles;
            if (seen.TryGetValue(projectile.Ptr, out double firedAt) && now - firedAt < MissileMemory)
                return;
            if (seen.Count > 64)
            {
                foreach (nint old in seen.Where(kv => now - kv.Value >= MissileMemory).Select(kv => kv.Key).ToList())
                    seen.Remove(old);
            }

            seen[projectile.Ptr] = now;
            projectile.Damage *= slider.Value;
        });
    }

    /// <summary>Tops up the meter the assisted takedown waits for. Only in a fight on foot, where the game shows and spends it.</summary>
    private static void TakedownTick()
    {
        if (World.Pc is not RPlayerControllerCombat pc || World.Pawn is RVehicleBatmobileBase || !pc.IsInCombat(false))
            return;

        float full = pc.GetBatmobileTakedownAdrenalineSpecialLimit();
        if (full > 0f && pc.BatmobileTakedownAdrenalineValue < full)
        {
            pc.BatmobileTakedownAdrenalineValue = full;
            pc.ShowBatmobileTakedownAdrenaline();
        }
    }
}
```
