`scripts/Modules/Batmobile/BatmobileAutoCombat.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// AUTO COMBAT: the Batmobile fights for you in pursuit or battle mode. Outside battle mode the weapons are holstered
/// and refuse to fire, so Oracle fires their shots itself, the way the weapons do: Spawn(archetype class, weapon,
/// None, location, rotation, archetype) then Init(direction), for the 60mm cannon's ProjectileArchetype and the
/// missile launcher's homing MissileClass (SetTarget first, bForceExplodeAtTarget for vehicles). The shots carry
/// the game's own damage, hits and kill credit. SHOOT DOWN MISSILES uses RTankMissile.TakeDamageFromWeapon, the
/// game's own "shot out of the sky" path, refused only in a missile's brief invincible start.
/// </summary>
internal sealed partial class Batmobile
{
    // Base gaps between shots at 1.00x FIRE RATE, in seconds.
    private const double ShellGap = 1.0;
    private const double MissileGap = 0.8;
    private const double BarrageGap = 8.0;
    private const double BarrageStagger = 0.12;
    private const int BarrageMin = 3;
    private const int BarrageDefault = 6;

    // Where shots leave from, above the car and out past its nose so they never hit it.
    private const float ShellLift = 160f;
    private const float ShellClear = 350f;
    private const float MissileLift = 220f;
    private const float MissileArc = 0.6f;

    // SHOOT DOWN MISSILES works between these distances from you (units), every so often.
    private const float ShootDownFar = 10000f;
    private const float ShootDownNear = 600f;
    private const float ShootDownClosing = 4000f;
    private const double ShootDownGap = 0.15;
    private const double ReportEvery = 10.0;

    private Slider _combatRange = null!;
    private Slider _combatRate = null!;
    private readonly List<RVehicleNPC> _foes = new();
    private readonly Queue<RVehicleNPC> _barrage = new();
    private Every _foeScan;
    private Every _combatReport;
    private double _shellAt;
    private double _missileAt;
    private double _barrageAt;
    private double _barrageNext;
    private double _downAt;
    private int _shells;
    private int _missiles;
    private int _barrages;
    private int _shotDown;

    private void BuildAutoCombat()
    {
        AddToggle("batmobile_auto_combat", "AUTO COMBAT", "While you drive, in pursuit or battle mode, the Batmobile fights for you: cannon shells at tanks, homing missiles at drones and missile barrages at groups. Heavy tanks are left to you.")
            .EveryTick(AutoCombatTick);
        AddToggle("batmobile_shoot_down", "SHOOT DOWN MISSILES", "Militia missiles heading for you are shot out of the sky before they arrive, in the Batmobile or on foot.")
            .EveryTick(ShootDownTick);
        _combatRange = AddSlider("batmobile_combat_range", "AUTO COMBAT RANGE", "How far away AUTO COMBAT picks its targets.", 120f, 40f, 300f, 10f, 200f, Fmt.Metres).Pref();
        _combatRate = AddSlider("batmobile_combat_rate", "AUTO COMBAT FIRE RATE", "How quickly AUTO COMBAT fires. 1.00x is a shell a second, a missile every 0.8 s and a barrage every 8 s.",
            1f, 0.5f, 4f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times).Pref();
    }

    private void AutoCombatTick()
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RVehicleBatmobileBase car || World.Paused || Car() == null)
        {
            _barrage.Clear();
            return;
        }

        double now = Clock.Now;
        float rate = _combatRate.Value;
        if (_foeScan.Elapsed(0.5))
            FindFoes(car);
        Report();

        RBatmobileMissileLauncher? launcher = Weapon<RBatmobileMissileLauncher>();
        if (_barrage.Count > 0)
        {
            if (now < _barrageNext)
                return;
            _barrageNext = now + BarrageStagger;
            RVehicleNPC next = _barrage.Dequeue();
            if (launcher != null && Hostile(next))
                FireMissile(car, launcher, next);
            return;
        }

        if (_foes.Count == 0)
            return;

        if (launcher != null && _foes.Count >= BarrageMin && now - _barrageAt > BarrageGap / rate)
        {
            _barrageAt = now;
            _barrages++;
            int size = launcher.MaxTargets > 0 ? launcher.MaxTargets : BarrageDefault;
            foreach (RVehicleNPC foe in _foes.Take(size))
                _barrage.Enqueue(foe);
            return;
        }

        RVehicleNPC target = _foes[0];
        RBatmobileHeavyCannon? cannon = Weapon<RBatmobileHeavyCannon>();
        bool flying = target is RVehicleFlying;
        if ((flying || cannon == null) && launcher != null)
        {
            if (now - _missileAt > MissileGap / rate)
            {
                _missileAt = now;
                FireMissile(car, launcher, target);
            }
        }
        else if (cannon != null && now - _shellAt > ShellGap / rate && FireShell(car, cannon, target))
        {
            _shellAt = now;
        }
    }

    private T? Weapon<T>() where T : RVehicleWeapon
    {
        foreach (RVehicleWeapon w in _weapons)
        {
            if (w is T { IsValid: true } found)
                return found;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>Militia tanks and drones in range that know you're there, the ones attacking you first, then the nearest.</summary>
    private void FindFoes(RVehicleBatmobileBase car)
    {
        _foes.Clear();
        Vector3 at = car.Location;
        float reach = _combatRange.Value * 100f;
        var ranked = new List<(RVehicleNPC Foe, bool OnMe, float Dist)>();
        foreach (RVehicleNPC v in World.All<RVehicleNPC>())
        {
            if (v is not (RVehicleTank or RVehicleFlying))
                continue;

            float dist = Vector3.Distance(v.Location, at);
            if (dist > reach || !Hostile(v))
                continue;
            if (!Safe.Try("foe awareness", () => v.IsAwareOfBatmobile() || v.AwareOfPlayer() || v.IsAttacking()))
                continue;

            bool onMe = Safe.Try("foe target", () => v.IsAttacking() && v.GetTargetActor() is { } t && t.Ptr == car.Ptr);
            ranked.Add((v, onMe, dist));
        }

        foreach (var r in ranked.OrderBy(r => r.OnMe ? 0 : 1).ThenBy(r => r.Dist))
            _foes.Add(r.Foe);
    }

    /// <summary>A live enemy vehicle Oracle may shoot: not parked set dressing, not a boss-style heavy tank, not hacked to your side.</summary>
    private static bool Hostile(RVehicleNPC v) =>
        v is { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false, bHidden: false, DroneHacked: false, CivilianVehicle: false } && v.Health > 0 &&
        v is not RVehicleStaticTank && v is not RVehicleHeavyTank && v.CurrentBehaviour is { IsValid: true };

    /// <summary>One 60mm shell, aimed ahead of a moving target, only with a clear line to it.</summary>
    private bool FireShell(RVehicleBatmobileBase car, RBatmobileHeavyCannon cannon, RVehicleNPC target)
    {
        if (cannon.ProjectileArchetype is not { IsValid: true } shell)
            return false;

        Vector3 aim = target.Location + new Vector3(0f, 0f, 60f);
        Vector3 start = car.Location + new Vector3(0f, 0f, ShellLift);
        Vector3 dir = Vector3.Normalize(aim - start);
        Vector3 from = start + dir * ShellClear;
        if (shell.Speed > 0f)
            aim += target.Velocity * (Vector3.Distance(from, aim) / shell.Speed);
        dir = Vector3.Normalize(aim - from);
        if (!car.FastTrace(aim, from, Vector3.Zero, false))
            return false;

        if (cannon.Spawn(shell.Class, cannon, FName.None, from, Rotator.FromDirection(dir), shell, true) is not RProjectile p)
            return false;

        if (p is RBasicProjectile basic)
        {
            basic.SetTarget(target);
            basic.bLockedOn = true;
        }

        p.Init(dir);
        _shells++;
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>One homing missile from the barrage launcher, launched upwards so it arcs onto the target.</summary>
    private void FireMissile(RVehicleBatmobileBase car, RBatmobileMissileLauncher launcher, RVehicleNPC target)
    {
        if (launcher.MissileClass is not { IsValid: true } missile)
            return;

        Vector3 from = car.Location + new Vector3(0f, 0f, MissileLift);
        Vector3 dir = Vector3.Normalize(Vector3.Normalize(target.Location - from) + new Vector3(0f, 0f, MissileArc));
        if (launcher.Spawn(missile.Class, launcher, FName.None, from, Rotator.FromDirection(dir), missile, true) is not RProjectile p)
            return;

        if (p is RBatmobileMissile homing)
        {
            homing.SetTarget(target);
            homing.bForceExplodeAtTarget = true;
            homing.ForceExplodeProxDist = 100f;
        }

        p.Init(dir);
        _missiles++;
    }

    private void ShootDownTick()
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not { } me || World.Paused || Clock.Now - _downAt < ShootDownGap)
            return;

        Report();
        Vector3 at = me.Location;
        nint player = World.Player?.Ptr ?? 0;
        foreach (RTankMissile m in World.All<RTankMissile>())
        {
            if (m.bDeleteMe || m.WasShotOutOfSky)
                continue;

            float dist = Vector3.Distance(m.Location, at);
            if (dist > ShootDownFar || dist < ShootDownNear)
                continue;

            bool aimedAtMe = m.Target is { } t && (t.Ptr == me.Ptr || t.Ptr == player);
            bool closing = Vector3.Dot(m.Velocity, at - m.Location) > 0f;
            if (!aimedAtMe && !(closing && dist < ShootDownClosing))
                continue;

            m.TakeDamageFromWeapon(1000, World.Pc!, m.Location, Vector3.UnitZ, Vector3.Zero, RDmgType_BatmobileChainGun.StaticClass(), default, me, false);
            if (m.WasShotOutOfSky)
            {
                _downAt = Clock.Now;
                _shotDown++;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>What AUTO COMBAT and SHOOT DOWN MISSILES did lately, so a fight can be read back from Oracle.log.</summary>
    private void Report()
    {
        if (!_combatReport.Elapsed(ReportEvery) || _shells + _missiles + _barrages + _shotDown == 0)
            return;

        Log.Info("AUTO COMBAT: in the last " + ReportEvery + " s, " + _foes.Count + " targets in range, fired " + _shells + " shells, " + _missiles + " missiles and " + _barrages +
            " barrages, shot down " + _shotDown + " missiles.");
        _shells = _missiles = _barrages = _shotDown = 0;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Batmobile/BatmobileAutopilot.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using PickupMode = BmSDK.BmGame.RVehicleBatmobileBase.EBatmobilePickupMode;
using SelfDrive = BmSDK.BmGame.RVehicle.ESelfDriveMode;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// AUTOPILOT: the Batmobile drives you along the roads, using the game's own route planner and self-drive, the
/// ones that bring the car when you call it. PlanBatmobileRoute only plans for an empty car (Driver == None), so
/// the driver is cleared for that one call. ExecuteBatmobileRoute then builds the spans and racing line and starts
/// the drive, and bControlledBySeqAct marks it the way the game's own Kismet drive-route action does.
/// </summary>
internal sealed partial class Batmobile
{
    // How far from the destination the route may end on a road, tried in turn (units: 30 m, 100 m, 300 m).
    private static readonly float[] RoadSearch = { 3000f, 10000f, 30000f };
    private const float AnyDistance = 1000000f;
    private const float ExactHeightRange = 2000f;
    private const float ArrivedWithin = 4000f;
    private const double StartGrace = 1.0;
    private const double ReportGap = 3.0;

    // Pulling up: self-drive lets go 15-20 m short of the route's end without braking, so Oracle brakes the car to a
    // stop there itself, hard enough to stop by the end (between these, in units per second squared).
    private const float BrakeMin = 800f;
    private const float BrakeMax = 3000f;
    private const float BrakeRoomMin = 300f;
    private const float StoppedSpeed = 60f;
    private const double BrakeFor = 4.0;

    private readonly Held<RVehicleBatmobileBase, bool> _pilotBoost = new("autopilot boost", b => b.SelfDriveAllowBoost, (b, v) => b.SelfDriveAllowBoost = v);

    private Toggle _autoBoost = null!;
    private RVehicleBatmobileBase? _pilotCar;
    private Vector3 _pilotGoal;
    private string _pilotTarget = "";
    private double _pilotSince;
    private Every _pilotReport;
    private RVehicleBatmobileBase? _brakeCar;
    private double _brakeSince;

    private bool Piloting => _pilotCar is { IsValid: true };

    private void BuildAutopilot()
    {
        AddCommand("autopilot_waypoint", "AUTOPILOT TO WAYPOINT", "The Batmobile drives you to your map waypoint along the roads, the way it drives itself when you call it. Run it again, or STOP AUTOPILOT, to take the wheel back.",
            () => ToggleAutopilot("WAYPOINT", Waypoint));
        AddCommand("autopilot_objective", "AUTOPILOT TO OBJECTIVE", "The Batmobile drives you to the current mission marker along the roads. Run it again, or STOP AUTOPILOT, to take the wheel back.",
            () => ToggleAutopilot("OBJECTIVE", ObjectiveSpot));
        AddCommand("autopilot_stop", "STOP AUTOPILOT", "Takes the wheel back from the autopilot.", () =>
        {
            if (!Piloting)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the autopilot isn't driving");
            StopAutopilot("YOU HAVE THE WHEEL");
        });
        _autoBoost = AddToggle("autopilot_boost", "AUTOPILOT CAN BOOST", "Lets the autopilot use the afterburner on the straights.").Pref();
    }

    private void ToggleAutopilot(string what, Func<(Vector3 At, bool Exact)> target)
    {
        if (Piloting)
        {
            StopAutopilot("YOU HAVE THE WHEEL");
            return;
        }

        StartAutopilot(what, target());
    }

    private static (Vector3 At, bool Exact) Waypoint()
    {
        RPersistentData pd = World.Info?.PersistentData ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        if (!pd.IsValid || !pd.GetCustomWaypointEnabled())
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no waypoint is set, pick one on the map first");

        // A pin dropped on the map has a made-up height; any other waypoint sits on the real spot.
        return (pd.GetCustomWaypoint(true), pd.CustomWaypoint_Type != RPersistentData.ECustomWayPointType.CustomWayType_Proximity);
    }

    private static (Vector3 At, bool Exact) ObjectiveSpot()
    {
        RGameInfo info = World.Info ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        return (TeleportTools.Objective(info) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("no objective is active"), true);
    }

    private void StartAutopilot(string what, (Vector3 At, bool Exact) target)
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RVehicleBatmobileBase car)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("get in the Batmobile first");
        RPlayerController pc = World.Pc ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        if (car.bControlledBySeqAct || car.SelfDriveMode != SelfDrive.SELFDRIVE_None)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is already driving the Batmobile");
        if (Safe.Try("battle mode check", car.IsInBattleMode))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("switch out of battle mode first");

        float heightRange = target.Exact ? ExactHeightRange : AnyDistance;
        int start = -1;
        float reach = 0f;
        Vector3 end = default;
        Pawn? driver = car.Driver;
        try
        {
            car.Driver = null!;
            foreach (float search in RoadSearch)
            {
                reach = search;
                start = pc.PlanBatmobileRoute(target.At, false, AnyDistance, out end, search, heightRange, false, Vector3.Zero, null!);
                // Only "no road near the destination" can get better with a wider search.
                if (start != -1)
                    break;
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            car.Driver = driver!;
        }

        Log.Info("AUTOPILOT: planning to the " + what.ToLowerInvariant() + " at " + Fmt.Position(target.At) + (target.Exact ? "" : " (map pin)") +
            " gave " + start + " with a road search of " + Fmt.Metres(reach / 100f).ToLowerInvariant() + ".");
        if (start < 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(RouteRefusal(start));

        pc.ExecuteBatmobileRoute(start, end, PickupMode.BPM_None, false);
        if (car.SelfDriveMode == SelfDrive.SELFDRIVE_None)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game wouldn't start driving");

        car.bControlledBySeqAct = true;
        if (_autoBoost.On)
            _pilotBoost.Set(car, true);

        _brakeCar = null;
        _pilotCar = car;
        _pilotGoal = end;
        _pilotTarget = what;
        _pilotSince = Clock.Now;
        _pilotReport = default;
        Log.Info("AUTOPILOT: driving, " + car.SelfDriveRouteSpans.Count + " route spans, the route ends at " + Fmt.Position(end) + ", " +
            Distance(Geo.DistXY(car.Location, end)).ToLowerInvariant() + " away in a straight line and " + Distance(Geo.DistXY(end, target.At)).ToLowerInvariant() + " from the " + what.ToLowerInvariant() + ".");
        Overlay.Notice("AUTOPILOT", "DRIVING TO " + what, true);
    }

    /// <summary>PlanBatmobileRoute's failure codes, read from its bytecode.</summary>
    private static string RouteRefusal(int code) => code switch
    {
        -1 => "there's no road near the Batmobile, or within 300 m of the destination",
        -2 => "the roads don't connect to there",
        -3 => "the winch is holding the Batmobile",
        -4 => "the roads don't come close enough to the destination",
        -5 => "the destination is inside a heavy tank's zone",
        _ => "the game couldn't plan a route (" + code + ")",
    };

    private void AutopilotTick(float dt)
    {
        if (_brakeCar != null)
            BrakeTick(dt);
        if (_pilotCar == null)
            return;

        RVehicleBatmobileBase car = _pilotCar;
        if (!car.IsValid || World.Pawn is not { } pawn || pawn.Ptr != car.Ptr)
        {
            StopAutopilot(null);
            Log.Info("AUTOPILOT: stopped, you left the Batmobile.");
            return;
        }

        float left = Geo.DistXY(car.Location, _pilotGoal);
        if (car.SelfDriveMode == SelfDrive.SELFDRIVE_None && Clock.Now - _pilotSince > StartGrace)
        {
            Log.Info("AUTOPILOT: the game finished driving to the " + _pilotTarget.ToLowerInvariant() + ", " + Distance(left).ToLowerInvariant() + " from the end of the route.");
            bool arrived = left < ArrivedWithin;
            StopAutopilot(arrived ? "ARRIVED" : "STOPPED SHORT");
            if (arrived)
                StartBrake(car);
            return;
        }

        if (Safe.Try("battle mode check", car.IsInBattleMode))
        {
            StopAutopilot("BATTLE MODE, YOU HAVE THE WHEEL");
            return;
        }

        if (_pilotReport.Elapsed(ReportGap))
        {
            Log.Info("AUTOPILOT: " + Speed(car.Velocity.Length()).ToLowerInvariant() + ", " + car.SelfDriveMode + ", span " + car.SelfDriveNextSpan + " of " +
                car.SelfDriveRouteSpans.Count + ", " + Distance(left).ToLowerInvariant() + " to go.");
        }
    }

    private void StartBrake(RVehicleBatmobileBase car)
    {
        _brakeCar = car;
        _brakeSince = Clock.Now;
        // The game's own hard stop: brake lights and its timed brake force, when the car is on the ground and moving fast.
        Safe.Run("emergency brake", car.EmergencyBrake);
        Log.Info("AUTOPILOT: pulling up from " + Speed(car.Velocity.Length()).ToLowerInvariant() + ".");
    }

    /// <summary>Slows the car along its own direction of travel, so it stops at the end of the route instead of coasting past.</summary>
    private void BrakeTick(float dt)
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase? car = _brakeCar;
        if (car is not { IsValid: true } || World.Pawn is not { } pawn || pawn.Ptr != car.Ptr || Clock.Now - _brakeSince > BrakeFor ||
            car.CollisionComponent is not { IsValid: true } body)
        {
            _brakeCar = null;
            return;
        }

        Vector3 flat = new(car.Velocity.X, car.Velocity.Y, 0f);
        float speed = flat.Length();
        if (speed < StoppedSpeed)
        {
            Log.Info("AUTOPILOT: stopped " + Distance(Geo.DistXY(car.Location, _pilotGoal)).ToLowerInvariant() + " from the end of the route.");
            _brakeCar = null;
            return;
        }

        // Stop by the end of the route; once past it, stop as hard as allowed.
        Vector3 toGoal = _pilotGoal - car.Location;
        bool ahead = Vector3.Dot(flat, new Vector3(toGoal.X, toGoal.Y, 0f)) > 0f;
        float room = MathF.Max(Geo.DistXY(car.Location, _pilotGoal), BrakeRoomMin);
        float decel = ahead ? Math.Clamp(speed * speed / (2f * room), BrakeMin, BrakeMax) : BrakeMax;
        body.SetRBLinearVelocity(-flat / speed * MathF.Min(decel * dt, speed), true);
    }

    private void StopAutopilot(string? notice)
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase? car = _pilotCar;
        _pilotCar = null;
        _brakeCar = null;
        _pilotBoost.Restore();
        if (car is { IsValid: true })
        {
            Safe.Run("autopilot stop", () =>
            {
                if (car.SelfDriveMode != SelfDrive.SELFDRIVE_None)
                    car.CancelSelfDrive();
                car.bControlledBySeqAct = false;
            });
        }

        if (notice == null)
            return;

        Log.Info("AUTOPILOT: " + notice.ToLowerInvariant() + ".");
        Overlay.Notice("AUTOPILOT", notice, notice == "ARRIVED");
    }

    /// <summary>What's left to drive, for the speedometer title.</summary>
    private string AutopilotTitle(RVehicleBatmobileBase car) => "AUTOPILOT " + Distance(Geo.DistXY(car.Location, _pilotGoal));

    /// <summary>A distance in the speedometer's unit family: miles with MPH, kilometres with KM/H, metres when close.</summary>
    private string Distance(float units)
    {
        bool kmh = _units.Index == 1;
        float metres = units / 100f;
        if (kmh)
            return metres < 1000f ? MathF.Round(metres).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " M" : (metres / 1000f).ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " KM";

        float miles = metres / 1609.344f;
        return miles < 0.1f ? MathF.Round(metres * 1.0936f).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " YD" : miles.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " MI";
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Batmobile/BatmobileDrive.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using EjectType = BmSDK.BmGame.RVehicleBatmobileBase.EBatmobileEjectType;
using TyreType = BmSDK.Engine.SVehicleWheel.ETyreType;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Handling, protection and stunts for the Batmobile you are driving. The car's physics is native, so speed, jumps
/// and gravity act on its rigid body directly (the way the game's own SlamBatmobile cheat moves it), and the
/// native tuning values are only scaled from what the game had.
/// </summary>
internal sealed partial class Batmobile
{
    // ENGINE POWER: extra acceleration per 1.00x above stock, and the cruising speed it scales (about 100 mph).
    // Tuned by feel; the native engine model isn't readable.
    private const float EngineAccel = 1500f;
    private const float EngineCruise = 4500f;
    private const float EngineSpeedLimit = 18000f;

    // BATMOBILE JUMP at 1.00x, in units per second straight up.
    private const float JumpSpeed = 1200f;
    private const double JumpGroundGrace = 0.3;

    // AUTO-RIGHT: how far over counts as tipped, how long it must stay that way, and the gap between tries.
    private const float TippedDegrees = 75f;
    private const float TippedSpeed = 400f;
    private const float RightAfter = 1.2f;
    private const double RightGap = 2.0;
    private const float RightLift = 150f;

    private readonly Held<RVehicleSimBatmobile, float> _topSpeed = new("top speed", s => s.ScaleTopSpeed, (s, v) => s.ScaleTopSpeed = v);
    private readonly Held<RVehicleSimBatmobile, float> _battleTopSpeed = new("battle mode speed", s => s.BattleModeMaxSpeed, (s, v) => s.BattleModeMaxSpeed = v);
    private readonly Held<RVehicleBatmobileBase, EjectType> _eject = new("super eject", b => b.MaxEjectType, (b, v) => b.MaxEjectType = v);
    private readonly Held<RVehicleBatmobileBase, bool> _doubleDodge = new("double dodge", b => b.bDoubleDodgeUpgrade, (b, v) => b.bDoubleDodgeUpgrade = v);
    private readonly Held<RVehicleBatmobileBase, bool> _empVulnerable = new("EMP", b => b.VulnerableToEMP, (b, v) => b.VulnerableToEMP = v);

    private Toggle _empProof = null!;
    private Toggle _selfRight = null!;
    private Toggle _superEject = null!;
    private Toggle _dodgeTwice = null!;
    private Slider _engine = null!;
    private Slider _grip = null!;
    private Slider _battleSpeed = null!;
    private Slider _jumpPower = null!;
    private Slider _airGravity = null!;

    private float _gripApplied = 1f;
    private float _gravity;
    private float _tippedFor;
    private double _rightedAt;
    private double _groundedAt;

    private void BuildDrive()
    {
        AddCommand("batmobile_repair", "REPAIR AND RECHARGE", "Fixes all of the Batmobile's damage and fills its weapon generator, once.", Repair);

        _empProof = AddToggle("batmobile_emp_proof", "EMP-PROOF", "EMP can't shut the Batmobile down, so it keeps driving and can always be called.",
            on => { if (!on) _empVulnerable.Restore(); });
        _selfRight = AddToggle("batmobile_self_right", "AUTO-RIGHT WHEN FLIPPED", "When the Batmobile lands on its roof or side and stays there, it is put back on its wheels a second later.");

        _engine = AddSlider("batmobile_engine", "ENGINE POWER", "Harder acceleration and a higher top speed while driving, boost included. 1.00x is the game's own engine.",
            1f, 1f, 4f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times, v => { if (v <= 1f) _topSpeed.Restore(); });
        _grip = AddSlider("batmobile_grip", "TYRE GRIP", "How hard the tyres hold the road. Lower slides and drifts more, higher corners flat. Handbrake turns and drifts keep their own grip.",
            1f, 0.25f, 3f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times, v => { if (MathF.Abs(v - _gripApplied) > 0.001f) SetGrip(v); });

        _battleSpeed = AddSlider("batmobile_battle_speed", "BATTLE MODE SPEED", "How fast the Batmobile moves in battle mode. 1.00x is the game's own speed.",
            1f, 1f, 3f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times, v => { if (v <= 1f) _battleTopSpeed.Restore(); });
        _dodgeTwice = AddToggle("batmobile_double_dodge", "DOUBLE DODGE", "Battle mode's dodge can be used twice in a row, as with its upgrade, without buying it.",
            on => { if (!on) _doubleDodge.Restore(); });

        AddCommand("batmobile_jump", "BATMOBILE JUMP", "Launches the Batmobile into the air. Bind it to a key. It needs its wheels on the ground, so it can't climb the sky.", Jump);
        _jumpPower = AddSlider("batmobile_jump_power", "JUMP POWER", "How high BATMOBILE JUMP launches the car.", 1f, 0.5f, 4f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times).Pref();
        _airGravity = AddSlider("batmobile_air_gravity", "AIR GRAVITY", "How strongly the Batmobile falls once its wheels leave the ground, for longer, floatier jumps. Driving on the road is unchanged.",
            1f, 0.1f, 1f, 0.05f, 0.4f, Fmt.Percent);
        _superEject = AddToggle("batmobile_super_eject", "MAX SUPER EJECT", "Holding the eject button always builds up to the highest super eject, as if fully upgraded.",
            on => { if (!on) _eject.Restore(); });
    }

    private void DriveTick(float dt)
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RVehicleBatmobileBase car)
        {
            _tippedFor = 0f;
            return;
        }

        RVehicleSimBatmobile? sim = car.SimObj is RVehicleSimBatmobile { IsValid: true } found ? found : null;
        bool grounded = car.HasWheelsOnGround();
        if (grounded)
            _groundedAt = Clock.Now;

        if (_empProof.On)
        {
            _empVulnerable.Set(car, false);
            if (car.DisabledByEMP)
                car.SetDisabledByEMP(false);
        }

        if (_superEject.On)
            _eject.Set(car, EjectType.EBET_SuperEject2);
        if (_dodgeTwice.On)
            _doubleDodge.Set(car, true);

        // Scale only real values: a zero would mean the game doesn't use it.
        if (sim != null && _engine.Value > 1f)
            _topSpeed.Set(sim, o => o > 0.01f ? o * _engine.Value : o);
        if (sim != null && _battleSpeed.Value > 1f)
            _battleTopSpeed.Set(sim, o => o > 0.01f ? o * _battleSpeed.Value : o);

        // The winch can hold the car up a wall with no wheels down; leave that to the game.
        bool winched = sim is { Abseiling: true };
        // The autopilot sets its own pace for the corners ahead, so the engine doesn't push it.
        if (_engine.Value > 1f && grounded && !Piloting && _brakeCar == null)
            Push(car, dt);
        if (_airGravity.Value < 1f && !grounded && !winched)
            Float(car, dt);
        if (_selfRight.On && !winched)
            SelfRight(car, dt);
    }

    private void RestoreDrive()
    {
        _topSpeed.Restore();
        _battleTopSpeed.Restore();
        _eject.Restore();
        _doubleDodge.Restore();
        _empVulnerable.Restore();
        _tippedFor = 0f;
        _gravity = 0f;
    }

    private void Repair()
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase car = Car() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("there's no Batmobile in this area");
        car.GiveMaxHealth();
        car.GiveMaxEnergy();
    }

    // ---- engine

    /// <summary>Adds speed along the car's nose while the throttle is held, up to a cruise speed the slider scales.</summary>
    private void Push(RVehicleBatmobileBase car, float dt)
    {
        float throttle = car.Throttle;
        if (throttle <= 0.05f || car.CollisionComponent is not { IsValid: true } body || Safe.Try("battle mode check", car.IsInBattleMode))
            return;

        Vector3 forward = car.Rotation.ToDirection();
        float along = Vector3.Dot(car.Velocity, forward);
        float limit = MathF.Min(EngineCruise * _engine.Value, EngineSpeedLimit);
        if (along < -50f || along >= limit)
            return;

        float gain = MathF.Min((_engine.Value - 1f) * EngineAccel * throttle * dt, limit - along);
        body.SetRBLinearVelocity(forward * gain, true);
    }

    // ---- grip

    /// <summary>
    /// The cheat manager's own BatmobileSetTireFrictionMod, on the Batmobile's normal and battle mode tyres. It is a
    /// static native: the mod belongs to the tyre type, not to one car, so it outlasts a new car or a reload.
    /// </summary>
    private void SetGrip(float mod)
    {
        RVehicleBatmobileBase.DebugSetTireFrictionMod(TyreType.ETyreType_Batmobile, mod);
        RVehicleBatmobileBase.DebugSetTireFrictionMod(TyreType.ETyreType_BatmobileBattleMode, mod);
        _gripApplied = mod;
        Log.Info("Tyre grip set to " + mod.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "x.");
    }

    private void RestoreGrip()
    {
        if (MathF.Abs(_gripApplied - 1f) > 0.001f)
            Safe.Run("grip restore", () => SetGrip(1f));
    }

    // ---- air

    private void Jump()
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RVehicleBatmobileBase car)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("you are not driving the Batmobile");
        if (!car.HasWheelsOnGround() && Clock.Now - _groundedAt > JumpGroundGrace)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the Batmobile is already in the air");
        if (car.CollisionComponent is not { IsValid: true } body)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the Batmobile has no physics body right now");

        body.WakeRigidBody(FName.None);
        body.SetRBLinearVelocity(new Vector3(0f, 0f, JumpSpeed * _jumpPower.Value), true);
    }

    /// <summary>Cancels part of gravity while airborne, so jumps hang longer.</summary>
    private void Float(RVehicleBatmobileBase car, float dt)
    {
        if (car.CollisionComponent is not { IsValid: true } body)
            return;

        if (_gravity <= 0f)
        {
            if (World.WorldInfo is not { } wi)
                return;

            float scale = wi.RBPhysicsGravityScaling > 0f ? wi.RBPhysicsGravityScaling : 1f;
            _gravity = -wi.GetGravityZ() * scale;
            Log.Info("AIR GRAVITY: world gravity " + wi.GetGravityZ().ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ", rigid body scaling " +
                wi.RBPhysicsGravityScaling.ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ", so cars fall at " + _gravity.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " per second squared.");
            if (_gravity <= 0f)
                return;
        }

        body.SetRBLinearVelocity(new Vector3(0f, 0f, _gravity * (1f - _airGravity.Value) * dt), true);
    }

    // ---- auto-right

    /// <summary>Sets a car that has sat tipped over back on its wheels, the way the game's own FlipBatmobile cheat moves it.</summary>
    private void SelfRight(RVehicleBatmobileBase car, float dt)
    {
        Rotator r = car.Rotation;
        bool tipped = MathF.Abs(Wrap(r.Roll)) > TippedDegrees || MathF.Abs(Wrap(r.Pitch)) > TippedDegrees;
        bool stuck = tipped && car.Velocity.Length() < TippedSpeed && car.GetNumWheelsOnGround() < 2;
        _tippedFor = stuck ? _tippedFor + dt : 0f;
        if (_tippedFor < RightAfter || Clock.Now - _rightedAt < RightGap || car.Mesh is not { IsValid: true } mesh)
            return;

        _tippedFor = 0f;
        _rightedAt = Clock.Now;
        mesh.SetRBRotation(new Rotator(0f, r.Yaw, 0f), FName.None);
        mesh.SetRBPosition(car.Location + new Vector3(0f, 0f, RightLift), FName.None);
        mesh.SetRBAngularVelocity(Vector3.Zero, false);
        Log.Info("AUTO-RIGHT: the Batmobile was tipped over (roll " + Wrap(r.Roll).ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ", pitch " +
            Wrap(r.Pitch).ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "), put back on its wheels.");
    }

    private static float Wrap(float degrees)
    {
        degrees %= 360f;
        if (degrees > 180f)
            degrees -= 360f;
        else if (degrees < -180f)
            degrees += 360f;
        return degrees;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Batmobile/BatmobileRemote.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using SelfDrive = BmSDK.BmGame.RVehicle.ESelfDriveMode;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Remote control without the gadget and its restrictions. RPlayerController.RemoteControlBatmobile with bForceSwitch
/// skips CanCallBatmobile (no-call areas, EMP); it still refuses while Batman is attacked or chased unless the
/// area's AffectPlayerInfo.CanUseRemoteControlInCombat is set, which Oracle sets for that one call. A fight then
/// ends the remote drive unless the car's DoNotBreakRemoteControlIfBatmanInCombat is set. The range limit is the
/// edge of the city loaded around Batman (GRI.GetDistanceToVisibleStreamingBoundary), so it stays.
/// </summary>
internal sealed partial class Batmobile
{
    private readonly Held<RVehicleBatmobileBase, bool> _remoteKeeps = new("remote control in fights",
        b => b.DoNotBreakRemoteControlIfBatmanInCombat, (b, v) => b.DoNotBreakRemoteControlIfBatmanInCombat = v);

    private Toggle _remoteInFights = null!;

    private void BuildRemote()
    {
        AddCommand("remote_control", "REMOTE CONTROL BATMOBILE", "Starts driving the Batmobile by remote without the gadget, even where the game won't let you call it. Run it again to stop. If the car is out of range, the game brings it closer first, as the gadget does.",
            ToggleRemote);
        _remoteInFights = AddToggle("remote_in_fights", "REMOTE CONTROL IN FIGHTS", "Enemies going for Batman no longer cut the remote control off, and REMOTE CONTROL BATMOBILE works mid-fight.",
            on => { if (!on) _remoteKeeps.Restore(); }).Maintain(() => { if (Car() is { } car) _remoteKeeps.Set(car, true); });
    }

    private void ToggleRemote()
    {
        RPlayerController pc = World.Pc ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        if (pc.IsBatmobileRemoteDrive())
        {
            if (World.Pawn is not RVehicleBatmobileBase driven)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the remote drive is already ending");
            if (!driven.DriverLeave(true, false))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the game wouldn't end the remote drive");
            return;
        }

        if (World.Pawn is RVehicleBatmobileBase)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("you are sitting in the Batmobile");
        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer player)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        if (!Teleport.InCityMap(player.Location))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the remote doesn't reach from indoors");

        RVehicleBatmobileBase car = Car() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("there's no Batmobile in this area");
        // A car the story is holding or driving stays the story's.
        if (car.IsStolen || car.bControlledBySeqAct || car.SelfDriveMode != SelfDrive.SELFDRIVE_None)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is using the Batmobile right now");

        bool callable = Safe.Try("call check", pc.CanCallBatmobile);
        ref var area = ref pc.AffectPlayerInfo;
        bool combatAllowed = area.CanUseRemoteControlInCombat;
        bool started;
        try
        {
            if (_remoteInFights.On)
                area.CanUseRemoteControlInCombat = true;
            started = pc.RemoteControlBatmobile(car, true);
        }
        finally
        {
            area.CanUseRemoteControlInCombat = combatAllowed;
        }

        Log.Info("REMOTE CONTROL: the game " + (started ? "started" : "refused") + " the remote drive (the gadget could " + (callable ? "" : "not ") + "call the car here).");
        if (!started)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(_remoteInFights.On
                ? "the game refused, Batman may be mid-move or going through a door"
                : "the game refused, probably because Batman is under attack (see REMOTE CONTROL IN FIGHTS)");
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Batmobile/BatmobileSkin.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Replaces the Batmobile with an unlocked Showcase skin, which the game can only swap while the car is free.</summary>
internal sealed class BatmobileSkin : SkinSwap
{
    public static readonly BatmobileSkin I = new();

    private const int SettleTicks = 120;
    private const string SkinPrefix = "Playable_Batmobile";
    private const string JokerSkin = "Playable_BatmobileJoker";

    private enum Swap
    {
        Idle,
        WaitingForFree,
        Loading,
        WaitingForReplacement,
    }

    private Choice _skin = null!;
    private Swap _swap;
    private int _settle;
    private int _damage;

    protected override string Title => "BATMOBILE SKIN";

    protected override string LogName => "Batmobile skin";

    protected override bool Busy => _swap != Swap.Idle;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _skin = AddChoice("batmobile_skin", "BATMOBILE SKIN", "Shows the currently loaded skin. Choose another, then run APPLY BATMOBILE SKIN.", new[] { "" }, new[] { "OPEN MENU IN GAME" }).Pref();
        AddCommand("apply_batmobile_skin", "APPLY BATMOBILE SKIN", "Applies the selected skin. It waits until the Batmobile is free, then replaces it; leave the car first if you are driving.", Apply);
        AddCommand("cancel_batmobile_skin", "CANCEL SKIN CHANGE", "Cancels a skin change that is still waiting for the Batmobile to become free.", CancelPending);
    }

    private static bool TryLoaded(RGameRI game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerBatmobile loaded) =>
        Showcase.TryRead(() => game.PlayerBatmobiles[0], out loaded);

    private static string ActiveSkin(RPersistentOptions options) =>
        options.GetActivePlayerSkin(new FString("Batmobile"), true, false, true).ToString() ?? "";

    protected override void RefreshChoices(RGameInfo info, RGameRI game, RPersistentOptions options)
    {
        info.ShowcaseValidateSorting();
        var keys = new List<string>();
        var labels = new List<string>();
        foreach (RGameInfo.FShowcaseItem item in info.ShowcaseItems)
        {
            string skin = item.Skin.ToString() ?? "";
            string key = item.Item.ToString() ?? "";
            if (!skin.StartsWith(SkinPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || key.Length == 0 || !Showcase.IsUnlocked(options, item, key))
                continue;
            if (keys.Exists(k => k.Equals(skin, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                continue;

            keys.Add(skin);
            labels.Add(Showcase.Label(key, skin));
        }

        if (keys.Count == 0)
        {
            _skin.SetOptions(new[] { "" }, new[] { "NO UNLOCKED SKINS" });
            return;
        }

        // Prefer the player's last pick, then whatever is loaded, then the saved active skin.
        string[] keyArray = keys.ToArray();
        int fallback = -1;
        if (TryLoaded(game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerBatmobile loaded))
        {
            fallback = Index(keyArray, loaded.BatmobileName.ToString());
            if (fallback < 0)
                fallback = Index(keyArray, loaded.BatmobileDataName.ToString());
        }

        if (fallback < 0)
            fallback = Index(keyArray, ActiveSkin(options));

        _skin.SetOptions(keyArray, labels.ToArray(), Math.Max(0, fallback));
    }

    private static int Index(string[] keys, string? name) => name == null ? -1 : Array.FindIndex(keys, k => k.Equals(name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    private void Apply()
    {
        string requested = _skin.CurrentKey;
        if (requested.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no unlocked Batmobile skin is selected");

        RGameRI? game = World.Ri;
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (game == null || game.PersistentOptions is not { IsValid: true } options || pc == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("player game state unavailable");

        options.SetActivePlayerSkin(new FString(requested));
        pc.SaveGameOptionsToMemory();

        string resolved = ActiveSkin(options);
        if (resolved.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game could not resolve the selected Batmobile skin");
        if (!TryLoaded(game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerBatmobile current))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no loaded Batmobile data available");

        string currentName = current.BatmobileName.ToString() ?? "";
        if (currentName.Equals(resolved, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            Reset();
            Notice(_skin.State);
            return;
        }

        if (currentName.Equals(JokerSkin, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            Reset();
            Note("saved; the story's Jokerized Batmobile can't be replaced here.");
            Notice("SAVED FOR NEXT BATMOBILE");
            return;
        }

        Pending = resolved;
        _damage = current.DamageLevel;
        _settle = 0;
        _swap = Swap.WaitingForFree;
        Timer.Restart();
        Note("waiting until the Batmobile is free before changing to " + resolved + ".");

        if (World.Pawn is RVehicleBatmobileBase)
        {
            Menu.ReleaseMovement();
            Notice("EXIT VEHICLE TO APPLY");
        }
        else
            Notice(IsFree(pc) ? "APPLYING SKIN" : "WAITING FOR BATMOBILE");
    }

    private static bool IsFree(RPlayerController pc)
    {
        RGameInfo? info = World.Info;
        if (info == null)
            return false;

        RVehicleBatmobileBase? vehicle = info.GetBatmobile();
        return vehicle is not { IsValid: true } || (pc.Pawn?.Ptr != vehicle.Ptr && vehicle.Driver == null);
    }

    protected override void Step()
    {
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (pc == null)
        {
            Fail("player controller unavailable");
            return;
        }

        switch (_swap)
        {
            case Swap.WaitingForFree:
                _settle = IsFree(pc) ? _settle + 1 : 0;
                if (_settle < SettleTicks)
                    return;

                if (World.Info is not { } info)
                {
                    Fail("game info unavailable");
                    return;
                }

                info.LoadPB(new FName(Pending), _damage);
                _swap = Swap.Loading;
                Timer.Restart();
                Note("loading " + Pending + ".");
                return;

            case Swap.Loading:
                bool ready = false;
                if (World.Ri is { } game && TryLoaded(game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerBatmobile loaded))
                    ready = loaded.BatmobileData != null && ((loaded.MeshName.ToString() ?? "").Length == 0 || loaded.MeshData != null);

                if (!ready)
                {
                    if (TimedOut)
                        Fail("timed out loading " + Pending);
                    return;
                }

                World.Info!.PersistentData.SetPlayableBatmobile(new FName(Pending));
                _swap = Swap.WaitingForReplacement;
                _settle = 0;
                Timer.Restart();
                return;
        }

        _settle = IsFree(pc) ? _settle + 1 : 0;
        if (_settle < SettleTicks)
        {
            if (TimedOut)
                Fail("the Batmobile stayed occupied; the selected skin loads the next time it is called");
            return;
        }

        string applied = Pending;
        pc.CheatBatmobileSkinRepossess();
        if (World.Ri is { } after && TryLoaded(after, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerBatmobile now))
        {
            string mesh = now.MeshName.ToString() ?? "";
            if (mesh.Length > 0)
                after.ClearOutRootSetBatmobiles(new FString(mesh));
        }

        // The old vehicle is gone, so drop every cached reference to it.
        Batmobile.I.Forget();
        Reset();
        Note("replaced with " + applied + ".");
        Notice("CHANGED");
    }

    protected override void Reset()
    {
        _swap = Swap.Idle;
        _settle = 0;
        base.Reset();
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Camera/CameraRig.View.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using Pov = BmSDK.GameObject.FTPOV;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The finished picture. A redirect on the camera's UpdateCamera lets the game work out its view as usual, then
/// changes the result in the camera cache, which is what the screen, the sound and GetPlayerViewPoint read.
/// Before the next update the game's own view goes back into the cache, so nothing the game works out from last
/// frame's view sees Oracle's change, and switching anything off is instant.
///
/// Field of view is done here, not in the camera's per-state FOV values as before. Several states save the live
/// FOV back into their own value when they end (Walk, Look, and every aim and zoom state, which all run Look's
/// EndState), so rewriting those values compounded: each aim took an already changed FOV as vanilla and changed
/// it again. Offsets ease in and out, so a state change or a cutscene camera never pops.
/// </summary>
internal sealed partial class CameraRig
{
    private const float MinFov = 5f;
    private const float MaxFov = 150f;
    private const float EaseRate = 4f;
    private const int CatFoot = 0;
    private const int CatGlide = 1;
    private const int CatCar = 2;
    private const int CatAim = 3;

    private static readonly HashSet<string> AimStates = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) { "Batarang", "LineLauncherAim", "HarpoonAim", "MagneticBlastAim", "RHDAim" };

    private static readonly (string Key, string Label, float Ratio)[] Bars =
    {
        ("off", "OFF", 0f), ("185", "1.85 : 1", 1.85f), ("200", "2 : 1", 2f), ("239", "2.39 : 1", 2.39f), ("276", "2.76 : 1", 2.76f),
    };

    private Slider _fov = null!, _aim = null!, _glideFov = null!, _carFov = null!, _tilt = null!, _fpForward = null!;
    private Toggle _collision = null!, _firstPerson = null!, _hideHud = null!, _readout = null!;
    private Choice _bars = null!;

    // ---- the picture
    private FrameTimer _frame;
    private float _add, _mult = 1f, _roll;
    private bool _povWritten;
    private nint _povCam;
    private Pov _povGame, _povMine;
    private float _gameFov, _shownFov;
    private Vector3 _shownAt;
    private int _shownCat;
    private int _stateIndex = -1;
    private int _stateCat;
    private string _stateName = "";

    // ---- CAMERA THROUGH WALLS: what the game wants, to put back
    private bool _collisionHeld, _collisionGame;
    private nint _collisionCam;

    // ---- first person hides the cape, and puts back what it was
    private bool _capeHeld, _capeWas;
    private nint _capePawn;

    // ---- HIDE GAME HUD
    private bool _hudHidden;
    private nint _hudPtr;
    private Every _hudEvery;

    public override bool HasHud => _readout.On || _bars.Index > 0;

    /// <summary>Bars stay up under the open menu, so their look can be picked with the menu open.</summary>
    public override bool HudWithMenu => _bars.Index > 0;

    private void BuildView()
    {
        _fov = AddSlider("fov_world", "FIELD OF VIEW", "Widens or narrows the view everywhere you play: on foot, in fights and predator, gliding and in the Batmobile. It's added to the game's own view, so its zooms and speed effects still work. Cutscenes keep their framing.",
            0f, -20f, 40f, 1f, 15f, Fmt.Signed);
        _aim = AddSlider("fov_aim", "AIM & ZOOM FOV", "Field of view while aiming a gadget (batarang, line launcher, remote claw, hacking device, disruptor) and while zooming. Lower zooms in further, higher is wider.",
            1f, 0.5f, 1.6f, 0.05f, 1.3f, Fmt.Percent);
        _glideFov = AddSlider("glide_fov", "GLIDE FOV", "Extra field of view while gliding and dive-bombing, on top of FIELD OF VIEW.", 0f, -20f, 40f, 1f, 15f, Fmt.Signed);
        _carFov = AddSlider("car_fov", "BATMOBILE FOV", "Extra field of view while driving and in battle mode, on top of FIELD OF VIEW.", 0f, -20f, 40f, 1f, 15f, Fmt.Signed);
        _tilt = AddSlider("cam_tilt", "CAMERA TILT", "Rolls the view sideways for a slanted, film-style angle. Only the picture tilts; steering and aiming stay the same.",
            0f, -30f, 30f, 1f, 10f, v => MathF.Abs(v) < 0.01f ? "DEFAULT" : (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + Fmt.Degrees(v));
        _collision = AddToggle("cam_no_collision", "CAMERA THROUGH WALLS", "Stops walls and scenery pushing the camera in towards you, so it keeps its distance and can look through walls.");
        _firstPerson = AddToggle("cam_first_person", "FIRST PERSON", "Puts the camera in your character's eyes when on foot (EXPERIMENTAL). The cape is hidden while it's on. Steering and gadgets work as normal; the Batmobile and cutscenes keep their own camera.");
        _fpForward = AddSlider("cam_fp_forward", "FIRST PERSON EYE", "Moves the first person eye forwards out of the cowl, or back. Raise it if you see the inside of the head.",
            12f, -10f, 40f, 2f, 24f, Fmt.Count).Pref();
        _hideHud = AddToggle("cam_hide_hud", "HIDE GAME HUD", "Hides the game's HUD: health, minimap, prompts, markers and objectives. Oracle's menu and notices still show.");
        _bars = AddChoice("cam_bars", "CINEMATIC BARS", "Black bars across the top and bottom for a widescreen film look. Pick the shape of the picture.",
            Bars.Select(b => b.Key).ToArray(), Bars.Select(b => b.Label).ToArray()).Pref();
        _readout = AddToggle("fov_readout", "FOV READOUT", "Shows the live field of view (on screen and the game's own), the camera mode and state, and the camera distance in the bottom left corner.").Pref();
    }

    public override void Frame() => Safe.Run("hide hud", HudTick);

    private void LeftGameView()
    {
        _povWritten = false;
        _collisionHeld = false;
        _capeHeld = false;
        _hudHidden = false;
        _stateIndex = -1;
    }

    private void ShutdownView()
    {
        Safe.Run("camera view restore", () =>
        {
            R3rdPersonCamera? cam = PlayerCam();
            if (cam != null && _povWritten && _povCam == cam.Ptr)
            {
                ref Camera.FTCameraCache cache = ref cam.CameraCache;
                if (SamePov(cache.POV, _povMine))
                    cache.POV = _povGame;
            }

            _povWritten = false;
            if (cam != null && _collisionHeld && _collisionCam == cam.Ptr && cam.bDisableCameraCollision != _collisionGame)
                cam.bDisableCameraCollision = _collisionGame;
            _collisionHeld = false;
        });
        Safe.Run("cape restore", ReleaseCape);
        Safe.Run("hud restore", () =>
        {
            if (_hudHidden && World.Pc?.ModularHud is { IsValid: true } hud && hud.Ptr == _hudPtr)
                hud.ManuallySetHudVisibility(true);
            _hudHidden = false;
        });
    }

    // ---- the camera update

    [Redirect(typeof(R3rdPersonCamera), nameof(R3rdPersonCamera.UpdateCamera))]
    private static void UpdateCameraRedirect(R3rdPersonCamera self, float deltaTime)
    {
        CameraRig rig = I;
        PlayerController? pc = null;
        bool ours = false;
        try
        {
            ours = rig.BeforeUpdate(self, out pc);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled("camera before", "Camera update (before) failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
        }

        self.UpdateCamera(deltaTime);

        if (!ours || pc == null)
            return;

        try
        {
            rig.AfterUpdate(self, pc);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled("camera after", "Camera update (after) failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
        }
    }

    private bool BeforeUpdate(R3rdPersonCamera self, out PlayerController? pc)
    {
        pc = null;
        if (_readout == null)
            return false;

        R3rdPersonCamera? cam = PlayerCam();
        if (cam == null || cam.Ptr != self.Ptr || World.Pc is not { } player)
        {
            _povWritten = false;
            return false;
        }

        pc = player;
        if (_povWritten && _povCam == cam.Ptr)
        {
            ref Camera.FTCameraCache cache = ref cam.CameraCache;
            if (SamePov(cache.POV, _povMine))
                cache.POV = _povGame;
        }

        _povWritten = false;
        if (_noShake.On)
            ClearShakes(cam);
        if (_steady.On && cam.bSwayWithPelvis)
            cam.bSwayWithPelvis = false;
        PinCollision(cam);
        FreeCam.I.BeforeCamera(cam, player);
        return true;
    }

    private void AfterUpdate(R3rdPersonCamera cam, PlayerController pc)
    {
        float dt = _frame.Step(0.1f);
        ref Camera.FTCameraCache cache = ref cam.CameraCache;
        Pov game = cache.POV;
        Pov pov = game;

        bool changed = Lens(cam, pc, ref pov, dt, FreeCam.I.Active);
        changed |= FreeCam.I.View(cam, pc, game, ref pov, dt);

        _gameFov = game.FOV;
        _shownFov = pov.FOV;
        _shownAt = pov.Location;
        if (!changed)
            return;

        cache.POV = pov;
        _povGame = game;
        _povMine = pov;
        _povCam = cam.Ptr;
        _povWritten = true;
    }

    private static bool SamePov(in Pov a, in Pov b)
    {
        Rotator ra = a.Rotation, rb = b.Rotation;
        return Vector3.DistanceSquared(a.Location, b.Location) < 0.01f && MathF.Abs(a.FOV - b.FOV) < 0.01f
            && MathF.Abs(ra.Pitch - rb.Pitch) < 0.01f && MathF.Abs(ra.Yaw - rb.Yaw) < 0.01f && MathF.Abs(ra.Roll - rb.Roll) < 0.01f;
    }

    /// <summary>True while the camera shows the player's own view, not a cutscene or a special move's camera.</summary>
    internal static bool IsPlayerView(Camera cam, PlayerController pc)
    {
        if (!Mine(cam.ViewTarget.Target, pc))
            return false;

        Actor? pending = cam.PendingViewTarget.Target;
        return pending is not { IsValid: true } || Mine(pending, pc);
    }

    private static bool Mine(Actor? target, PlayerController pc) => target is { IsValid: true } && (target.Ptr == pc.Ptr || target is Pawn);

    internal static bool InCinematic(PlayerController pc) =>
        pc.bCinematicMode || pc is RPlayerControllerBase { ActiveCinematicMode: { IsValid: true } };

    // ---- field of view, tilt and first person

    private static int CategoryOf(string state)
    {
        if (state.Contains("Glid", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || state.Contains("Dive", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return CatGlide;
        if (AimStates.Contains(state) || state.Contains("Aim", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || state.Contains("Zoom", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || state.Contains("Sniper", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return CatAim;
        if (state.Contains("Driv", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || state.Contains("Batmobile", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || state.Contains("Battle", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || state.Contains("Boosting", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            || state.Contains("Chasing", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || state.Contains("Vehicle", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return CatCar;
        return CatFoot;
    }

    private int Category(R3rdPersonCamera cam)
    {
        FName state = cam.GetStateName();
        if (state.Index != _stateIndex)
        {
            _stateIndex = state.Index;
            _stateName = state.ToString() ?? "";
            _stateCat = CategoryOf(_stateName);
        }

        // The Z zoom can run inside a walking state.
        return _stateCat == CatFoot && cam.bZoomed ? CatAim : _stateCat;
    }

    private bool Lens(R3rdPersonCamera cam, PlayerController pc, ref Pov pov, float dt, bool free)
    {
        int cat = Category(cam);
        _shownCat = cat;
        bool player = IsPlayerView(cam, pc) && !InCinematic(pc);

        float add = 0f, mult = 1f, roll = 0f;
        if (player)
        {
            switch (cat)
            {
                case CatAim:
                    mult = _aim.Value;
                    break;
                case CatGlide:
                    add = _fov.Value + _glideFov.Value;
                    break;
                case CatCar:
                    add = _fov.Value + _carFov.Value;
                    break;
                default:
                    add = _fov.Value;
                    break;
            }

            roll = _tilt.Value;
        }

        float k = Ease.Follow(EaseRate, dt);
        _add = Settle(_add, add, k, 0.01f);
        _mult = Settle(_mult, mult, k, 0.001f);
        _roll = Settle(_roll, roll, k, 0.01f);

        bool eyes = !free && player && _firstPerson.On && cat != CatCar && FirstPerson(ref pov);
        if (!eyes)
            ReleaseCape();

        bool fov = MathF.Abs(_add) > 0.01f || MathF.Abs(_mult - 1f) > 0.001f;
        bool tilt = MathF.Abs(_roll) > 0.01f;
        if (fov && pov.FOV > 0f)
            pov.FOV = Math.Clamp(pov.FOV * _mult + _add, MinFov, MaxFov);
        if (tilt)
        {
            Rotator r = pov.Rotation;
            pov.Rotation = new Rotator(r.Pitch, r.Yaw, r.Roll + _roll);
        }

        return fov || tilt || eyes;
    }

    private static float Settle(float value, float target, float k, float snap)
    {
        value += (target - value) * k;
        return MathF.Abs(target - value) < snap ? target : value;
    }

    /// <summary>Moves the view into the character's eyes, a little forward so the cowl doesn't fill the screen.</summary>
    private bool FirstPerson(ref Pov pov)
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer p || !p.IsValid)
            return false;

        Vector3 eye = p.GetPawnViewLocation();
        if (!float.IsFinite(eye.X) || eye == Vector3.Zero)
            return false;

        float yaw = pov.Rotation.Yaw * (MathF.PI / 180f);
        pov.Location = eye + new Vector3(MathF.Cos(yaw), MathF.Sin(yaw), 0f) * _fpForward.Value;
        HoldCape(p);
        return true;
    }

    private void HoldCape(RPawnPlayer p)
    {
        if (p is not RPawnPlayerBmBase bm || bm.CapeComponent is not { IsValid: true } cape)
            return;

        if (!_capeHeld || _capePawn != p.Ptr)
        {
            ReleaseCape();
            _capeHeld = true;
            _capePawn = p.Ptr;
            _capeWas = cape.IsCapeHiddenGame;
        }

        if (!cape.IsCapeHiddenGame)
            cape.CapeSetHiddenGame(true);
    }

    private void ReleaseCape()
    {
        if (!_capeHeld)
            return;

        _capeHeld = false;
        if (World.Pawn is RPawnPlayerBmBase bm && bm.Ptr == _capePawn && bm.CapeComponent is { IsValid: true } cape && cape.IsCapeHiddenGame != _capeWas)
            cape.CapeSetHiddenGame(_capeWas);
    }

    // ---- effects run before each update

    private static void ClearShakes(R3rdPersonCamera cam)
    {
        RBMScreenShakeModifier shake = cam.ScreenShakeModifier;
        if (shake is { IsValid: true } && shake.Shakes.Count > 0)
            shake.Reset();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Holds camera collision off. A few first person states switch it themselves, so what the game last set is
    /// tracked and put back when the toggle goes off.
    /// </summary>
    private void PinCollision(R3rdPersonCamera cam)
    {
        if (_collisionHeld && _collisionCam != cam.Ptr)
            _collisionHeld = false;

        if (_collision.On)
        {
            bool now = cam.bDisableCameraCollision;
            if (!_collisionHeld)
            {
                _collisionHeld = true;
                _collisionCam = cam.Ptr;
                _collisionGame = now;
            }
            else if (!now)
            {
                _collisionGame = false;
            }

            if (!now)
                cam.bDisableCameraCollision = true;
        }
        else if (_collisionHeld)
        {
            _collisionHeld = false;
            if (cam.bDisableCameraCollision != _collisionGame)
                cam.bDisableCameraCollision = _collisionGame;
        }
    }

    // ---- HIDE GAME HUD

    /// <summary>
    /// Uses the switch photo mode uses to hide every HUD movie. The game turns it back on at times (menus,
    /// cutscenes), so it is asked again a few times a second while it should be hidden.
    /// </summary>
    private void HudTick()
    {
        bool want = _hideHud.On || FreeCam.I.HidesHud;
        if (!want && !_hudHidden)
            return;

        RGFxMovieModularHud? hud = World.Pc?.ModularHud is { IsValid: true } h ? h : null;
        if (want)
        {
            if (hud == null || (_hudHidden && hud.Ptr == _hudPtr && !_hudEvery.Elapsed(0.25)))
                return;

            hud.ManuallySetHudVisibility(false);
            _hudHidden = true;
            _hudPtr = hud.Ptr;
            return;
        }

        _hudHidden = false;
        if (hud != null && hud.Ptr == _hudPtr)
            hud.ManuallySetHudVisibility(true);
    }

    // ---- drawing

    public override void Draw(Canvas c)
    {
        DrawBars();
        if (_readout.On)
            DrawReadout();
    }

    private void DrawBars()
    {
        float ratio = Bars[Math.Clamp(_bars.Index, 0, Bars.Length - 1)].Ratio;
        if (ratio <= 0f)
            return;

        float bar = (Gfx.H - Gfx.W / ratio) * 0.5f;
        if (bar < 1f)
            return;

        Gfx.Rect(0f, 0f, Gfx.W, bar, Theme.Black);
        Gfx.Rect(0f, Gfx.H - bar, Gfx.W, bar, Theme.Black);
    }

    private void DrawReadout()
    {
        if (PlayerCam() == null)
            return;

        Pawn? pawn = World.Pawn;
        float dist = pawn != null ? Vector3.Distance(_shownAt, pawn.Location) : 0f;
        string mode = FreeCam.I.Active ? FreeCam.I.ModeLabel : _shownCat switch { CatGlide => "GLIDE", CatCar => "BATMOBILE", CatAim => "AIM", _ => "ON FOOT" };
        string line1 = "FOV " + _shownFov.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "  ON SCREEN";
        string line2 = "GAME " + _gameFov.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "  " + mode + "  " + _stateName.ToUpperInvariant();
        string line3 = "DISTANCE " + dist.ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        const float scale = 0.72f;
        float lh = Gfx.S(20);
        float w = Math.Max(Gfx.TextW(line2, scale), Gfx.TextW(line1, 0.85f)) + Gfx.S(32);
        float h = Gfx.S(22) + lh * 3f;
        float x = Gfx.S(24);
        float y = Gfx.H - h - Gfx.S(120);
        Gfx.Panel(x, y, w, h, 0.75f, 2f);
        float cy = y + Gfx.S(10) + lh * 0.5f;
        Gfx.TextMid(x + Gfx.S(14), cy, line1, Theme.Accent, 0.85f);
        Gfx.TextMid(x + Gfx.S(14), cy + lh, line2, Theme.Mid, scale);
        Gfx.TextMid(x + Gfx.S(14), cy + lh * 2f, line3, Theme.Mid, scale);
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using System.Reflection;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using CamConfig = BmSDK.BmGame.R3rdPersonCamera.FFreeCameraConfig;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The CAMERA page. This file rewrites the camera's per-state framing values (distance, height, shoulder, pivot,
/// glide and Batmobile distance, speed kicks, sway); <c>CameraRig.View.cs</c> changes the finished picture each
/// frame (field of view, tilt, first person, HUD, bars).
///
/// The game changes the framing values too, and many states save the live values back into their own config
/// when they end (Walk, AgilityWalk, the combat cameras). So every write is recorded, and when a value no longer
/// matches, only the parts the game really changed become the new vanilla baseline: a field still holding what
/// Oracle wrote keeps its old original. A value that turns up as an exact copy of what Oracle wrote to a sibling
/// (the Batmobile's three camera sets, the alternative walk camera) takes that sibling's original. Without this,
/// each save-back would be taken as vanilla and offset again, and the camera would creep further every time.
/// </summary>
internal sealed partial class CameraRig : Module
{
    public static readonly CameraRig I = new();

    private const double RecheckSeconds = 1.0;
    private const float Tolerance = 0.001f;
    private const string MemoryKey = "CameraMemory.v2";
    private const string OldMemoryKey = "CameraMemory";

    private delegate ref CamConfig CfgRef(R3rdPersonCamera cam);
    private delegate ref Vector3 VecRef(R3rdPersonCamera cam);

    private readonly record struct Rig(float Height, float Shoulder, float Pull, float Pivot, float GlideKick, float GlideDist, float CarKick, float CarDist, bool Steady, bool NoShake);

    private static readonly Rig Vanilla = new(0f, 1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 1f, 1f, 1f, false, false);

    private sealed record Preset(string Key, string Label, float Fov, float Height, float Shoulder, float Pull, float Pivot, float GlideFov, float GlideDist, float CarFov, float CarDist,
        float GlideKick = 1f, float CarKick = 1f);

    private static readonly Preset[] Presets =
    {
        new("pick", "CHOOSE", 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 1f),
        new("vanilla", "VANILLA", 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 1f),
        new("wide", "WIDE", 10f, 0f, 1f, 40f, 0f, 5f, 1.1f, 5f, 1.1f),
        new("ultra", "ULTRA WIDE", 20f, 0f, 1f, 30f, 0f, 10f, 1.1f, 10f, 1.1f),
        new("cinematic", "CINEMATIC", -5f, 15f, 0.8f, 120f, 10f, 0f, 1.3f, 0f, 1.25f),
        new("shoulder", "OVER SHOULDER", 0f, -5f, 1.3f, -40f, 0f, 0f, 0.9f, 0f, 1f),
        new("centred", "CENTRED", 5f, 10f, 0f, 60f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 1f),
        new("action", "ACTION", 15f, -10f, 1.15f, -30f, -5f, 10f, 0.9f, 10f, 0.95f, 1.75f, 1.75f),

    private static readonly string[] GlideKicks = { "GlidingCameraExtraFOVAngle" };
    private static readonly string[] CarKicks = { "DrivingCamMaxExtraFOV", "DrivingCamMaxExtraFOV1", "DrivingCamMaxExtraFOV2" };

    /// <summary>
    /// Hip sway and the running camera's overlay animation (RunLoop, played at RunOverlayStrength when a run
    /// starts), which is the handheld bob while running.
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly string[] SwayFloats = { "PelvisSway", "DefaultPelvisSway", "RunStatePelvisSway", "CurrentPelvisSway", "RunOverlayStrength" };

    private static readonly string[] GlideOffsets = { "GlidingCameraOffset", "BoostGlidingCameraOffset" };

    private static readonly string[] FootCfgs =
    {
        "WalkCamConfig", "WalkCanisterCamConfig", "AgilityWalkCamConfig", "AlternativeWalkCamConfig", "RunCamConfig", "RooftopRunCamConfig",
        "StealthCamConfig", "CombatWalkCamConfig", "CorridorCombatCamConfig", "HighCombatCamConfig", "DemonTrialsCamConfig", "RailingCamConfig",
        "GrateCameraConfig", "LedgeSwingCamConfig", "GrappleCamConfig", "HqGrappleStartCamConfig", "PerchLedgeCamConfig", "SilentPredatorCamConfig",
        "VantageClimbCamConfig", "IntroCamConfig", "FloorAttackCamConfig", "ThugCamConfig",
    };

    private static readonly string[] CarCfgs =
    {
        "DrivingCamConfig", "DrivingCamConfig1", "DrivingCamConfig2", "BoostingCamConfig", "BoostingCamConfig1", "BoostingCamConfig2",
        "BattleModeCamConfig", "BattleModeWinchCamConfig",
    };

    private static readonly FName DrivingState = new("DrivingCamera");
    private static readonly FName RunLoop = new("RunLoop");

    /// <summary>What has been written, kept in BCL and BmSDK types so a hot reload can restore the true vanilla values.</summary>
    private sealed class Memory
    {
        private readonly object[] _slots;

        public Memory(object[] slots) => _slots = slots;

        public static object[] Make() => new object[]
        {
            new Dictionary<string, float>(StringComparer.Ordinal), new Dictionary<string, float>(StringComparer.Ordinal),
            new Dictionary<string, Vector3>(StringComparer.Ordinal), new Dictionary<string, Vector3>(StringComparer.Ordinal),
            new Dictionary<string, CamConfig>(StringComparer.Ordinal), new Dictionary<string, CamConfig>(StringComparer.Ordinal),
            new long[2], new float[] { 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 1f, 1f, 1f, 0f, 0f },
        };

        public Dictionary<string, float> FloatOrig => (Dictionary<string, float>)_slots[0];
        public Dictionary<string, float> FloatWritten => (Dictionary<string, float>)_slots[1];
        public Dictionary<string, Vector3> VecOrig => (Dictionary<string, Vector3>)_slots[2];
        public Dictionary<string, Vector3> VecWritten => (Dictionary<string, Vector3>)_slots[3];
        public Dictionary<string, CamConfig> CfgOrig => (Dictionary<string, CamConfig>)_slots[4];
        public Dictionary<string, CamConfig> CfgWritten => (Dictionary<string, CamConfig>)_slots[5];
        private long[] Meta => (long[])_slots[6];
        private float[] Values => (float[])_slots[7];

        public nint Ptr
        {
            get => (nint)Meta[0];
            set => Meta[0] = value;
        }

        public bool Live
        {
            get => Meta[1] != 0;
            set => Meta[1] = value ? 1 : 0;
        }

        public Rig Applied
        {
            get
            {
                float[] a = Values;
                return new Rig(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6], a[7], a[8] > 0.5f, a[9] > 0.5f);
            }
            set
            {
                float[] a = Values;
                (a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6], a[7]) = (value.Height, value.Shoulder, value.Pull, value.Pivot, value.GlideKick, value.GlideDist, value.CarKick, value.CarDist);
                (a[8], a[9]) = (value.Steady ? 1f : 0f, value.NoShake ? 1f : 0f);
            }
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            FloatOrig.Clear();
            FloatWritten.Clear();
            VecOrig.Clear();
            VecWritten.Clear();
            CfgOrig.Clear();
            CfgWritten.Clear();
            Ptr = 0;
            Live = false;
            Applied = Vanilla;
        }
    }

    private readonly Dictionary<string, (Func<R3rdPersonCamera, float> Get, Action<R3rdPersonCamera, float> Set)?> _floats = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, CfgRef?> _cfgs = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, VecRef?> _vecs = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private Memory _mem = null!;
    private Every _recheck;

    private Slider _height = null!, _shoulder = null!, _pull = null!, _pivot = null!;
    private Slider _glideKick = null!, _glideDist = null!, _carKick = null!, _carDist = null!;
    private Toggle _steady = null!, _noShake = null!;
    private Choice _preset = null!, _carView = null!;

    // ---- BATMOBILE VIEW: applied once each time the driving camera starts
    private bool _carViewDone;
    private int _carViewTries;
    private Every _carViewStep;

    private Rig Wanted => new(_height.Value, _shoulder.Value, _pull.Value, _pivot.Value, _glideKick.Value, _glideDist.Value, _carKick.Value, _carDist.Value, _steady.On, _noShake.On);

    public override void Build()
    {

        _height = AddSlider("cam_height", "CAMERA HEIGHT", "Raises or lowers where the camera sits behind your character when on foot.", 0f, -60f, 120f, 5f, 30f, Fmt.Signed);

        _pivot = AddSlider("cam_pivot", "PIVOT HEIGHT", "Moves the point the camera orbits around and looks at up or down. Higher looks over your character's head.", 0f, -50f, 100f, 5f, 30f, Fmt.Signed);
```
