```cs
    }

    public override void Started()
    {
        // An Oracle from before the field of view moved to the final picture kept its record under the old key.
        // Its own unload put every value back, so the record is only dropped here.
        Shared.Set(OldMemoryKey, null);
        _mem = new Memory(Shared.Keep(MemoryKey, Memory.Make));
    }

    public override void LeftGame()
    {
        if (_mem.Ptr != 0)
            _mem.Clear();
        LeftGameView();
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        Safe.Run("camera restore", () =>
        {
            R3rdPersonCamera? cam = PlayerCam();
            if (cam != null && cam.Ptr == _mem.Ptr && (_mem.Live || _mem.Applied != Vanilla))
                Apply(cam, Vanilla);
        });
        ShutdownView();
    }

    private void ApplyPreset(int i)
    {
        if (i <= 0 || i >= Presets.Length)
            return;

        Preset p = Presets[i];
        Set(_fov, p.Fov);
        Set(_height, p.Height);
        Set(_shoulder, p.Shoulder);
        Set(_pull, p.Pull);
        Set(_pivot, p.Pivot);
        Set(_glideFov, p.GlideFov);
        Set(_glideDist, p.GlideDist);
        Set(_carFov, p.CarFov);
        Set(_carDist, p.CarDist);
        Set(_glideKick, p.GlideKick);
        Set(_carKick, p.CarKick);
        if (p.Key == "vanilla")
            Set(_aim, 1f);
    }

    private static void Set(Slider f, float v)
    {
        v = Math.Clamp(v, f.Min, f.Max);
        if (MathF.Abs(f.Value - v) < 0.0001f)
            return;

        f.Value = v;
        Settings.MarkDirty();
    }

    private void SwapShoulder()
    {
        float v = _shoulder.Value;
        if (MathF.Abs(v) < 0.05f)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the camera is centred");

        Set(_shoulder, -v);
    }

    private void ResetAll()
    {
        foreach (Slider f in new[] { _fov, _height, _shoulder, _pull, _pivot, _aim, _glideFov, _glideKick, _glideDist, _carFov, _carKick, _carDist, _tilt, _fpForward })
            Set(f, f.Default);

        foreach (Toggle t in new[] { _steady, _noShake, _collision, _firstPerson, _hideHud })
            t.On = false;

        _preset.ResetValue();
        _carView.ResetValue();
        _bars.ResetValue();
        Settings.MarkDirty();
    }

    internal static R3rdPersonCamera? PlayerCam() =>
        World.Pc?.PlayerCamera is R3rdPersonCamera { IsValid: true, IsClassDefaultObject: false } cam ? cam : null;

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        R3rdPersonCamera? cam = PlayerCam();
        if (cam == null)
            return;

        if (cam.Ptr != _mem.Ptr)
        {
            _mem.Clear();
            _mem.Ptr = cam.Ptr;
        }

        Rig want = Wanted;
        Rig applied = _mem.Applied;
        bool recheck = _recheck.Elapsed(RecheckSeconds);
        if ((want != applied || recheck) && !(want == Vanilla && applied == Vanilla && !_mem.Live))
            Apply(cam, want);

        CarViewTick(cam);
    }

    private void Apply(R3rdPersonCamera cam, Rig s)
    {
        Rig old = _mem.Applied;

        foreach (string n in GlideKicks)
            MapFloat(cam, n, GlideKicks, v => v * s.GlideKick);
        foreach (string n in CarKicks)
            MapFloat(cam, n, CarKicks, v => v * s.CarKick);
        foreach (string n in SwayFloats)
            MapFloat(cam, n, SwayFloats, v => s.Steady ? 0f : v);
        foreach (string n in GlideOffsets)
            MapVec(cam, n, GlideOffsets, v => v * s.GlideDist);

        // The run bob is an overlay animation started with the run, so one already playing is stopped here.
        if (s.Steady && !old.Steady)
            Safe.Run("run camera bob", () => cam.OverlayPlayer?.StopAnim(RunLoop, 0.3f));

        ApplyShake(cam, s.NoShake, old.NoShake);

        CamConfig current = cam.CurrentCameraConfig;
        CamConfig? live = null;
        foreach (string n in FootCfgs)
        {
            if (MapConfig(cam, n, FootCfgs, c => FootConfig(c, s), current, out CamConfig made) && live == null)
                live = made;
        }

        foreach (string n in CarCfgs)
        {
            if (MapConfig(cam, n, CarCfgs, c => CarConfig(c, s), current, out CamConfig made) && live == null)
                live = made;
        }

        if (live is { } config)
            cam.SetFreeCameraConfig(config);

        _mem.Applied = s;
        _mem.Live = s != Vanilla;
    }

    private static Vector3 SitMove(Vector3 v, Rig s) => new(v.X, v.Y * s.Shoulder, v.Z + s.Height);

    private static CamConfig FootConfig(CamConfig c, Rig s)
    {
        c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin = SitMove(c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin, s);
        c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax = SitMove(c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax, s);
        if (c.UseStateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp)
            c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp = SitMove(c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp, s);
        if (c.bUseSeparate43Settings)
        {
            c.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMin = SitMove(c.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMin, s);
            c.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMax = SitMove(c.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMax, s);
            c.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetLookUp = SitMove(c.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetLookUp, s);
        }

        Vector3 pivot = c.CameraPivotOffset;
        c.CameraPivotOffset = new Vector3(pivot.X, pivot.Y * s.Shoulder, pivot.Z + s.Pivot);
        c.MinFreeCameraDistance = MathF.Max(5f, c.MinFreeCameraDistance + s.Pull);
        c.MaxFreeCameraDistance = MathF.Max(5f, c.MaxFreeCameraDistance + s.Pull);
        return c;
    }

    private static CamConfig CarConfig(CamConfig c, Rig s)
    {
        float k = s.CarDist;
        c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin *= k;
        c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax *= k;
        if (c.UseStateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp)
            c.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp *= k;
        c.MinFreeCameraDistance *= k;
        c.MaxFreeCameraDistance *= k;
        return c;
    }

    private static bool Near(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => Vector3.DistanceSquared(a, b) < 0.0001f;

    private static bool Near(float a, float b) => MathF.Abs(a - b) < 0.01f;

    private static bool SameConfig(in CamConfig a, in CamConfig b)
    {
        return Near(a.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin, b.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin) && Near(a.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax, b.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax)
            && Near(a.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp, b.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp) && Near(a.CameraPivotOffset, b.CameraPivotOffset)
            && Near(a.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMin, b.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMin) && Near(a.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMax, b.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMax)
            && Near(a.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetLookUp, b.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetLookUp)
            && Near(a.MinFreeCameraDistance, b.MinFreeCameraDistance) && Near(a.MaxFreeCameraDistance, b.MaxFreeCameraDistance)
            && MathF.Abs(a.maxPitch - b.maxPitch) < 0.5f && MathF.Abs(a.ShortCamSpringConst - b.ShortCamSpringConst) < 0.01f;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A config the game changed, as its new vanilla: the game's values, except fields Oracle rewrites that still
    /// hold exactly what Oracle wrote there. Those came back in a save-back of the live camera, not from the game.
    /// </summary>
    private static CamConfig Merge(CamConfig now, in CamConfig written, in CamConfig orig)
    {
        if (Near(now.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin, written.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin))
            now.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin = orig.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMin;
        if (Near(now.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax, written.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax))
            now.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax = orig.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetMax;
        if (Near(now.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp, written.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp))
            now.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp = orig.StateFreeCameraSitOffsetUp;
        if (Near(now.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMin, written.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMin))
            now.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMin = orig.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMin;
        if (Near(now.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMax, written.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMax))
            now.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMax = orig.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetMax;
        if (Near(now.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetLookUp, written.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetLookUp))
            now.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetLookUp = orig.StateFreeCamera43SitOffsetLookUp;
        if (Near(now.CameraPivotOffset, written.CameraPivotOffset))
            now.CameraPivotOffset = orig.CameraPivotOffset;
        if (Near(now.MinFreeCameraDistance, written.MinFreeCameraDistance))
            now.MinFreeCameraDistance = orig.MinFreeCameraDistance;
        if (Near(now.MaxFreeCameraDistance, written.MaxFreeCameraDistance))
            now.MaxFreeCameraDistance = orig.MaxFreeCameraDistance;
        return now;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Writes one config, worked out from its vanilla value. True when this config is the one the camera is using
    /// right now (its content before this write matches the live config), so the caller pushes it live.
    /// </summary>
    private bool MapConfig(R3rdPersonCamera cam, string name, string[] group, Func<CamConfig, CamConfig> map, in CamConfig current, out CamConfig made)
    {
        made = default;
        CfgRef? get = Bind(_cfgs, name);
        if (get == null)
            return false;

        ref CamConfig slot = ref get(cam);
        CamConfig now = slot;
        if (!_mem.CfgWritten.TryGetValue(name, out CamConfig written))
            _mem.CfgOrig[name] = now;
        else if (!SameConfig(now, written))
            _mem.CfgOrig[name] = CopiedConfig(group, name, now) ?? Merge(now, written, _mem.CfgOrig[name]);

        made = map(_mem.CfgOrig[name]);
        bool changed = !SameConfig(now, made);
        if (changed)
            slot = made;
        _mem.CfgWritten[name] = made;

        return changed && SameConfig(current, now);
    }

    private CamConfig? CopiedConfig(string[] group, string name, in CamConfig now)
    {
        foreach (string other in group)
        {
            if (other != name && _mem.CfgWritten.TryGetValue(other, out CamConfig w) && SameConfig(now, w)
                && _mem.CfgOrig.TryGetValue(other, out CamConfig o) && !SameConfig(w, o))
                return o;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private void MapVec(R3rdPersonCamera cam, string name, string[] group, Func<Vector3, Vector3> map)
    {
        VecRef? get = Bind(_vecs, name);
        if (get == null)
            return;

        ref Vector3 slot = ref get(cam);
        Vector3 now = slot;
        if (!_mem.VecWritten.TryGetValue(name, out Vector3 written) || !Near(now, written))
            _mem.VecOrig[name] = CopiedVec(group, name, now) ?? now;

        Vector3 v = map(_mem.VecOrig[name]);
        if (!Near(now, v))
            slot = v;
        _mem.VecWritten[name] = v;
    }

    private Vector3? CopiedVec(string[] group, string name, Vector3 now)
    {
        foreach (string other in group)
        {
            if (other != name && _mem.VecWritten.TryGetValue(other, out Vector3 w) && Near(now, w)
                && _mem.VecOrig.TryGetValue(other, out Vector3 o) && !Near(w, o))
                return o;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private void MapFloat(R3rdPersonCamera cam, string name, string[] group, Func<float, float> map)
    {
        if (!_floats.TryGetValue(name, out var access))
        {
            PropertyInfo? p = typeof(R3rdPersonCamera).GetProperty(name);
            if (p != null && p.PropertyType == typeof(float) && p.CanWrite)
                access = (p.GetGetMethod()!.CreateDelegate<Func<R3rdPersonCamera, float>>(), p.GetSetMethod()!.CreateDelegate<Action<R3rdPersonCamera, float>>());
            else
                Log.Info("Camera value missing: " + name);
            _floats[name] = access;
        }

        if (access is not { } a)
            return;

        float now = a.Get(cam);
        if (!_mem.FloatWritten.TryGetValue(name, out float written) || MathF.Abs(now - written) > Tolerance)
            _mem.FloatOrig[name] = CopiedFloat(group, name, now) ?? now;

        float v = map(_mem.FloatOrig[name]);
        if (MathF.Abs(now - v) > 0.0001f)
            a.Set(cam, v);
        _mem.FloatWritten[name] = v;
    }

    private float? CopiedFloat(string[] group, string name, float now)
    {
        foreach (string other in group)
        {
            if (other != name && _mem.FloatWritten.TryGetValue(other, out float w) && MathF.Abs(now - w) <= Tolerance
                && _mem.FloatOrig.TryGetValue(other, out float o) && MathF.Abs(w - o) > Tolerance)
                return o;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static T? Bind<T>(Dictionary<string, T?> cache, string name) where T : Delegate
    {
        if (cache.TryGetValue(name, out T? bound))
            return bound;

        MethodInfo? m = typeof(R3rdPersonCamera).GetProperty(name)?.GetGetMethod();
        bound = m?.CreateDelegate<T>();
        if (bound == null)
            Log.Info("Camera entry missing: " + name);
        cache[name] = bound;
        return bound;
    }

    private static void ApplyShake(R3rdPersonCamera cam, bool off, bool wasOff)
    {
        CameraModifier m = cam.CameraShakeCamMod;
        if (m is not { IsValid: true })
            return;

        if (off && !m.bDisabled)
            m.DisableModifier(true);
        else if (!off && wasOff && m.bDisabled)
            m.EnableModifier();
    }

    // ---- BATMOBILE VIEW

    private void RestartCarView()
    {
        _carViewDone = false;
        _carViewTries = 0;
    }

    private static bool Driving(R3rdPersonCamera cam) =>
        Safe.Try("driving camera", () => cam.IsChildState(cam.GetStateName(), DrivingState));

    /// <summary>
    /// Steps the driving camera to the chosen one with the game's own toggle, once per drive, so the game's key
    /// and its deep-water switch still win afterwards.
    /// </summary>
    private void CarViewTick(R3rdPersonCamera cam)
    {
        int want = _carView.Index - 1;
        if (want < 0 || !Driving(cam))
        {
            RestartCarView();
            return;
        }

        if (_carViewDone)
            return;

        if ((int)cam.DrivingCameraSetup == want || _carViewTries >= 3)
        {
            _carViewDone = true;
            return;
        }

        if (!cam.CanToggleDrivingCam || !_carViewStep.Elapsed(0.4))
            return;

        _carViewTries++;
        cam.ToggleDrivingCam();
    }

    private void NextCarView()
    {
        R3rdPersonCamera cam = PlayerCam() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("no camera yet");
        if (!Driving(cam))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("get in the Batmobile first");
        if (!cam.CanToggleDrivingCam)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game won't switch cameras right now");

        cam.ToggleDrivingCam();
        _carViewDone = true;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Camera/FreeCam.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using Pov = BmSDK.GameObject.FTPOV;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// FREE CAMERA and TRIPOD. Both take over the finished picture in CameraRig's camera update, so the game's own
/// camera keeps running underneath: it still turns with the mouse or right stick, and each frame's turn is passed
/// on, which keeps the player's own sensitivity and invert settings. The game's debug and photo cameras swap the
/// player controller out, which would leave Oracle without a player, so they aren't used.
///
/// FREE CAMERA holds Batman still (his update and animation stop, as in EDITOR MODE) and mutes the game's keys the
/// way the menu does, so WASD flies the camera instead of walking him. TRIPOD leaves the camera where it is and
/// gives Batman back, optionally turning to keep him in shot.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class FreeCam : Module
{
    public static readonly FreeCam I = new();

    private enum Mode
    {
        Off,
        Fly,
        Tripod,
    }

    private const float Metre = 100f;
    private const float PitchLimit = 89f;
    private const int GamePitchLimit = 15000;
    private const float RollSpeed = 45f;
    private const float ZoomSpeed = 1.2f;
    private const float MinFov = 5f;
    private const float MaxFov = 120f;
    private const float BlendSeconds = 0.4f;
    private const double HintSeconds = 8.0;
    private const float GroundReach = 5000f;
    private const float ChestHeight = 40f;
    private const float Deg = 180f / MathF.PI;

    // Virtual-key codes, read straight from the keyboard.
    private const int VkShift = 0x10, VkControl = 0x11, VkAlt = 0x12, VkSpace = 0x20;

    /// <summary>Every key flying reads. Oracle hotkeys on these wait while flying.</summary>
    private static readonly int[] FlyKeys = { 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', 'Q', 'E', 'Z', 'X', 'C', 'T', 'B', 'P', 'H', VkSpace, VkControl, VkShift, VkAlt };

    private static readonly string[] Hint =
    {
        "WASD  FLY      SPACE / CTRL  UP / DOWN",
        "SHIFT  FAST    ALT  SLOW     MOUSE  LOOK",
        "Q / E  TILT    Z / X  ZOOM   C  STRAIGHTEN",
        "T  TRIPOD HERE    B  PUT BATMAN HERE",
        "P  FREEZE WORLD   H  HIDE THESE KEYS",
    };

    private Toggle _fly = null!, _tripod = null!, _track = null!, _freeze = null!, _hud = null!;
    private Slider _speed = null!, _smooth = null!, _look = null!;

    private Mode _mode;
    private Vector3 _pos, _vel;
    private float _yaw, _pitch, _roll, _fov, _startFov;
    private float _viewYaw, _viewPitch;
    private bool _haveLast;
    private float _lastYaw, _lastPitch;
    private readonly bool[] _was = new bool[256];
    private double _hintUntil;
    private bool _muted;

    // ---- Batman, held still while flying
    private nint _pawn;
    private bool _held, _wasTickOff, _wasAnimsPaused, _wasGrounded;

    // ---- the game camera's pitch limits, opened up while flying so the mouse can look straight up or down
    private nint _pinCam;
    private bool _pinned;
    private int _minPitch, _maxPitch;

    private bool _worldFrozen;
    private float _blend;
    private Pov _blendFrom;
    private string? _ended;

    public bool Active => _mode != Mode.Off;

    public bool HidesHud => _mode != Mode.Off && _hud.On;

    public string ModeLabel => _mode == Mode.Tripod ? "TRIPOD" : "FREE CAMERA";

    public override bool HasHud => _mode == Mode.Fly && Clock.Now < _hintUntil;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _fly = AddToggle("cam_free", "FREE CAMERA",
            "Detach the camera and fly it anywhere. WASD fly, SPACE and CTRL go up and down, SHIFT is faster and ALT slower, the mouse looks. Q and E tilt, Z and X zoom, C straightens and resets the zoom. T leaves the camera there as a TRIPOD, B puts Batman down under the camera, P freezes the world, H shows the keys. The city only loads around Batman, so far away looks rough.",
            OnFly).Unsaved();
        _speed = AddSlider("cam_free_speed", "FLY SPEED", "How fast FREE CAMERA flies. SHIFT is four times this, ALT a quarter.", 8f, 1f, 50f, 1f, 20f, v => Fmt.Count(v) + " M/S").Pref();
        _smooth = AddSlider("cam_free_smooth", "SMOOTH MOVES", "Eases the free camera into and out of its moves and turns, for smooth film-style shots. 0% starts and stops dead.",
            0.3f, 0f, 1f, 0.05f, 0.75f, Fmt.Percent).Pref();
        _look = AddSlider("cam_free_look", "LOOK SPEED", "How fast the free camera turns, on top of the game's own mouse and stick sensitivity.", 1f, 0.25f, 3f, 0.05f, 0.5f, Fmt.Times).Pref();
        _freeze = AddToggle("cam_free_freeze", "HOLD BATMAN STILL", "Freezes Batman mid-move while you fly, mid-glide and mid-fight included. Off, he keeps moving on his own but his controls stay with the camera.",
            on: true).Pref();
        _hud = AddToggle("cam_free_hud", "HIDE HUD WHILE ON", "Hides the game's HUD while FREE CAMERA or TRIPOD is on.", on: true).Pref();
        _tripod = AddToggle("cam_tripod", "TRIPOD",
            "Leaves the camera where it is and gives you Batman back, like a fixed film camera. Press T in FREE CAMERA to choose the spot, or turn this on to keep the current view.",
            OnTripod).Unsaved();
        _track = AddToggle("cam_tripod_track", "FOLLOW BATMAN", "The tripod turns to keep Batman in shot.", on: true).Pref();
    }

    /// <summary>An Oracle hotkey on a key flying uses waits, unless it's one that turns the camera off.</summary>
    public bool Claims(Keys key, IReadOnlyList<Feature> features) =>
        _mode == Mode.Fly && !Menu.IsOpen && Array.IndexOf(FlyKeys, (int)key & 0xFF) >= 0 && !features.Contains(_fly) && !features.Contains(_tripod);

    public override void WorldChanged() => Safe.Run("free camera", () => Stop(false));

    public override void LeftGame() => Safe.Run("free camera", () => Stop(false));

    public override void Shutdown() => Safe.Run("free camera", () => Stop(false));

    public override void Frame()
    {
        if (_ended == null)
            return;

        Overlay.Notice("FREE CAMERA", _ended, false);
        _ended = null;
    }

    // ---- turning on and off

    private void OnFly(bool on)
    {
        if (on)
            Try(_fly, StartFly, () => _fly.On = _mode == Mode.Fly);
        else if (_mode == Mode.Fly)
            Stop(true);
    }

    private void OnTripod(bool on)
    {
        if (on)
            Try(_tripod, StartTripod, () => _tripod.On = _mode == Mode.Tripod);
        else if (_mode == Mode.Tripod)
            Stop(true);
    }

    private static void Try(Feature row, Action change, Action revert)
    {
        try
        {
            change();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Safe.Run("free camera revert", revert);
            Log.Info(row.Label + " failed: " + ex.Message);
            Overlay.Notice(row.Label, ex.Message.ToUpperInvariant(), false);
        }
    }

    private static (PlayerController Pc, R3rdPersonCamera Cam) Require()
    {
        Transition.RequireIdle();
        if (WorldEditor.I.ModeOn)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("turn off EDITOR MODE first");

        PlayerController pc = World.Pc ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        R3rdPersonCamera cam = CameraRig.PlayerCam() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("no camera yet");
        if (!CameraRig.IsPlayerView(cam, pc) || CameraRig.InCinematic(pc))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("not during a cutscene");

        return (pc, cam);
    }

    private void StartFly()
    {
        if (_mode == Mode.Fly)
            return;

        if (_mode == Mode.Off)
        {
            (_, R3rdPersonCamera cam) = Require();
            TakePose(cam);
        }
        else if (WorldEditor.I.ModeOn)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("turn off EDITOR MODE first");
        }

        _mode = Mode.Fly;
        _fly.On = true;
        _tripod.On = false;
        _vel = Vector3.Zero;
        _haveLast = false;
        _blend = 0f;
        if (_freeze.On)
            Hold(World.Pawn);
        if (World.Pc is { } pc)
            MuteKeys(pc);

        // Keys already down (the hotkey that started this) count only once they're let go.
        foreach (int vk in FlyKeys)
            _was[vk] = true;
        _hintUntil = Clock.Now + HintSeconds;
    }

    private void StartTripod()
    {
        if (_mode == Mode.Tripod)
            return;

        if (_mode == Mode.Fly)
        {
            GiveBack();
        }
        else
        {
            (_, R3rdPersonCamera cam) = Require();
            TakePose(cam);
        }

        _mode = Mode.Tripod;
        _tripod.On = true;
        _fly.On = false;
        _blend = 0f;
    }

    /// <summary>Ends either mode. With <paramref name="blend"/> the view glides back to the game's camera.</summary>
    private void Stop(bool blend)
    {
        Mode was = _mode;
        _mode = Mode.Off;
        _fly.On = false;
        _tripod.On = false;
        GiveBack();
        _blend = 0f;
        if (blend && was != Mode.Off)
        {
            _blendFrom = Pose();
            _blend = BlendSeconds;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Hands Batman, the keys, the camera's pitch limits and the world back to the game.</summary>
    private void GiveBack()
    {
        Release();
        Unmute();
        Unpin();
        Thaw();
    }

    private void End(string why)
    {
        Stop(true);
        _ended = why;
    }

    private void TakePose(R3rdPersonCamera cam)
    {
        Pov pov = cam.CameraCache.POV;
        Rotator r = pov.Rotation;
        _pos = pov.Location;
        _yaw = _viewYaw = r.Yaw;
        _pitch = _viewPitch = Math.Clamp(Wrap(r.Pitch), -PitchLimit, PitchLimit);
        _roll = Wrap(r.Roll);
        _fov = _startFov = pov.FOV > 1f ? pov.FOV : 70f;
    }

    private Pov Pose() => new() { Location = _pos, Rotation = new Rotator(_viewPitch, _viewYaw, _roll), FOV = _fov };

    // ---- Batman, keys, pitch limits, world

    private void Hold(Pawn? pawn)
    {
        // The Batmobile isn't frozen, only its controls are taken.
        if (pawn is not RPawnPlayer p)
            return;

        _pawn = p.Ptr;
        _held = true;
        _wasTickOff = p.bTickIsDisabled;
        _wasAnimsPaused = p.Mesh is { IsValid: true } mesh && mesh.bPauseAnims;
        _wasGrounded = p.Physics == Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_Walking;
        Still(p);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Stops Batman's own update and animation. AK ignores IgnoreMoveInput, and a pad's stick isn't a key, so
    /// muting keys alone would still let him walk.
    /// </summary>
    private static void Still(RPawnPlayer p)
    {
        if (!p.bTickIsDisabled)
            p.SetTickIsDisabled(true);
        if (p.Mesh is { IsValid: true } mesh && !mesh.bPauseAnims)
            mesh.bPauseAnims = true;
    }

    private void Release()
    {
        if (!_held)
            return;

        _held = false;
        Safe.Run("free camera release", () =>
        {
            if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer p || p.Ptr != _pawn)
                return;

            if (p.bTickIsDisabled != _wasTickOff)
                p.SetTickIsDisabled(_wasTickOff);
            if (p.Mesh is { IsValid: true } mesh && mesh.bPauseAnims != _wasAnimsPaused)
                mesh.bPauseAnims = _wasAnimsPaused;

            // Frozen mid-move, he can wake up in a pose where WASD does nothing. Mid-air he is left alone, so a
            // glide or a fall carries on; landing gives him a fresh pose anyway.
            if (_wasGrounded)
                Teleport.Settle(p, moved: false);
        });
    }

    /// <summary>The menu and radial unmute every key when they close, so flying takes its keys back after them.</summary>
    private void MuteKeys(PlayerController pc)
    {
        _muted = true;
        if (!GameKeys.IsMuted && !Menu.IsOpen && !Radial.IsLive)
            GameKeys.Mute(pc, editor: true);
    }

    private void Unmute()
    {
        if (!_muted)
            return;

        _muted = false;
        if (!Menu.IsOpen && !Radial.IsLive)
            Safe.Run("free camera keys", () => GameKeys.Unmute(World.Pc));
    }

    private void Pin(R3rdPersonCamera cam)
    {
        if (!_pinned || _pinCam != cam.Ptr)
        {
            _pinned = true;
            _pinCam = cam.Ptr;
            _minPitch = cam.MinPitch;
            _maxPitch = cam.maxPitch;
        }

        if (cam.MinPitch != -GamePitchLimit)
            cam.MinPitch = -GamePitchLimit;
        if (cam.maxPitch != GamePitchLimit)
            cam.maxPitch = GamePitchLimit;
    }

    private void Unpin()
    {
        if (!_pinned)
            return;

        _pinned = false;
        Safe.Run("free camera pitch", () =>
        {
            if (CameraRig.PlayerCam() is not { } cam || cam.Ptr != _pinCam)
                return;

            if (cam.MinPitch == -GamePitchLimit)
                cam.MinPitch = _minPitch;
            if (cam.maxPitch == GamePitchLimit)
                cam.maxPitch = _maxPitch;
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Freezes everything but the player, the way the game's debug camera does. Mods stop ticking while it's on
    /// (Oracle's menu and hotkeys keep going from the render hook), so flying runs in the camera update.
    /// </summary>
    private void ToggleWorld()
    {
        if (_worldFrozen)
        {
            Thaw();
        }
        else
        {
            WorldInfo wi = World.WorldInfo ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
            if (wi.bPlayersOnly)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the game already has the world frozen");

            wi.bPlayersOnly = true;
            _worldFrozen = true;
        }

        Overlay.Toast("FREEZE WORLD", _worldFrozen ? "ON" : "OFF", _worldFrozen);
    }

    private void Thaw()
    {
        if (!_worldFrozen)
            return;

        _worldFrozen = false;
        Safe.Run("world unfreeze", () =>
        {
            if (World.WorldInfo is { bPlayersOnly: true } wi)
                wi.bPlayersOnly = false;
        });
    }

    /// <summary>Puts Batman on the ground under the camera, facing the way it looks, and ends flying.</summary>
    private void BringBatman()
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer p)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("get out of the Batmobile first");

        if (!Teleport.Ray(p, _pos, _pos - Vector3.UnitZ * GroundReach, out Vector3 floor, out _))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no ground under the camera");

        Release();
        Teleport.Place(p, floor + Vector3.UnitZ * Teleport.Lift(p), new Rotator(0f, _yaw, 0f));
        p.SetPhysics(Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_Falling, true);
        Teleport.Settle(p);
        Stop(false);
    }

    // ---- each frame, from the camera update

    /// <summary>Before the game's camera update: keep Batman still, the keys muted and the pitch limits open.</summary>
    public void BeforeCamera(R3rdPersonCamera cam, PlayerController pc)
    {
        if (_mode != Mode.Fly)
            return;

        try
        {
            Pin(cam);
            MuteKeys(pc);
            if (_held)
            {
                if (World.Pawn is RPawnPlayer p && p.Ptr == _pawn)
                    Still(p);
                else
                    End("ENDED: BATMAN CHANGED");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Fail(ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// After the game's camera update: replaces the view. <paramref name="game"/> is the game's own view this
    /// frame (its turn drives the free camera's), <paramref name="pov"/> what the screen shows otherwise.
    /// </summary>
    public bool View(R3rdPersonCamera cam, PlayerController pc, in Pov game, ref Pov pov, float dt)
    {
        if (_mode == Mode.Off)
            return BlendBack(ref pov, dt);

        try
        {
            if (CameraRig.InCinematic(pc))
            {
                End("ENDED FOR A CUTSCENE");
                return BlendBack(ref pov, dt);
            }

            if (_mode == Mode.Fly)
            {
                // A special move or scripted camera took over (Batman is held, so it's the game's doing).
                if (!CameraRig.IsPlayerView(cam, pc))
                {
                    End("ENDED: THE GAME TOOK THE CAMERA");
                    return BlendBack(ref pov, dt);
                }

                FlyStep(game.Rotation, dt);
            }
            else
            {
                TripodStep(dt);
            }

            if (_mode == Mode.Off)
                return BlendBack(ref pov, dt);

            pov = Pose();
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Fail(ex);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>After a mode ends, glides the view from where the free camera was back to the game's.</summary>
    private bool BlendBack(ref Pov pov, float dt)
    {
        if (_blend <= 0f)
            return false;

        _blend -= dt;
        pov = Lerp(_blendFrom, pov, Ease.Smooth(1f - Math.Max(_blend, 0f) / BlendSeconds));
        return true;
    }

    private void Fail(Exception ex)
    {
        Log.Info("Free camera stopped: " + Log.Why(ex));
        Safe.Run("free camera stop", () => Stop(false));
        _ended = "STOPPED: " + ex.Message.ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    private static bool Down(int vk) => (Native.GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) != 0;

    /// <summary>True on the frame a key goes down.</summary>
    private bool Pressed(int vk)
    {
        bool down = Down(vk);
        bool was = _was[vk];
        _was[vk] = down;
        return down && !was;
    }

    private void FlyStep(Rotator game, float dt)
    {
        bool listening = !Menu.IsOpen && !Radial.IsLive && Native.GameInFront() && !World.Paused;

        // The game's camera turned this much from the mouse or stick; the free camera turns the same.
        if (_haveLast && listening)
        {
            _yaw += Wrap(game.Yaw - _lastYaw) * _look.Value;
            _pitch = Math.Clamp(_pitch + Wrap(game.Pitch - _lastPitch) * _look.Value, -PitchLimit, PitchLimit);
        }

        _lastYaw = game.Yaw;
        _lastPitch = game.Pitch;
        _haveLast = true;

        Vector3 move = Vector3.Zero;
        float boost = 1f;
        if (listening)
        {
            Vector3 forward = Forward(_yaw, _pitch);
            Vector3 right = Right(_yaw);
            if (Down('W')) move += forward;
            if (Down('S')) move -= forward;
            if (Down('D')) move += right;
            if (Down('A')) move -= right;
            if (Down(VkSpace)) move += Vector3.UnitZ;
            if (Down(VkControl)) move -= Vector3.UnitZ;
            boost = Down(VkShift) ? 4f : Down(VkAlt) ? 0.25f : 1f;

            if (Down('Q')) _roll = Wrap(_roll - RollSpeed * dt);
            if (Down('E')) _roll = Wrap(_roll + RollSpeed * dt);
            if (Down('Z')) _fov = Math.Clamp(_fov * MathF.Exp(-ZoomSpeed * dt), MinFov, MaxFov);
            if (Down('X')) _fov = Math.Clamp(_fov * MathF.Exp(ZoomSpeed * dt), MinFov, MaxFov);
        }
        else
        {
            // Nothing pressed while the menu had the keys counts once it closes.
            foreach (int vk in FlyKeys)
                _was[vk] = true;
        }

        Vector3 want = move.LengthSquared() > 0.0001f ? Vector3.Normalize(move) * (_speed.Value * Metre * boost) : Vector3.Zero;
        float s = _smooth.Value;
        float k = s <= 0.001f ? 1f : Ease.Follow(25f + (1.5f - 25f) * s, dt);
        _vel += (want - _vel) * k;
        _pos += _vel * dt;
        Turn(dt, 30f + (3f - 30f) * s);

        if (!listening)
            return;

        if (Pressed('C'))
        {
            _roll = 0f;
            _fov = _startFov;
        }

        if (Pressed('H'))
            _hintUntil = Clock.Now < _hintUntil ? 0.0 : double.MaxValue;
        if (Pressed('P'))
            Act("FREEZE WORLD", ToggleWorld);
        if (Pressed('T'))
            Act("TRIPOD", StartTripod);
        else if (Pressed('B'))
            Act("PUT BATMAN HERE", BringBatman);
    }

    private void TripodStep(float dt)
    {
        if (_track.On && World.Pawn is { IsValid: true } p)
        {
            Vector3 d = p.Location + Vector3.UnitZ * ChestHeight - _pos;
            float flat = MathF.Sqrt(d.X * d.X + d.Y * d.Y);
            if (flat > 1f || MathF.Abs(d.Z) > 1f)
            {
                _yaw = _viewYaw + Wrap(MathF.Atan2(d.Y, d.X) * Deg - _viewYaw);
                _pitch = Math.Clamp(MathF.Atan2(d.Z, flat) * Deg, -PitchLimit, PitchLimit);
            }
        }

        Turn(dt, 12f + (2f - 12f) * _smooth.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>The shown view follows where the camera is aimed; instantly when the rate is high.</summary>
    private void Turn(float dt, float rate)
    {
        float k = rate >= 29f ? 1f : Ease.Follow(rate, dt);
        _viewYaw += Wrap(_yaw - _viewYaw) * k;
        _viewPitch += (_pitch - _viewPitch) * k;
    }

    private void Act(string what, Action action)
    {
        try
        {
            action();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Overlay.Notice(what, ex.Message.ToUpperInvariant(), false);
        }
    }

    // ---- maths

    private static float Wrap(float deg)
    {
        deg %= 360f;
        if (deg > 180f)
            deg -= 360f;
        else if (deg < -180f)
            deg += 360f;
        return deg;
    }

    private static Vector3 Forward(float yaw, float pitch)
    {
        float y = yaw / Deg, p = pitch / Deg;
        return new Vector3(MathF.Cos(p) * MathF.Cos(y), MathF.Cos(p) * MathF.Sin(y), MathF.Sin(p));
    }

    private static Vector3 Right(float yaw)
    {
        float y = yaw / Deg;
        return new Vector3(-MathF.Sin(y), MathF.Cos(y), 0f);
    }

    private static Pov Lerp(in Pov a, in Pov b, float t)
    {
        Rotator ra = a.Rotation, rb = b.Rotation;
        return new Pov
        {
            Location = Vector3.Lerp(a.Location, b.Location, t),
            Rotation = new Rotator(ra.Pitch + Wrap(rb.Pitch - ra.Pitch) * t, ra.Yaw + Wrap(rb.Yaw - ra.Yaw) * t, ra.Roll + Wrap(rb.Roll - ra.Roll) * t),
            FOV = a.FOV + (b.FOV - a.FOV) * t,
        };
    }

    // ---- the keys hint

    public override void Draw(Canvas c)
    {
        const float scale = 0.72f;
        float lh = Gfx.S(20);
        float w = Hint.Max(l => Gfx.TextW(l, scale)) + Gfx.S(32);
        float h = Gfx.S(22) + lh * (Hint.Length + 1);
        float x = Gfx.S(24);
        float y = Gfx.S(90);
        Gfx.Panel(x, y, w, h, 0.75f, 2f);
        float cy = y + Gfx.S(10) + lh * 0.5f;
        Gfx.TextMid(x + Gfx.S(14), cy, _worldFrozen ? "FREE CAMERA - WORLD FROZEN" : "FREE CAMERA", Theme.Accent, 0.85f);
        for (int i = 0; i < Hint.Length; i++)
            Gfx.TextMid(x + Gfx.S(14), cy + lh * (i + 1), Hint[i], Theme.Mid, scale);
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The PLAYER/COMBAT page. AUTO COUNTER and AUTO DODGE use the same calls as the game's own dev combat bot
/// (RCombatMove_VillainAttack.BotTryCounter / BotTryRedirect): TryCounter(false) on a counterable attack aimed at
/// the player, TryRedirect(attacker) on a red one. A counter window opens in CanCounterStart, which lights the icon
/// for every attack but only sets bCanCounter for ACT_Counter, ACT_Blade and ACT_Fury.
/// </summary>
internal sealed partial class Combat : Module
{
    public static readonly Combat I = new();

    private const float WatchRange = 2500f;
    private const double WatchSeconds = 0.25;
    private const double EvadeAfter = 0.25;
    private const double WindowLife = 2.0;
    private const float ChargeVault = 500f;
    private const float ChargeStop = 300f;

    /// <summary>Penalty-free resets COMBO NEVER RESETS still lets through: the fight banking its XP, and leaving on foot.</summary>
    private static readonly HashSet<string> BankingReasons = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        "Combat xp spawned", "Possessed Bmbl", "Enter Batmobile", "Entering Bmbl", "Interrogating", "Interrogation",
    };

    public Toggle CounterIcons = null!;
    public Toggle AutoCounter = null!;
    public Toggle AutoDodge = null!;
    public Toggle ComboLock = null!;
    public Toggle AutoFight = null!;
    public Toggle AlwaysTakedown = null!;
    public Toggle GunMiss = null!;
    public Slider ComboMulti = null!;

    private const double StrikeGap = 0.12;
    private const float StrikeReach = 1500f;
    private static readonly Random Rng = new();
    private Every _strikeGap;

    private readonly List<RPawnVillain> _watch = new();
    private Every _rewatch;

    /// <summary>Red attacks whose counter window is open, by move, with the attacker and when it opened.</summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<nint, (RCombatMove_VillainAttack Move, RPawnVillain Villain, double Opened)> _redOpen = new();

    /// <summary>Attack moves already answered, so one charge isn't vaulted twice. Moves are reused, so entries expire.</summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<nint, double> _answered = new();
    private readonly HashSet<string> _reported = new();

    public override void Build()
    {
        AutoCounter = AddToggle("auto_counter", "AUTO COUNTER", "Counters every attack aimed at you the moment its counter window opens, knife slashes included.",
            on => { if (!on) Forget(); }).EveryTick(CounterTick);
        AutoDodge = AddToggle("auto_dodge_red", "AUTO DODGE RED ATTACKS", "Vaults over red unblockable attacks and charging thugs. A charge that can't be vaulted is stopped, as a batarang would.",
            on => { if (!on) Forget(); }).EveryTick(DodgeTick);
        ComboLock = AddToggle("combo_lock", "COMBO NEVER RESETS", "Getting hit, missing a strike, double evading or waiting too long no longer resets your combo multiplier during a fight. It still banks normally when the fight ends.");
        ComboMulti = AddSlider("combo_multiplier", "COMBO MULTIPLIER", "Every hit adds this many to your combo instead of one, so special takedowns and the freeflow bonus come much sooner.",
            1f, 1f, 10f, 1f, 3f, Fmt.Multiplier);
        AutoFight = AddToggle("auto_fight", "AUTO FIGHT", "Batman fights by himself: he counters and dodges every attack, picks the best move from his whole moveset, and learns from every fight.",
            on => { if (!on) { Forget(); ReleaseTakedown(); } }).EveryTick(FightTick);
        Command forget = AddCommand("auto_fight_forget", "FORGET AUTO FIGHT TRAINING", "AUTO FIGHT forgets everything it has learned, including the training it ships with, and learns again from nothing. Reinstall Oracle to get the shipped training back.", ForgetTraining).Setting().Confirmed();
        forget.ConfirmPrompt = () => "FORGET EVERYTHING AUTO FIGHT HAS LEARNED?";
        GunMiss = AddToggle("gun_miss", "AUTO DODGE GUNFIRE", "Gunmen still open fire on you, but every shot misses.");

        AddToggle("one_hit_ko", "ONE HIT KO", "Every enemy near you is left on 1 health, so any hit knocks them out.").Maintain(Npcs.I.LeaveOnOneHealth);
        AddConsoleToggle("upgraded_batsuit", "UPGRADED BATSUIT", "Turns on the batsuit's combat upgrades.", new ConsoleProp("RPawnPlayerCombat", "bUpgradedBatsuit", "True", "False"));
        AlwaysTakedown = DebugFlags.AddFlag("always_takedown", "ALWAYS TAKEDOWN READY", "Special combo takedowns are always ready, no combo needed.",
            d => d.Debug_Combat_CanAlwaysTakedown, (d, v) => d.Debug_Combat_CanAlwaysTakedown = v);
        DebugFlags.AddFlag("freeflow_focus", "FREEFLOW FOCUS ALWAYS", "Freeflow focus is always available in fights.",
            d => d.Debug_Combat_AlwaysFreeflowFocusMode, (d, v) => d.Debug_Combat_AlwaysFreeflowFocusMode = v);
        CounterIcons = AddToggle("counter_icons", "COUNTER ICONS IN NG+", "Brings back the counter warning icons above attacking enemies in New Game + and Knightmare.");

        DebugFlags.AddFlag("silent_takedowns", "SILENT COMBAT TAKEDOWNS", "Combat takedowns are silent, so nearby enemies don't hear them.",
            d => d.Debug_Player_ForceSilentCombatTakedowns, (d, v) => d.Debug_Player_ForceSilentCombatTakedowns = v);
        DebugFlags.AddFlag("env_takedowns", "ENVIRONMENT TAKEDOWNS", "Batman uses environmental takedowns whenever a wall or object is near.",
            d => d.Debug_Combat_ForceEnvironmentUse, (d, v) => d.Debug_Combat_ForceEnvironmentUse = v);
        AddConsoleToggle("predator_combos", "COMBO TAKEDOWNS IN PREDATOR", "Combo takedowns work in predator encounters too.",
            new ConsoleProp("RPawnPlayerCombat", "bCanDoComboTakedownOnPredator", "True", "False"));
        AddConsoleToggle("double_shockwave", "DOUBLE SHOCKWAVE LANDING", "Shockwave landings trigger a second shockwave.",
            new ConsoleProp("RSpecialMoveConfig_ShockwaveLand", "bTriggerSecondaryShockwave", "True", "False"));
    }

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        DebugFlags.Forget();
        Forget();
    }

    public override void LeftGame() => Forget();

    private void Forget()
    {
        _watch.Clear();
        _redOpen.Clear();
        _answered.Clear();
        _seen.Clear();
        _rewatch.Force();
        _specialFailed.Clear();
        _pending = null;
    }

    // ---- who might be attacking

    /// <summary>The player when on foot and able to fight; null in a vehicle or menu.</summary>
    private static RPawnPlayerCombat? Fighter() => World.InGame && World.Pawn is RPawnPlayerCombat { IsValid: true } me && !me.bDeleteMe ? me : null;

    private static bool Aims(RCombatMove_VillainAttack m, RPawnPlayerCombat me) => m.Target is { IsValid: true } t && t.Ptr == me.Ptr;

    /// <summary>Enemies close enough to attack soon. Rebuilt a few times a second; each entry is re-validated before use.</summary>
    private List<RPawnVillain> Watch(RPawnPlayerCombat me)
    {
        if (!_rewatch.Elapsed(WatchSeconds))
            return _watch;

        _watch.Clear();
        Vector3 at = me.Location;
        foreach (RPawnVillain v in World.All<RPawnVillain>())
        {
            if (!v.bDeleteMe && !v.bGoodAsDead && Vector3.DistanceSquared(v.Location, at) <= WatchRange * WatchRange)
                _watch.Add(v);
        }

        return _watch;
    }

    private void Report(string key, string text)
    {
        if (_reported.Add(key))
            Log.Info(text);
    }

    private bool Answered(nint move)
    {
        double now = GameNow;
        if (_answered.TryGetValue(move, out double at) && now - at < WindowLife)
            return true;

        return false;
    }

    // ---- AUTO COUNTER

    private void CounterTick() => Counter();

    /// <summary>Counters an attack aimed at the player if one is in its window. True when Batman did something.</summary>
    private bool Counter()
    {
        if (Fighter() is not { } me)
            return false;

        foreach (RPawnVillain v in Watch(me))
        {
            if (!v.IsValid || v.bDeleteMe || v.CombatMove is not { IsValid: true } move)
                continue;

            // Group (slow-mo) attacks are RCombatMove_VillainSimultaneousAttack, which derives from RCombatMove, not
            // RCombatMove_VillainAttack. Its CanCounterStart is empty: the window is per attacker in
            // VillainList[i].bCanCounter, read through its own CanCounter(), the same check TrySimultaneousCounter uses.
            string kind, cls;
            bool open, swinging;
            if (move is RCombatMove_VillainSimultaneousAttack group)
            {
                kind = "group attack";
                cls = "group attack";
                // CanCounter only goes true in the slow-motion moment, which the game skipped while Batman was mid-strike
                // and the group hit him with no try made. TryCounter(false) on a group attack in progress can't whiff, so
                // it is tried throughout.
                swinging = group.IsAttacking();
                open = group.CanCounter() || swinging;
            }
            else if (move is RCombatMove_VillainAttack m && Aims(m, me))
            {
                kind = m.AttackCounterType.ToString();
                cls = move.Class.Name;
                open = m.bCanCounter;
                swinging = m.IsAttacking();
            }
            else
                continue;

            Seen seen = Observe(move, kind, open, swinging, v);
            if (!open)
                continue;

            LearnLead(seen, cls);
            if (seen.OpenAt == 0)
                seen.OpenAt = GameNow;
            // Batman's own move still on its way: the counter waits a moment for it to land, since a counter that cuts it
            // off breaks the combo and one straight after it keeps it.
            if (move is RCombatMove_VillainAttack holdable && HoldCounter(holdable, seen))
                continue;

            // bCanFail false: never plays the whiff animation (which would also clear the combo). TryCounter hands
            // group attacks to TrySimultaneousCounter itself; each call counters the next attacker in the group.
            RPawnPlayerCombat.ETryCounterResult result;
            _defending = true;
            try
            {
                result = me.TryCounter(false, 0f);
            }
            finally
            {
                _defending = false;
            }

            seen.Tries++;
            seen.Last = result.ToString();
            seen.BatmanMove = me.CombatMove is { IsValid: true } bm ? bm.Class.Name : "none";
            if (result != RPawnPlayerCombat.ETryCounterResult.ETCR_Nothing)
            {
                BrainDefended(seen.Foe);
                seen.Countered = true;
                if (seen.Held)
                    HeldCounterLanded();
                Report("counter " + kind + " " + result, "Auto counter: " + result + " against " + kind + " (" + move.Class.Name + ").");
            }

            // One try per tick. TryCounter itself picks up simultaneous attackers.
            return result != RPawnPlayerCombat.ETryCounterResult.ETCR_Nothing;
        }

        return false;
    }

    // ---- missed-counter diagnostics
    // Every attack aimed at the player that auto counter sees is remembered briefly: whether its window opened and
    // what TryCounter said. When a hit still lands, DamagedBy logs the attacker against that record, so a log after a
    // fight shows which kind of attack slips through and why.

    private const double SeenLife = 4.0;
    private const int MaxHitReports = 40;
    private int _hitReports;

    private sealed class Seen
    {
        public required string Kind;

        /// <summary>The attacker's kind (thug, shield, knife...), for AUTO FIGHT's per-kind attack rates.</summary>
        public string Foe = "thug";
        public double At;

        /// <summary>When the attack was first seen aimed at Batman, and when it first swung (0 if not yet): AUTO FIGHT learns lead times from them.</summary>
        public double First, SwingFirst;

        /// <summary>When its counter window opened, and whether AUTO FIGHT held the counter for its own move to land.</summary>
        public double OpenAt;
        public bool Held, Countered, WindowClosed;
        public bool Sampled;
        public bool WindowOpened;
        public int Tries;
        public string Last = "not tried";
        public string BatmanMove = "";
    }

    private readonly Dictionary<nint, Seen> _seen = new();

    private Seen Observe(RCombatMove move, string kind, bool open, bool swinging, RPawnVillain attacker)
    {
        double now = GameNow;
        // Seen every tick while it lasts, so a gap means the move object is being reused for a new attack.
        if (!_seen.TryGetValue(move.Ptr, out Seen? s) || now - s.At > 0.3)
        {
            s = new Seen { Kind = kind, First = now, Foe = move is RCombatMove_VillainSimultaneousAttack ? "group" : KindOf(attacker) };
            _seen[move.Ptr] = s;
            LearnAttackStarted(s.Foe);
            TokenAttackStarted();
        }

        s.At = now;
        if (swinging && s.SwingFirst == 0)
            s.SwingFirst = now;
        s.WindowOpened |= open;

        if (_seen.Count > 64)
        {
            foreach (nint stale in _seen.Where(kv => now - kv.Value.At > SeenLife).Select(kv => kv.Key).ToList())
                _seen.Remove(stale);
        }

        return s;
    }

    private void ExplainHit(RPawnPlayerCombat me, RPawnCombat.FDamageInfo dmg, RPawnCombat.DamageResult result)
    {
        if (!(AutoCounter.On || AutoFight.On) || result is not (RPawnCombat.DamageResult.DMG_Hit or RPawnCombat.DamageResult.DMG_KO))
            return;

        string by = dmg.Attacker is { IsValid: true } a ? a.Class.Name : "nothing";
        BrainHit();
        _hitsThisFight++;
        _hitsBy[by] = _hitsBy.GetValueOrDefault(by) + 1;
        if (_hitReports >= MaxHitReports)
            return;

        _hitReports++;
        string type = dmg.DamageType is { IsValid: true } t ? t.Name : "?";
        string batman = me.CombatMove is { IsValid: true } bm ? bm.Class.Name : "none";
        string text = "Missed counter? Hit by " + by + " with " + type + (dmg.bCanBeBlocked ? "" : " (unblockable)")
                      + ". Batman was in " + batman + ", bCanDoCounter=" + me.bCanDoCounter + ".";

        if (dmg.Attacker is RPawnVillain { IsValid: true } v && v.CombatMove is { IsValid: true } move)
        {
            text += " Attacker move " + move.Class.Name;
            if (move is RCombatMove_VillainAttack m)
                text += " (" + m.AttackCounterType + ", aimed at you " + Aims(m, me) + ", bCanCounter now " + m.bCanCounter + ")";

            if (_seen.TryGetValue(move.Ptr, out Seen? held) && held.Held && GameNow - held.At <= SeenLife)
            {
                text += " (AUTO FIGHT had held this counter for its own move)";
                HeldCounterHit();
            }

            text += _seen.TryGetValue(move.Ptr, out Seen? s) && GameNow - s.At <= SeenLife
                ? ". Auto counter saw it: window opened " + s.WindowOpened + ", tries " + s.Tries + ", last result " + s.Last
                  + (s.Tries > 0 ? " while Batman was in " + s.BatmanMove : "") + "."
                : ". Auto counter never saw this attack.";
        }
        else if (dmg.Attacker is RPawnVillain { IsValid: true })
            text += " Attacker had no combat move.";

        Log.Info(text);
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RPawnPlayerCombat), nameof(RPawnPlayerCombat.DamagedBy))]
    private static RPawnCombat.DamageResult DamagedByRedirect(RPawnPlayerCombat self, RPawnCombat.FDamageInfo dmgInfo)
    {
        RPawnCombat.DamageResult result = self.DamagedBy(dmgInfo);
        if (I.AutoCounter is { On: true } || I.AutoFight is { On: true })
            Safe.Run("missed counter report", () => I.ExplainHit(self, dmgInfo, result));
        return result;
    }

    // ---- AUTO FIGHT
    // Oracle's own fighter, the game's dev bot is not used. Each tick, in order:
    //   1. Defence, by reflex. Counter any attack whose window is open; knife combos count as held and end in the
    //      finishing counter. A charging enemy gets a quick batarang (the batarang's auto-aim ranks chargers at 1000);
    //      red attacks and charges that still close in are vaulted (DodgeTick).
    //   2. A pending gadget takedown fires, a running beatdown keeps going.
    //   3. Offence, by the brain (FightBrain.cs), whenever a new move can start without losing the combo: every move
    //      possible right now is scored by expected value, using timings and success rates it learns as it fights.
    //      Tough enemies (shields, stun sticks, guns, brutes, armour, electrified, ninjas) only ever get specials.
    //      ALWAYS TAKEDOWN READY is held on during fights so those specials are always there.
    // Specials, snatches and environment attacks are spawned on the chosen enemy or object directly, doing what the
    // button handlers do minus their stick-based target search. Quick gadgets aim along MovementDir, which is pointed
    // at the target only for the instant of the throw.

    private const double SpecialGap = 0.6;
    private const double SpecialRetry = 3.0;
    private const float SpecialReach = 900f;
    private const float CloseReach = 600f;
    private const double SuperDelay = 0.15;
    // Well beyond vault range (ChargeVault): a batarang at a charger 0.07 s before the vault on the same charger broke
    // the combo twice, because the vault started while the batarang still had the window shut.
    private const float BatarangMin = 800f;
    private const float BatarangMax = 2000f;
    private const int MaxTraces = 120;
    // Short: the brain waits for each gadget to land (its learned time) before the next move anyway; a 1.5 s gap here
    // left Batman idle after gadgets.
    private const double GadgetGap = 0.5;
    private const double ComboWait = 0.5;
    // Takedowns and weapon destroys only reopen the combo (SetContinueComboTimer) when they finish, after 2-3 s.
    private const double MoveWait = 6.0;
    private const double ElectroTakedownGap = 3.0;
    private const double LastResort = 0.35;

    private const double IdleReport = 3.0;
    private double _lastMoveAt;
    private double _idleReportedAt;
    private Every _profileGap;
    private nint _waitMove;
    private double _waitMoveAt;
    private const float BeatdownReach = 450f;

    /// <summary>A thug Oracle just cape-stunned to start a beatdown on, and when.</summary>
    private RPawnVillain? _beatdownTarget;
    private double _beatdownAt;
    private double _comboClosedAt;

    private const float GadgetReach = 1200f;

    /// <summary>The game's own combo numbers this fight, for the end-of-fight line: biggest combo and variation.</summary>
    private int _maxCombo;
    private int _maxVariation;

    /// <summary>Why the combo was reset this fight, by the game's reason string, and how often.</summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _breaks = new();
    private readonly HashSet<string> _usedThisFight = new();

    /// <summary>When each kind of move may be used again (seconds of GameNow), so the moveset rotates.</summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<string, double> _moveReadyAt = new();

    /// <summary>Tough enemies whose special didn't start, by pawn, and when: they're passed over for a while.</summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<nint, double> _specialFailed = new();

    /// <summary>Charges a batarang was already thrown at.</summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<nint, double> _bataranged = new();

    /// <summary>When a quick gadget just thrown should be upgraded to its gadget takedown (0 for none).</summary>
    private double _superAt;

    /// <summary>True while AUTO FIGHT holds ALWAYS TAKEDOWN READY on for a fight.</summary>
    private bool _forcedTakedown;

    private int _hitsThisFight;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _hitsBy = new();
    private int _traces;

    // Quick gadgets are listed with the brain (GadgetMoves). No quick explosive gel: it only sprays until detonated, so it
    // never lands in combo terms, and three logged combo breaks came straight after it.

    private void FightTick()
    {
        RPawnPlayerCombat? me = Fighter();
        RPlayerControllerCombat? pc = World.Pc as RPlayerControllerCombat;
        if (me == null || pc == null)
        {
            EndFight();
            return;
        }

        // 1. Defence, even in the moment before the game counts it as a fight (a stun stick landed there once).
        // Counter and dodge run here only when their own rows are off, so nothing runs twice in a tick.
        if (!AutoCounter.On && Counter())
            return;
        if (!AutoDodge.On)
            DodgeTick();

        if (!pc.IsInCombat(false))
        {
            EndFight();
            return;
        }

        ForceTakedown();
        Watchdog(pc, me);
        _maxCombo = Math.Max(_maxCombo, pc.ComboSize);
        _maxVariation = Math.Max(_maxVariation, pc.MaxComboVariation);

        // The charger batarang is a move like any other: thrown while Batman's last move hadn't landed, it broke combos
        // of 36 and 25. So it waits for the combo to allow a new move; the vault still answers the charge if it can't.
        if ((pc.ComboSize <= 0 || pc.CanContinueCombo()) && BatarangCharger(pc, me))
            return;

        // 2. Follow-ups.
        if (_superAt > 0 && GameNow >= _superAt)
        {
            _superAt = 0;
            nint before = MovePtr(me);
            pc.UpgradeQuickGadgetToSuperGadget();
            if (MovePtr(me) != before)
            {
                Used("gadget takedown");
                Trace("gadget takedown.");
            }
        }

        // A cape stun Oracle started: release it at once for the quick stun (the button-release handler reaches the
        // ChargeUp state's UnLeashStun), then strike the stunned thug once the stun lands, which starts a beatdown.
        if (me.CombatMove is RCombatMove_BatmanStunStrike { IsValid: true })
            pc.BlockBreakerReleased();
        if (_beatdownTarget is { } bdt)
        {
            bool live = GameNow - _beatdownAt < 1.5 && bdt.IsValid && !bdt.bDeleteMe && !bdt.bGoodAsDead && bdt.Health > 0;
            if (!live)
            {
                Trace("beatdown attempt on " + Describe(bdt) + " ended without a beatdown.");
                _beatdownTarget = null;
            }
            else if (me.CombatMove is RCombatMove_BatmanBeatdown)
            {
                Trace("beatdown on " + Describe(bdt) + ".");
                _beatdownTarget = null;
            }
            else if (pc.CanContinueCombo())
            {
                me.TryStrike(0f, bdt);
                return;
            }
        }

        if (me.CombatMove is RCombatMove_BatmanBeatdown { IsValid: true } beat)
        {
            Used("beatdown");
            // Only while the window is open (each beatdown hit reopens it): pressed after the beatdown had closed it, the
            // strike became a heavy strike that broke a combo of 7.
            if (pc.CanContinueCombo() && beat.Target is RPawnVillain { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false } bt)
                me.TryStrike(0f, bt);
            return;
        }

        CountExposure(me);
        ExpirePending();
        SettleReactions(force: false);
        SettlePounce();
        TokenTick(pc);

        // 3. The brain picks the next move, whenever one can start without losing the combo. The window's last moments
        // are part of its sums (waiting then costs the whole combo), so no separate last-moment rule is needed.
        if (!_strikeGap.Elapsed(StrikeGap) || !ComboOpen(pc, me))
            return;

        if (_profileGap.Elapsed(1.0))
        {
            foreach (RPawnVillain v in Watch(me))
            {
                if (v.IsValid && !v.bDeleteMe && !v.bGoodAsDead)
                    Profile(me, v);
            }
        }

        Think(pc, me);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether a new move can start without losing the combo. NewComboMoveStarted clears the combo ("New move started
    /// and cant continue combo") unless CanContinueCombo (bAllowCombo), then disables it until the move lands. So after
    /// a move starts, the next one waits for it to connect, however long its animation (throws take over a second).
    /// Only when Batman has been out of any move for ComboWait without the combo reopening (a gadget that missed) does
    /// he go on anyway, rather than stand idle.
    /// </summary>
    private bool ComboOpen(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me)
    {
        // A strike the instant the last hit lands is a critical strike, so strikes never wait once the combo reopens.
        if (pc.ComboSize <= 0 || pc.CanContinueCombo())
        {
            _comboClosedAt = 0;
            return true;
        }

        if (me.CombatMove is { IsValid: true } move)
        {
            // Some moves wait for the next press rather than landing on their own (the throw's grab waits for where to
            // throw him). Waiting for those to land would freeze Batman in the pose, so after MoveWait in one move he
            // acts anyway.
            _comboClosedAt = 0;
            if (move.Ptr != _waitMove)
            {
                _waitMove = move.Ptr;
                _waitMoveAt = GameNow;
            }

            if (GameNow - _waitMoveAt < MoveWait)
                return false;

            Trace("stuck " + MoveWait + " s in " + move.Class.Name + " waiting for the combo; going on.");
            _waitMoveAt = GameNow;
            return true;
        }

        if (_comboClosedAt == 0)
            _comboClosedAt = GameNow;
        if (GameNow - _comboClosedAt < ComboWait)
            return false;

        // Waited out with Batman idle: the last move never landed (a gadget that missed). The brain counts it as a
        // failure of that move and goes on.
        ResolvePending(false, "never landed");
        return true;
    }

    // ---- defence extras

    /// <summary>
    /// A charging enemy gets a quick batarang while he's still some way off. The batarang's auto-aim ranks a charge at
    /// 1000 (GetBatarangPriority), so it goes for him; a hit sets bQuickBataranged and slows him. If it misses, the
    /// charge is vaulted when it gets close, as before.
    /// </summary>
    private bool BatarangCharger(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me)
    {
        foreach (RPawnVillain v in Watch(me))
        {
            if (!v.IsValid || v.bDeleteMe || v.CombatMove is not RCombatMove_VillainChargeAttack { IsValid: true } c)
                continue;
            // Move objects are reused for later charges, so a charge counts as answered only for a few seconds.
            if (!c.bCharging || c.bStartedGrab || c.bQuickBataranged || !Aims(c, me)
                || _bataranged.TryGetValue(c.Ptr, out double thrown) && GameNow - thrown < 4)
                continue;

            float dist = Vector3.Distance(v.Location, me.Location);
            if (dist < BatarangMin || dist > BatarangMax)
                continue;

            _bataranged[c.Ptr] = GameNow;

            if (FireGadget(pc, me, 0, v))
            {
                Used("batarang");
                Trace("batarang at a charging " + Describe(v) + ".");
                return true;
            }

            Trace("couldn't batarang a charging " + Describe(v) + ": batarang "
                  + (Gadget(me, 0) is { IsValid: true } g ? "not ready to quick-fire (CanQuickFire " + g.CanQuickFire() + ")" : "not owned") + ".");
        }

        if (_bataranged.Count > 32)
            _bataranged.Clear();
        return false;
    }

    private bool StartBeatdown(RPawnPlayerCombat me, RPawnVillain enemy)
    {
        if (!me.TryStun(enemy, false))
            return false;

        _beatdownTarget = enemy;
        _beatdownAt = GameNow;
        return true;
    }

    // ---- the moveset

    private bool Ready(string move) => !_moveReadyAt.TryGetValue(move, out double at) || GameNow >= at;

    private void Cool(string move, double seconds) => _moveReadyAt[move] = GameNow + seconds;

    private static bool CanStartSpecial(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me) =>
        pc.CanDoCombat(false, false) && (me.CombatMove is not { IsValid: true } m || m.CanPerformNextComboMove(true, false));

    /// <summary>Runs a spawn call when Batman can start a special move; true when his move changed.</summary>
    private static bool Spawn(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me, Action spawn)
    {
        if (!CanStartSpecial(pc, me))
            return false;

        nint before = MovePtr(me);
        spawn();
        return MovePtr(me) != before;
    }

    /// <summary>Takes a bat or pipe out of an enemy's hands, or picks one up off the floor (what TrySpawnWeaponSnatch does).</summary>
    private static bool Snatch(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me, RPawnVillain? from, RBMCombatThrownObject? pickup)
    {
        if (!pc.CanDoWeaponSnatch(true))
            return false;

        return Spawn(pc, me, () =>
        {
            pc.NewComboMoveStarted();
            me.SpawnWeaponSnatch(from!, pickup!);
        });
    }

    /// <summary>A weapon lying close by, looked for toward the enemy and then around Batman.</summary>
    private RBMCombatThrownObject? FloorWeapon(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me, RPawnVillain enemy)
    {
        if (!Ready("weapon search"))
            return null;

        Cool("weapon search", 1.0);
        Vector3 toward = enemy.Location - me.Location;
        toward.Z = 0f;
        if (toward.LengthSquared() > 1f && pc.FindWeaponToPickup(Vector3.Normalize(toward), CloseReach) is { IsValid: true } ahead)
            return ahead;

        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            float a = i * MathF.PI / 2f;
            if (pc.FindWeaponToPickup(new Vector3(MathF.Cos(a), MathF.Sin(a), 0f), CloseReach) is { IsValid: true } found)
                return found;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>A gadget by EBatmanGadgetList slot. The list lives on RPawnPlayer, which derives from RPawnPlayerCombat.</summary>
    private static RInventoryGadget? Gadget(RPawnPlayerCombat me, int slot) => me is not RPawnPlayer p ? null : slot switch
    {
        0 => p.GadgetList_0,
        3 => p.GadgetList_3,
        4 => p.GadgetList_4,
        7 => p.GadgetList_7,
        8 => p.GadgetList_8,
        _ => null,
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// Quick-fires a gadget at an enemy. The throw aims along MovementDir, which is pointed at him only for this call and
    /// put back straight after, so nothing else that reads it is affected.
    /// </summary>
    private static bool FireGadget(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me, int slot, RPawnVillain at)
    {
        if (Gadget(me, slot) is not { IsValid: true } g || !g.CanQuickFire())
            return false;
        if (WouldDoubleGadget(me, g))
            return false;

        Vector3 d = at.Location - me.Location;
        d.Z = 0f;
        Vector3 saved = me.MovementDir;
        if (d.LengthSquared() > 1f)
            me.MovementDir = Vector3.Normalize(d);
        try
        {
            return pc.FireQuickGadget(g, false);
        }
        finally
        {
            me.MovementDir = saved;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The game's own rule (RProjectileGadgetBase.TryContinueComboStartMove): when a quick gadget continues the combo, it
    /// clears it ("Double gadget", "Double REC", "Brang clearing") if Batman's last attack move is this gadget's combo move
    /// class. So a gadget that would follow its own kind of move isn't thrown at all. (REC, batarang and freeze blast
    /// 0.53 s apart broke a combo of 6 that way.)
    /// </summary>
    private static bool WouldDoubleGadget(RPawnPlayerCombat me, RInventoryGadget g)
    {
        if (g is not RProjectileGadgetBase { ComboCombatClass: { IsValid: true } cc })
            return false;

        string last = me.LastAttackMoveClassName.ToString() ?? "";
        bool same = last.Length > 0 && string.Equals(last, cc.Name.ToString(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (same)
            I.Report("double gadget " + cc.Name, "Auto fight: not throwing a gadget whose combo move (" + cc.Name + ") was Batman's last attack: the game would clear the combo.");
        return same;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A quick gadget at the enemy, followed by its gadget takedown (the special combo upgrade) when that kind of gadget
    /// takedown isn't in this combo yet: it counts as a move kind of its own for the variation bonus.
    /// </summary>
    private bool QuickGadget(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me, int slot, RPawnVillain enemy, RGameInfo.EComboMoveType super)
    {
        if (!FireGadget(pc, me, slot, enemy))
            return false;

        Cool("gadget", GadgetGap);

        if (Ready("gadget takedown") && pc.CanDoGadgetSpecial() && !InCombo(pc, super))
        {
            _superAt = GameNow + SuperDelay;
            Cool("gadget takedown", 6);
        }

        return true;
    }

    // ---- tough enemies and specials

    /// <summary>A weapon weapon destroy should break: shields, stun sticks and guns, or anything that blocks strikes.</summary>
    private static bool BreakableWeapon(RPawnVillain v) =>
        v.CurrWeapon is { IsValid: true } w
        && (w.bCanBlockHoldingWeapon || w.WeaponDestroyType is RPawnPlayerCombat.EWeaponDestroyType.WDT_Shield
            or RPawnPlayerCombat.EWeaponDestroyType.WDT_StunStick or RPawnPlayerCombat.EWeaponDestroyType.WDT_Gun);

    private static bool IsBrute(RPawnVillain v) => v.CombatPawnType == RPawnCombat.ECombatPawnType.ECPT_MultiStage;

    /// <summary>An enemy that gets a special instead of strikes: breakable weapon, brute, armour, electrified, or a blocker.</summary>
    private static bool NeedsSpecial(RPawnPlayerCombat me, RPawnVillain v) =>
        // Ninjas (ECPT_Ninja, e.g. RPawnVillainCombatExpert with a sword) dodge ordinary strikes: a heavy strike at one
        // never landed and the next forced counter broke a combo of 39. A takedown they can't dodge.
        BreakableWeapon(v) || IsBrute(v) || v.bArmoured || v.ChargedUpBy is { IsValid: true }
        || v.CombatPawnType == RPawnCombat.ECombatPawnType.ECPT_Ninja
        || v.CanBlockAttack(me, RDmgType_Strike.StaticClass()) || v.CanBlockAttack(me, RDmgType_HeavyStrike.StaticClass());

    /// <summary>
    /// What SpawnTakedown does, on a chosen enemy. With <paramref name="environment"/> the game's ENVIRONMENT TAKEDOWNS
    /// switch is on for just this call, so a wall or object nearby turns it into an environment takedown.
    /// </summary>
    private void Takedown(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me, RPawnVillain v, bool environment)
    {
        RPersistentDebugData? d = environment ? DebugFlags.Data : null;
        bool was = d is { Debug_Combat_ForceEnvironmentUse: true };
        if (d != null)
            d.Debug_Combat_ForceEnvironmentUse = true;
        try
        {
            pc.MovesSinceSpecial = 0;
            pc.SpendAdrenaline();
            pc.NewComboMoveStarted();
            if (!v.SpawnOverrideTakedown(me))
                me.SpawnComboTakeDown(v);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (d != null && !was)
                d.Debug_Combat_ForceEnvironmentUse = false;
        }
    }

    private void Fail(RPawnVillain v, string why)
    {
        _specialFailed[v.Ptr] = GameNow;
        Trace("passing over " + Describe(v) + " for now: " + why + ".");
    }

    // ---- ALWAYS TAKEDOWN READY, held on during an AUTO FIGHT fight

    private void ForceTakedown()
    {
        if (DebugFlags.Data is not { } d)
            return;

        if (!d.Debug_Combat_CanAlwaysTakedown)
            d.Debug_Combat_CanAlwaysTakedown = true;
        if (!_forcedTakedown)
        {
            _forcedTakedown = true;
            Report("forced takedown", "Auto fight: ALWAYS TAKEDOWN READY is held on during fights, for the specials on tough enemies.");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Gives ALWAYS TAKEDOWN READY back to its own row once AUTO FIGHT stops holding it.</summary>
    private void ReleaseTakedown()
    {
        if (!_forcedTakedown)
            return;

        _forcedTakedown = false;
        if (AlwaysTakedown is { On: false } && DebugFlags.Data is { } d)
            d.Debug_Combat_CanAlwaysTakedown = false;
    }

    private void EndFight()
    {
        ReleaseTakedown();
        if (_pending != null || _tally.Count > 0 || _model is { Dirty: true })
            BrainSummary();
        _lastMoveAt = 0;
        _specialFailed.Clear();
        _moveReadyAt.Clear();
        _bataranged.Clear();
        _superAt = 0;
        if (_usedThisFight.Count == 0 && _hitsThisFight == 0)
            return;

        string hits = _hitsThisFight == 0 ? "no hits taken" : _hitsThisFight + " hits taken ("
            + string.Join(", ", _hitsBy.OrderByDescending(kv => kv.Value).Select(kv => kv.Key + " " + kv.Value)) + ")";
        string breaks = _breaks.Count == 0 ? "combo never broken" : "combo broken by "
            + string.Join(", ", _breaks.OrderByDescending(kv => kv.Value).Select(kv => kv.Key + " x" + kv.Value));
        Log.Info("Auto fight: fight over, used " + _usedThisFight.Count + " kinds of move (" + string.Join(", ", _usedThisFight) + "), " + hits
                 + ". Best combo " + _maxCombo + ", game's variation " + _maxVariation + ", " + breaks + ".");
        _usedThisFight.Clear();
        _hitsThisFight = 0;
        _hitsBy.Clear();
        _breaks.Clear();
        _maxCombo = 0;
        _maxVariation = 0;
        _traces = 0;
    }

    /// <summary>A step worth seeing in a fight log (specials, batarangs, why an enemy was passed over). Capped per fight.</summary>
    private void Trace(string text)
    {
        if (_traces >= MaxTraces)
            return;

        _traces++;
        Log.Info("Auto fight: " + text);
    }

    private static string Describe(RPawnVillain v)
    {
        string state = v is RPawnVillainMultiStageBase ms ? " " + ms.ThugState : "";
        string weapon = v.CurrWeapon is { IsValid: true } w ? " with " + w.Class.Name : "";
        return v.Class.Name + state + weapon;
    }

    /// <summary>Logs once what each kind of enemy looks like to the fight logic, so a log shows why it was handled as it was.</summary>
    private void Profile(RPawnPlayerCombat me, RPawnVillain v)
    {
        string state = v is RPawnVillainMultiStageBase ms ? " " + ms.ThugState : "";
        string weapon = v.CurrWeapon is { IsValid: true } w ? w.Class.Name + " (" + w.WeaponDestroyType + (w.bCanBlockHoldingWeapon ? ", blocks" : "") + ")" : "none";
        string key = "profile " + v.Class.Name + state + weapon + (v.ChargedUpBy is { IsValid: true } ? " electrified" : "");
        if (_reported.Contains(key))
            return;

        Report(key, "Auto fight: enemy " + v.Class.Name + state + ": type " + v.CombatPawnType + ", armoured " + v.bArmoured
                    + ", weapon " + weapon + ", blocks strikes " + v.CanBlockAttack(me, RDmgType_Strike.StaticClass())
                    + ", electrified " + (v.ChargedUpBy is { IsValid: true }) + ", can be taken down " + v.bCanBeTakenDown
                    + ", beatdown " + v.bCanBeatdown + ", ready " + v.ReadyForCombat()
                    + ", gets a special " + NeedsSpecial(me, v) + ".");
    }

    private static nint MovePtr(RPawnPlayerCombat me) => me.CombatMove is { IsValid: true } m ? m.Ptr : 0;

    /// <summary>
    /// If AUTO FIGHT hasn't made a move for IdleReport seconds mid-fight, logs every gate that could be holding it, so a
    /// freeze in a log names its cause.
    /// </summary>
    private void Watchdog(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me)
    {
        double now = GameNow;
        if (_lastMoveAt == 0)
            _lastMoveAt = now;
        if (now - _lastMoveAt < IdleReport || now - _idleReportedAt < IdleReport)
            return;

        _idleReportedAt = now;
        Trace("idle " + (now - _lastMoveAt).ToString("0.0") + " s: combo " + pc.ComboSize + ", can continue " + pc.CanContinueCombo()
              + ", Batman in " + (me.CombatMove is { IsValid: true } m ? m.Class.Name : "nothing")
              + ", can start special " + CanStartSpecial(pc, me) + ", " + FoeCounts(pc, me) + ". Last thought: " + _thought + ".");
    }

    private void Used(string move)
    {
        _lastMoveAt = GameNow;
        _usedThisFight.Add(move);
        Report("fight " + move, "Auto fight: " + move + ".");
    }

    // ---- AUTO DODGE RED ATTACKS

    private static bool IsRed(RCombatMove_VillainAttack m) =>
        m.AttackCounterType is RPawnVillain.AttackCounterTypes.ACT_Unblockable or RPawnVillain.AttackCounterTypes.ACT_UnblockableNoIcon;

    /// <summary>Called from the CanCounterStart redirect: remembers a red attack on the player whose window just opened.</summary>
    private void WindowOpened(RCombatMove_VillainAttack m)
    {
        if (!IsRed(m) || Fighter() is not { } me || !Aims(m, me) || m.Villain is not { IsValid: true } v)
            return;

        _redOpen[m.Ptr] = (m, v, GameNow);
        LearnRedLead(m);
    }
```
