```cs
    /// <summary>Picks and makes Batman's next move, or decides to wait. Called only when a new move can start.</summary>
    private void Think(RPlayerControllerCombat pc, RPawnPlayerCombat me)
    {
        double now = GameNow;
        List<Foe> foes = Perceive(pc, me);
        int standingNear = foes.Count(f => f.Dist <= RiskReach);

        // The last move still on its way: let it land before the next, even with no combo yet (a strike 0.25 s after a
        // freeze blast left the freeze never landing, which also taught the model that freezes fail).
        // Never past the combo window's last moment, though.
        double windowLeft = WindowLeft(pc);
        if (_pending is { Done: false } p && now - p.At < LandTime(p.O.Spec, p.O.Dist) + 0.15 && windowLeft >= LastResort)
        {
            _thought = "waiting for " + p.O.Spec.Name + " to land";
            return;
        }

        List<Threat> threats = Threats(me, foes);
        List<(double Rate, double Lead, bool Red)> hazards = Hazards(me, foes);
        _thinkFoes = foes;
        _thinkMe = me;
        Threat? soonest = threats.OrderBy(t => t.Guess).FirstOrDefault();
        string threat = soonest == null ? "no attack under way" : "next attack " + soonest.What + " in about " + soonest.Guess.ToString("0.00") + " s";
        double stake = Stake(pc);
        double left = windowLeft;
        bool urgent = left < LastResort;

        // A counter or vault that starts while the window is open continues the combo, so with one coming in time,
        // waiting is safe even at the last moment. A move of Batman's would shut the window first and the defence
        // starting after it would break the combo (a strike 0.016 s before a vault did exactly that).
        // (A blanket "an attack is swinging, wait for its counter" rule used to stand here. An attack that looked like it was
        // swinging but never needed answering let a combo of 6 run out of time; the sums below already weigh how likely a
        // counter is to come in time.)

        List<Option> options = Options(pc, me, foes);
        Option? best = null;
        foreach (Option o in options)
        {
            Evaluate(o, pc, stake, threats, hazards);
            if (best == null || o.Ev > best.Ev)
                best = o;
        }

        // Waiting at the last moment loses the combo, unless a counter or vault starts before the window shuts and
        // refreshes it. (A REC thrown with 0.34 s left and a counter due in 0.1 s was cut off and broke a combo of 15.)
        // Corrected by how last-moment waits have really gone: a batarang chosen over waiting at 0.23 s left was cut off by a
        // vault 16 ms later, which would have kept the combo of 293 going had he waited.
        double defenceInTime = urgent ? Math.Min(0.99, AnyWithin(threats, left - 0.05, 0) * CalibFactor(UrgentWait)) : 0;
        // Outside the last moment a move has to beat waiting by a margin that grows with the stake: a batarang worth 12
        // with 210 at stake, judged a near-certain success, still ended in a "Brang clearing" break.
        double waitEv = urgent ? -stake * (1 - defenceInTime) : StakeMargin * stake;
        if (best == null || best.Ev <= waitEv || double.IsNegativeInfinity(best.Ev))
        {
            if (urgent && pc.ComboSize > 0 && _urgentWaitFrom == 0)
            {
                _urgentWaitFrom = GameNow;
                _urgentWaitPredicted = defenceInTime;
            }

            _thought = "waiting: " + (best == null ? "no move available" : "best was " + best.Describe())
                       + ", stake " + stake.ToString("0") + (urgent ? ", window " + left.ToString("0.00") + " s, counter in time " + defenceInTime.ToString("0.00") : "")
                       + ", " + threat + ", " + threats.Count + " attacks under way, " + options.Count + " options";
            return;
        }

        // Near ties: a little randomness keeps the moveset rotating.
        Option pick = best;
        var close = options.Where(o => o != best && !double.IsNegativeInfinity(o.Ev) && o.Ev > waitEv && best.Ev - o.Ev < 3).ToList();
        if (close.Count > 0 && Rng.NextDouble() < 0.5)
            pick = close[Rng.Next(close.Count)];

        Execute(me, pick, stake, urgent ? left : -1);
    }

    private void Execute(RPawnPlayerCombat me, Option o, double stake, double urgentLeft)
    {
        ResolvePending(false, "never landed");

        nint before = MovePtr(me);
        bool did = o.Do();
        if (!did && MovePtr(me) == before)
        {
            // Refused: nothing started, nothing at risk. Rest it briefly so the next best gets a turn.
            Cool(o.Spec.Name + " refused", 0.4);
            if (urgentLeft >= 0 && _reported.Add("urgent refused " + o.Spec.Name + " " + _fightNumber))
                Trace("the game refused " + o.Describe() + " with " + urgentLeft.ToString("0.00") + " s of combo window left.");
            _thought = "the game refused " + o.Describe();
            return;
        }

        if (o.Spec.Cooldown > 0)
            Cool(o.Spec.Name, o.Spec.Cooldown);
        _urgentWaitFrom = 0;
        _pending = new Pending { O = o, At = GameNow };
        _movedAt[o.Spec.Name] = GameNow;
        if (o.Spec.Gadget)
        {
            _gadgetFiredAt[o.Spec.Name] = GameNow;
            if (o.Target is { IsValid: true } gt)
                _gadgetHitAt[gt.Ptr] = GameNow;
        }
        if (_thinkFoes != null)
            WatchReactions(_thinkFoes);
        TallyOf(o.Spec.Name).Tries++;
        Used(o.Spec.Name);
        _thought = "made " + o.Describe();
        if (o.Spec != MStrike || urgentLeft >= 0)
            Trace(o.Describe() + ", stake " + stake.ToString("0")
                  + (urgentLeft >= 0 ? ", with " + urgentLeft.ToString("0.00") + " s of combo window left" : "") + ".");
    }

    /// <summary>The pending move's outcome. Landed teaches its timing; failures teach how often it works.</summary>
    private void ResolvePending(bool landed, string why, bool cut = false)
    {
        if (_pending is not { Done: false } p)
            return;

        p.Done = true;
        _pending = null;
        MoveSpec s = p.O.Spec;
        Tally t = TallyOf(s.Name);
        double took = GameNow - p.At;
        Brain.Dirty = true;

        if (cut)
        {
            Calibrate(p.O, false);
            t.Cut++;
            if (s.Protected)
                CutOdds(s).Bad++;
            return;
        }

        // A gadget whose hit hasn't been scored yet: its timing counts now, its success once the hit is scored or not.
        bool deferWorks = landed && s.Gadget && !p.Hit;
        if (deferWorks)
            _awaitHit.Add((p.O, GameNow));
        else
            CountWorks(p.O, landed);

        if (landed)
        {
            t.Landed++;
            t.LandSum += took;
            if (s.Protected)
            {
                CutOdds(s).Ok++;
                WatchPounce();
            }
            if (took > 0.05)
            {
                string key = s.Name + "/" + Bucket(p.O.Dist);
                if (!Brain.Land.TryGetValue(key, out Stat? st))
                    Brain.Land[key] = st = new Stat();
                st.Add(took);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            t.Failed++;
            t.Why[why] = t.Why.GetValueOrDefault(why) + 1;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>How much a move's predicted success chance needs correcting: what really worked over what was predicted.</summary>
    private double CalibFactor(string move)
    {
        if (!Brain.Calib.TryGetValue(move, out double[]? c))
            return 1;
        return Math.Clamp((c[1] + 3) / (c[0] + 3), 0.5, 1.5);
    }

    private void Calibrate(Option o, bool ok)
    {
        if (o.Predicted <= 0)
            return;
        if (!Brain.Calib.TryGetValue(o.Spec.Name, out double[]? c))
            Brain.Calib[o.Spec.Name] = c = new double[2];
        // Recent fights count most.
        c[0] = c[0] * 0.98 + o.Predicted;
        c[1] = c[1] * 0.98 + (ok ? 1 : 0);
        Brain.Dirty = true;
    }

    /// <summary>Whether a move worked: its general rate, its rate against this kind of enemy, and its situation rates.</summary>
    private void CountWorks(Option o, bool ok)
    {
        Calibrate(o, ok);
        MoveSpec s = o.Spec;
        Odds all = WorksOdds(s.Name, s);
        Odds kind = WorksOdds(s.Name + "|" + o.Kind, s with { PriorOk = 0, PriorBad = 0 });
        var odds = new List<Odds> { all, kind };
        if (o.Again)
            odds.Add(AgainOdds(s.Name));
        if (o.Gadgeted)
            odds.Add(AgainOdds("gadgeted target"));
        foreach (Odds x in odds)
        {
            if (ok)
                x.Ok++;
            else
                x.Bad++;
        }

        Brain.Dirty = true;
    }

    /// <summary>A scored hit settles the oldest gadget of that kind still waiting for one.</summary>
    private void GadgetHitScored(string gadget)
    {
        int i = _awaitHit.FindIndex(a => a.O.Spec.Name == gadget);
        if (i < 0)
            return;
        CountWorks(_awaitHit[i].O, true);
        _awaitHit.RemoveAt(i);
    }

    /// <summary>Gadgets whose hit was never scored: they missed, whatever the combo window did.</summary>
    private void SettleGadgetHits()
    {
        double now = GameNow;
        for (int i = _awaitHit.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (now - _awaitHit[i].At <= HitGrace)
                continue;
            (Option o, _) = _awaitHit[i];
            CountWorks(o, false);
            Tally t = TallyOf(o.Spec.Name);
            t.Why["no hit scored"] = t.Why.GetValueOrDefault("no hit scored") + 1;
            _awaitHit.RemoveAt(i);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The gadget a combo move type belongs to (its own hit or its gadget takedown), or null.</summary>
    private static string? GadgetOf(CMT type)
    {
        foreach (MoveSpec g in GadgetMoves)
        {
            if (g.Type == type || GadgetInfo[g.Name].Super == type)
                return g.Name;
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ---- hooks from the game's combo events and the defence code

    /// <summary>SetContinueComboTimer: the last move landed and the combo window reopened.</summary>
    private void BrainLanded()
    {
        SettleUrgentWait(true);
        if (_pending is { Done: false })
            ResolvePending(true, "");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// ClearCombo: the pending move broke the combo, unless a defence cut in first (already resolved then). With no combo
    /// running only resets that name a failed move count, in case the game clears an empty combo for other reasons.
    /// </summary>
    private void BrainBroken(string reason, int combo)
    {
        if (combo > 0 && !BankingReasons.Contains(reason))
            SettleUrgentWait(false);
        bool moveFailed = reason.Contains("strike", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || reason.Contains("target", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                          || reason.Contains("blocker", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || reason.Contains("miss", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                          || reason.Contains("fail", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        // A reset from inside a counter or vault is the defence cutting the move off (ClearCombo runs before the
        // counter call returns, so this is the only place to tell).
        if (_pending is { Done: false } && _defending && !BankingReasons.Contains(reason))
            ResolvePending(false, "", cut: true);
        else if (_pending is { Done: false } && !BankingReasons.Contains(reason) && (combo > 0 || moveFailed))
            ResolvePending(false, reason.Split(' ').Length > 4 ? string.Join(' ', reason.Split(' ').Take(4)) : reason);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether a counter whose window is open should wait: only during AUTO FIGHT, for an ordinary counterable attack,
    /// while Batman's own (unprotected) move is still on its way with a combo to keep, and only up to the hold budget.
    /// </summary>
    private bool HoldCounter(RCombatMove_VillainAttack a, Seen s)
    {
        if (AutoFight is not { On: true } || !CanHold(a) || _pending is not { Done: false } p || p.O.Spec.Protected)
            return false;
        if (World.Pc is not RPlayerControllerCombat pc || pc.ComboSize <= 0 || pc.CanContinueCombo())
            return false;
        if (GameNow - s.OpenAt >= HoldBudget)
            return false;

        if (!s.Held)
        {
            s.Held = true;
            _heldCounters++;
            Report("counter hold", "Auto fight: holding a counter for Batman's own move to land first (up to " + HoldBudget.ToString("0.00") + " s).");
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Batman's own unprotected move is still on its way with a combo to keep, so a vault may wait a moment.</summary>
    private bool HoldForOwnMove() =>
        AutoFight is { On: true } && _pending is { Done: false } p && !p.O.Spec.Protected
        && World.Pc is RPlayerControllerCombat { ComboSize: > 0 } pc && !pc.CanContinueCombo();

    /// <summary>A held counter still went in fine: the budget creeps up.</summary>
    private void HeldCounterLanded()
    {
        Brain.Hold = Math.Min(HoldMax, Brain.Hold + 0.02);
        Brain.Dirty = true;
    }

    /// <summary>Hit by an attack whose counter was held: the hold was too long, so the budget halves.</summary>
    private void HeldCounterHit()
    {
        Brain.Hold *= 0.5;
        Brain.Dirty = true;
        Log.Info("Auto fight: hit while holding a counter, so counters now wait at most " + HoldBudget.ToString("0.00") + " s.");
    }

    /// <summary>A counter or vault started: a move still on its way is cut off by it.</summary>
    private void BrainDefended(string? foe = null)
    {
        Pounced();
        if (foe != null)
            Reacted(foe);
        if (_pending is { Done: false } p && GameNow - p.At > 0.02)
            ResolvePending(false, "", cut: true);
    }

    private void BrainHit()
    {
        if (_pending is { Done: false } p)
        {
            Tally t = TallyOf(p.O.Spec.Name);
            t.Why["hit during it"] = t.Why.GetValueOrDefault("hit during it") + 1;
            ResolvePending(false, "", cut: true);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Enemies by pawn and when one of Batman's moves last hit them (from MovePerformed).</summary>
    private readonly Dictionary<nint, double> _lastHitAt = new();

    private const double ReelTime = 1.2;

    private bool RecentlyHit(RPawnVillain v, double now) => _lastHitAt.TryGetValue(v.Ptr, out double at) && now - at < ReelTime;

    /// <summary>MovePerformed: which combo move type the pending move scored as, so novelty is judged by the game's own types.</summary>
    private void BrainMoveType(CMT type, RPawnCombat? target)
    {
        if (target is { IsValid: true })
        {
            double now = GameNow;
            _lastHitAt[target.Ptr] = now;
            if (_lastHitAt.Count > 64)
            {
                foreach (nint old in _lastHitAt.Where(kv => now - kv.Value > ReelTime).Select(kv => kv.Key).ToList())
                    _lastHitAt.Remove(old);
            }
        }

        if (GadgetOf(type) is { } gadget)
        {
            if (_pending is { Done: false } gp && gp.O.Spec.Name == gadget)
                gp.Hit = true;
            else
                GadgetHitScored(gadget);
        }

        if (_pending is not { Done: false } p || DefenceTypes.Contains(type) || p.O.Spec == MStrike)
            return;

        TallyOf(p.O.Spec.Name).Types.Add(type.ToString().Replace("ECMT_", ""));
        if (!Brain.Types.ContainsKey(p.O.Spec.Name))
        {
            Brain.Types[p.O.Spec.Name] = (int)type;
            Brain.Dirty = true;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A move that never resolved: gadgets that miss leave the combo hanging, takedowns take a few seconds.</summary>
    private void ExpirePending()
    {
        SettleGadgetHits();
        if (_pending is { Done: false } p && GameNow - p.At > (p.O.Spec.Protected ? ProtectedLife : PendingLife))
            ResolvePending(false, "never landed");
    }

    /// <summary>End of fight: what each move did, what the model now believes, and the model saved.</summary>
    private void BrainSummary()
    {
        _fightNumber++;
        ResolvePending(false, "fight ended");
        SettleReactions();
        foreach ((Option o, double _) in _awaitHit)
            CountWorks(o, false);
        _awaitHit.Clear();
        if (_tally.Count > 0)
        {
            string moves = string.Join("; ", _tally.OrderByDescending(kv => kv.Value.Tries).Select(kv =>
            {
                Tally t = kv.Value;
                string s = kv.Key + " " + t.Tries + " (landed " + t.Landed;
                if (t.Landed > 0)
                    s += " in " + (t.LandSum / t.Landed).ToString("0.00") + " s";
                if (t.Cut > 0)
                    s += ", cut " + t.Cut;
                if (t.Failed > 0)
                    s += ", failed " + t.Failed;
                if (t.Why.Count > 0)
                    s += ": " + string.Join(", ", t.Why.Select(w => w.Key + " x" + w.Value));
                if (t.Types.Count > 0)
                    s += ", scored as " + string.Join("/", t.Types);
                return s + ")";
            }));
            Log.Info("Auto fight brain: " + moves + ".");
            Log.Info("Auto fight brain: enemies start " + AttackRate.ToString("0.00") + " attacks a second each; a quick attack needs answering "
                     + QuickLead().ToString("0.00") + " s after it starts; counters wait up to " + HoldBudget.ToString("0.00")
                     + " s for Batman's move to land (" + _heldCounters + " held this fight). Enemies answering his moves at once: "
                     + string.Join(", ", Brain.React.Where(kv => kv.Value.N >= 3).OrderByDescending(kv => ReactP(kv.Key))
                         .Select(kv => kv.Key + " " + (ReactP(kv.Key) * 100).ToString("0") + "%"))
                     + ". Enemies pounce as a takedown or multi special ends " + (Brain.Pounce.P * 100).ToString("0") + "% of the time ("
                     + Brain.Pounce.N.ToString("0") + " seen). Attack rationing: " + GapSummary() + ". Self-correction: "
                     + string.Join(", ", Brain.Calib.Where(kv => kv.Value[0] >= 3).OrderBy(kv => kv.Key)
                         .Select(kv => kv.Key + " x" + CalibFactor(kv.Key).ToString("0.00"))) + ".");
            _heldCounters = 0;
        }

        if (_stillTotal > 0)
            Log.Info("Auto fight brain: stood still " + _stillTotal.ToString("0.0") + " s in all, " + _stillStretches + " times for 0.3 s or more.");
        _stillTotal = 0;
        _stillFor = 0;
        _stillStretches = 0;
        _tally.Clear();
        _pending = null;
        SaveModel();
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Gfx;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Draws the editor over the world: a box, name and tracer for each marked object (one DrawTris per colour for all
/// the lines), a white bracket on what SELECT AIMED would take, and the selected object's wireframe and card.
/// </summary>
internal static class EditorView
{
    private const float Metre = 100f;
    private const float DetailRange = 6000f;
    private const float NameScale = 0.58f;
    private const float DetailScale = 0.5f;
    private const float MinBox = 6f;

    private static readonly CultureInfo Inv = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

    private readonly record struct Shown(Thing T, float X0, float Y0, float X1, float Y1, bool Removed);

    private static readonly List<Shown> _shown = new();

    public static void Draw(WorldEditor ed, Canvas canvas)
    {
        WorldView.Begin(canvas);
        if (!WorldView.Ready)
            return;

        Alpha = 1f;
        Thing? sel = ed.Selected;

        _shown.Clear();
        int marked = 0;
        foreach (Thing t in ed.Visible)
        {
            if (t == sel || !ed.Shows(t.Kind) || !t.Alive)
                continue;
            if (++marked > ed.MostShown)
                break;

            Vector3 at = t.Actor.Location;
            if (WorldView.Bounds(at + t.Min, at + t.Max, out float x0, out float y0, out float x1, out float y1))
                _shown.Add(new Shown(t, x0, y0, x1, y1, Edits.Find(t)?.Removed ?? false));
        }

        float thick = MathF.Max(1f, S(1.5f));
        if (ed.Boxes || ed.Tracers)
        {
            for (int k = 0; k < Things.KindCount; k++)
            {
                Lines(ed, (ThingKind)k, false, thick);
                Lines(ed, (ThingKind)k, true, thick);
            }
        }

        foreach (Shown s in _shown)
            Label(s, ed.Details);

        if (ed.Picking && ed.Aimed() is { } aimed && aimed != sel)
            Bracket(aimed);

        if (sel != null)
            DrawSelected(ed, sel);

        if (ed.Picking)
            Reticle();

        if (ed.ModeOn && ed.Picking)
            Controls(ed);
    }

    private static readonly string[] Keys =
    {
        "WASD  FLY", "SPACE CTRL  UP DOWN", "SHIFT  FAST", "CLICK  SELECT", "HOLD  GRAB", "RIGHT CLICK  DESELECT",
        "Q E  TURN", "Z X  SIZE", "F  FREEZE", "G  GROUND", "DEL  REMOVE", "R  RESTORE",
    };

    private static readonly string[] HeldKeys = { "W S  PUSH PULL", "Q E  TURN", "LET GO  DROP", "FLICK AS YOU LET GO  THROW" };

    /// <summary>The key guide along the bottom of the screen while editor mode is on.</summary>
    private static void Controls(WorldEditor ed)
    {
        string[] keys = ed.Grabbing ? HeldKeys : Keys;
        const float scale = 0.5f;
        float gap = S(22);
        float w = -gap;
        foreach (string k in keys)
            w += TextW(k, scale) + gap;

        string title = ed.Grabbing ? "HOLDING" : "EDITOR MODE";
        float th = TextH(0.6f), kh = TextH(scale);
        float pad = S(10);
        float pw = MathF.Max(w, TextW(title, 0.6f)) + pad * 2f;
        float ph = th + kh + pad * 2f + S(4);
        float x = (W - pw) * 0.5f;
        float y = H - ph - S(28);
        Panel(x, y, pw, ph, 0.8f);
        Text(x + pad, y + pad, title, Theme.Accent, 0.6f);
        float kx = x + pad;
        float ky = y + pad + th + S(4);
        foreach (string k in keys)
            kx += Text(kx, ky, k, Theme.Mid, scale) + gap;
    }

    private static Rgba ColourOf(Thing t, bool removed)
    {
        Rgba c = Things.Colors[(int)t.Kind];
        return removed ? Rgba.Mix(c, Theme.Black, 0.55f) : c;
    }

    /// <summary>Every box and tracer of one kind and state in a single call.</summary>
    private static void Lines(WorldEditor ed, ThingKind kind, bool removed, float thick)
    {
        Thing? first = null;
        foreach (Shown s in _shown)
        {
            if (s.T.Kind != kind || s.Removed != removed)
                continue;

            first ??= s.T;
            if (ed.Boxes)
                QueueRect(s.X0, s.Y0, s.X1, s.Y1, thick);
            if (ed.Tracers)
                Shapes.QueueLine(W * 0.5f, 0f, (s.X0 + s.X1) * 0.5f, s.Y0, thick * 0.75f);
        }

        if (first != null)
            Shapes.FlushLines(ColourOf(first, removed));
    }

    private static void QueueRect(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float thick)
    {
        Grow(ref x0, ref x1);
        Grow(ref y0, ref y1);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x0, y0, x1, y0, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x1, y0, x1, y1, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x1, y1, x0, y1, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x0, y1, x0, y0, thick);
    }

    /// <summary>Keeps a far-off object's box big enough to see.</summary>
    private static void Grow(ref float a, ref float b)
    {
        float min = S(MinBox);
        if (b - a >= min)
            return;

        float mid = (a + b) * 0.5f;
        a = mid - min * 0.5f;
        b = mid + min * 0.5f;
    }

    // ---- labels

    private static void Label(Shown s, bool details)
    {
        Thing t = s.T;
        Rgba col = ColourOf(t, s.Removed);
        float cx = (s.X0 + s.X1) * 0.5f;
        string name = s.Removed ? t.Name + "  REMOVED" : t.Name;
        float h = TextH(NameScale);
        float y = s.Y0 - h - S(4);
        Tag(cx, y, name, col, NameScale);

        float dist = Vector3.Distance(WorldView.Eye, t.Centre);
        if (!details || dist > DetailRange)
            return;

        string line = Fmt.Metres(dist / Metre);
        if (t.Actor is BmSDK.Engine.Pawn p && p.HealthMax > 0)
        {
            line += "  " + Math.Max(0, p.Health) + " HP";
            HealthBar(s.X0, s.Y0, s.Y1, p.Health, p.HealthMax, col);
        }

        Tag(cx, s.Y1 + S(3), line, Theme.Mid, DetailScale);
    }

    /// <summary>Text centred on x over a dark strip, so it reads against any background.</summary>
    private static void Tag(float cx, float y, string text, Rgba col, float scale)
    {
        float w = TextW(text, scale);
        float h = TextH(scale);
        Rect(cx - w * 0.5f - S(4), y, w + S(8), h, Theme.Black, 0.45f);
        Text(cx - w * 0.5f, y, text, col, scale);
    }

    private static void HealthBar(float x0, float y0, float y1, int health, int max, Rgba col)
    {
        float h = y1 - y0;
        if (h < S(14))
            return;

        float frac = Math.Clamp(health / (float)Math.Max(1, max), 0f, 1f);
        float bx = x0 - S(6);
        Rect(bx, y0, S(3), h, Theme.Black, 0.6f);
        Rect(bx, y1 - h * frac, S(3), h * frac, frac > 0.35f ? col : Theme.Warn);
    }

    // ---- aim and selection

    private static void Bracket(Thing t)
    {
        Vector3 at = t.Actor.Location;
        if (!WorldView.Bounds(at + t.Min, at + t.Max, out float x0, out float y0, out float x1, out float y1))
            return;

        float pad = S(6);
        x0 -= pad;
        y0 -= pad;
        x1 += pad;
        y1 += pad;
        float arm = MathF.Min(S(14), MathF.Min(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) * 0.4f);
        float thick = MathF.Max(1f, S(2f));
        Shapes.QueueLine(x0, y0, x0 + arm, y0, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x0, y0, x0, y0 + arm, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x1, y0, x1 - arm, y0, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x1, y0, x1, y0 + arm, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x0, y1, x0 + arm, y1, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x0, y1, x0, y1 - arm, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x1, y1, x1 - arm, y1, thick);
        Shapes.QueueLine(x1, y1, x1, y1 - arm, thick);
        Shapes.FlushLines(Theme.White);
        Tag((x0 + x1) * 0.5f, y1 + S(4), "SELECT  " + t.Name, Theme.Hi, DetailScale);
    }

    private static void DrawSelected(WorldEditor ed, Thing t)
    {
        Vector3 at = t.Actor.Location;
        Span<Vector2> c = stackalloc Vector2[8];
        bool front = WorldView.Corners(at + t.Min, at + t.Max, c);
        bool seen = WorldView.Bounds(at + t.Min, at + t.Max, out float x0, out float y0, out float x1, out float y1);
        if (!front || !seen)
        {
            EdgeMarker(t);
            return;
        }

        // The twelve edges of the box: corners whose index differs by one bit (one axis) are joined.
        float thick = MathF.Max(1.5f, S(2.5f));
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            for (int bit = 1; bit < 8; bit <<= 1)
            {
                int j = i | bit;
                if (j != i)
                    Shapes.QueueLine(c[i].X, c[i].Y, c[j].X, c[j].Y, thick);
            }
        }

        Shapes.FlushLines(Theme.Accent);
        Card(ed, t, x1 + S(14), y0);
    }

    private static void Card(WorldEditor ed, Thing t, float x, float y)
    {
        Actor a = t.Actor;
        var lines = new List<(string Text, Rgba Col, float Scale)>
        {
            (t.Name, Theme.Hi, 0.68f),
            (t.KindLabel + "  " + a.Class.Name.ToString().ToUpperInvariant(), Theme.Low, 0.48f),
        };

        string where = Fmt.Metres(Vector3.Distance(WorldView.Eye, t.Centre) / Metre) + " AWAY";
        if (a is BmSDK.Engine.Pawn p && p.HealthMax > 0)
            where += "   " + Math.Max(0, p.Health) + " / " + p.HealthMax + " HP";
        lines.Add((where, Theme.Mid, 0.52f));
        lines.Add(("AT " + Fmt.Position(a.Location), Theme.Low, 0.48f));

        string flags = Flags(ed, t);
        if (flags.Length > 0)
            lines.Add((flags, Theme.Signal, 0.5f));

        float pad = S(10);
        float w = 0f, h = pad * 2f;
        foreach (var l in lines)
        {
            w = MathF.Max(w, TextW(l.Text, l.Scale));
            h += TextH(l.Scale) + S(2);
        }

        w += pad * 2f;
        x = Math.Clamp(x, S(8), W - w - S(8));
        y = Math.Clamp(y, S(8), H - h - S(8));
        Panel(x, y, w, h, 0.82f);
        float ly = y + pad;
        foreach (var l in lines)
        {
            Text(x + pad, ly, l.Text, l.Col, l.Scale);
            ly += TextH(l.Scale) + S(2);
        }
    }

    private static string Flags(WorldEditor ed, Thing t)
    {
        var f = new List<string>();
        if (ed.Grabbing)
            f.Add("GRABBED");
        if (Edits.Find(t) is { } e)
        {
            if (e.Frozen)
                f.Add("FROZEN");
            if (e.Removed)
                f.Add("REMOVED");
            if (e.Ghost)
                f.Add("NO COLLISION");
            if (e.Scale != 1f)
                f.Add("SIZE " + e.Scale.ToString("0.0", Inv) + "X");
            if (e.Moved)
                f.Add("MOVED");
        }

        if (t.Fixed)
            f.Add("PART OF THE LEVEL");
        return string.Join("  ", f);
    }

    /// <summary>An arrow at the screen edge toward a selected object that is off screen or behind you.</summary>
    private static void EdgeMarker(Thing t)
    {
        Vector3 v = t.Centre - WorldView.Eye;
        float rx = Vector3.Dot(v, WorldView.Right);
        float uy = Vector3.Dot(v, WorldView.Up);
        if (MathF.Abs(rx) < 0.001f && MathF.Abs(uy) < 0.001f)
            rx = 1f;

        float cx = W * 0.5f, cy = H * 0.5f;
        float margin = S(60);
        float len = MathF.Sqrt(rx * rx + uy * uy);
        float dx = rx / len, dy = -uy / len;
        float sx = dx == 0f ? float.MaxValue : (cx - margin) / MathF.Abs(dx);
        float sy = dy == 0f ? float.MaxValue : (cy - margin) / MathF.Abs(dy);
        float r = MathF.Min(sx, sy);
        float px = cx + dx * r, py = cy + dy * r;

        float size = S(12);
        float nx = -dy, ny = dx;
        Shapes.Triangle(px + dx * size, py + dy * size, px + nx * size * 0.6f, py + ny * size * 0.6f, px - nx * size * 0.6f, py - ny * size * 0.6f, Theme.Accent, 1f);
        string label = t.Name + "  " + Fmt.Metres(v.Length() / Metre);
        Tag(px - dx * S(28), py - dy * S(28) - TextH(DetailScale) * 0.5f, label, Theme.Hi, DetailScale);
    }

    private static void Reticle()
    {
        float cx = W * 0.5f, cy = H * 0.5f;
        float l = S(7), t = MathF.Max(1f, S(2));
        Rect(cx - l, cy - t * 0.5f, l * 2f, t, Theme.White, 0.85f);
        Rect(cx - t * 0.5f, cy - l, t, l * 2f, Theme.White, 0.85f);
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Editor/Edits.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// What an object was like before the editor first touched it, and what the editor has done to it since. RESTORE
/// puts back exactly the parts that were changed, so an object the game moved on its own isn't dragged back
/// unless the editor moved it too.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Edit
{
    public required Thing Thing;

    // ---- as found
    public Vector3 Location;
    public Rotator Rotation;
    public float DrawScale;
    public bool Hidden;
    public bool CollideActors;
    public bool BlockActors;
    public bool IgnoreEncroachers;
    public Actor.EPhysics Physics;
    public bool TickDisabled;

    // ---- changed
    public bool Moved;
    public float Forward, Side, Up;
    public float Yaw, Pitch, Roll;
    public float Scale = 1f;
    public bool Frozen;
    public Vector3 FrozenAt;
    public Rotator FrozenRotation;
    public bool Removed;
    public bool Ghost;

    public bool Changed => Moved || Scale != 1f || Frozen || Removed || Ghost;
}

/// <summary>The editor's undo journal and the moves every kind of object shares.</summary>
internal static class Edits
{
    private const float HoldTolerance = 4f;

    private static readonly Dictionary<nint, Edit> _edits = new();

    public static int Count => _edits.Values.Count(e => e.Changed);

    public static IReadOnlyCollection<nint> Pointers => _edits.Keys;

    public static Edit? Find(Thing t) => _edits.TryGetValue(t.Ptr, out Edit? e) && e.Thing == t ? e : null;

    /// <summary>The journal entry for an object, recording how it is now if this is the first edit.</summary>
    public static Edit Begin(Thing t)
    {
        if (Find(t) is { } found)
            return found;

        Actor a = t.Actor;
        var e = new Edit
        {
            Thing = t,
            Location = a.Location,
            Rotation = a.Rotation,
            DrawScale = a.DrawScale,
            Hidden = a.bHidden,
            CollideActors = a.bCollideActors,
            BlockActors = a.bBlockActors,
            IgnoreEncroachers = a.bIgnoreEncroachers,
            Physics = a.Physics,
            TickDisabled = a.bTickIsDisabled,
        };
        _edits[t.Ptr] = e;
        return e;
    }

    /// <summary>Drops every entry without touching the game. For a world change, when the objects are gone anyway.</summary>
    public static void Forget() => _edits.Clear();

    // ---- kinds of body

    /// <summary>Simulated by PhysX: vehicles and loose props. Moving one means moving its rigid body too.</summary>
    public static bool IsRigid(Actor a) => a is SVehicle || a.Physics == Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_RigidBody;

    /// <summary>A character on foot, as opposed to a vehicle (which is a pawn too).</summary>
    public static bool IsCharacter(Actor a) => a is Pawn and not Vehicle;

    private static PrimitiveComponent? Body(Actor a)
    {
        PrimitiveComponent? body = a is Vehicle v && v.Mesh is { IsValid: true } mesh ? mesh : a.CollisionComponent;
        return body is { IsValid: true } ? body : null;
    }

    // ---- moving

    /// <summary>
    /// Moves any object and stops it dead. A rigid body is moved with it or it snaps straight back; the Batmobile goes
    /// through the teleport's own placement, which also resets its driving state. SetLocation refuses a spot that
    /// overlaps something, so a refused move is tried again with collision briefly off.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Put(Actor a, Vector3 at, Rotator rot)
    {
        if (a is RVehicleBatmobileBase car)
        {
            Teleport.Place(car, at, rot);
            return;
        }

        a.SetRotation(rot);
        if (!a.SetLocation(at))
        {
            bool collide = a.bCollideActors, block = a.bBlockActors, ignore = a.bIgnoreEncroachers;
            a.SetCollision(false, false, ignore);
            a.SetLocation(at);
            a.SetCollision(collide, block, ignore);
        }

        a.Velocity = Vector3.Zero;
        if (IsRigid(a) && Body(a) is { } body)
        {
            body.SetRBPosition(at, default);
            body.SetRBRotation(rot, default);
            body.SetRBLinearVelocity(Vector3.Zero, false);
            body.SetRBAngularVelocity(Vector3.Zero, false);
            body.WakeRigidBody(default);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Sets an object moving: a character falls through the air, a rigid body is given the velocity.</summary>
    public static void Fling(Actor a, Vector3 velocity, Vector3 spin)
    {
        if (IsCharacter(a))
        {
            a.SetPhysics(Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_Falling, true);
            a.Velocity = velocity;
            return;
        }

        if (IsRigid(a) && Body(a) is { } body)
        {
            body.WakeRigidBody(default);
            body.SetRBLinearVelocity(velocity, false);
            body.SetRBAngularVelocity(spin, false);
            return;
        }

        throw new InvalidOperationException("it isn't a physics object");
    }

    // ---- state

    /// <summary>
    /// Stops an object thinking and moving. Characters and vehicles stop ticking (a character's AI and animation
    /// too) and are held where they are. A loose prop is taken out of physics so it hangs in place.
    /// </summary>
    public static void SetFrozen(Edit e, bool frozen)
    {
        Actor a = e.Thing.Actor;
        if (frozen == e.Frozen)
            return;

        e.Frozen = frozen;
        if (frozen)
        {
            e.FrozenAt = a.Location;
            e.FrozenRotation = a.Rotation;
        }

        // A removed object is already stopped, and must stay stopped until it's restored.
        if (e.Removed)
            return;

        if (a is Pawn p)
            Npcs.SetFrozen(p, frozen);
        else if (a.Physics == Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_RigidBody || (!frozen && e.Physics == Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_RigidBody))
        {
            a.SetPhysics(frozen ? Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_None : e.Physics, true);
        }
        else
        {
            a.SetTickIsDisabled(frozen || e.TickDisabled);
        }

        if (frozen)
            return;

        // A vehicle that was removed while frozen came back out of physics; it goes back in now.
        if (a.Physics != e.Physics && e.Physics == Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_RigidBody)
            a.SetPhysics(e.Physics, true);
        if (IsRigid(a) && Body(a) is { } body)
            body.WakeRigidBody(default);
    }

    /// <summary>Called every tick: keeps frozen objects where they were frozen.</summary>
    public static void Hold()
    {
        foreach (Edit e in _edits.Values)
        {
            if (!e.Frozen || e.Removed || !e.Thing.Alive)
                continue;

            Actor a = e.Thing.Actor;
            if (a is Pawn p)
                Npcs.SetFrozen(p, true);
            if (Vector3.DistanceSquared(a.Location, e.FrozenAt) > HoldTolerance * HoldTolerance)
                Put(a, e.FrozenAt, e.FrozenRotation);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// REMOVE: hidden, no collision, not thinking and out of physics. Nothing is destroyed, so a mission that still
    /// refers to the object can't break, and RESTORE brings it back as it was.
    /// </summary>
    public static void SetRemoved(Edit e, bool removed)
    {
        Actor a = e.Thing.Actor;
        if (removed == e.Removed)
            return;

        e.Removed = removed;
        if (removed)
        {
            if (a is Pawn p)
                Npcs.SetFrozen(p, true);
            else
                a.SetTickIsDisabled(true);
            if (!IsCharacter(a) && a.Physics == Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_RigidBody)
                a.SetPhysics(Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_None, false);
            a.SetCollision(false, false, e.IgnoreEncroachers);
            a.SetHidden(true);
            return;
        }

        a.SetHidden(e.Hidden);
        if (!e.Ghost)
            a.SetCollision(e.CollideActors, e.BlockActors, e.IgnoreEncroachers);
        if (!e.Frozen)
        {
            if (a is Pawn p)
                Npcs.SetFrozen(p, false);
            else
                a.SetTickIsDisabled(e.TickDisabled);
            if (a.Physics != e.Physics && e.Physics == Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_RigidBody)
                a.SetPhysics(e.Physics, true);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>GHOST: no collision, so you and everything else pass through it. It stays visible and keeps working.</summary>
    public static void SetGhost(Edit e, bool ghost)
    {
        if (ghost == e.Ghost)
            return;

        e.Ghost = ghost;
        if (!e.Removed)
        {
            Actor a = e.Thing.Actor;
            if (ghost)
                a.SetCollision(false, false, e.IgnoreEncroachers);
            else
                a.SetCollision(e.CollideActors, e.BlockActors, e.IgnoreEncroachers);
        }
    }

    // ---- undo

    /// <summary>Puts one object back the way it was found. Returns false if it had nothing to undo.</summary>
    public static bool Restore(Edit e)
    {
        _edits.Remove(e.Thing.Ptr);
        if (!e.Changed || !e.Thing.Alive)
            return false;

        Actor a = e.Thing.Actor;
        SetRemoved(e, false);
        SetGhost(e, false);
        SetFrozen(e, false);
        if (e.Scale != 1f)
            a.SetDrawScale(e.DrawScale);
        if (e.Moved)
            Put(a, e.Location, e.Rotation);
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Puts every edited object back. Returns how many there were.</summary>
    public static int RestoreAll()
    {
        int n = 0;
        foreach (Edit e in _edits.Values.ToArray())
        {
            try
            {
                if (Restore(e))
                    n++;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Info("Editor: restoring " + e.Thing.Name + " failed: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }

        _edits.Clear();
        return n;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Editor/Things.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>The editor's categories, in menu order.</summary>
internal enum ThingKind
{
    Enemy,
    Friendly,
    Vehicle,
    Turret,
    Prop,
    Mover,
    Pickup,

    /// <summary>Anything else, picked by aiming at it: doors, scenery, interactables. Not marked by the ESP.</summary>
    Other,
}

/// <summary>
/// One object the editor can see and select. Kept across scans by pointer, so its name is worked out once and
/// its box only every few seconds. The box is relative to the actor's location, so it follows the actor between scans.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Thing
{
    public required Actor Actor;
    public required nint Ptr;
    public required nint ClassPtr;
    public required ThingKind Kind;
    public required string Name;
    public Vector3 Min;
    public Vector3 Max;
    public double BoxAt = double.MinValue;
    public float Distance;

    /// <summary>Still the same live object. A freed pointer can be reused by another object, so the class is checked too.</summary>
    public bool Alive => Actor is { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false } && Actor.Class is { } c && c.Ptr == ClassPtr;

    public Vector3 Centre => Actor.Location + (Min + Max) * 0.5f;

    /// <summary>Half the box's widest flat side: how far something must stand off to be beside it, not inside it.</summary>
    public float Radius => MathF.Max(Max.X - Min.X, Max.Y - Min.Y) * 0.5f;

    /// <summary>Static or unmovable actors are part of the level; they don't move even when their transform is written.</summary>
    public bool Fixed => Actor.bStatic || !Actor.bMovable;

    public string Key => Ptr.ToString("X");

    public string KindLabel => Things.Labels[(int)Kind];
}

/// <summary>Finds and names the objects in each editor category.</summary>
internal static class Things
{
    /// <summary>The kinds the ESP marks and scans for; <see cref="ThingKind.Other"/> comes after them.</summary>
    public const int KindCount = 7;
    private const double BoxSeconds = 2.0;
    private const float MaxBox = 6000f;
    private const float DefaultHalf = 50f;

    public static readonly string[] Labels = { "ENEMY", "FRIENDLY", "VEHICLE", "TURRET", "PROP", "SCENERY", "PICKUP", "OBJECT" };
    public static readonly string[] Plural = { "ENEMIES", "FRIENDLIES", "VEHICLES", "TURRETS", "PROPS", "MOVABLE SCENERY", "PICKUPS", "OTHER OBJECTS" };

    public static readonly Rgba[] Colors =
    {
        new(255, 86, 76),    // enemies: red
        new(84, 230, 140),   // friendlies: green
        new(255, 170, 60),   // vehicles: orange
        new(255, 90, 200),   // turrets: magenta
        new(110, 190, 255),  // props: blue
        new(190, 150, 255),  // movable scenery: violet
        new(255, 226, 90),   // pickups: gold
        new(200, 210, 210),  // other: grey
    };

    private static readonly Dictionary<nint, Thing> _known = new();

    /// <summary>Forgets every object. Called on a world change, when every pointer goes stale.</summary>
    public static void Forget() => _known.Clear();

    /// <summary>
    /// Fills <paramref name="into"/> with every live object of the wanted kinds within range, nearest first, at most
    /// <paramref name="max"/>. Objects in <paramref name="keep"/> (selected or edited) are kept whatever their range
    /// or visibility, so a hidden edit can still be found and restored.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Scan(List<Thing> into, Vector3 from, float range, bool[] wanted, IReadOnlySet<nint> keep, int max)
    {
        into.Clear();
        float r2 = range * range;
        double now = Clock.Now;
        nint me = World.PawnPtr;
        nint player = World.Player?.Ptr ?? 0;

        // One object that can't be read (half streamed in, being torn down) is skipped, not the whole scan.
        void Consider(Actor a, ThingKind kind)
        {
            try
            {
                Take(a, kind);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Throttled("editor scan", "Editor: skipped " + (a.IsValid ? a.Name.ToString() : "a dead object") + ": " + Log.Why(ex));
            }
        }

        void Take(Actor a, ThingKind kind)
        {
            // bPendingDelete is set while Destroy runs, before bDeleteMe: its parts may already be gone.
            if (a.Ptr == me || a.Ptr == player || a.bDeleteMe || a.bPendingDelete)
                return;

            bool kept = keep.Contains(a.Ptr);
            if (!kept && (!wanted[(int)kind] || a.bHidden || Vector3.DistanceSquared(a.Location, from) > r2))
                return;

            Thing t = Know(a, kind, now);
            t.Distance = Vector3.Distance(a.Location, from);
            into.Add(t);
        }

        foreach (RBMPawnAI p in World.All<RBMPawnAI>())
        {
            if (p is not RPawnCrowdRagdoll)
                Consider(p, p is RPawnVillain ? ThingKind.Enemy : ThingKind.Friendly);
        }

        foreach (RPawnPlayer p in World.All<RPawnPlayer>())
        {
            if (p.Controller is AIController { IsValid: true })
                Consider(p, ThingKind.Friendly);
        }

        foreach (RVehicle v in World.All<RVehicle>())
            Consider(v, ThingKind.Vehicle);

        // Parked and wrecked cars are animated mesh props, not driving vehicles, but they read as vehicles.
        foreach (RAbandonedVehicle v in World.All<RAbandonedVehicle>())
            Consider(v, ThingKind.Vehicle);
        foreach (RDeadVehicle v in World.All<RDeadVehicle>())
            Consider(v, ThingKind.Vehicle);
        foreach (RSentryGunBase g in World.All<RSentryGunBase>())
            Consider(g, ThingKind.Turret);
        foreach (RTurretBase g in World.All<RTurretBase>())
            Consider(g, ThingKind.Turret);
        foreach (KActor k in World.All<KActor>())
            Consider(k, ThingKind.Prop);
        foreach (ApexDestructibleActor d in World.All<ApexDestructibleActor>())
            Consider(d, ThingKind.Prop);
        foreach (InterpActor m in World.All<InterpActor>())
            Consider(m, ThingKind.Mover);
        foreach (RPickupBaseBase p in World.All<RPickupBaseBase>())
            Consider(p, ThingKind.Pickup);
        foreach (DroppedPickup p in World.All<DroppedPickup>())
            Consider(p, ThingKind.Pickup);

        // Kept objects no scan above finds (one picked by aiming at it) come along too.
        foreach (nint ptr in keep)
        {
            if (_known.TryGetValue(ptr, out Thing? k) && k.Alive && !into.Contains(k))
            {
                k.Distance = Vector3.Distance(k.Actor.Location, from);
                into.Add(k);
            }
        }

        into.Sort((a, b) => a.Distance.CompareTo(b.Distance));
        if (into.Count > max)
        {
            // Trim the furthest, but never a kept object.
            var trimmed = into.Take(max).ToList();
            trimmed.AddRange(into.Skip(max).Where(t => keep.Contains(t.Ptr)));
            into.Clear();
            into.AddRange(trimmed);
        }

        // Aiming around records scenery too, so the cache is emptied now and then. A selected or edited object is never
        // dropped: its edits point at that record.
        if (_known.Count > 4096)
        {
            foreach (nint gone in _known.Keys.Where(p => !keep.Contains(p)).ToArray())
                _known.Remove(gone);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The category an actor belongs in, for one picked by aiming rather than found by a scan.</summary>
    public static ThingKind KindOf(Actor a) => a switch
    {
        RPawnVillain => ThingKind.Enemy,
        RBMPawnAI or RPawnPlayer => ThingKind.Friendly,
        RVehicle or RAbandonedVehicle or RDeadVehicle => ThingKind.Vehicle,
        RSentryGunBase or RTurretBase => ThingKind.Turret,
        KActor or ApexDestructibleActor => ThingKind.Prop,
        InterpActor => ThingKind.Mover,
        RPickupBaseBase or DroppedPickup => ThingKind.Pickup,
        _ => ThingKind.Other,
    };

    /// <summary>The editor's record of any actor, the same one a scan would give.</summary>
    public static Thing Wrap(Actor a) => Know(a, KindOf(a), Clock.Now);

    private static Thing Know(Actor a, ThingKind kind, double now)
    {
        nint cls = a.Class?.Ptr ?? 0;
        if (!_known.TryGetValue(a.Ptr, out Thing? t) || t.ClassPtr != cls)
        {
            t = new Thing { Actor = a, Ptr = a.Ptr, ClassPtr = cls, Kind = kind, Name = NameOf(a, kind) };
            _known[a.Ptr] = t;
        }

        t.Kind = kind;
        if (now - t.BoxAt >= BoxSeconds)
        {
            t.BoxAt = now;
            Measure(t);
        }

        return t;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A pawn's box is its collision cylinder, which is centred on its location. Anything else uses its components'
    /// bounds; a box that is missing or absurdly large (a component far off in the level) becomes a metre cube.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Measure(Thing t)
    {
        Actor a = t.Actor;
        if (a is Pawn p and not Vehicle && p.CylinderComponent is { IsValid: true } cyl)
        {
            float r = cyl.CollisionRadius, h = cyl.CollisionHeight;
            if (r > 1f && h > 1f)
            {
                t.Min = new Vector3(-r, -r, -h);
                t.Max = new Vector3(r, r, h);
                return;
            }
        }

        // Never call Actor.GetComponentsBoundingBox: its out FBox overran BmSDK's buffer and crashed the game in
        // coreclr (2026-11-05). This is the same sum done here from properties the engine keeps up to date: the
        // bounds of every attached component that collides (UE3's AActor::GetComponentsBoundingBox). Only when none
        // does is the main component's bounds used on its own.
        // A vehicle's component list couldn't be read in game (2026-11-05: every RVehicleCar threw), and its skeletal
        // mesh covers the whole vehicle anyway, so vehicles skip straight to the mesh below.
        Vector3 min = new(float.MaxValue), max = new(float.MinValue);
        bool any = false;
        if (a is not Vehicle)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (ActorComponent c in a.Components)
                {
                    if (c is PrimitiveComponent { IsValid: true, bAttached: true, CollideActors: true } prim)
                        any |= Add(prim, ref min, ref max);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // Unreadable parts: fall back to the main component below.
                min = new Vector3(float.MaxValue);
                max = new Vector3(float.MinValue);
                any = false;
            }
        }

        if (!any)
        {
            // Some RVehicleCars throw from the Mesh getter itself (2026-11-05, every few seconds in the log), so a
            // part that can't be read leaves the default box instead of skipping the whole thing.
            // No generic CollisionComponent fallback: an actor with no attached colliding part is usually being torn
            // down, and reading its CollisionComponent then hit a freed object and crashed the game (2026-11-05, NG+
            // opening scene, an access violation no try/catch can stop). Such actors get the default box.
            PrimitiveComponent? main;
            try
            {
                main = a switch
                {
                    Vehicle v when v.Mesh is { IsValid: true } m => m,
                    SkeletalMeshActor k when k.SkeletalMeshComponent is { IsValid: true } sk => sk,
                    DynamicSMActor d when d.StaticMeshComponent is { IsValid: true } s => s,
                    _ => null,
                };
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                main = null;
            }

            if (main is { IsValid: true })
                any = Add(main, ref min, ref max);
        }

        Vector3 size = max - min;
        if (any && size.X > 1f && size.Y > 1f && size.Z > 1f && size.X < MaxBox && size.Y < MaxBox && size.Z < MaxBox)
        {
            Vector3 at = a.Location;
            t.Min = min - at;
            t.Max = max - at;
            return;
        }

        t.Min = new Vector3(-DefaultHalf);
        t.Max = new Vector3(DefaultHalf);
    }

    /// <summary>Grows a box to take in one component's bounds. Ignores a component that has no size yet.</summary>
    private static bool Add(PrimitiveComponent c, ref Vector3 min, ref Vector3 max)
    {
        GameObject.FBoxSphereBounds b = c.Bounds;
        Vector3 e = b.BoxExtent;
        if (!(e.X > 0f && e.Y > 0f && e.Z > 0f) || !float.IsFinite(b.Origin.X))
            return false;

        min = Vector3.Min(min, b.Origin - e);
        max = Vector3.Max(max, b.Origin + e);
        return true;
    }

    // ---- names

    private static readonly HashSet<string> Noise = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        "R", "SM", "SK", "SKM", "SKEL", "SKMESH", "MESH", "CHAR", "BASE", "DEFAULT", "BM", "LOD", "PAWN", "ACTOR", "KACTOR", "ARCHETYPE", "ARCH",
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// A short readable name. Props and characters are named after their mesh, which says what they are (a crate,
    /// a medic); a class name only says how they work. Vehicles, turrets and pickups are named after their class.
    /// </summary>
    private static string NameOf(Actor a, ThingKind kind)
    {
        string raw = "";
        try
        {
            raw = kind switch
            {
                ThingKind.Prop or ThingKind.Mover => (a as DynamicSMActor)?.StaticMeshComponent?.StaticMesh?.Name.ToString() ?? "",
                ThingKind.Other => a switch
                {
                    DynamicSMActor d => d.StaticMeshComponent?.StaticMesh?.Name.ToString() ?? "",
                    StaticMeshActor s => s.StaticMeshComponent?.StaticMesh?.Name.ToString() ?? "",
                    SkeletalMeshActor k => k.SkeletalMeshComponent?.SkeletalMesh?.Name.ToString() ?? "",
                    _ => "",
                },
                ThingKind.Enemy or ThingKind.Friendly => (a as Pawn)?.Mesh?.SkeletalMesh?.Name.ToString() ?? "",
                _ => "",
            };
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            raw = "";
        }

        string name = Pretty(raw);
        if (name.Length == 0)
            name = Pretty(a.Class?.Name.ToString() ?? "");
        return name.Length == 0 ? Labels[(int)kind] : name;
    }

    /// <summary>Splits an asset or class name into upper-case words, dropping prefixes like SM_ and R that say nothing.</summary>
    public static string Pretty(string raw)
    {
        if (raw.Length == 0)
            return "";

        var words = new List<string>();
        var word = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < raw.Length; i++)
        {
            char c = raw[i];
            if (c is '_' or ' ' or '-' or '.')
            {
                Flush();
                continue;
            }

            // A new word at a lower-to-upper change, or where letters meet digits.
            if (word.Length > 0)
            {
                char prev = word[^1];
                bool upperAfterLower = char.IsUpper(c) && char.IsLower(prev);
                bool upperRun = char.IsUpper(c) && char.IsUpper(prev) && i + 1 < raw.Length && char.IsLower(raw[i + 1]);
                bool digitEdge = char.IsDigit(c) != char.IsDigit(prev);
                if (upperAfterLower || upperRun || digitEdge)
                    Flush();
            }

            word.Append(c);
        }

        Flush();

        // A class prefix: "RVehicleTank" reads as R + Vehicle + Tank.
        while (words.Count > 1 && Noise.Contains(words[0]))
            words.RemoveAt(0);
        words.RemoveAll(w => Noise.Contains(w) && words.Count > 1);

        string name = string.Join(' ', words).ToUpperInvariant();
        return name.Length > 26 ? name.Substring(0, 26).TrimEnd() : name;

        void Flush()
        {
            if (word.Length > 0)
                words.Add(word.ToString());
            word.Clear();
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Editor/WorldEditor.Mode.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// EDITOR MODE: fly around and edit with the mouse and a few keys, without the menu. The game's own debug camera
/// swaps the player controller out, which would leave Oracle with no player, so this keeps the real camera instead:
/// Batman turns invisible, loses his collision and physics, and is flown by Oracle, with the game's camera following
/// him and the mouse still turning it. The game's bindings on the keys and buttons used here are muted the same
/// way the menu mutes its keys, and Oracle's own hotkeys on those keys wait until the mode ends.
/// </summary>
internal sealed partial class WorldEditor
{
    private const float FastFly = 4f;
    private const float GrabPush = 1.5f;
    private const double HoldToGrab = 0.2;
    private const float TurnStep = 15f;
    private const float SizeStep = 0.1f;

    // Virtual-key codes, read straight from the keyboard each tick.
    private const int VkLeftMouse = 0x01, VkRightMouse = 0x02, VkShift = 0x10, VkControl = 0x11, VkSpace = 0x20, VkDelete = 0x2E;

    /// <summary>Every key the mode reads. Oracle hotkeys on these wait while the mode is on.</summary>
    private static readonly int[] ModeKeys =
    {
        'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', 'Q', 'E', 'Z', 'X', 'F', 'G', 'R', VkSpace, VkControl, VkShift, VkDelete, VkLeftMouse, VkRightMouse,
    };

    private Toggle _mode = null!;
    private Slider _flySpeed = null!;
    private Toggle _stay = null!;
    private bool _modeOn;
    private readonly bool[] _was = new bool[256];
    private double _clickAt = -1;
    private bool _clickGrab;

    // ---- how the player was, to put back
    private nint _modePawn;
    private bool _modeInput;
    private Vector3 _modeStart;
    private Rotator _modeStartRot;
    private Vector3 _flyAt;
    private bool _wasHidden, _wasCollide, _wasBlock, _wasIgnore, _wasTickOff, _wasAnimsPaused;

    public bool ModeOn => _modeOn;

    private void BuildMode()
    {
        _mode = AddToggle("ed_mode", "EDITOR MODE",
            "Fly around and edit without the menu. WASD fly, SPACE and CTRL go up and down, SHIFT is faster. Left click selects, hold it to grab and let go to drop or throw; W and S push and pull what you hold. Right click deselects. Q E turn, Z X size, F freeze, G drop to ground, DELETE removes, R restores. Batman goes back where he was when it ends.",
            OnMode).Unsaved();
        _flySpeed = AddSlider("ed_fly_speed", "FLY SPEED", "How fast EDITOR MODE flies. Hold SHIFT for four times this.", 10f, 1f, 50f, 1f, 20f, v => Fmt.Count(v) + " M/S").Pref();
        _stay = AddToggle("ed_mode_stay", "STAY WHERE YOU FLEW", "When EDITOR MODE ends, Batman lands on the ground under where you flew to, instead of going back to where he started.").Pref();
    }

    /// <summary>An Oracle hotkey on a key editor mode uses waits, unless it's the key that turns the mode off.</summary>
    public bool Claims(Keys key, IReadOnlyList<Feature> features) =>
        _modeOn && !Menu.IsOpen && Array.IndexOf(ModeKeys, (int)key & 0xFF) >= 0 && !features.Contains(_mode);

    private void OnMode(bool on)
    {
        if (on)
            Change(_mode, EnterMode, () => _mode.On = false);
        else
            Change(_mode, () => LeaveMode(false), () => { });
    }

    private void EnterMode()
    {
        Transition.RequireIdle();
        if (FreeCam.I.Active)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("turn off FREE CAMERA and TRIPOD first");
        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer p || World.Pc is not { } pc)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("get out of the Batmobile first");

        _modePawn = p.Ptr;
        _modeStart = p.Location;
        _modeStartRot = p.Rotation;
        _flyAt = p.Location;
        _wasHidden = p.bHidden;
        _wasCollide = p.bCollideActors;
        _wasBlock = p.bBlockActors;
        _wasIgnore = p.bIgnoreEncroachers;
        _wasTickOff = p.bTickIsDisabled;
        _wasAnimsPaused = p.Mesh is { IsValid: true } mesh && mesh.bPauseAnims;

        p.SetCollision(false, false, _wasIgnore);
        p.SetPhysics(Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_None, false);
        p.Velocity = Vector3.Zero;
        p.SetHidden(true);
        Still(p);
        pc.IgnoreMoveInput(true);
        _modeInput = true;

        Array.Clear(_was);
        // Keys already down when the mode starts (the hotkey, a held click) count only once they're let go.
        foreach (int vk in ModeKeys)
            _was[vk] = Native.GameInFront() && (Native.GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) != 0;
        _clickAt = -1;
        _clickGrab = false;
        _modeOn = true;
        MuteKeys();
        Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, "EDITOR MODE", true);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Puts Batman back as he was. <paramref name="quiet"/> is for a load or unload: the pawn may already be gone,
    /// so he isn't moved, only made visible and solid again if he's still there.
    /// </summary>
    public void LeaveMode(bool quiet)
    {
        if (!_modeOn)
            return;

        _modeOn = false;
        _mode.On = false;
        if (_grab.On)
        {
            _grab.On = false;
            Release(false);
        }

        PlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (!Menu.IsOpen && !Radial.IsLive)
            Safe.Run("editor keys", () => GameKeys.Unmute(pc));
        if (_modeInput && pc != null)
            Safe.Run("editor input", () => pc.IgnoreMoveInput(false));
        _modeInput = false;

        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer p || p.Ptr != _modePawn)
            return;

        p.SetHidden(_wasHidden);
        p.SetCollision(_wasCollide, _wasBlock, _wasIgnore);
        if (p.bTickIsDisabled != _wasTickOff)
            p.SetTickIsDisabled(_wasTickOff);
        if (p.Mesh is { IsValid: true } mesh && mesh.bPauseAnims != _wasAnimsPaused)
            mesh.bPauseAnims = _wasAnimsPaused;
        if (!quiet)
        {
            Vector3 at = _modeStart;
            if (_stay.On)
            {
                var top = _flyAt + Vector3.UnitZ * 50f;
                if (Teleport.Ray(p, top, top - Vector3.UnitZ * GroundReach, out Vector3 floor, out _))
                    at = floor + Vector3.UnitZ * Teleport.Lift(p);
            }

            Teleport.Place(p, at, _modeStartRot);
        }

        p.SetPhysics(Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_Falling, true);
        p.Velocity = Vector3.Zero;
        if (!quiet)
            Teleport.Settle(p);
    }

    /// <summary>The menu and radial unmute every key when they close, so the mode takes its keys back after them.</summary>
    private static void MuteKeys()
    {
        if (!GameKeys.IsMuted && World.Pc is { } pc)
            GameKeys.Mute(pc, editor: true);
    }

    private bool Down(int vk) => (Native.GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) != 0;

    /// <summary>True on the tick a key goes down.</summary>
    private bool Pressed(int vk, bool down)
    {
        bool was = _was[vk];
        _was[vk] = down;
        return down && !was;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the mode's tick. If it ever fails, the mode ends and Batman is given back at once: he's hidden, frozen
    /// and out of physics while it runs, so a mode that silently stops working would leave him stuck.
    /// </summary>
    private void RunMode(float dt)
    {
        try
        {
            ModeTick(dt);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Editor mode stopped: " + Log.Why(ex));
            Safe.Run("editor mode", () => LeaveMode(false));
            Overlay.Notice("EDITOR MODE", "STOPPED: " + ex.Message.ToUpperInvariant(), false);
        }
    }

    private void ModeTick(float dt)
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer p || p.Ptr != _modePawn)
        {
            LeaveMode(true);
            return;
        }

        // Keep Batman out of the way: the game puts walking physics back when it thinks he has landed.
        if (p.Physics != Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_None)
            p.SetPhysics(Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_None, false);
        if (!p.bHidden)
            p.SetHidden(true);
        if (p.bCollideActors)
            p.SetCollision(false, false, _wasIgnore);
        Still(p);

        bool listening = !Menu.IsOpen && !Radial.IsLive && !World.Paused && Native.GameInFront();
        if (!listening)
        {
            // Nothing pressed while the menu had the keys may count once it closes.
            foreach (int vk in ModeKeys)
                _was[vk] = true;
            Hover(p);
            return;
        }

        MuteKeys();
        WorldView.ReadCamera();
        bool held = _grab.On && _clickGrab;

        // ---- flying
        var move = Vector3.Zero;
        if (!held)
        {
            if (Down('W')) move += WorldView.Forward;
            if (Down('S')) move -= WorldView.Forward;
        }
        else
        {
            float push = (Down('W') ? 1f : 0f) - (Down('S') ? 1f : 0f);
            _holdDistance = Math.Clamp(_holdDistance + push * _flySpeed.Value * Metre * GrabPush * dt, GrabMin, CrosshairReach);
        }

        if (Down('D')) move += Flat(WorldView.Right);
        if (Down('A')) move -= Flat(WorldView.Right);
        if (Down(VkSpace)) move += Vector3.UnitZ;
        if (Down(VkControl)) move -= Vector3.UnitZ;
        if (move.LengthSquared() > 0.0001f)
            _flyAt += Vector3.Normalize(move) * _flySpeed.Value * Metre * (Down(VkShift) ? FastFly : 1f) * dt;
        Hover(p);

        // ---- mouse: click selects, holding grabs, letting go drops or throws
        bool left = Down(VkLeftMouse);
        if (Pressed(VkLeftMouse, left))
        {
            Scan();
            Thing? aimed = Aimed();
            if (aimed != _selected)
                Select(aimed);
            _clickAt = aimed != null ? Clock.Now : -1;
        }
        else if (left && _clickAt >= 0 && !_grab.On && Clock.Now - _clickAt >= HoldToGrab && Selected is { Fixed: false })
        {
            _grab.On = true;
            OnGrab(true);
            _clickGrab = _grab.On;
        }
        else if (!left)
        {
            _clickAt = -1;
            if (_clickGrab)
            {
                _clickGrab = false;
                if (_grab.On)
                {
                    _grab.On = false;
                    OnGrab(false);
                }
            }
        }

        if (Pressed(VkRightMouse, Down(VkRightMouse)) && !_grab.On)
            Select(null);

        // ---- edit keys
        if (Pressed('Q', Down('Q')))
            Turn(-TurnStep);
        if (Pressed('E', Down('E')))
            Turn(TurnStep);
        if (Pressed('Z', Down('Z')))
            Resize(-SizeStep);
        if (Pressed('X', Down('X')))
            Resize(SizeStep);
        if (Pressed('F', Down('F')))
            Flip(_freeze);
        if (Pressed(VkDelete, Down(VkDelete)))
            Flip(_remove);
        if (Pressed('G', Down('G')))
            Try("DROP TO GROUND", DropToGround);
        if (Pressed('R', Down('R')))
            Try("RESTORE", RestoreSelected);

        // Keys not read above still need their state kept, so a press is seen once.
        foreach (int vk in new[] { 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D', VkSpace, VkControl, VkShift })
            _was[vk] = Down(vk);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Stops Batman's own update and animation. AK ignores IgnoreMoveInput (as it does IgnoreButtonInput), so WASD
    /// still walked him in place: footsteps, and a camera reacting to his walk. The controller keeps ticking, so the
    /// mouse still turns the camera.
    /// </summary>
    private static void Still(RPawnPlayer p)
    {
        if (!p.bTickIsDisabled)
            p.SetTickIsDisabled(true);
        if (p.Mesh is { IsValid: true } mesh && !mesh.bPauseAnims)
            mesh.bPauseAnims = true;
    }

    /// <summary>Holds Batman at the fly position, which the camera follows.</summary>
    private void Hover(RPawnPlayer p)
    {
        if (Vector3.DistanceSquared(p.Location, _flyAt) > 1f)
            p.SetLocation(_flyAt);
        p.Velocity = Vector3.Zero;
    }

    private void Turn(float step)
    {
        if (_grab.On)
        {
            _holdYaw += step;
            return;
        }

        Try("TURN", () =>
        {
            float v = _yaw.Value + step;
            if (v > 180f)
                v -= 360f;
            if (v < -180f)
                v += 360f;
            Rotate(v, e => e.Yaw, (e, x) => e.Yaw = x, (r, d) => new Rotator(r.Pitch, r.Yaw + d, r.Roll));
            _yaw.Value = v;
        });
    }

    private void Resize(float step)
    {
        if (Selected == null)
        {
            Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, "NOTHING SELECTED", false);
            return;
        }

        _scale.Value = MathF.Round(Math.Clamp(_scale.Value + step, _scale.Min, _scale.Max), 2);
        SetScale(_scale.Value);
    }

    /// <summary>Flips a state row as if it had been changed in the menu.</summary>
    private static void Flip(Toggle row)
    {
        row.On = !row.On;
        row.Changed?.Invoke(row.On);
        Overlay.Toast(row.Label, row.State, row.On);
    }

    private static void Try(string what, Action action)
    {
        try
        {
            action();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Overlay.Notice(what, ex.Message.ToUpperInvariant(), false);
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
    public override void Started() => SetStep(_step.Value);

    private Slider AddNudge(string id, string label, string help, Func<Edit, float> get, Action<Edit, float> set, Func<Vector3> axis)
    {
        Slider row = null!;
        row = AddSlider(id, label, help, 0f, -100f, 100f, 0.5f, 1f, SignedMetres, v => Change(row, () => Nudge(v, get, set, axis), () => row.Value = Current(get, 0f)));
        return row.Pref().Unsaved();
    }

    private Slider AddTurn(string id, string label, string help, Func<Edit, float> get, Action<Edit, float> set, Func<Rotator, float, Rotator> turn)
    {
```
