```cs
        row = AddSlider(id, label, help, 0f, -180f, 180f, 15f, 90f, SignedDegrees, v => Change(row, () => Rotate(v, get, set, turn), () => row.Value = Current(get, 0f)));
        return row.Pref().Unsaved();
    }

    private static string SignedMetres(float v) => MathF.Abs(v) < 0.001f ? "0 M" : (v > 0f ? "+" : "") + v.ToString("0.0", Inv) + " M";

    private static string SignedDegrees(float v) => MathF.Abs(v) < 0.001f ? "0 DEG" : (v > 0f ? "+" : "") + v.ToString("0", Inv) + " DEG";

    private void SetStep(float v)
    {
        foreach (Slider s in new[] { _forward, _side, _up })
        {
            if (s != null)
                s.Stride = v;
        }
    }

    // ---- lifecycle

    public override void WorldChanged() => Reset();

    public override void LeftGame() => Reset();

    /// <summary>A new world: every object is gone, so the journal is dropped without trying to put anything back.</summary>
    private void Reset()
    {
        _modeOn = false;
        _mode.On = false;
        _grab.On = false;
        _holding = false;
        _selected = null;
        _things.Clear();
        Edits.Forget();
        Things.Forget();
        SyncRows();
        _target.Saved = "";
        _target.SetOptions(new[] { "" }, new[] { "NOTHING" });
        _scan.Force();
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        Safe.Run("editor mode", () => LeaveMode(true));
        Safe.Run("editor grab", () => Release(false));
        Safe.Run("editor restore", () => Edits.RestoreAll());
    }

    public override void MenuOpening()
    {
        Scan();
        RefreshList();
    }

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (!World.InGame)
            return;

        if (_selected != null && !_selected.Alive)
        {
            if (_grab.On)
                _grab.On = false;
            _holding = false;
            _selected = null;
            SyncRows();
        }

        // Cutscenes spawn and tear down actors fastest, which is where a half-destroyed one crashed a scan, and
        // nothing in the list can be used during one anyway.
        bool cinematic = Safe.Try("editor cinematic check", () => World.Pc is { } pc && CameraRig.InCinematic(pc), fallback: true);
        if (!cinematic && (AnyShown || _selected != null || _grab.On || _modeOn || Menu.IsOpen || Edits.Count > 0) && _scan.Elapsed(ScanSeconds))
        {
            Scan();
            if (Menu.IsOpen)
                RefreshList();
        }

        if (_modeOn)
            RunMode(dt);
        if (_grab.On)
            Safe.Run("editor grab", () => HoldGrabbed(dt));
        Safe.Run("editor hold", Edits.Hold);
    }

    public override void Draw(Canvas c) => EditorView.Draw(this, c);

    // ---- scanning and the list

    private bool PicksKind(ThingKind k) => _pickFrom.Index == 0 || _pickFrom.Index - 1 == (int)k;

    private void Scan()
    {
        _scan.Force();
        _scan.Elapsed(ScanSeconds);
        Pawn? me = World.Pawn;
        if (me == null)
        {
            _things.Clear();
            return;
        }

        // Kinds that are marked, plus whatever selecting can choose from while the editor is in use.
        bool editing = Menu.IsOpen || _selected != null || _grab.On || _modeOn;
        for (int k = 0; k < Things.KindCount; k++)
            _wanted[k] = _show[k].On || (editing && PicksKind((ThingKind)k));

        _keep.Clear();
        if (_selected != null)
            _keep.Add(_selected.Ptr);
        foreach (nint p in Edits.Pointers)
            _keep.Add(p);

        Things.Scan(_things, me.Location, _range.Value * Metre, _wanted, _keep, ScanMax);
    }

    private void RefreshList()
    {
        var keys = new List<string> { "" };
        var labels = new List<string> { "NOTHING" };
        foreach (Thing t in _things)
        {
            if (keys.Count > ListMax)
                break;
            if (PicksKind(t.Kind) && t.Alive)
            {
                keys.Add(t.Key);
                labels.Add(ListLabel(t));
            }
        }

        if (Selected is { } s && !keys.Contains(s.Key))
        {
            keys.Insert(1, s.Key);
            labels.Insert(1, ListLabel(s));
        }

        _target.Saved = Selected?.Key ?? "";
        _target.SetOptions(keys.ToArray(), labels.ToArray());
    }

    private static string ListLabel(Thing t) =>
        t.Name + "  " + Fmt.Metres(t.Distance / Metre) + (Edits.Find(t) is { Changed: true } ? "  *" : "");

    private void OnTarget()
    {
        string key = _target.CurrentKey;
        Select(key.Length == 0 ? null : _things.Find(t => t.Key == key && t.Alive));
    }

    // ---- selection

    private void Select(Thing? t)
    {
        if (_grab.On && t != _selected)
        {
            Release(false);
            _grab.On = false;
        }

        _selected = t;
        SyncRows();
        RefreshList();
    }

    /// <summary>Shows the selected object's state on the editor rows.</summary>
    private void SyncRows()
    {
        Edit? e = _selected == null ? null : Edits.Find(_selected);
        _forward.Value = e?.Forward ?? 0f;
        _side.Value = e?.Side ?? 0f;
        _up.Value = e?.Up ?? 0f;
        _yaw.Value = e?.Yaw ?? 0f;
        _pitch.Value = e?.Pitch ?? 0f;
        _roll.Value = e?.Roll ?? 0f;
        _scale.Value = e?.Scale ?? 1f;
        _freeze.On = e?.Frozen ?? false;
        _remove.On = e?.Removed ?? false;
        _ghost.On = e?.Ghost ?? false;
    }

    private bool Has(Func<Edit, bool> get) => _selected != null && Edits.Find(_selected) is { } e && get(e);

    private float Current(Func<Edit, float> get, float fallback) =>
        _selected != null && Edits.Find(_selected) is { } e ? get(e) : fallback;

    /// <summary>
    /// What the crosshair is on: the object whose silhouette is nearest the middle of the screen. Inside a
    /// silhouette the nearest object wins, so a crate in front of a tank is picked over the tank.
    /// </summary>
    public Thing? Aimed()
    {
        if (!WorldView.Ready)
            return null;

        Thing? best = Nearest(out float bestDist, out bool inside);
        Thing? hit = Traced(out float hitDist);
        if (hit == null)
            return best;
        if (best == null || best == hit)
            return hit;

        // The crosshair's ray is exact; the silhouette pick is forgiving. The silhouette wins only when the crosshair
        // is inside its outline and it's in front of what the ray hit, so a crate that doesn't block the ray (no
        // collision) is still picked, but one beside the crosshair doesn't steal the car the ray is on.
        return inside && bestDist <= hitDist + best.Radius ? best : hit;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whatever the crosshair's ray hits first, of any kind: doors, scenery, a vehicle the scan didn't reach.
    /// Level geometry (BSP, which reports as WorldInfo) and volumes are skipped.
    /// </summary>
    private Thing? Traced(out float dist)
    {
        dist = float.MaxValue;
        Pawn? me = World.Pawn;
        if (me == null)
            return null;

        Vector3 eye = WorldView.Eye;
        Actor? a = me.Trace(out Vector3 at, out _, eye + WorldView.Forward * TraceReach, eye, Component.ECollisionFilter.COF_TraceAll, Vector3.Zero, out _, 0);
        if (a is not { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false } || a is WorldInfo or Brush || a.Ptr == me.Ptr || a.Ptr == (World.Player?.Ptr ?? 0))
            return null;

        Thing t = Things.Wrap(a);
        if (!PicksKind(t.Kind))
            return null;

        dist = Vector3.Distance(eye, at);
        return t;
    }

    private Thing? Nearest(out float bestDist, out bool inside)
    {
        bestDist = float.MaxValue;
        inside = false;

        Thing? best = null;
        float bestScore = float.MaxValue;
        foreach (Thing t in _things)
        {
            if (!PicksKind(t.Kind) || !t.Alive)
                continue;

            Vector3 c = t.Centre;
            float dist = Vector3.Distance(c, WorldView.Eye);
            if (dist < 1f)
                continue;

            float half = MathF.Max(t.Radius, (t.Max.Z - t.Min.Z) * 0.5f);
            float size = MathF.Atan2(half, dist) * 180f / MathF.PI;
            float outside = WorldView.AngleTo(c) - size;
            if (outside > PickCone)
                continue;

            float score = MathF.Max(0f, outside) * 100f + dist / Metre;
            if (score < bestScore)
            {
                bestScore = score;
                best = t;
                bestDist = dist;
                inside = outside <= 0f;
            }
        }

        return best;
    }

    private void PickAimed()
    {
        WorldView.ReadCamera();
        Scan();
        Thing t = Aimed() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(_pickFrom.Index == 0 ? "nothing there" : "no " + _pickFrom.State.ToLowerInvariant() + " there");
        Select(t);
        Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, t.Name + " SELECTED", true);
    }

    private Thing RequireSelected() => Selected ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("nothing selected: use SELECT AIMED or the SELECTED list");

    private Thing RequireMovable()
    {
        Thing t = RequireSelected();
        return t.Fixed ? throw new InvalidOperationException("it's part of the level and can't move") : t;
    }

    private Edit Edit() => Edits.Begin(RequireSelected());

    /// <summary>
    /// Runs a row's change on the selected object. A row can't refuse through the menu the way a command does, so a
    /// failure shows its reason and the row goes back to what the object really is.
    /// </summary>
    private static void Change(Feature row, Action change, Action revert)
    {
        try
        {
            change();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Safe.Run("editor revert", revert);
            Log.Info(row.Label + " failed: " + ex.Message);
            Overlay.Notice(row.Label, ex.Message.ToUpperInvariant(), false);
        }
    }

    // ---- moving

    private static Vector3 Flat(Vector3 v)
    {
        v.Z = 0f;
        return v.LengthSquared() < 0.0001f ? Vector3.UnitX : Vector3.Normalize(v);
    }

    /// <summary>Moves the selected object and records it, keeping a frozen object frozen at its new spot.</summary>
    private static void Move(Thing t, Edit e, Vector3 at, Rotator rot)
    {
        e.Moved = true;
        Edits.Put(t.Actor, at, rot);
        if (e.Frozen)
        {
            e.FrozenAt = at;
            e.FrozenRotation = rot;
        }
    }

    private void Nudge(float value, Func<Edit, float> get, Action<Edit, float> set, Func<Vector3> axis)
    {
        Thing t = RequireMovable();
        Edit e = Edits.Begin(t);
        float delta = value - get(e);
        if (MathF.Abs(delta) < 0.0001f)
            return;

        WorldView.ReadCamera();
        Move(t, e, t.Actor.Location + axis() * delta * Metre, t.Actor.Rotation);
        set(e, value);
    }

    private void Rotate(float value, Func<Edit, float> get, Action<Edit, float> set, Func<Rotator, float, Rotator> turn)
    {
        Thing t = RequireMovable();
        Edit e = Edits.Begin(t);
        float delta = value - get(e);
        if (MathF.Abs(delta) < 0.0001f)
            return;

        Move(t, e, t.Actor.Location, turn(t.Actor.Rotation, delta));
        set(e, value);
    }

    private void SetScale(float v) => Change(_scale, () =>
    {
        Thing t = RequireSelected();
        Edit e = Edits.Begin(t);
        t.Actor.SetDrawScale(e.DrawScale * v);
        e.Scale = v;
        t.BoxAt = double.MinValue;
    }, () => _scale.Value = Current(e => e.Scale, 1f));

    /// <summary>
    /// Sets an object down with the bottom of its box on the floor under <paramref name="spot"/>, searching down from
    /// <paramref name="fromZ"/>. The box is centred on the spot. With no floor found it goes to the spot as it is.
    /// </summary>
    private static void Land(Thing t, Vector3 spot, float fromZ, Rotator rot)
    {
        Pawn tracer = World.RequirePawn();
        Vector3 centre = (t.Min + t.Max) * 0.5f;
        var top = new Vector3(spot.X, spot.Y, fromZ);
        Vector3 at = Teleport.Ray(tracer, top, top - Vector3.UnitZ * GroundReach, out Vector3 floor, out _)
            ? new Vector3(spot.X, spot.Y, floor.Z - t.Min.Z + 2f)
            : new Vector3(spot.X, spot.Y, spot.Z - centre.Z);
        at.X -= centre.X;
        at.Y -= centre.Y;
        Move(t, Edits.Begin(t), at, rot);
    }

    private void GoTo()
    {
        Thing t = RequireSelected();
        Pawn mover = Teleport.RequireMover();
        Vector3 c = t.Centre;
        Vector3 away = mover.Location - c;
        away.Z = 0f;
        Vector3 dir = away.LengthSquared() > 1f ? Vector3.Normalize(away) : -Flat(Geo.Facing(mover.Rotation.Yaw));
        Vector3 spot = c + dir * (t.Radius + StandOff);
        float bottom = t.Actor.Location.Z + t.Min.Z;
        float lift = Teleport.Lift(mover);
        var top = new Vector3(spot.X, spot.Y, bottom + 200f);
        spot = Teleport.Ray(mover, top, top - Vector3.UnitZ * GroundReach, out Vector3 floor, out _)
            ? floor + Vector3.UnitZ * lift
            : new Vector3(spot.X, spot.Y, bottom + lift);
        Teleport.I.Hop(spot, new Rotator(0f, Rotator.FromDirection(-dir).Yaw, 0f));
    }

    private void Bring()
    {
        Thing t = RequireMovable();
        Pawn me = World.RequirePawn();
        WorldView.ReadCamera();
        Vector3 spot = me.Location + Flat(WorldView.Forward) * (t.Radius + me.GetCollisionRadius() + BringGap);
        Land(t, spot, me.Location.Z + 200f, t.Actor.Rotation);
        Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, t.Name + " BROUGHT", true);
    }

    private void PlaceAtCrosshair()
    {
        Thing t = RequireMovable();
        Pawn me = World.RequirePawn();
        WorldView.ReadCamera();
        Vector3 eye = WorldView.Eye;
        if (!Teleport.Ray(me, eye, eye + WorldView.Forward * CrosshairReach, out Vector3 hit, out Vector3 normal))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("aim at the ground or a wall");

        // A floor takes the object standing on it; a wall takes it in front, then down to the floor there.
        Vector3 spot = normal.Z > 0.5f ? hit : hit + normal * (t.Radius + 20f);
        Land(t, spot, spot.Z + 50f, t.Actor.Rotation);
    }

    private void DropToGround()
    {
        Thing t = RequireMovable();
        Land(t, t.Centre, t.Actor.Location.Z + t.Min.Z - 5f, t.Actor.Rotation);
    }

    // ---- grab

    private void OnGrab(bool on)
    {
        if (!on)
        {
            Release(true);
            return;
        }

        Change(_grab, () =>
        {
            WorldView.ReadCamera();
            if (Selected == null)
            {
                Scan();
                Select(Aimed() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("nothing to grab: aim at something or select it first"));
                _grab.On = true;
            }

            Thing t = RequireMovable();
            Edit e = Edits.Begin(t);
            if (e.Removed)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("it's removed");

            e.Moved = true;
            Vector3 c = t.Centre;
            _holdOffset = c - t.Actor.Location;
            _holdDistance = MathF.Max(GrabMin, Vector3.Distance(WorldView.Eye, c));
            _holdYaw = t.Actor.Rotation.Yaw - WorldView.Rotation.Yaw;
            _handVelocity = Vector3.Zero;
            _holding = false;
            Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, "GRABBED " + t.Name, true);
        }, () => _grab.On = false);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Holds the grabbed object at a point in front of the camera every tick, turning with the camera. A character is
    /// kept frozen while held, so its AI and walking don't fight the hold. The hand's speed is tracked for the throw.
    /// </summary>
    private void HoldGrabbed(float dt)
    {
        Thing? t = Selected;
        if (t == null || dt <= 0f || !WorldView.ReadCamera())
        {
            if (t == null)
                _grab.On = false;
            return;
        }

        Actor a = t.Actor;
        float dist = !_modeOn && _grabDistance.Value > 0f ? _grabDistance.Value * Metre : _holdDistance;
        Vector3 at = WorldView.Eye + WorldView.Forward * dist - _holdOffset;
        var rot = new Rotator(a.Rotation.Pitch, WorldView.Rotation.Yaw + _holdYaw, a.Rotation.Roll);

        if (_holding)
            _handVelocity = Vector3.Lerp(_handVelocity, (at - _lastHold) / dt, 0.35f);
        _lastHold = at;
        _holding = true;

        if (a is Pawn p && Edits.IsCharacter(a))
            Npcs.SetFrozen(p, true);
        Move(t, Edits.Begin(t), at, rot);
    }

    /// <summary>Lets go. A frozen object stays put; anything else falls, flying off at the hand's speed if thrown.</summary>
    private void Release(bool throwIt)
    {
        bool held = _holding;
        _holding = false;
        Thing? t = Selected;
        if (!held || t == null)
            return;

        Actor a = t.Actor;
        Edit? e = Edits.Find(t);
        if (e is { Frozen: true } || e is { Removed: true })
            return;

        if (a is Pawn p && Edits.IsCharacter(a))
            Npcs.SetFrozen(p, false);

        Vector3 v = throwIt ? _handVelocity : Vector3.Zero;
        if (v.Length() > ThrowMax)
            v = Vector3.Normalize(v) * ThrowMax;
        if (Edits.IsCharacter(a) || Edits.IsRigid(a))
            Edits.Fling(a, v, Vector3.Zero);
    }

    // ---- actions

    private void Launch()
    {
        Thing t = RequireMovable();
        Edit e = Edits.Begin(t);
        if (e.Frozen || e.Removed)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(e.Frozen ? "it's frozen" : "it's removed");

        WorldView.ReadCamera();
        var spin = new Vector3(Random.Shared.NextSingle() - 0.5f, Random.Shared.NextSingle() - 0.5f, Random.Shared.NextSingle() - 0.5f) * 6f;
        Edits.Fling(t.Actor, Vector3.UnitZ * LaunchUp + Flat(WorldView.Forward) * LaunchForward, spin);
        e.Moved = true;
    }

    private void Flip()
    {
        Thing t = RequireMovable();
        if (!Edits.IsRigid(t.Actor))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("only vehicles and loose props flip");

        Actor a = t.Actor;
        Rotator r = a.Rotation;
        Move(t, Edits.Begin(t), a.Location + Vector3.UnitZ * FlipLift, new Rotator(r.Pitch, r.Yaw, r.Roll + 180f));
    }

    private void Heal()
    {
        if (RequireSelected().Actor is not Pawn p)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("it has no health");
        if (p.Health <= 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(p is Vehicle ? "it's destroyed" : "they're knocked out: use REVIVE");

        int full = Math.Max(p.HealthMax, p.Health);
        if (p.Health >= full)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("already at full health");
        p.Health = full;
        Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, "HEALED", true);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Each kind goes the way the game itself destroys it, so its death, debris and save state all run. Parked or
    /// sleeping tanks are refused: lethal damage left them frozen at 0 health without their death sequence (see
    /// DESTROY ALL TANKS).
    /// </summary>
    private void Destroy()
    {
        Thing t = RequireSelected();
        Actor a = t.Actor;
        Controller? by = World.Pc;
        switch (a)
        {
            case RVehicleBatmobileBase:
                throw new InvalidOperationException("not the Batmobile");
            case RVehicleTank tank when tank is RVehicleStaticTank || tank.CurrentBehaviour is not { IsValid: true }:
                throw new InvalidOperationException("that tank is parked or held by a mission and would break");
            case RSentryGunBase gun:
                if (gun.bGoneRagdoll)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("already destroyed");
                gun.Explode(true);
                if (!gun.bGoneRagdoll)
                    gun.GoPhysicsAndTriggerEvent();
                break;
            case RTurretBase turret:
                if (turret.bDisabled)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("already switched off");
                turret.Disrupted();
                break;
            case RSmashableProp prop:
                prop.BreakProp();
                break;
            case Pawn p:
                if (p.Health <= 0 || p is RPawnVillain { bGoodAsDead: true })
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("already down");
                p.TakeDamage(Lethal, by!, p.Location, Vector3.Zero, RDmgType_DebugKill.StaticClass(), default, null!);
                break;
            default:
                a.TakeDamage(Lethal, by!, a.Location, Vector3.UnitZ * 1000f, RDmgType_DebugKill.StaticClass(), default, null!);
                break;
        }

        Log.Info("Editor: destroyed " + t.Name + " (" + a.Class.Name + ").");
    }

    private RBMPawnAI RequireCharacter() =>
        RequireSelected().Actor as RBMPawnAI ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("only characters can do that");

    private void Disarm()
    {
        RBMPawnAI ai = RequireCharacter();
        if (ai.CurrWeapon is not { IsValid: true })
            throw new InvalidOperationException("they aren't holding a weapon");
        ai.ForceDisarm();
    }

    private void Revive()
    {
        RBMPawnAI ai = RequireCharacter();
        if (ai.Health > 0 && ai is not RPawnVillain { bGoodAsDead: true })
            throw new InvalidOperationException("they aren't knocked out");
        ai.WakeFromDeadWithDefaults();
    }

    private void Turn()
    {
        if (RequireSelected().Actor is not RPawnVillain v)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("only enemies can be turned");
        Npcs.I.Turn(v);
    }

    // ---- undo

    private void RestoreSelected()
    {
        Thing t = RequireSelected();
        Edit e = Edits.Find(t) is { Changed: true } found ? found : throw new InvalidOperationException("it hasn't been changed");
        if (_grab.On)
        {
            _holding = false;
            _grab.On = false;
        }

        Edits.Restore(e);
        SyncRows();
        RefreshList();
        Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, t.Name + " RESTORED", true);
    }

    private void RestoreAll()
    {
        if (_grab.On)
        {
            _holding = false;
            _grab.On = false;
        }

        int n = Edits.RestoreAll();
        SyncRows();
        RefreshList();
        if (n == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("nothing has been changed");
        Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, Fmt.Plural(n, "OBJECT") + " RESTORED", true);
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Plays the player's own songs through Windows MCI, on a worker thread because MCI calls can stall, and lets
/// the player browse and play the game's own sound events through its audio engine.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Music : Module
{
    public static readonly Music I = new();

    private const string Folder = "Music";
    private const string Alias = "oraclemusic";
    private const string SoundsFile = "sounds.txt";
    private const string StopKey = "MusicStop";
    private const int Shuffle = 1;
    private const int RepeatOne = 2;
    private const int MaxLabel = 30;

    private static readonly string[] Extensions = { ".mp3", ".wav", ".wma" };

    [DllImport("winmm.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private static extern int mciSendString(string command, StringBuilder? returnValue, int returnLength, nint hwndCallback);

    private sealed class Worker
    {
        private readonly BlockingCollection<Action> _jobs = new();
        private volatile bool _open;
        public volatile bool Finished;
        public volatile string Error = "";

        public Worker()
        {
            var thread = new Thread(Loop) { IsBackground = true, Name = "Oracle music" };
            thread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
            thread.Start();
        }

        public void Post(Action job)
        {
            if (!_jobs.IsAddingCompleted)
                _jobs.Add(job);
        }

        /// <summary>Ends the thread. A running thread would keep the old assembly alive after a hot reload.</summary>
        public void Stop() => _jobs.CompleteAdding();

        private static string Send(string cmd)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder(128);
            int err = mciSendString(cmd, sb, sb.Capacity, 0);
            return err == 0 ? sb.ToString() : "!" + err;
        }

        public void Open(string file, int volume)
        {
            Close();
            string type = file.EndsWith(".wav", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "waveaudio" : "mpegvideo";
            string r = Send("open \"" + file + "\" type " + type + " alias " + Alias);
            if (r.StartsWith('!') && type == "waveaudio")
                r = Send("open \"" + file + "\" type mpegvideo alias " + Alias);
            if (r.StartsWith('!'))
            {
                Error = "could not open " + Path.GetFileName(file) + " (MCI error " + r.Substring(1) + ")";
                return;
            }

            _open = true;
            Finished = false;
            SetVolume(volume);
            Send("play " + Alias);
        }

        public void SetVolume(int volume)
        {
            if (_open)
                Send("setaudio " + Alias + " volume to " + Math.Clamp(volume, 0, 1000));
        }

        public void Pause()
        {
            if (_open)
                Send("pause " + Alias);
        }

        public void Resume()
        {
            if (_open)
                Send("resume " + Alias);
        }

        public void Close()
        {
            if (!_open)
                return;

            Send("stop " + Alias);
            Send("close " + Alias);
            _open = false;
        }


        private void Loop()
        {
            while (!_jobs.IsCompleted)
            {
                if (_jobs.TryTake(out Action? job, 250))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        job();
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        Error = ex.Message;
                    }
                }

                if (_open && Send("status " + Alias + " mode") == "stopped")
                {
                    Close();
                    Finished = true;
                }
            }

            Close();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The game's soundtrack is not a set of sound events but the states of one Wwise state group,
    /// Ww_MUSIC_GameState (explore, combat, chase, predator, puzzle...), which its sound director switches
    /// between. Other state groups shape the mix (rooms, districts, fear gas). Sound events live in packages
    /// named Ww_&lt;category&gt;_... The browser shows all of it, by category.
    /// </summary>
    private static readonly (string Key, string Label)[] Categories =
    {
        ("music", "MUSIC"),
        ("mix", "MIX STATES"),
        ("MUS", "MUSIC CUES"),
        ("PSO", "WORLD OBJECTS"),

        ("WEA", "WEATHER"),

        ("UI", "INTERFACE"),

        ("SEQ", "SEQUENCES"),
        ("other", "OTHER EVENTS"),
        ("all", "EVERY EVENT"),
    };

    private const string NoSound = "none";

    private const string StatePrefix = "state:";
    private const string MusicGroup = "MUSIC";
    private const string MusicStatePrefix = "MUSIC_";

    /// <summary>Words that mark an event as placed music (the Penguin van jingle, lifts, jukeboxes), whatever its package.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] MusicWords = { "MUSIC", "_MUS", "_MX", "MUZAK", "JINGLE", "JUKEBOX", "SONG", "PIANO", "GRAMOPHONE", "RECORD_PLAYER", "ELEVATOR", "LIFT_MUS" };

    private readonly List<string> _tracks = new();
    private readonly List<string> _sounds = new();
    private Choice _soundFilter = null!;
    private Choice _sound = null!;
    private Choice _transitionSound = null!;
    private string _playingSound = "";
    private string _transitionPlaying = "";
    private nint _attachedTo;
    private (int Music, int Dialogue)? _volumes;
    private readonly List<AkParameterName> _quietened = new();

    /// <summary>Mixer parameters that take the world down under the teleport sound: the weather, combat and effects buses, and a muffle on the ambience beds.</summary>
    private static readonly (string Name, float Value)[] QuietParameters =
    {
        ("BUS_SFX_Weather", -1f),
        ("BUS_SFX_Combat", -1f),
        ("BUS_SFX_VFX", -1f),
        ("Ambience_LowPass", 1f),
    };
    private readonly Random _random = new();
    private Worker? _worker;

    private bool _playing;

    public override void Build()

        _soundFilter = AddChoice("sound_filter", "SHOW", "Which sounds to list. MUSIC is the soundtrack: the moods the game's sound director switches between (explore, combat, chase, predator, puzzle...). MIX STATES shape the sound of rooms and districts. The rest are the game's sound events by category.",
            Categories.Select(f => f.Key).ToArray(), Categories.Select(f => f.Label).ToArray(), _ => ListSounds()).Setting();
        _sound = AddChoice("sound_event", "SOUND", "Hold left or right to scroll. PLAY SOUND starts the selected one.", new[] { "" }, new[] { "PRESS REFRESH SOUND LIST" }).Pref();
        _sound.HoldToScroll = true;
        AddCommand("sound_play", "PLAY SOUND", "Plays the selected sound through the game's own audio engine. A music state takes over the soundtrack until STOP SOUND; loops keep going until then; a one-off sound plays once.", PlaySound);
        AddCommand("sound_stop", "STOP SOUND", "Stops the sound started with PLAY SOUND, or hands the soundtrack back to the game.", StopSound);
        AddCommand("sound_use_teleport", "USE FOR TELEPORTS", "Plays the selected sound behind the black screen of every long teleport, and stops it as the picture returns.", UseForTeleports);
        _transitionSound = AddChoice("sound_teleport", "TELEPORT SOUND", "The game sound that plays during a teleport's black screen: the Penguin van's jingle unless you pick another with USE FOR TELEPORTS, or NONE for silence. A sound only plays where the game has it loaded.",
            new[] { DefaultTeleportSound, NoSound }, new[] { SoundLabel(DefaultTeleportSound), "NONE" }).Pref();
        AddCommand("sound_dump", "SAVE SOUND LIST TO FILE", "Writes every loaded sound event to sounds.txt in the Oracle folder.", DumpSounds).Setting();

    // ---- the game's own sounds

    private static string ShortName(string path)
    {
        int dot = path.LastIndexOf('.');
        return (dot >= 0 ? path[(dot + 1)..] : path).Replace('_', ' ').ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    private static AkEvent? FindSound(string path)
    {
        if (path.Length == 0 || path == NoSound || path.StartsWith(StatePrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return null;

        foreach (AkEvent e in World.All<AkEvent>())
        {
            if (e.IsValid && e.GetPathName(null!).Equals(path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return e;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static AkStateName? FindState(string key)
    {
        if (!key.StartsWith(StatePrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return null;

        string path = key[StatePrefix.Length..];
        foreach (AkStateName s in World.All<AkStateName>())
        {
            if (s.IsValid && s.GetPathName(null!).Equals(path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return s;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>A music state shows by its own name, a mix state as GROUP / STATE, an event by its name.</summary>
    private static string SoundLabel(string key)
    {
        if (!key.StartsWith(StatePrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return ShortName(key);

        string path = key[StatePrefix.Length..];
        string state = ShortName(path);
        if (state.StartsWith(MusicStatePrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return state[MusicStatePrefix.Length..].TrimStart();

        int dot = path.LastIndexOf('.');
        string group = dot >= 0 ? path[..dot] : "";
        int gdot = group.LastIndexOf('.');
        if (gdot >= 0)
            group = group[(gdot + 1)..];
        if (group.StartsWith("Ww_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            group = group[3..];
        return (group.Length > 0 ? group.Replace('_', ' ').ToUpperInvariant() + " / " : "") + state;
    }

    /// <summary>True for a state of the soundtrack's group rather than a mix state.</summary>
    private static bool IsMusicState(AkStateName state)
    {
        try
        {
            if (state.ParentStateGroup is { IsValid: true } group && group.GetPathName(null!).Contains(MusicGroup, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return true;
        }
        catch
        {
            // A state with no readable group is judged by its name below.
        }

        return state.GetPathName(null!).Contains(MusicGroup, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    /// <summary>The Ww_&lt;category&gt;_ token of an event's package, upper-cased, or "other".</summary>
    private static string CategoryOf(string path)
    {
        string upper = path.ToUpperInvariant();
        if (MusicWords.Any(w => upper.Contains(w, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
            return "MUS";
        if (!upper.StartsWith("WW_", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            return "other";

        int end = upper.IndexOf('_', 3);
        if (end < 0)
            return "other";

        string token = upper[3..end];
        return Categories.Any(c => c.Key == token) ? token : "other";
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts a sound or music state by its key, for the browser and the teleport screen. A sound event is
    /// attached to the player, the way the game attaches gadget and vehicle sounds: many events are positional
    /// with a short range (the Penguin van's jingle), and on a global source they played in silence.
    /// </summary>
    private bool Start(string key, AkWwise.EGlobalAudioSourceID source)
    {
        if (FindState(key) is { } state)
        {
            AkWwise.SetGlobalAudioState(state);
            return true;
        }

        if (FindSound(key) is not { } sound)
            return false;

        if (World.Pawn is { IsValid: true } pawn)
        {
            pawn.AddLoopingAudioEvent(sound);
            _attachedTo = pawn.Ptr;
            return true;
        }

        _attachedTo = 0;
        return AkWwise.AddGlobalLoopingEvent(sound, source);
    }

    private void Finish(string key)
    {
        if (FindState(key) is { } state)
        {
            AkWwise.ResetGlobalAudioState(state);
            return;
        }

        if (FindSound(key) is not { } sound)
            return;

        if (_attachedTo != 0 && World.Pawn is { IsValid: true } pawn && pawn.Ptr == _attachedTo)
            pawn.RemoveLoopingAudioEvent(sound);
        else
            AkWwise.RemoveGlobalLoopingEvent(sound);
        _attachedTo = 0;
    }

    private void RefreshSounds()
    {
        ListSounds();
        Overlay.Notice("SOUNDS", Fmt.Plural(_sounds.Count, "SOUND") + " LISTED", _sounds.Count > 0);
    }

    private void ListSounds()
    {
        _sounds.Clear();
        string category = Categories[Math.Clamp(_soundFilter.Index, 0, Categories.Length - 1)].Key;
        var all = new List<string>();
        foreach (AkStateName s in World.All<AkStateName>())
        {
            if (!s.IsValid)
                continue;

            string key = StatePrefix + s.GetPathName(null!);
            all.Add(key);
            bool music = IsMusicState(s);
            if ((category == "music" && music) || (category == "mix" && !music))
                _sounds.Add(key);
        }

        foreach (AkEvent e in World.All<AkEvent>())
        {
            if (!e.IsValid)
                continue;

            string path = e.GetPathName(null!);
            all.Add(path);
            if (category == "all" || CategoryOf(path) == category)
                _sounds.Add(path);
        }

        _sounds.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (_sounds.Count == 0)
            _sound.SetOptions(new[] { "" }, new[] { "NONE LOADED" });
        else
            _sound.SetOptions(_sounds.ToArray(), _sounds.Select(SoundLabel).ToArray());

        ShowTransitionChoice(all);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The TELEPORT SOUND row: the default jingle first (so it counts as the default), NONE, the saved choice even
    /// when it isn't loaded right now, and every loaded event.
    /// </summary>
    private void ShowTransitionChoice(List<string> loaded)
    {
        string saved = TransitionKey();
        var keys = new List<string> { DefaultTeleportSound, NoSound };
        if (saved != NoSound && !keys.Contains(saved, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            keys.Add(saved);
        foreach (string path in loaded.OrderBy(p => p, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            if (!keys.Contains(path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                keys.Add(path);
        }

        _transitionSound.SetOptions(keys.ToArray(), keys.Select(k => k == NoSound ? "NONE" : SoundLabel(k)).ToArray());
    }

    private string TransitionKey()
    {
        string key = _transitionSound.Saved.Length > 0 ? _transitionSound.Saved : _transitionSound.CurrentKey;
        return key.Length == 0 ? NoSound : key;
    }

    private void PlaySound()
    {
        string key = _sound.CurrentKey;
        if (key.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("pick a sound first");

        StopSound();
        if (!Start(key, AkWwise.EGlobalAudioSourceID.AK_GLOBAL_SOURCE_ID))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("that sound isn't loaded any more, refresh the list");

        _playingSound = key;
        Overlay.Notice("PLAYING", SoundLabel(key), true);
        Log.Info("Sound: playing " + key + ".");
    }

    private void StopSound()
    {
        if (_playingSound.Length == 0)
            return;

        Finish(_playingSound);
        _playingSound = "";
    }

    private void UseForTeleports()
    {
        string key = _sound.CurrentKey;
        if (key.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("pick a sound first");

        _transitionSound.Saved = key;
        ShowTransitionChoice(_sounds);
        Overlay.Notice("TELEPORT SOUND", SoundLabel(key), true);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Starts the chosen game sound or music state for a teleport's black screen. Returns true when it started;
    /// nothing plays when none is chosen or it isn't loaded here.
    /// </summary>
    public bool BeginTransition()
    {
        string key = TransitionKey();
        if (key == NoSound)
            return false;
        if (_transitionPlaying.Length > 0)
            return true;

        StopSound();
        if (Start(key, AkWwise.EGlobalAudioSourceID.AK_MUSIC_SOURCE_ID))
        {
            _transitionPlaying = key;
            Safe.Run("game volumes", MuteGame);
            Log.Info("Sound: teleport sound " + key + " started.");
            return true;
        }

        Log.Info("Sound: the teleport sound " + key + " isn't loaded here.");
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>Stops the teleport sound, or hands the soundtrack back, as the picture comes back.</summary>
    public void EndTransition()
    {
        Safe.Run("game volumes", RestoreGame);
        if (_transitionPlaying.Length == 0)
            return;

        Finish(_transitionPlaying);
        _transitionPlaying = "";
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Quietens the game under the teleport sound: the music and dialogue channels go to nothing, the way the
    /// options menu sets them, which takes the score with them. The effects channel stays up, because placed
    /// music like the Penguin van's jingle plays through it (and the director ignores a MUSIC_Silence state set
    /// from outside). Everything comes back exactly as it was in <see cref="RestoreGame"/>.
    /// </summary>
    private void MuteGame()
    {
        if (_volumes != null || World.Ri?.PersistentOptions is not { IsValid: true } options)
            return;

        _volumes = (options.GetVolumeMusic(), options.GetVolumeDialogue());
        options.SetVolumeMusic(0f, false);
        options.SetVolumeDialogue(0f, false);

        _quietened.Clear();
        foreach (AkParameterName prm in World.All<AkParameterName>())
        {
            if (!prm.IsValid)
                continue;

            string path = prm.GetPathName(null!);
            foreach ((string name, float value) in QuietParameters)
            {
                if (path.EndsWith("." + name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    AkWwise.SetGlobalAudioParameter(prm, value);
                    _quietened.Add(prm);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void RestoreGame()
    {
        if (_volumes is not { } v)
            return;

        _volumes = null;
        foreach (AkParameterName prm in _quietened)
        {
            if (prm.IsValid)
                AkWwise.ResetGlobalAudioParameter(prm);
        }

        _quietened.Clear();
        if (World.Ri?.PersistentOptions is not { IsValid: true } options)
            return;

        options.SetVolumeMusic(v.Music, false);
        options.SetVolumeDialogue(v.Dialogue, false);
    }

    private void DumpSounds()
    {
        var lines = new List<string> { "# Oracle sound list, " + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), "", "[states] path  group  (music or mix)" };
        foreach (AkStateName s in World.All<AkStateName>().Where(s => s.IsValid).OrderBy(s => s.GetPathName(null!), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            string group = s.ParentStateGroup is { IsValid: true } g ? g.GetPathName(null!) : "?";
            lines.Add(s.GetPathName(null!) + "  " + group + "  " + (IsMusicState(s) ? "music" : "mix"));
        }
        lines.Add("");
        lines.Add("[parameters] path  min  max  default");
        foreach (AkParameterName prm in World.All<AkParameterName>().Where(x => x.IsValid).OrderBy(x => x.GetPathName(null!), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            lines.Add(prm.GetPathName(null!) + "  " + prm.MinValue + "  " + prm.MaxValue + "  " + prm.DefaultValue);
        lines.Add("");
        lines.Add("[switches] path  group");
        foreach (AkSwitchName sw in World.All<AkSwitchName>().Where(x => x.IsValid).OrderBy(x => x.GetPathName(null!), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            lines.Add(sw.GetPathName(null!) + "  " + (sw.ParentSwitchGroup is { IsValid: true } g ? g.GetPathName(null!) : "?"));
        lines.Add("");
        lines.Add("[sound events] path  kind");
        int count = 0;
        foreach (AkEvent e in World.All<AkEvent>().Where(e => e.IsValid).OrderBy(e => e.GetPathName(null!), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            lines.Add(e.GetPathName(null!) + "  " + e.DurationType.ToString().Replace("AK_EVENT_DURATION_", "").ToLowerInvariant());
            count++;
        }

        File.WriteAllLines(Path.Combine(App.Dir, SoundsFile), lines);
        Log.Info("Sound: saved " + count + " events to " + SoundsFile + ".");
        Overlay.Notice("SAVED " + SoundsFile.ToUpperInvariant(), Fmt.Plural(count, "SOUND"), true);
    }

    public override void Started()
    {
        Safe.Run("music folder", () =>
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Dir);
            string readme = Path.Combine(Dir, "PUT YOUR SONGS HERE.txt");
            if (!File.Exists(readme))
                File.WriteAllText(readme, "Drop .mp3, .wav or .wma files in this folder, then open the Oracle menu (F3) > MUSIC.\r\nSongs play in alphabetical order; rename them with numbers (01 ..., 02 ...) to choose the order.\r\n");
        });

        // A leftover worker from before a hot reload has a different type, so it's stopped through a plain delegate.
        Shared.Get<Action>(StopKey)?.Invoke();
        Worker worker = new();
        _worker = worker;
        Shared.Set(StopKey, (Action)worker.Stop);
        Scan();
    }

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        Safe.Run("game volumes", RestoreGame);
        _playingSound = "";
        _transitionPlaying = "";
    }

    public override void LeftGame()
    {
        Safe.Run("game volumes", RestoreGame);
        _playingSound = "";
        _transitionPlaying = "";
        if (_playing || _track >= 0)
            Stop();
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        Safe.Run("sound stop", StopSound);
        Safe.Run("sound stop", EndTransition);
        ShutdownPlayer();
    }

    private void ShutdownPlayer()
    {
        if (_worker is { } worker)
        {
            worker.Post(worker.Close);
            worker.Stop();
        }

        Shared.Set(StopKey, null);
    }

    private void Scan()
    {
        string current = _track >= 0 && _track < _tracks.Count ? _tracks[_track] : "";
        _tracks.Clear();
        try
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(Dir))
            {
                foreach (string f in Directory.GetFiles(Dir))
                {
                    if (Array.IndexOf(Extensions, Path.GetExtension(f).ToLowerInvariant()) >= 0)
                        _tracks.Add(f);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Music scan failed: " + ex.Message);
        }

        _tracks.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        _track = current.Length > 0 ? _tracks.IndexOf(current) : -1;

        if (_tracks.Count == 0)
            _pick.SetOptions(new[] { "none" }, new[] { "NO SONGS FOUND" });
        else
            _pick.SetOptions(_tracks.Select(t => Path.GetFileName(t)).ToArray(), _tracks.Select(Label).ToArray(), Math.Max(0, _track));
    }

    private static string Label(string file)
    {
        string name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file).Replace('_', ' ').ToUpperInvariant();
        return name.Length > MaxLabel ? name.Substring(0, MaxLabel - 1) + "..." : name;
    }

    private void PlayPicked(int index)
    {
        if (_tracks.Count > 0)
            Play(Math.Clamp(index, 0, _tracks.Count - 1));
    }

    private void Play(int index)
    {
        if (_worker is not { } worker || _tracks.Count == 0)
            return;

        _track = (index % _tracks.Count + _tracks.Count) % _tracks.Count;
        string file = _tracks[_track];
        int volume = Volume;
        worker.Error = "";
        worker.Post(() => worker.Open(file, volume));
        _playing = true;
        _pausedByGame = false;
        _pick.Index = _track;
        _pick.Saved = _pick.CurrentKey;
        Overlay.Notice("NOW PLAYING", Label(file), true);
        Log.Info("Music: " + Path.GetFileName(file));
    }

    private bool HaveSongs()
    {
        if (_tracks.Count == 0)
            Scan();
        if (_tracks.Count > 0)
            return true;

        Overlay.Notice("MUSIC", "NO SONGS IN THE MUSIC FOLDER", false);
        return false;
    }

    private void PlayPause()
    {
        if (!HaveSongs())
            return;

        if (_track < 0)
        {
            Play(_order.Index == Shuffle ? _random.Next(_tracks.Count) : 0);
            return;
        }

        if (_playing)
        {
            _worker?.Post(_worker.Pause);
            _playing = false;
            Overlay.Notice("MUSIC", "PAUSED", false);
        }
        else
        {
            _worker?.Post(_worker.Resume);
            _playing = true;
            Overlay.Notice("MUSIC", "PLAYING", true);
        }
    }

    private void Step(int dir)
    {
        if (!HaveSongs())
            return;

        if (_order.Index == Shuffle && _tracks.Count > 1)
        {
            int next;
            do
                next = _random.Next(_tracks.Count);
            while (next == _track);
            Play(next);
            return;
        }

        Play(_track < 0 ? 0 : _track + dir);
    }

    private void Stop()
    {
        _worker?.Post(_worker.Close);
        _playing = false;
        _pausedByGame = false;
        _track = -1;
    }

    public override void Frame()
    {
        if (_worker is not { } worker)
            return;

        if (worker.Error.Length > 0)
        {
            Log.Info("Music: " + worker.Error);
            Overlay.Notice("MUSIC", "CAN'T PLAY THIS FILE", false);
            worker.Error = "";
            _playing = false;
        }

        if (_playing && _followPause.On)
        {
            bool paused = World.Paused;
            if (paused && !_pausedByGame)
            {
                _pausedByGame = true;
                worker.Post(worker.Pause);
            }
            else if (!paused && _pausedByGame)
            {
                _pausedByGame = false;
                worker.Post(worker.Resume);
            }
        }

        if (_playing && worker.Finished)
        {
            worker.Finished = false;
            if (_order.Index == RepeatOne)
                Play(_track);
            else
                Step(1);
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Player/CharacterSuit.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Changes the played character's suit to any unlocked Showcase suit for them. The pick is recorded the way the
/// Showcase does it (SetActivePlayerSkin). A character the game loaded itself is re-meshed in place: LoadPC
/// streams the suit in and SetupPlayerMesh puts it on. A character Oracle switched to T-poses when re-meshed, so
/// it is switched in again instead, through Characters, and arrives in the new suit.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class CharacterSuit : SkinSwap
{
    public static readonly CharacterSuit I = new();

    private const string ShowcasePage = "Players";

    private enum Swap
    {
        Idle,
        WaitingOnFoot,
        Loading,
    }

    private Choice _suit = null!;
    private Swap _swap;
    private string _pendingId = "";

    protected override string Title => "SUIT";

    protected override string LogName => "Suit";

    protected override string CancelNote => "; it is still the saved pick";

    protected override bool Busy => _swap != Swap.Idle;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _suit = AddChoice("suit", "SUIT", "Shows the suit your character is wearing. Choose another unlocked Showcase suit for them, then run APPLY SUIT.", new[] { "" }, new[] { "OPEN MENU IN GAME" }).Pref();
        AddCommand("apply_suit", "APPLY SUIT", "Puts the selected suit on right where you stand. In the Batmobile it waits until you get out. A character you switched to with PLAY AS is switched in again, wearing it.", Apply);
        AddCommand("cancel_suit", "CANCEL SUIT CHANGE", "Cancels a suit change that is still waiting to go on.", CancelPending);
    }

    public override void LeftGame() => Reset();

    private static bool TryLoaded(RGameRI game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerCharacter loaded) =>
        Showcase.TryRead(() => game.PlayerCharacters[0], out loaded);

    private static bool SameSkin(string? a, string? b) =>
        string.Equals(Showcase.Unprefixed(a), Showcase.Unprefixed(b), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    /// <summary>The skin id ("batman", "nightwing", "dlcredhood", ...) a skin or character name belongs to.</summary>
    private static string SkinId(RPersistentOptions options, string skinOrCharacter) =>
        options.GetActivePlayerSkinId(new FString(skinOrCharacter), false).ToString() ?? "";

    /// <summary>Skin id of the character being played, or "" when it can't be read.</summary>
    private static string PlayedId(RGameRI game)
    {
        if (game.PersistentOptions is not { IsValid: true } options || !TryLoaded(game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerCharacter loaded))
            return "";

        return SkinId(options, loaded.CharacterName.ToString() ?? "");
    }

    /// <summary>On foot and alive, not driving or remote-controlling anything.</summary>
    private static bool OnFoot(RPlayerController pc)
    {
        RPawnPlayer? pawn = pc.CombatPawn;
        return pawn is { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false } && pawn.Health > 0 && pc.Pawn?.Ptr == pawn.Ptr;
    }

    protected override void RefreshChoices(RGameInfo info, RGameRI game, RPersistentOptions options)
    {
        string played = PlayedId(game);
        if (played.Length == 0)
        {
            _suit.SetOptions(new[] { "" }, new[] { "NO CHARACTER LOADED" });
            return;
        }

        // One row per Showcase item, in the Showcase's order. Some installs list an item several times with
        // different skins (filler rows pointing at another item's skin); for those, prefer the skin no other item uses.
        info.ShowcaseValidateSorting();
        var order = new List<string>();
        var itemSkins = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var skinItems = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (RGameInfo.FShowcaseItem item in info.ShowcaseItems)
        {
            string skin = item.Skin.ToString() ?? "";
            string key = item.Item.ToString() ?? "";
            if (skin.Length == 0 || key.Length == 0
                || !string.Equals(item.Page.ToString(), ShowcasePage, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || !SkinId(options, skin).Equals(played, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || !Showcase.IsUnlocked(options, item, key))
                continue;

            if (!itemSkins.TryGetValue(key, out List<string>? skins))
            {
                itemSkins[key] = skins = new List<string>();
                order.Add(key);
            }

            if (!skins.Exists(s => s.Equals(skin, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                skins.Add(skin);

            if (!skinItems.TryGetValue(skin, out HashSet<string>? items))
                skinItems[skin] = items = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            items.Add(key);
        }

        var keys = new List<string>();
        var labels = new List<string>();
        foreach (string key in order)
        {
            List<string> skins = itemSkins[key];
            string skin = skins.Find(s => skinItems[s].Count == 1) ?? skins[0];
            if (keys.Exists(k => k.Equals(skin, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                continue;

            keys.Add(skin);
            labels.Add(Showcase.Label(key, skin));
        }

        if (keys.Count == 0)
        {
            _suit.SetOptions(new[] { "" }, new[] { "NO UNLOCKED SUITS" });
            return;
        }

        // Keep the last pick if it belongs to this character, otherwise show what they're wearing.
        string[] keyArray = keys.ToArray();
        string wearing = TryLoaded(game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerCharacter loaded) ? loaded.MeshName.ToString() ?? "" : "";
        if (wearing.Length == 0)
            wearing = ChosenSkin(options, played);

        _suit.SetOptions(keyArray, labels.ToArray(), Math.Max(0, Array.FindIndex(keyArray, k => SameSkin(k, wearing))));
        _suit.Saved = _suit.CurrentKey;
    }

    /// <summary>The suit picked for a character, as the Showcase shows it.</summary>
    private static string ChosenSkin(RPersistentOptions options, string id)
    {
        foreach (var entry in options.ActivePlayerSkins)
        {
            if (string.Equals(entry.Id.ToString(), id, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return entry.Skin.ToString() ?? "";
        }

        return "Playable_" + id + "_Std";
    }

    private void Apply()
    {
        string requested = _suit.CurrentKey;
        if (requested.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no unlocked suit is selected");
        Transition.RequireIdle();

        RGameRI? game = World.Ri;
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (game == null || game.PersistentOptions is not { IsValid: true } options || pc == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("player game state unavailable");

        string played = PlayedId(game);
        if (played.Length == 0 || !SkinId(options, requested).Equals(played, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("that suit is for another character, reopen the menu");

        if (TryLoaded(game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerCharacter current) && SameSkin(current.MeshName.ToString(), requested))
        {
            Reset();
            Notice(_suit.State);
            return;
        }

        // A switched character can't be re-meshed in place, and switching needs them on foot, so check before
        // recording anything.
        if (Characters.I.PlayingOther && World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("get out of the Batmobile first");

        options.SetActivePlayerSkin(new FString(requested));
        pc.SaveGameOptionsToMemory();
        Note("chose " + requested + " for " + played + ".");

        if (Characters.I.PlayingOther)
        {
            Reset();
            Characters.I.Reload();
            return;
        }

        Pending = requested;
        _pendingId = played;
        _swap = Swap.WaitingOnFoot;
        if (OnFoot(pc))
        {
            // Streams in while the menu is open, so it goes on as the game resumes.
            StartLoad(game);
            Notice("APPLYING SUIT");
            return;
        }

        Menu.ReleaseMovement();
        Notice("GET ON FOOT TO APPLY");
        Note("waiting until you are on foot.");
    }

    private void StartLoad(RGameRI game)
    {
        if (World.Info is not { } info || !TryLoaded(game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerCharacter current))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no loaded character data available");

        info.LoadPC(current.CharacterName, current.DamageLevel);
        _swap = Swap.Loading;
        Timer.Restart();
    }

    protected override void Step()
    {
        RGameRI? game = World.Ri;
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (game == null || pc == null)
        {
            Fail("player game state unavailable");
            return;
        }

        if (Characters.I.PlayingOther || !PlayedId(game).Equals(_pendingId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            Note("the character changed, " + Pending + " goes on the next time " + _pendingId + " is played.");
            Reset();
            return;
        }

        if (Transition.Busy)
            return;

        if (_swap == Swap.WaitingOnFoot)
        {
            if (OnFoot(pc))
                StartLoad(game);
            return;
        }

        if (!TryLoaded(game, out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerCharacter c))
        {
            Fail("no loaded character data available");
            return;
        }

        string mesh = c.MeshName.ToString() ?? "";
        if (c.CharacterData == null || (mesh.Length > 0 && c.MeshData == null))
        {
            if (TimedOut)
                Fail("timed out loading " + Pending);
            return;
        }

        if (!OnFoot(pc))
        {
            // Got into a vehicle while it streamed in: put it on once back on foot.
            _swap = Swap.WaitingOnFoot;
            return;
        }

        pc.CombatPawn!.SetupPlayerMesh(true);
        Note("now wearing " + mesh + " (" + Timer.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("0.00") + " s to load).");
        Reset();
        Notice("CHANGED");
    }

    protected override void Reset()
    {
        _swap = Swap.Idle;
        _pendingId = "";
        base.Reset();
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Collections;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Reflection;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.BmScript;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Plays as other characters by driving the game's own switch sequence action. Saving is blocked meanwhile,
/// because a save made as someone else can't be loaded properly as the story's Batman.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Characters : Module
{
    public static readonly Characters I = new();

    private sealed record Def(string Key, string Label, string Packages, string PlayerClass, string Name, bool DiveBoost, bool InstantCar);

    private static readonly Def[] Roster =
    {
        new("batman", "BATMAN", "Playable_Batman_Std_SF", "Playable_Batman", "Batman", false, false),
        new("nightwing", "NIGHTWING", "Playable_Nightwing0_SF|Playable_Nightwing_SF", "Playable_Nightwing0", "Nightwing0", false, false),
        new("robin", "ROBIN", "Playable_Robin0_SF|Playable_Robin_SF", "Playable_Robin0", "Robin0", true, false),
        new("catwoman", "CATWOMAN", "Playable_Catwoman0_SF|Playable_Catwoman_SF", "Playable_Catwoman0", "Catwoman0", false, false),
        new("batgirl", "BATGIRL", "Playable_DLCBatgirl_SF", "Playable_DLCBatgirl", "DLCBatgirl", false, true),
        new("redhood", "RED HOOD", "Playable_DLCRedHood_SF", "Playable_DLCRedHood", "DLCRedHood", false, true),
        new("harley", "HARLEY QUINN", "Playable_DLCHarleyQuinn", "Playable_DLCHarleyQuinn", "DLCHarleyQuinn", false, true),
    };

    private const string CurrentKey = "Character";
    private const string SpawnedKey = "SpawnedClasses";
    private const string Caption = "ORACLE // SWITCHING CHARACTER";
    private const float FadeOutSeconds = 1.8f;
    private const float FadeInSeconds = 1.4f;
    private const float CarFadeSeconds = 0.45f;
    private const float SpawnSettle = 4f;
    private const float SpawnGiveUp = 12f;
    private const float CallReach = 1400f;
    private const float DoorReach = 900f;
    private const float SaveNoticeGap = 30f;
    private const float CleanupDelay = 6f;

    private enum Phase
    {
        Idle,
        FadeOut,
        Spawning,
    }

    private Choice _pick = null!;
    private Phase _phase;
    private float _timer;
    private int _target;
    private nint _oldPawn;
    private bool _recovering;
    private bool _protecting;
    private bool _guardDone;
    private bool _aliasesDone;
    private float _saveNoticeLeft;
    private float _upkeepLeft;
    private float _cleanupLeft;
    private RSeqAct_SwitchPlayerCharacter? _action;
    private PlayerStart? _start;

    private static int Current

        set => Shared.Set(CurrentKey, value);

    private static string SpawnedClasses

    }

    public bool Busy => _phase != Phase.Idle;

    public bool PlayingOther => Current != 0;

    private static bool IsBatman(Pawn? p) => p is RPawnPlayerBm;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _pick = AddChoice("play_as", "PLAY AS", "Pick a character, then run SWITCH CHARACTER. Batgirl, Red Hood and Harley Quinn need their story pack DLC.",
            Roster.Select(d => d.Key).ToArray(), Roster.Select(d => d.Label).ToArray()).Pref();
        Command sw = AddCommand("switch_character", "SWITCH CHARACTER", "Fades to black and swaps you to the character above, right where you stand. Saving pauses until you are Batman again.", StartSwitch).Confirmed();
        sw.ConfirmPrompt = () => "SWITCH TO " + Roster[_pick.Index].Label + "?";
        AddCommand("back_to_batman", "BACK TO BATMAN", "Swaps back to Batman right where you stand. Saving works again after this.", () =>
        {
            _pick.ResetValue();
            StartSwitch();
        });

        AddCommand("call_batmobile", "CALL / ENTER BATMOBILE", "Any character: gets in the Batmobile when it is close, otherwise calls it to you. As another character the game's own E key (LB on a controller) gets you in too.", CarAction);
    }

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        if (Busy)
            return;

        NoteLeftAsOther();
        Reset();
    }

    public override void LeftGame()
    {
        NoteLeftAsOther();
        if (PlayingOther || Busy)
            Reset();
    }

    private void NoteLeftAsOther()
    {
        if (PlayingOther)
            Log.Info("Left the game as " + Roster[Current].Label + ", Batman comes back on the next load.");
        _guardDone = false;
    }

    private void StartSwitch()
    {
        int target = _pick.Index;
        Transition.RequireIdle();
        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer pawn)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("get out of the Batmobile first");

        if (target == Current && (target != 0 || IsBatman(pawn)))
        {
            Overlay.Notice("CHARACTER", "ALREADY " + Roster[target].Label, false);
            return;
        }

        Begin(target);
    }

    /// <summary>Switches in the character being played again, so a suit just picked for them loads with them.</summary>
    public void Reload()
    {
        if (!PlayingOther)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("not playing as a switched character");
        Transition.RequireIdle();
        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("get out of the Batmobile first");

        Begin(Current);
    }

    private void Begin(int target)
    {
        _target = target;
        _recovering = false;
        _protecting = false;
        _phase = Phase.FadeOut;
        Menu.Close();
        Fader.Out(FadeOutSeconds, true, Caption);
        Log.Info("Switching character to " + Roster[target].Label + ".");
    }

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (_saveNoticeLeft > 0f)
            _saveNoticeLeft -= dt;

        switch (_phase)
        {
            case Phase.FadeOut:
                if (!Fader.IsDark)
                    return;

                if (!BeginSwitch(_target))
                {
                    Fail("COULD NOT SWITCH");
                    return;
                }

                _timer = 0f;
                _phase = Phase.Spawning;
                return;

            case Phase.Spawning:
                _timer += dt;
                if (!Fader.IsDark)
                    Fader.Cut(Caption);
                WaitForSpawn();
                return;
        }

        if (PlayingOther)
            Upkeep(dt);

        if (_cleanupLeft > 0f)
        {
            _cleanupLeft -= dt;
            if (_cleanupLeft <= 0f)
                CollectAfterSwitch();
        }
    }

    private bool BeginSwitch(int index)
    {
        Def def = Roster[index];
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        RGameInfo? gi = World.Info;
        WorldInfo? wi = World.WorldInfo;
        if (pc == null || gi == null || wi == null)
            return false;

        Sequence seq = wi.GetGameSequence();
        if (seq is not { IsValid: true })
        {
            Log.Info("Character switch: no game sequence.");
            return false;
        }

        RegisterPawnAliases();

        foreach (string package in def.Packages.Split('|'))
        {
            string name = package;
            Safe.Run("package " + name, () => Game.LoadPackage(name));
        }

        gi.LoadPC(def.PlayerClass);

        _oldPawn = World.PawnPtr;
        _start = Game.SpawnActor(PlayerStart.StaticClass(), default, pc.Location, pc.Rotation) as PlayerStart;
        if (_start == null)
        {
            Log.Info("Character switch: could not place a start point.");
            return false;
        }

        _action = new RSeqAct_SwitchPlayerCharacter(seq);
        _action.ParentSequence = seq;
        _action.CharacterName = def.Name;
        _action.PlayerStartPoint = _start;
        _action.SwitchToThisPawn = null!;

        pc.PrepareForPlayerSwitch();
        _action.ForceActivateInput(0);
        Log.Info("Character switch to " + def.Label + " sent to the game.");
        return true;
    }

    private void WaitForSpawn()
    {
        Pawn? pawn = World.Pawn;
        if (_timer >= SpawnSettle && pawn != null && pawn.Ptr != _oldPawn)
        {
            Finish(pawn);
            return;
        }

        if (_timer < SpawnGiveUp)
            return;

        _action = null;
        _start = null;
        if (_target != 0 && !_recovering)
        {
            Log.Info("Character switch: " + Roster[_target].Label + " did not appear, going back to Batman.");
            _recovering = true;
            _target = 0;
            _timer = 0f;
            if (BeginSwitch(0))
                return;
        }

        Current = 0;
        Fail(_recovering ? "NOT AVAILABLE" : "SWITCH FAILED");
    }

    private void Finish(Pawn pawn)
    {
        Def def = Roster[_target];
        _action = null;
        _start = null;
        _phase = Phase.Idle;
        Current = _target;

        if (_target != 0)
        {
            string cls = pawn.Class.GetPathName(null);
            if (!SpawnedClasses.Contains(";" + cls + ";", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                SpawnedClasses += cls + ";";
            if (World.Pc is { } pc)
                pc.bCanGetInBatmobile = true;
        }

        _upkeepLeft = 0f;
        _cleanupLeft = CleanupDelay;
        _pick.Index = _target;
        _pick.Saved = _pick.CurrentKey;

        string title = _protecting ? "SAVE PROTECTED" : _recovering ? "CHARACTER" : "NOW PLAYING AS";
        Fader.In(FadeInSeconds, title, _protecting || _recovering ? "BACK TO BATMAN" : def.Label);
        _protecting = false;
        Log.Info("Now playing as " + def.Label + " (" + pawn.GetPathName(null) + ").");
    }

    private void Fail(string why)
    {
        Log.Info("Character switch failed: " + why);
        _phase = Phase.Idle;
        _action = null;
        _start = null;
        Fader.In(FadeInSeconds, "CHARACTER", why, false);
    }

    private void Upkeep(float dt)
    {
        _upkeepLeft -= dt;
        if (_upkeepLeft > 0f || World.Pc is not { } pc)
            return;

        _upkeepLeft = 1f;
        if (!pc.bCanGetInBatmobile)
            pc.bCanGetInBatmobile = true;
        if (Roster[Current].DiveBoost && pc.Pawn is RPawnPlayer p)
            SetBool(p, "bCanDiveBoost", true);
    }

    private static void SetBool(object target, string name, bool value)
    {
        PropertyInfo? pi = target.GetType().GetProperty(name, BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
        if (pi != null && pi.PropertyType == typeof(bool) && pi.CanWrite && (bool)pi.GetValue(target)! != value)
            pi.SetValue(target, value);
    }

    private bool TryEnterCar(float reach)
    {
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (pc == null || pc.IsInBatmobile() || pc.IsBatmobileUnderRemoteControl() || pc.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer pawn)
            return false;

        RVehicleBatmobileBase? car = Batmobile.I.Car();
        if (car is not { IsValid: true } || car.Driver != null || Vector3.Distance(car.Location, pawn.Location) > reach)
            return false;
        if (car is RVehicleBatmobile rb && !rb.CanEnterVehicle(pawn))
            return false;

        if (Roster[Current].InstantCar)
        {
            Fader.Cut("");
            Fader.In(CarFadeSeconds);
            car.GetInBatmobileInstant(pawn, false);
        }
        else
            car.GetInBatmobile(pawn);

        Log.Info("Entered the Batmobile as " + Roster[Current].Label + ".");
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Handles E for non-Batman characters, who have no prompt of their own at the car.</summary>
    public bool EntryKey(Keys key) => key == Keys.E && EnterNearby();

    public bool EnterNearby()
    {
        if (!PlayingOther || Menu.IsOpen || Busy)
            return false;

        return Safe.Try("Batmobile entry", () => TryEnterCar(DoorReach));
    }

    private void CarAction()
    {
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (pc == null || pc.IsInBatmobile() || pc.IsBatmobileUnderRemoteControl())
            return;

        pc.bCanGetInBatmobile = true;
        if (TryEnterCar(CallReach))
            return;

        var mode = pc.CallBatmobile();
        bool coming = mode != RVehicleBatmobileBase.EBatmobilePickupMode.BPM_None;
        Overlay.Notice("BATMOBILE", coming ? "ON ITS WAY" : "CAN'T REACH YOU HERE", coming);
        Log.Info("Batmobile called: " + mode + ".");
    }

    private void CollectAfterSwitch()
    {
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (pc == null || World.Pawn == null || pc.IsInBatmobile() || pc.IsBatmobileUnderRemoteControl() || Transition.Busy)
            return;

        Safe.Run("cleanup after switch", () => World.WorldInfo?.ForceGarbageCollection(true));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Some playable pawn classes exist only as BmScript paths with an MPawnPlayer...Base wrapper in BmSDK. Without
    /// a mapping BmSDK wraps them as a plain pawn and every player feature silently stops applying.
    /// </summary>
    private void RegisterPawnAliases()
    {
        if (_aliasesDone)
            return;
        _aliasesDone = true;

        Safe.Run("character class aliases", () =>
        {
            Type? init = typeof(Game).Assembly.GetType("BmSDK.Framework.StaticInit", false);
            if (init?.GetField("_classPathToManagedTypeMap", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic)?.GetValue(null) is not IDictionary map)
                return;

            Type[] types;
            try
            {
                types = typeof(Game).Assembly.GetTypes();
            }
            catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException ex)
            {
                types = Array.FindAll(ex.Types, t => t != null)!;
            }

            foreach (Type t in types)
            {
                if (!t.Name.StartsWith("MPawnPlayer", StringComparison.Ordinal) || !t.Name.EndsWith("Base", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    continue;

                string path = "BmScript." + t.Name.Substring(0, t.Name.Length - 4);
                if (!map.Contains(path))
                    map[path] = t;
            }
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// If the story loads as a character Oracle switched to, puts Batman back before anything can be saved.
    /// Returns true on the tick it takes over.
    /// </summary>
    public bool GuardLoadedCharacter()
    {
        if (_guardDone || Busy || SpawnedClasses.Length <= 1)
            return false;

        // App only asks in a playable world, so this is never the main menu's pawn.
        if (World.Pawn is not { } pawn)
            return false;

        _guardDone = true;
        RGameInfo? gi = World.Info;
        if (gi == null || !gi.IsCoreStory() || gi.IsChallengeMode() || IsBatman(pawn) || PlayingOther)
            return false;
        if (!SpawnedClasses.Contains(";" + pawn.Class.GetPathName(null) + ";", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return false;

        Log.Info("Loaded the story as " + pawn.GetPathName(null) + " instead of Batman, switching back to keep the save safe.");
        _target = 0;
        _recovering = false;
        _protecting = true;
        _phase = Phase.FadeOut;
        Fader.Cut(Caption);
        return true;
    }

    private void Reset()
    {
        _phase = Phase.Idle;
        Current = 0;
        _action = null;
        _start = null;
        _cleanupLeft = 0f;
        _pick.ResetValue();
    }

    private bool SaveBlocked()
    {
        if (!PlayingOther && !Busy)
            return false;

        Log.Info("Save skipped: playing as " + Roster[Current].Label + ".");
        if (_saveNoticeLeft <= 0f)
        {
            _saveNoticeLeft = SaveNoticeGap;
            Overlay.Notice("SAVING PAUSED", "SWITCH BACK TO BATMAN TO SAVE", false);
        }

        return true;
    }

    // Failing closed: if the check can't run, assume the save is unsafe rather than risk writing a bad one.
    [Redirect(typeof(RPlayerController), nameof(RPlayerController.SaveGame))]
    private static void SaveGameRedirect(RPlayerController self, FString name, bool a, bool b)
    {
        if (!Safe.Try("save check", I.SaveBlocked, fallback: true))
            self.SaveGame(new FString(name.ToString() ?? ""), a, b);
    }
}
```
