```cs
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal sealed class Cosmetics : Module
{
    public static readonly Cosmetics I = new();

    public override void Build()
    {
        AddToggle("hide_cape", "HIDE CAPE", "Hides the cape of Batman and other caped characters.", ApplyCape).Maintain(() => ApplyCape(true));
        Slider size = AddSlider("batman_size", "CHARACTER SIZE", "Shrinks or grows your character. Purely visual, the collision stays the same.", 1f, 0.6f, 1.6f, 0.05f, 1.2f, Fmt.Times, ApplySize);
        size.Maintain(() => ApplySize(size.Value));

        string[] keys = Enumerable.Range(0, DamageLevels).Select(i => i.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).ToArray();
        string[] labels = keys.Select(k => k == "0" ? "CLEAN" : "LEVEL " + k).ToArray();
        _damage = AddChoice("battle_damage", "BATTLE DAMAGE", "Shows how torn up Batman's suit is. Pick a level, then run APPLY BATTLE DAMAGE. The story still adds damage at its usual points.", keys, labels).Pref();
        AddSaveCommand("apply_battle_damage", "APPLY BATTLE DAMAGE", "Puts the chosen battle damage on Batman's suit. Your save keeps it.", ApplyDamage);
    }

    // ---- battle damage
    // The story raises it with RSeqAct_UpdateBatmanDamageLevel: RPawnPlayer.SetDamageLevel(character, level,
    // HigherDamageOnly) on the original Batman pawn, then SetupPlayerMesh(true) to re-mesh him. The level is kept in
    // the save (GRI PlayerCharacters[].DamageLevel). RPlayerController.ReceivedPlayer clears the
    // BatmanDamageLevel0..9 story flags; Oracle leaves those, and the static SetDamageLevelFlags, alone.

    private const int DamageLevels = 7;
    private Choice _damage = null!;

    public override void MenuOpening()
    {
        if (World.Ri is { } game && Showcase.TryRead(() => game.PlayerCharacters[0], out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerCharacter loaded))
            _damage.Index = Math.Clamp(loaded.DamageLevel, 0, DamageLevels - 1);
    }

    private void ApplyDamage()
    {
        RPlayerController pc = World.Pc ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        RGameRI game = World.Ri ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        RPawnPlayer batman = pc.OriginalBatmanPawn;
        if (Characters.I.PlayingOther || batman is not { IsValid: true } || pc.Pawn?.Ptr != batman.Ptr)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("only for Batman, on foot");
        if (batman.Health <= 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Batman is down");
        if (!Showcase.TryRead(() => game.PlayerCharacters[0], out RGameRI.FLoadedPlayerCharacter loaded))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no loaded character data available");

        int level = _damage.Index;
        batman.SetDamageLevel(loaded.CharacterName, level, false);
        batman.SetupPlayerMesh(true);
        Log.Info("Battle damage set to " + level + " on " + loaded.CharacterName + ".");
    }

    private static void ApplySize(float v)
    {
        RPawnPlayer? p = World.Player;
        if (p != null && MathF.Abs(p.DrawScale - v) > 0.001f)
            p.SetDrawScale(v);
    }

    private static void ApplyCape(bool hidden)
    {
        if (World.Player is RPawnPlayerBmBase bm)
        {
            RCapeComponent cape = bm.CapeComponent;
            if (cape is { IsValid: true } && cape.IsCapeHiddenGame != hidden)
                cape.CapeSetHiddenGame(hidden);
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Player/Gadgets.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Disruptor options on the PLAYER/GADGETS page. Read from BmGame.upk:
/// - Charges are RDisruptorSniper.iAntiEquipmentRemainingAmmo (mirrored into Ammo for the HUD). AimedFireDD refuses
///   with NoAmmoLeftThought at 0 and otherwise calls ReduceAmmo after each disruption. FullyRestoreAmmo sets it back
///   to iAntiEquipmentMaximumAmmo; predator rooms do the same in OnRoomChange, the open world refills on a timer.
/// - Which kinds of target can be disrupted is the bBatmanHas...Upgrade flags. UpdateDisruptorUpgrades only ever
///   turns a flag on (from PC.HasUpgrade), so flags set here stay set until cleared.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Gadgets : Module
{
    public static readonly Gadgets I = new();

    public Toggle UnlimitedCharges = null!;
    private Toggle _allTargets = null!;

    /// <summary>Every upgrade flag that unlocks a kind of disruptor target. ExtraAmmo is left out: it changes the max.</summary>
    private static readonly (Func<RDisruptorSniper, bool> Get, Action<RDisruptorSniper, bool> Set)[] TargetUpgrades =
    {
        (d => d.bBatmanHasDroneDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasDroneDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasMineDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasMineDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasMedicDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasMedicDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasStunStickDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasStunStickDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasInvisibleThugDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasInvisibleThugDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasSentryGunDispenserDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasSentryGunDispenserDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasMinidroneControllerDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasMinidroneControllerDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasDetectiveModeJammerDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasDetectiveModeJammerDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasDetectiveModeDetectorDisruptorUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasDetectiveModeDetectorDisruptorUpgrade = v),
        (d => d.bBatmanHasRHDBlindDroneUpgrade, (d, v) => d.bBatmanHasRHDBlindDroneUpgrade = v),
    };

    public override void Build()
    {
        UnlimitedCharges = AddToggle("disruptor_unlimited", "UNLIMITED DISRUPTOR CHARGES",
            "The disruptor never runs out of charges, so you can sabotage every gun, mine, drone and medic in an area. The charge count stays full.")
            .Maintain(Refill);
        _allTargets = AddToggle("disruptor_all_targets", "DISRUPT ANY TARGET",
            "The disruptor works on every kind of target without buying its upgrades: drones, mines, medic packs, stun sticks, cloaked thugs, sentry dispensers and more. Turning it off goes back to the upgrades you own.",
            on => { if (!on) Safe.Run("disruptor upgrades restore", RestoreUpgrades); }).Maintain(GrantUpgrades);
        AddToggle("auto_password_hack", "AUTO PASSWORD HACK",
            "Remote hacking device password cracks solve themselves: start the hack as normal and every security level is cracked for you a moment later.")
            .Maintain(SolvePasswordHack);
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        if (_allTargets.On)
            Safe.Run("disruptor upgrades restore", RestoreUpgrades);
    }

    private static IEnumerable<RDisruptorSniper> Disruptors()
    {
        foreach (RDisruptorSniper d in World.All<RDisruptorSniper>())
        {
            if (d.IsValid && !d.bDeleteMe)
                yield return d;
        }
    }

    // ---- UNLIMITED DISRUPTOR CHARGES

    /// <summary>Tops up a disruptor that came in below full: a new save, or charges spent before the toggle went on.</summary>
    private static void Refill()
    {
        foreach (RDisruptorSniper d in Disruptors())
        {
            if (d.iAntiEquipmentMaximumAmmo > 0 && d.iAntiEquipmentRemainingAmmo < d.iAntiEquipmentMaximumAmmo)
                d.FullyRestoreAmmo();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The only place a charge is spent. Skipped outright, so a shot never shows the count dropping.</summary>
    [Redirect(typeof(RDisruptorSniper), nameof(RDisruptorSniper.ReduceAmmo))]
    private static void ReduceAmmoRedirect(RDisruptorSniper self)
    {
        if (I.UnlimitedCharges is { On: true })
        {
            Log.Throttled("disruptor charge", "Unlimited disruptor charges: kept a charge.");
            return;
        }

        self.ReduceAmmo();
    }

    // ---- AUTO PASSWORD HACK

    /// <summary>How long the crack has to be on screen first, so the Flash movie has started its own game.</summary>
    private const double HackSolveDelay = 0.75;

    private nint _hackSeen;
    private DateTime _hackSeenAt;

    /// <summary>
    /// Read from BmGame.upk: the Flash movie owns the passwords and the stick targets. When the last one is found it
    /// calls XI_PasswordFound, then XI_OutroComplete (which sets MinigameComplete), and the special move's
    /// Resonating.UpdateSpecialMove then runs SuccessfullActivateDisruptor: the target's SuccessfullyDisrupted, the
    /// success animation and the normal exit. This makes those two Flash calls itself and leaves the rest to the game.
    /// </summary>
    private static void SolvePasswordHack()
    {
        foreach (RSpecialMoveInstance_OmnitronPasswordCracking crack in World.All<RSpecialMoveInstance_OmnitronPasswordCracking>())
        {
            if (crack.bDeleteMe || crack.GetStateName().ToString() != "Resonating")
                continue;
            if (crack.TheOmnitronMovie is not { IsValid: true } movie || movie.MinigameComplete)
                continue;
            if (crack.PlayerPawn is not { IsValid: true } pawn || pawn.Ptr != World.PawnPtr)
                continue;

            if (I._hackSeen != crack.Ptr)
            {
                I._hackSeen = crack.Ptr;
                I._hackSeenAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            }

            if ((DateTime.UtcNow - I._hackSeenAt).TotalSeconds < HackSolveDelay)
                continue;

            movie.XI_PasswordFound();
            movie.XI_OutroComplete();
            I._hackSeen = 0;
            Log.Info("Auto password hack: cracked " + (crack.CurrentTarget is { IsValid: true } t ? t.Name : "the target") + ".");
        }
    }

    // ---- DISRUPT ANY TARGET

    private static void GrantUpgrades()
    {
        foreach (RDisruptorSniper d in Disruptors())
        {
            foreach ((Func<RDisruptorSniper, bool> get, Action<RDisruptorSniper, bool> set) in TargetUpgrades)
            {
                if (!get(d))
                    set(d, true);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Clears every flag, then lets the game set back the ones the save has bought.</summary>
    private static void RestoreUpgrades()
    {
        foreach (RDisruptorSniper d in Disruptors())
        {
            foreach ((_, Action<RDisruptorSniper, bool> set) in TargetUpgrades)
                set(d, false);
            d.UpdateDisruptorUpgrades();
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Swaps the explosion of a disruptor-jammed gun. The tank effect only exists in memory once the game has
/// streamed in drone tanks, so a TANK pick keeps waiting for it rather than giving up.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class JammedGuns : Module
{
    public static readonly JammedGuns I = new();

    private const string Cls = "RBMWeaponRanged";
    private const string Prop = "JammedExplosionVFX";
    private const string Vanilla = "ParticleSystem'VFX_Gadgets.Disruptor.Double_Jammed_Explosion'";
    private const string TankPath = "VFX_Vehicles.Particles.Tank.HeavyTank_Explosion";
    private const double RetrySeconds = 5.0;

    private Choice _choice = null!;
    private bool _set;
    private Every _retry;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _choice = AddChoice("jammed_blast", "JAMMED GUN EXPLOSION", "What a disruptor-jammed gun looks like when it blows up. TANK uses the drone tank explosion, which is available once drone tanks are nearby.",
            new[] { "vanilla", "tank" }, new[] { "VANILLA", "TANK" }, Apply);
    }

    public override void WorldChanged() => _set = false;

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (_choice.Index == 1 && !_set && _retry.Elapsed(RetrySeconds))
            TrySet();
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        if (_set)
            Safe.Run("jammed gun restore", () => Cvars.Restore(Cls, Prop, Vanilla));
    }

    private void Apply(int mode)
    {
        if (mode == 0)
        {
            _set = false;
            Cvars.Restore(Cls, Prop, Vanilla);
            return;
        }

        TrySet();
    }

    private void TrySet()
    {
        if (Game.FindObject<ParticleSystem>(TankPath) == null)
            return;

        Cvars.Override(Cls, Prop, "ParticleSystem'" + TankPath + "'");
        _set = true;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Player/Glide.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal sealed class GlideMod : Module
{
    public static readonly GlideMod I = new();

    private const string PitchKey = "GlideMaxPitch";
    private const float LevelSink = -45f;
    private const float DivePitch = -5f;
    private const float Floor = -1500f;
    private const float RotUnitsPerDegree = 65536f / 360f;

    private Slider _climb = null!;
    private nint _pc;
    private nint _pawn;
    private float _holdZ = float.NaN;
    private float _lastSpeed = -1f;

    public override void Build()
    {
        AddToggle("infinite_glide", "INFINITE GLIDE", "Glide as long as you hold glide. Look up to climb, look ahead to fly level, look down to dive. Batman keeps his glide pose and the speed GLIDE SPEED sets.",
            on => { if (!on) Restore(); }).EveryTick(GlideTick);
        _climb = AddSlider("glide_climb", "GLIDE CLIMB ANGLE", "How steeply Batman climbs when you look up during INFINITE GLIDE. Higher climbs faster.", 22f, 8f, 40f, 1f, 30f, Fmt.Degrees).Pref();
    }

    public override void Shutdown() => Restore();

    private void GlideTick()
    {
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (pc == null)
            return;

        if (pc.Ptr != _pc)
        {
            _pc = pc.Ptr;
            ResetHold();
        }

        if (Shared.GetValue(PitchKey, int.MinValue) == int.MinValue)
            Shared.Set(PitchKey, pc.CapeGlideMaxPitch);

        int want = (int)MathF.Round(_climb.Value * RotUnitsPerDegree);
        if (pc.CapeGlideMaxPitch != want)
            pc.CapeGlideMaxPitch = want;

        if (pc.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer p || !p.IsValid || !p.bGliding || p.Physics != Actor.EPhysics.PHYS_Flying)
        {
            ResetHold();
            return;
        }

        if (p.Ptr != _pawn)
        {
            _pawn = p.Ptr;
            ResetHold();
        }

        float pitch = pc.GlideRotator.Pitch;
        float speed = pc.CapeGlideSpeed;
        if (pitch > DivePitch && _lastSpeed > 0f && speed > _lastSpeed + 0.01f)
        {
            speed = MathF.Max(_lastSpeed, pc.CapeGlideMinSpeed);
            pc.CapeGlideSpeed = speed;
        }

        _lastSpeed = speed;

        System.Numerics.Vector3 at = p.Location;
        float vz = p.Velocity.Z;
        bool level = vz < 0f && vz > LevelSink && pitch > DivePitch && at.Z > Floor;
        if (!level || float.IsNaN(_holdZ) || at.Z > _holdZ)
        {
            _holdZ = at.Z;
            return;
        }

        if (at.Z < _holdZ - 0.1f)
            p.SetLocation(new System.Numerics.Vector3(at.X, at.Y, _holdZ));
    }

    private void ResetHold()
    {
        _holdZ = float.NaN;
        _lastSpeed = -1f;
    }

    private void Restore()
    {
        ResetHold();
        int vanilla = Shared.GetValue(PitchKey, int.MinValue);
        Safe.Run("glide restore", () =>
        {
            if (vanilla != int.MinValue && World.Pc is { } pc && pc.CapeGlideMaxPitch != vanilla)
                pc.CapeGlideMaxPitch = vanilla;
        });
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Player/Movement.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// PLAYER > MOVEMENT speeds and gravity. Each slider scales values the game's own movement code reads, from what
/// the game had, so 1.00x is always stock:
/// - Glide: the native glide update (CapeGlideMovement) eases CapeGlideSpeed toward a target between
///   CapeGlideMinSpeed and CapeGlideMaxSpeed at CapeGlideAccel / CapeGlideDecel, clamps it, and copies it into the
///   pawn's AirSpeed. Scaling the limits and both rates scales cruise, dive and how quickly each is reached.
/// - Grapple: native grapple movement clamps GrappleSpeed between MinGrappleSpeed and MaxGrappleSpeed.
/// - Grapple boost: GrappleMovement.GetGrappleBonusSpeed/Height read the gun's MaxGrappleBoostExtra* per upgrade tier.
/// - Line launcher: RLineLauncher.IncremementZipSpeed accelerates CurrentZipSpeed up to ZipForwardMaxSpeed.
/// - Fall gravity: RPawnPlayer's native GetGravityZ returns OverrideFallingGravity whenever it isn't 0.
/// - Tunnels: StealthMoveMode sets DesiredMovementScale to TunnelSpeedScale while Batman is forced to crouch.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Movement : Module
{
    public static readonly Movement I = new();

    private readonly Scaled<RPlayerController> _glide = new(
        Field<RPlayerController>("glide min speed", c => c.CapeGlideMinSpeed, (c, v) => c.CapeGlideMinSpeed = v),
        Field<RPlayerController>("glide max speed", c => c.CapeGlideMaxSpeed, (c, v) => c.CapeGlideMaxSpeed = v),
        Field<RPlayerController>("glide city min speed", c => c.CapeGlideOverworldMinSpeed, (c, v) => c.CapeGlideOverworldMinSpeed = v),
        Field<RPlayerController>("glide soaring speed", c => c.CapeSoaringMinSpeed, (c, v) => c.CapeSoaringMinSpeed = v),
        Field<RPlayerController>("glide accel", c => c.CapeGlideAccel, (c, v) => c.CapeGlideAccel = v),
        Field<RPlayerController>("glide decel", c => c.CapeGlideDecel, (c, v) => c.CapeGlideDecel = v));

    private readonly Scaled<RPawnPlayer> _grapple = new(
        Field<RPawnPlayer>("grapple min speed", p => p.MinGrappleSpeed, (p, v) => p.MinGrappleSpeed = v),
        Field<RPawnPlayer>("grapple max speed", p => p.MaxGrappleSpeed, (p, v) => p.MaxGrappleSpeed = v));

    private readonly Scaled<RGrappleGun> _boost = new(
        Field<RGrappleGun>("boost speed", g => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraSpeed, (g, v) => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraSpeed = v),
        Field<RGrappleGun>("boost speed mk3", g => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraSpeedMk3, (g, v) => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraSpeedMk3 = v),
        Field<RGrappleGun>("boost speed mk4", g => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraSpeedMk4, (g, v) => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraSpeedMk4 = v),
        Field<RGrappleGun>("boost height", g => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraHeight, (g, v) => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraHeight = v),
        Field<RGrappleGun>("boost height mk3", g => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraHeightMk3, (g, v) => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraHeightMk3 = v),
        Field<RGrappleGun>("boost height mk4", g => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraHeightMk4, (g, v) => g.MaxGrappleBoostExtraHeightMk4 = v));

    private readonly Scaled<RLineLauncher> _zip = new(
        Field<RLineLauncher>("line launcher max speed", l => l.ZipForwardMaxSpeed, (l, v) => l.ZipForwardMaxSpeed = v),
        Field<RLineLauncher>("line launcher accel", l => l.ZipForwardAccel, (l, v) => l.ZipForwardAccel = v));

    private readonly Scaled<RPawnPlayer> _tunnel = new(
        Field<RPawnPlayer>("tunnel speed", p => p.TunnelSpeedScale, (p, v) => p.TunnelSpeedScale = v));

    private Slider _glideSpeed = null!;
    private Slider _grappleSpeed = null!;
    private Slider _boostPower = null!;
    private Slider _zipSpeed = null!;
    private Slider _gravity = null!;
    private Slider _tunnelSpeed = null!;

    // FALL GRAVITY writes the pawn's gravity override, which the game also uses (Catwoman's whip rappel), so it
    // only writes while the override is free or still holds Oracle's last value.
    private RPawnPlayer? _gravityPawn;
    private float _gravityWritten;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _glideSpeed = AddSlider("glide_speed", "GLIDE SPEED", "How fast you glide: cruising, diving and dive boosts all scale, and so does how quickly you reach them. 1.00x is the game's own speed.",
            1f, 0.5f, 4f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times, _ => ApplyGlide());
        _glideSpeed.Maintain(ApplyGlide);

        _grappleSpeed = AddSlider("grapple_speed", "GRAPPLE SPEED", "How fast the grapple gun pulls you up to a ledge.",
            1f, 0.5f, 3f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times, _ => ApplyGrapple());
        _grappleSpeed.Maintain(ApplyGrapple);

        _boostPower = AddSlider("grapple_boost", "GRAPPLE BOOST POWER", "How far and how high a grapple boost throws you off the ledge, at every upgrade level.",
            1f, 0.5f, 3f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times, _ => ApplyBoost());
        _boostPower.Maintain(ApplyBoost);

        _zipSpeed = AddSlider("line_launcher_speed", "LINE LAUNCHER SPEED", "How fast the line launcher carries you along its line, and how quickly it gets there.",
            1f, 0.5f, 3f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times, _ => ApplyZip());
        _zipSpeed.Maintain(ApplyZip);

        _gravity = AddSlider("fall_gravity", "FALL GRAVITY", "How strongly you fall after a jump or a drop. Lower falls slower and floatier. Gliding is unchanged.",
            1f, 0.1f, 2f, 0.05f, 0.4f, Fmt.Percent, _ => ApplyGravity());
        _gravity.Maintain(ApplyGravity);

        _tunnelSpeed = AddSlider("tunnel_speed", "LOW TUNNEL SPEED", "How fast you move through low passages where you are forced to crouch.",
            1f, 0.5f, 3f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times, _ => ApplyTunnel());
        _tunnelSpeed.Maintain(ApplyTunnel);
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        _glide.Restore();
        _grapple.Restore();
        _boost.Restore();
        _zip.Restore();
        _tunnel.Restore();
        ClearGravity();
    }

    private void ApplyGlide() => _glide.Apply(World.Pc, _glideSpeed.Value);

    private void ApplyGrapple() => _grapple.Apply(World.Player, _grappleSpeed.Value);

    private void ApplyBoost() => _boost.Apply(World.Player?.GrappleGun, _boostPower.Value);

    private void ApplyZip() => _zip.Apply(World.Player?.LineLauncher, _zipSpeed.Value);

    private void ApplyTunnel() => _tunnel.Apply(World.Player, _tunnelSpeed.Value);

    private void ApplyGravity()
    {
        float scale = _gravity.Value;
        if (Scaled<RPawnPlayer>.IsStock(scale))
        {
            ClearGravity();
            return;
        }

        RPawnPlayer? p = World.Player;
        if (p == null)
            return;

        if (_gravityPawn is { IsValid: true } old && old.Ptr != p.Ptr)
            ClearGravity();

        float now = p.OverrideFallingGravity;
        if (now != 0f && now != _gravityWritten)
            return;

        float world = WorldGravity(p);
        if (world >= 0f)
            return;

        float want = world * scale;
        if (now != want)
            p.OverrideFallingGravity = want;
        _gravityPawn = p;
        _gravityWritten = want;
    }

    private void ClearGravity()
    {
        RPawnPlayer? p = _gravityPawn;
        float written = _gravityWritten;
        _gravityPawn = null;
        _gravityWritten = 0f;
        if (p is { IsValid: true } && written != 0f)
            Safe.Run("fall gravity restore", () => { if (p.OverrideFallingGravity == written) p.OverrideFallingGravity = 0f; });
    }

    /// <summary>The gravity the pawn would fall with untouched: its physics volume's, else the world's.</summary>
    private static float WorldGravity(Pawn p)
    {
        if (p.PhysicsVolume is { IsValid: true } volume)
        {
            float g = volume.GetGravityZ();
            if (g < 0f)
                return g;
        }

        WorldInfo? wi = World.WorldInfo;
        if (wi == null)
            return 0f;
        return wi.WorldGravityZ < 0f ? wi.WorldGravityZ : wi.DefaultGravityZ;
    }

    private static Held<T, float> Field<T>(string what, Func<T, float> get, Action<T, float> set) where T : GameObject => new(what, get, set);

    /// <summary>Several game values on one object, all scaled by one slider and all restored together.</summary>
    private sealed class Scaled<T> where T : GameObject
    {
        private readonly Held<T, float>[] _fields;

        public Scaled(params Held<T, float>[] fields) => _fields = fields;

        public static bool IsStock(float scale) => MathF.Abs(scale - 1f) < 0.001f;

        /// <summary>Scales every value on <paramref name="obj"/>, or puts them back at 1.00x or with no object.</summary>
        public void Apply(T? obj, float scale)
        {
            if (obj is not { IsValid: true } || IsStock(scale))
            {
                Restore();
                return;
            }

            foreach (Held<T, float> f in _fields)
                f.Set(obj, v => v * scale);
        }

        public void Restore()
        {
            foreach (Held<T, float> f in _fields)
                f.Restore();
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Player/Player.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal sealed class Player : Module
{
    public static readonly Player I = new();

    public Toggle God = null!;

    public override void Build()
    {
        God = AddToggle("god_mode", "GOD MODE", "You take no damage and your health stays full. Works for every playable character.", ApplyGod);
        God.Maintain(() => ApplyGod(true));
        AddCommand("restore_health", "RESTORE HEALTH", "Refills your health right now.", () => World.RequireCheats().RestoreHealth());

        Slider speed = AddSlider("move_speed", "RUN SPEED", "Multiplies how fast you walk and run.", 1f, 0.5f, 3f, 0.05f, 1.6f, Fmt.Times, ApplyMoveSpeed);
        speed.Maintain(() => ApplyMoveSpeed(speed.Value));

        AddConsoleToggle("gadget_no_cooldown", "NO GADGET COOLDOWN", "Gadgets can be equipped and used again while they recharge.",
            new ConsoleProp("RInventoryGadget", "bCanEquipWhileRecharging", "True", "False"));
        AddConsoleToggle("gadget_anywhere", "GADGETS ANYWHERE", "Use gadgets from vents, corner cover, vantage points and silent predator.",
            new ConsoleProp("RInventoryGadget", "bUsableFromCrawlSpace", "True", "False"),
            new ConsoleProp("RInventoryGadget", "bUsableFromCornerCover", "True", "False"),
            new ConsoleProp("RInventoryGadget", "bUsableFromVantagePoints", "True", "False"),
            new ConsoleProp("RInventoryGadget", "bCanUseFromSilentPredator", "True", "False"));
        AddConsoleSlider("smoke_duration", "SMOKE PELLET DURATION", "How long Batman's smoke pellet cloud lasts.", "RSmokeScreenBm", "SmokeScreenDuration", 10f, 5f, 60f, 5f, 30f, Fmt.Secs);
        AddCommand("give_gadgets", "GIVE ALL GADGETS", "Adds every gadget to the gadget wheel.", () => World.RequireCheats().DebugGiveAllGadgets());

        AddConsoleToggle("silent_running", "SILENT RUNNING", "Your footsteps make no noise.", new ConsoleProp("RPawnPlayer", "bSilentRunning", "True", "False"));
        DroneInvisible = AddToggle("drone_invisible", "INVISIBLE TO DRONES", "Sentry guns, flying drones and helicopter searchlights can't see you. Thugs, and the small drones they pilot, still can.");
        ThugInvisible = AddToggle("thug_invisible", "INVISIBLE TO THUGS", "Thugs, gunmen and snipers can't see you, even right in front of them, and ones already hunting you lose you. Street thugs already fighting you break off and run, as they do while you interrogate someone. They can still hear noise, and story fights keep going.", on =>
        {
            if (!on)
                RestoreSight();
        });
    }

    // ---- invisible to drones
    // RPawnPlayer.bInvisibleToDrones does nothing: no script reads it and setting it changed nothing in game. What the
    // game really asks:
    // - Sentry guns: the native ARSentryGunBase::UpdatePlayerVis calls the event RPlayerController.ScriptIsHidden
    //   with no Checker before anything else, and a hidden player isn't seen at all. Thugs pass themselves as the
    //   Checker, so answering only the Checker-less call leaves them alone.
    // - Flying drones and helicopters (RHelicopterBase): the native vision asks the event IsPlayerInvisible, which is
    //   how the game hides you during conversations and door transitions. The small thug-piloted mini drones are the
    //   same class but spot you some other way, so they still see you.

    // ---- invisible to thugs
    // Thug sight is native: RBMAIController.CalcVisibilityFor and ProcessSpottableAlerts build each thug's alert on
    // you from his RBMPawnAI sight ranges (Instant, Focused, Peripheral, Extended). Answering IsHidden alone did
    // nothing in game (2026-11-05). So every tick each villain's ranges are held at 1 unit. The game rewrites them
    // itself (snipers' SetLongFOV/SetShortFOV, CanSeeTargetCombatPawn's temporary ExtendedSightRange), so any other
    // value seen is taken as the game's latest wish, remembered, and put back when the toggle goes off.
    //
    // RPlayerController.IsHidden (script: in a cinematic, or in a vent entered unseen) is still answered for thug
    // checkers, which covers the script-side checks (CanSeeTargetCombatPawn, RBMBehaviour_CombatAI.AwareOfPlayer,
    // AlertAndAddAttacker). Story fight starts ask with no Checker (RAEC_Attack_Base.ForceStartAttack) and are left alone.

    private const float BlindRange = 1f;

    private readonly Dictionary<nint, (RPawnVillain Pawn, float Instant, float Focused, float Peripheral, float Extended)> _sight = new();

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (ThugInvisible is { On: true })
            Blind();
    }

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        _sight.Clear();
    }

    private void Blind()
    {
        foreach (RPawnVillain v in World.All<RPawnVillain>())
        {
            if (v.bDeleteMe)
                continue;

            if (!_sight.TryGetValue(v.Ptr, out var s))
                s = (v, v.InstantSightRange, v.FocusedSightRange, v.PeripheralSightRange, v.ExtendedSightRange);

            s = (v, Wish(v.InstantSightRange, s.Instant), Wish(v.FocusedSightRange, s.Focused), Wish(v.PeripheralSightRange, s.Peripheral), Wish(v.ExtendedSightRange, s.Extended));
            _sight[v.Ptr] = s;

            v.InstantSightRange = BlindRange;
            v.FocusedSightRange = BlindRange;
            v.PeripheralSightRange = BlindRange;
            v.ExtendedSightRange = BlindRange;
            Forget(v);
        }
    }

    // A thug who already spotted you keeps an AlertInstance on you with a SightLevel that only decays slowly.
    // RBMRoomAIState.PreASyncGameInfoTick keeps the hunt on while any thug's level is above 0, and once every one
    // is at 0 it fires FireSightLostEvents (the room's Batman-lost Kismet event and bark), which sends them
    // searching. Zeroing the level each tick lets the game lose you its own way; TimeSinceSeen keeps counting up.
    // Scripted re-spots (thermal checks, shots at a gargoyle) that set the level to SpottedLimit are undone the same tick.
    private static void Forget(RPawnVillain v)
    {
        if (v.AIController is not { IsValid: true } ai || ai.FindAlertForPlayer() is not { IsValid: true } alert)
            return;

        if (alert.SightLevel > 0f)
            alert.SightLevel = 0f;
        if (alert.bVisible)
            alert.bVisible = false;
    }

    /// <summary>The value the game wants: what it just wrote, unless that is still Oracle's own.</summary>
    private static float Wish(float now, float remembered) => MathF.Abs(now - BlindRange) < 0.001f ? remembered : now;

    private void RestoreSight()
    {
        foreach (var s in _sight.Values)
        {
            RPawnVillain v = s.Pawn;
            if (!v.IsValid || v.bDeleteMe)
                continue;

            Safe.Run("thug sight restore", () =>
            {
                v.InstantSightRange = s.Instant;
                v.FocusedSightRange = s.Focused;
                v.PeripheralSightRange = s.Peripheral;
                v.ExtendedSightRange = s.Extended;
            });
        }

        _sight.Clear();
    }

    // The redirects can run before Build, so the toggles may still be null.
    public Toggle? DroneInvisible;
    public Toggle? ThugInvisible;

    private static bool Hidden => I.DroneInvisible is { On: true };

    private static bool HiddenFrom(RBMPawnAI checker) => checker is { IsValid: true } ? I.ThugInvisible is { On: true } : Hidden;

    [Redirect(typeof(RPlayerController), nameof(RPlayerController.ScriptIsHidden))]
    private static bool ScriptIsHiddenRedirect(RPlayerController self, RBMPawnAI checker, bool combatCheck) =>
        HiddenFrom(checker) || self.ScriptIsHidden(checker, combatCheck);

    [Redirect(typeof(RPlayerController), nameof(RPlayerController.IsHidden))]
    private static bool IsHiddenRedirect(RPlayerController self, RBMPawnAI checker, bool combatCheck, bool ignoreCinematicCheck) =>
        (I.ThugInvisible is { On: true } && checker is { IsValid: true }) || self.IsHidden(checker, combatCheck, ignoreCinematicCheck);

    // Ending a fight. Answering IsCurrentCombatantWhileTaunting with false (the "Batman got away" check the combat
    // manager polls) was tried and did nothing: it was asked ~90 times a second and thugs stayed in combat
    // (Oracle.log, 2026-11-05). What does break open-world thugs out is RBMBehaviour_Combat.Tick ->
    // WandererHandleSpookedBy: for militia, wanderers, rioters and car or riot spawns, a Batman interrogation
    // (InterrogationInProgress = player bInInterrogation) makes RioterWillBreak true and forces a flee even mid-move.
    // The behaviour then runs ExitCombat, InstantExitBehaviour(self) from its own state, and its run-away behaviour,
    // so the game does the state work. Story-only thugs aren't in those groups and keep fighting. Confirmed in game 2026-11-05.
    [Redirect(typeof(RBMBehaviour_Combat), nameof(RBMBehaviour_Combat.InterrogationInProgress))]
    private static bool InterrogationRedirect(RBMBehaviour_Combat self)
    {
        return I.ThugInvisible is { On: true } || self.InterrogationInProgress();
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RHelicopterBase), nameof(RHelicopterBase.IsPlayerInvisible))]
    private static bool HelicopterInvisibleRedirect(RHelicopterBase self) => Hidden || self.IsPlayerInvisible();

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        if (God.On)
            Safe.Run("god mode restore", () => ApplyGod(false));
        RestoreSight();
    }

    private static void ApplyGod(bool on)
    {
        RPlayerController? pc = World.Pc;
        if (pc != null && pc.bGodMode != on)
            pc.bGodMode = on;

        if (World.Cheats is { } cm && cm.bIgnoreDamage != on)
            cm.bIgnoreDamage = on;

        RPawnPlayer? p = on ? World.Player : null;
        if (p != null && p.Health > 0 && p.Health < p.HealthMax)
            p.Health = p.HealthMax;
    }

    private static void ApplyMoveSpeed(float v)
    {
        RPawnPlayer? p = World.Player;
        if (p != null && MathF.Abs(p.MovementSpeedModifier - v) > 0.001f)
            p.MovementSpeedModifier = v;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Player/Progress.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.BmScript;
using BmSDK;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal sealed class Progress : Module
{
    public static readonly Progress I = new();

    public override void Build()
    {
        AddSaveCommand("upgrade_points", "+10 UPGRADE POINTS", "Adds 10 points to spend on upgrades.", () => GivePoints(10));
        AddSaveCommand("give_xp", "+5000 XP", "Adds 5000 experience, as a fight would. Enough of it levels you up and earns upgrade points.", () => GiveXp(5000));
        _xpScale = AddSlider("xp_multiplier", "XP MULTIPLIER", "Multiplies the experience you earn from fights, predator rooms, Batmobile battles and everything else.", 1f, 1f, 10f, 0.5f, 2f, Fmt.Times);
        AddSaveCommand("unlock_upgrades", "UNLOCK ALL UPGRADES", "Unlocks every upgrade for Batman and the Batmobile.", () => World.RequireCheats().UnlockAllUpgrades(true));
        AddSaveCommand("riddler_map", "REVEAL RIDDLER MAP", "Reveals every Riddler trophy and puzzle on the map.", RevealRiddlerMap);
        AddSaveCommand("unlock_all", "UNLOCK EVERYTHING", "The game's own unlock-all cheat: upgrades, gadgets, extras and more.", () => World.RequireCheats().UnlockAll());
        Command achievements = AddSaveCommand("unlock_achievements", "UNLOCK ALL ACHIEVEMENTS", "Unlocks every achievement on your Steam account, DLC ones included. This is permanent: Oracle can't take them back.", UnlockAchievements);
        achievements.ConfirmPrompt = () => "UNLOCK EVERY STEAM ACHIEVEMENT FOR GOOD?";
        AddCommand("save_now", "SAVE GAME NOW", "Autosaves right now, as the game does at story points. Batman reloads at the nearest start point, not the exact spot. The game has no manual save, so this is the only way to keep where you are.", SaveNow);
    }

    // RCheatManager.AutoSaveGame calls RGameRI.AutoSaveAtNearestStartPoint, the same native autosave the story uses.
    private static void SaveNow()
    {
        RGameInfo game = World.Info ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("load into the game first");
        if (game.GetIsSaveInProgress())
            throw new InvalidOperationException("a save is already in progress");

        World.RequireCheats().AutoSaveGame();
        Log.Info("Asked the game to autosave.");
    }

    // RCheatManager.UnlockAllAchievements loops ids 0..130 through RPlayerController.UnlockAchievement, which skips
    // any already earned and sends the rest to Steam. Its float argument defaults to 100 (fully done) in script,
    // and the cheat passes it as an empty optional, so the script default applies; calling
    // RPlayerController.UnlockAchievement from C# directly would send 0 instead (see BmSDK optional parameters).
    private static void UnlockAchievements()
    {
        World.RequireCheats().UnlockAllAchievements();
        Log.Info("Asked the game to unlock every achievement.");
    }

    // RiddlerRevealItems walks the whole map item list and sets the Riddler_<item> reveal flag (and its _Shared copy)
    // for every Riddler item whose name contains MapName; empty means all of them. BmSDK passes 0 or empty for an
    // omitted argument rather than the script default, so the empty name is passed on purpose. The similar
    // RiddlerRevealItemsOnlyValid only covers the 999 nearest items on CityZ. GiveRiddlerMap adds the current
    // map's informant flag on top.
    private static void RevealRiddlerMap()
    {
        RCheatManager cheats = World.RequireCheats();
        cheats.RiddlerRevealItems(new FString(""));
        cheats.GiveRiddlerMap();
    }

    // ---- experience
    // Every XP award goes through RExperienceSystem.AddUnbankedXP (fights, predator and Batmobile bonuses, XP
    // sequences, the AddXP cheat); BankXP later adds the unbanked total to RPersistentShared.Xp and levels you up.
    // XP also heals in combat (RPawnPlayer.ExperienceAwarded), so the multiplier heals more too.

    // The redirect can run before Build, so the slider may still be null.
    private Slider? _xpScale;
    private bool _granting;

    private int ScaleXp(int xp)
    {
        float scale = _xpScale?.Value ?? 1f;
        return _granting || xp <= 0 || scale <= 1.001f ? xp : (int)MathF.Round(xp * scale);
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RExperienceSystem), nameof(RExperienceSystem.AddUnbankedXP))]
    private static void AddUnbankedXPRedirect(RExperienceSystem self, int xpAwarded, bool teeth)
    {
        int xp = xpAwarded;
        Safe.Run("xp multiplier", () => xp = I.ScaleXp(xpAwarded));
        self.AddUnbankedXP(xp, teeth);
    }

    // RCheatManager.AddXP adds unbanked XP and banks it at once. Its 500 default is script only, so pass the amount.
    private void GiveXp(int xp)
    {
        RCheatManager cheats = World.RequireCheats();
        _granting = true;
        try
        {
            cheats.AddXP(xp);
        }
        finally
        {
            _granting = false;
        }
    }

    private static void GivePoints(int n)
    {
        RPersistentShared? ps = World.Info?.PersistentShared;
        if (ps is not { IsValid: true })
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no persistent data");
        ps.UpgradePointsAvailable += n;
    }
}

/// <summary>Adds NEW GAME ++ to the main menu, and brings back counter icons in New Game +.</summary>
internal sealed class NewGamePlus : Module
{
    public static readonly NewGamePlus I = new();

    private const int ButtonId = 79;
    private const string BootKey = "NgppAtBoot";
    private const string ButtonLabel = "NEW GAME ++";

    // START NEW GAME + NOW: set (as a UTC tick count) when Oracle quits to the main menu to start New Game + there.
    private const string PendingKey = "NgpPending";
    private const double PendingSeconds = 120;
    private const float MenuSettle = 1.5f;

    private Toggle _setting = null!;
    private bool _askLogged;
    private float _menuSeen;
    private Every _menuLook;

    // The main menu is built once, so the choice is fixed for a game session even if the setting changes.
    private static bool ThisSession => Shared.GetValue(BootKey, false);

    public override void Build()
    {
        _setting = AddToggle("new_game_plus_plus", "NEW GAME ++", "Adds NEW GAME ++ to the main menu once your save has a New Game + run: play New Game + again from the start. Restart the game after switching.").Setting();

        Command now = AddCommand("ngp_start_now", "START NEW GAME + NOW",
            "Starts a fresh New Game + run straight from your game: Oracle keeps a copy of your save, quits to the main menu and starts New Game + there, as the menu's own button does. Any New Game + run in this slot starts over; the main story is untouched. Needs the story finished.",
            StartNow).Confirmed();
        now.ConfirmPrompt = () => Safe.Try("ng+ check", () => World.Ri?.PersistentOptions is { IsValid: true } po && po.NewGamePlusStarted != 0)
            ? "WIPE YOUR NEW GAME + RUN AND START OVER?"
            : "START NEW GAME +?";
    }

    // ---- START NEW GAME + NOW
    // The main menu starts New Game + with SetActiveStorySlotID(2), Live_InvalidateStoryData and a full
    // "start batentry" load (RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu.OnFadeCompleted_Callback, fade 7). Doing that over a live story
    // world risks carrying its state into the new run, so Oracle goes to the main menu and presses the game's
    // own confirmed button there: PopupType NewGamePlus, then PopupRequester_Callback(none, 1), exactly what
    // answering YES to "overwrite story progress?" runs.

    private static void StartNow()
    {
        if (!World.InGame)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("load into the game first");

        RPlayerController pc = World.Pc ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        RGameInfo game = World.Info ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        RPersistentOptions po = World.Ri?.PersistentOptions is { IsValid: true } o ? o : throw new InvalidOperationException("the save isn't loaded");
        if (po.NewGamePlusEnabled == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("finish the story first to unlock New Game +");
        if (game.GetIsSaveInProgress() || Saves.I.Saving)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is saving, try again in a moment");
        if (Characters.I.PlayingOther || Characters.I.Busy)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("switch back to Batman first");

        Saves.I.KeepCurrentSlot("before New Game +");
        Shared.Set(PendingKey, DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks);
        Log.Info("NEW GAME +: quitting to the main menu to start a fresh run there.");
        Menu.Close();
        pc.FE_ExitToFrontend();
    }

    public override void Frame()
    {
        long since = Shared.GetValue(PendingKey, 0L);
        if (since == 0)
            return;

        if ((DateTime.UtcNow - new DateTime(since, DateTimeKind.Utc)).TotalSeconds > PendingSeconds)
        {
            Shared.Set(PendingKey, null);
            Log.Info("NEW GAME +: the main menu never came up, nothing started.");
            Overlay.Notice("START NEW GAME + NOW", "THE MAIN MENU NEVER CAME UP", false);
            return;
        }

        if (!World.InFrontend)
        {
            _menuSeen = 0f;
            return;
        }

        if (!_menuLook.Elapsed(0.25))
            return;

        // Wait for the main menu to sit still with nothing in front of it, then press its New Game + button.
        RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu? menu = World.All<RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu>().FirstOrDefault(m => m.IsValid);
        if (menu == null || menu.bInputBlocked || menu.ActivePopup is { IsValid: true })
        {
            _menuSeen = 0f;
            return;
        }

        _menuSeen += 0.25f;
        if (_menuSeen < MenuSettle)
            return;

        Shared.Set(PendingKey, null);
        if (!menu.IsNewGamePlusUnlocked())
        {
            Log.Info("NEW GAME +: the main menu says New Game + isn't unlocked, nothing started.");
            Overlay.Notice("START NEW GAME + NOW", "NEW GAME + ISN'T UNLOCKED", false);
            return;
        }

        Log.Info("NEW GAME +: starting a fresh New Game + run from the main menu.");
        menu.PopupType = RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu.MMPopTypes.MMPopType_NewGamePlus;
        menu.PopupRequester_Callback(null!, 1);
    }

    public override void Started()
    {
        if (Shared.Get<object>(BootKey) == null)
            Shared.Set(BootKey, _setting.On);
    }

    public override void WorldChanged() => _askLogged = false;

    private void AddButton(RGFxMovieUI self)
    {
        if (ThisSession && self is RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu && self.IsNewGamePlusStarted())
        {
            self.UC_AddButton(ButtonId, new FString(ButtonLabel), true, false, false, new FString(""));
            Log.Info("Added NEW GAME ++ to the main menu.");
        }
    }

    private bool ForceIcons(RBMCombatManager self, bool shown)
    {
        bool forced = !shown && Combat.I.CounterIcons.On && self.DisableCounterIconSequenceAction is not { IsValid: true };
        if (!_askLogged)
        {
            _askLogged = true;
            Log.Detail("Counter icons: game says " + (shown ? "show" : "hide") + (forced ? ", Oracle shows them anyway." : "."));
        }

        return forced;
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RGFxMovieUI), nameof(RGFxMovieUI.IsNewGamePlusUnlocked))]
    private static bool IsNewGamePlusUnlockedRedirect(RGFxMovieUI self)
    {
        bool unlocked = self.IsNewGamePlusUnlocked();
        if (unlocked)
            Safe.Run("NEW GAME ++ button", () => I.AddButton(self));
        return unlocked;
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu), nameof(RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu.XI_OnClicked))]
    private static void MainMenuClickedRedirect(RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu self, int id)
    {
        if (id != ButtonId || !ThisSession)
        {
            self.XI_OnClicked(id);
            return;
        }

        Log.Info("NEW GAME ++ picked: starting a fresh New Game + run.");
        self.GotoNewGamePlus();
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RBMCombatManager), nameof(RBMCombatManager.CanShowCounterIcons))]
    private static bool CanShowCounterIconsRedirect(RBMCombatManager self)
    {
        bool shown = self.CanShowCounterIcons();
        return shown || Safe.Try("counter icons", () => I.ForceIcons(self, shown));
    }
}
```

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static BmSDK.BmGame.RGameInfo;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Finishes Riddler items anywhere in the city, loaded or not. A real pickup only records named flags and
/// updates the puzzle grid, so doing the same from BmGame.ini's item list needs no actor. Follows
/// RPickup_Riddler.PickedUp and RRiddleSolution.RiddleFound, minus their messages and sounds.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Riddler : Module
{
    public static readonly Riddler I = new();

    private const string Title = "RIDDLER";
    private const string PickedUpPrefix = "PickedUp_";
    private const string RevealedPrefix = "Riddler_";
    private const string Trophy = "RiddlerPickup";
    private const string Riddle = "RiddlerCameo";
    private const string Bomb = "RiddlerBomb";
    private const string Breakable = "RiddlerBreakable";

    // Trophies from 100 up are the other spot of a trophy that moves. They have flags but no grid piece.
    private const int FirstAlternateId = 100;

    // RiddlerPuzzleSetPieceStateByIndex treats this as every piece of the puzzle.
    private const byte AllPieces = 255;

    // RiddlerPuzzleGetPieceStateCount's script default for "any puzzle". BmSDK passes 0 for an omitted
    // optional argument instead of the script default, which counts only puzzle 0 and so finds nothing.
    private const byte AnyPuzzle = 255;

    // Solved from the Batmobile, so RVehicleBatmobileBase hard-codes it and the map list leaves it out.
    private const string BatmobileRiddle = "CityY_Riddler_23";

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, ERiddlerLocationName> Zones = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        ["CityX"] = ERiddlerLocationName.RiddlerLoc_CityX,
        ["CityY"] = ERiddlerLocationName.RiddlerLoc_CityY,
        ["CityZ"] = ERiddlerLocationName.RiddlerLoc_CityZ,
        ["Film"] = ERiddlerLocationName.RiddlerLoc_Film,
        ["Stagg"] = ERiddlerLocationName.RiddlerLoc_Stagg,
        ["HideOut"] = ERiddlerLocationName.RiddlerLoc_HideOut,
    };

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, ERiddlerCollection> Collections = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        ["MilitiaShield"] = ERiddlerCollection.RiddlerCollection_Shields,
        ["JackInTheBox"] = ERiddlerCollection.RiddlerCollection_Jacks,
        ["MiniDrone"] = ERiddlerCollection.RiddlerCollection_SpiderBots,
        ["InsectCrate"] = ERiddlerCollection.RiddlerCollection_Insects,
    };

    public override void Build()
    {
        AddSaveCommand("riddler_finale", "SKIP TO RIDDLER FINALE", "Collects all 243 trophies, riddles, bombs and breakables, then plays out every Riddler challenge, race and the first mech fight through the game's own script, leaving only the final battle. Needs story chapter 5 or later, when the GCPD can take Riddler. Run it outside in the city.", StartFinale);
    }

    // ---- skip to the finale
    // Riddler's Revenge lives in the city's Riddler_Unlock Kismet. Each challenge has an unlock event (marker,
    // progress text) and a completion event (percentage, marker removed), all guarded by their own flags, so
    // firing them in story order replays the mission exactly. One step per interval lets each chain finish.

    private const float FinaleStepSeconds = 0.5f;
    private const string FinalFightEvent = "SS_Riddler_FinalMechFight(External)";

    // (unlock event, completion event) in the order the game reveals them (progress letters B to L).
    private static readonly (string Unlock, string Done)[] Challenges =
    {
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_C6", "Orphan_A1_Cave_C6_Done"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_C2", "Orphan_A1_Cave_C2_Done"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_01", "KeyCollected_in_01"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_C3", "Orphan_A1_Cave_C3_Done"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_C8", "Orphan_A1_Cave_C8_Done"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_04", "Orphan_04_Finished"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_C4", "Orphan_A1_Cave_C4_Done"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_09", "NRiddler_09_Done"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_C7", "Orphan_A1_Cave_C7_Done"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_15", "NRiddler_3A_Key_Collar_Done"),
        ("Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_C1", "Orphan_A1_Cave_C1_Done"),
    };

    // Set inside the challenge levels themselves, which the city script never sees.
    private static readonly string[] ChallengeLevelFlags =
    {
        "All_Trophies_Collected",
        "Orphan_01_Complete", "Orphan_04_Complete", "Orphan_09_Complete", "Orphan_15_Complete",
        "Orphan_A1_Key_Cage_Set_C2_Done", "Orphan_A1_Key_Cage_Set_C3_Done", "Orphan_A1_Key_Cage_Set_C4_Done",
        "Orphan_A1_Key_Cage_Set_C6_Done", "Orphan_A1_Key_Cage_Set_C7_Done", "Orphan_A1_Key_Cage_Set_C8_Done",
        "Riddler_All_Puzzle_Rooms_Done",
    };

    // What the Orphanage's own Mech_Fight_1 ending sets. Without Orphan_CW_Freedom_Done, Catwoman is never
    // spawned and the trophy plinth plays her radio lines instead of starting the final fight.
    private static readonly string[] MechFightOneFlags =
    {
        "Orphan_A1_Mech1_Intro_Done", "Orphan_A1_Mech1_Retreat", "Orphan_A1_Mech_Fight_1_Done",
        "Riddler_PostMechFight1_Search", "Orphan_CW_Freedom_Done",
    };

    private const string MechFightOneUnlock = "Orphan_Unlock_Map_Orphan_A1";

    // Set while the player is in the Orphanage, where its own script is loaded and would react to the events.
    private const string InsideOrphanageFlag = "InsideOrphanage";

    // Set by the story's first Orphanage visit, where Riddler takes Catwoman. Before it his missions don't exist yet.
    private const string RiddlerStoryStartedFlag = "Orphan_A1_Intro_Robots_Done";

    // Logged when the skip refuses, to show where a save's Riddler story stands.
    private static readonly string[] StoryFlags =
    {
        "Ch3c_Riddlers_Hideout_Open", "Ch3b_CityX_16_Head_To_Riddler_Cave", "RiddlerStarted", "RiddlerOrphangeActive",
        "Orphan_C6_Unlocked", "Orphan_A1_Intro_Robots_Done", "All_Trophies_Collected",
    };

    private readonly Queue<(string Label, Action<RGameInfo, RFlagManager> Run)> _finale = new();
    private float _finaleWait;

    private static void StartFinale()
    {
        if (!World.InGame)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("load into the game first");
        if (I._finale.Count > 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("already running");

        RGameInfo game = World.Info ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("no game info");
        RFlagManager flags = Flags(game);
        if (!flags.GetGlobalFlag(new FString(RiddlerStoryStartedFlag)))
        {
            Log.Info("Riddler finale: refused, story flags " + string.Join(", ", StoryFlags.Select(f => f + "=" + flags.GetGlobalFlag(new FString(f)))) + ".");
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Riddler's story hasn't started: play his first Orphanage visit first");
        }

        int chapter = game.GetChapterNumber(), sub = game.GetSubChapterNumber();
        if (!GcpdTakesRiddler(chapter, sub))
        {
            Log.Info("Riddler finale: refused at chapter " + chapter + ", sub-chapter " + sub + "; the GCPD can't take Riddler yet.");
            throw new InvalidOperationException("too early in the story: the GCPD can't take Riddler until chapter 5, play on first");
        }

        bool inside = flags.GetGlobalFlag(new FString(InsideOrphanageFlag));
        if (!inside && !World.All<SeqEvent_RemoteEvent>().Any(e => e.EventName.ToString() == FinalFightEvent))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("go outside into the city first");

        CollectEverything();
        SetAll(flags, ChallengeLevelFlags);

        if (inside)
        {
            // The city's events have run before, or will on the next visit; here only the state is needed.
            SetAll(flags, MechFightOneFlags);
            Log.Info("Riddler finale: inside the Orphanage, set its state only.");
            Overlay.Notice(Title, "READY, USE THE TROPHY PODIUM", true);
            return;
        }

        foreach (var (unlock, done) in Challenges)
        {
            I._finale.Enqueue((unlock, Fire(unlock)));
            I._finale.Enqueue((done, Fire(done)));
        }

        I._finale.Enqueue((MechFightOneUnlock, Fire(MechFightOneUnlock)));
        I._finale.Enqueue(("first mech fight won", (g, f) => SetAll(f, MechFightOneFlags)));
        I._finale.Enqueue((FinalFightEvent, Fire(FinalFightEvent)));
        I._finaleWait = 0f;
        Log.Info("Riddler finale: " + I._finale.Count + " steps queued.");
        Overlay.Notice(Title, "SKIPPING TO THE FINALE, STAY PUT", true);
    }

    // Beating Riddler ends with driving him to the GCPD, and that drop-off only streams in from chapter 5c
    // (CityZ_T17_Cine_Ch5c6789_Riddler_GCPD_Lockup). Before it the car holds him with no marker and won't let
    // Batman out, a soft lock. The sub-chapter may count a as 0 or 1, so 3 means c or later either way.
    private const int DeliveryChapter = 5;
    private const int DeliverySubChapter = 3;

    private static bool GcpdTakesRiddler(int chapter, int sub) =>
        chapter > DeliveryChapter || (chapter == DeliveryChapter && sub >= DeliverySubChapter);

    private static void SetAll(RFlagManager flags, string[] names)
    {
        foreach (string name in names)
            flags.SetGlobalFlag(new FString(name), true);
    }

    private static Action<RGameInfo, RFlagManager> Fire(string remoteEvent) => (g, _) => g.ActivateRemoteEvent(new FName(remoteEvent));

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (_finale.Count == 0)
            return;

        _finaleWait -= dt;
        if (_finaleWait > 0f)
            return;

        _finaleWait = FinaleStepSeconds;
        if (World.Info is not { } game)
            return;

        var (label, run) = _finale.Dequeue();
        Safe.Run("riddler finale " + label, () => run(game, Flags(game)));
        Log.Info("Riddler finale: " + label + " (" + _finale.Count + " left).");
        if (_finale.Count == 0)
        {
            Log.Info("Riddler finale: done. The final fight should now be on the map and mission wheel.");
            Overlay.Notice(Title, "FINAL BATTLE READY, CHECK THE MAP", true);
        }
    }

    // ---- GCPD delivery rescue
    // Delivering Riddler plays Lockup_B1_Cine_Ch5c6789_Delivering_Riddler_GCPD, which first links its cinematic
    // proxy to the named pawn GCPD_AaronCash. On a chapter 9 save Cash was not there, so that latent op waited
    // forever behind a black screen. Cash's spawners are spawn-once, so one used earlier in the story ignores a
    // new request until its spawned mark is cleared. Once Cash exists, restarting the link step lets the
    // cutscene play with him in it; skipping the link is the last resort and leaves his cutscene double empty.

    private const string LockupCinematicFlag = "Lockup_B1_InCinematic";
    private const string DeliveryLevel = "Delivering_Riddler";
    private const string CashName = "GCPD_AaronCash";
    private const string CashLevel = "Lockup_B1.";
    private const float DeliveryCheckSeconds = 1f;
    private const int DeliveryGrace = 3;
    private const int SkipLinkAfter = 14;

    private Every _deliveryCheck;
    private int _deliveryStuck;
    private int _cashAttempt;
    private bool _cashLinked;

    // Frame, not Tick: the game can stop ticking mods while a cutscene holds the screen.
    public override void Frame()
    {
        if (_cellCheck.Elapsed(CellCheckSeconds))
            Safe.Run("gcpd cells", RefillCells);

        if (!_deliveryCheck.Elapsed(DeliveryCheckSeconds))
            return;

        Safe.Run("riddler delivery", () =>
        {
            RSeqAct_LinkCinematicProxyToInGameActor? link = StuckDeliveryLink();
            if (link == null)
            {
                _deliveryStuck = 0;
                _cashAttempt = 0;
                _cashLinked = false;
                return;
            }

            _deliveryStuck++;
            if (_deliveryStuck < DeliveryGrace)
                return;

            if (_deliveryStuck >= SkipLinkAfter)
            {
                Log.Info("Riddler delivery: Aaron Cash could not be brought in, moving the cutscene past him.");
                link.ForceActivateOutput(0);
                _deliveryStuck = 0;
                return;
            }

            if (CashPawn() is { } cash)
            {
                if (!_cashLinked)
                {
                    _cashLinked = true;
                    Log.Info("Riddler delivery: Aaron Cash is here (" + cash.GetPathName(null) + "), restarting the cutscene's link step.");
                    link.ForceActivateInput(0);
                }

                return;
            }

            SpawnCash(_cashAttempt++);
        });
    }

    private static RSeqAct_LinkCinematicProxyToInGameActor? StuckDeliveryLink()
    {
        if (World.Info is not { } game || !Flags(game).GetGlobalFlag(new FString(LockupCinematicFlag)))
            return null;

        return World.All<RSeqAct_LinkCinematicProxyToInGameActor>()
            .FirstOrDefault(l => l.bActive && l.GetPathName(null).Contains(DeliveryLevel, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
    }

    /// <summary>Cash's spawners, the GCPD's own first, then the chapter 9 ones.</summary>
    private static List<RBmPawnSpawner> CashSpawners() => World.All<RBmPawnSpawner>()
        .Where(s => s.PawnReferenceName.ToString() == CashName)
        .OrderBy(s => s.GetPathName(null).StartsWith(CashLevel, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? 0 : 1)
        .ToList();

    private static Pawn? CashPawn() => CashSpawners().Select(s => s.SpawnedPawn).FirstOrDefault(p => p is { IsValid: true } && !p.bDeleteMe);

    /// <summary>Two tries per spawner: the script's own input, then the spawner's SpawnPawn.</summary>
    private static void SpawnCash(int attempt)
    {
        List<RBmPawnSpawner> spawners = CashSpawners();
        if (spawners.Count == 0)
        {
            if (attempt == 0)
                Log.Info("Riddler delivery: no Aaron Cash spawner is loaded.");
            return;
        }

        RBmPawnSpawner spawner = spawners[attempt / 2 % spawners.Count];
        string name = spawner.GetPathName(null);
        if (attempt % 2 == 0)
        {
            Log.Info("Riddler delivery: the cutscene is waiting for Aaron Cash. Spawner " + name + " had bSpawned=" + spawner.bSpawned
                + ", bSpawnOnceOnly=" + spawner.bSpawnOnceOnly + ", bSpawnHidden=" + spawner.bSpawnHidden + "; clearing and firing it.");
            spawner.bSpawned = false;
            spawner.ForceActivateInput(0);
        }
        else
        {
            Log.Info("Riddler delivery: no Cash from " + name + " yet, calling its SpawnPawn directly.");
            spawner.bSpawned = false;
            spawner.SpawnPawn();
        }
    }

    // ---- GCPD cells
    // Entering the GCPD activates every captured villain's cell spawner at once. Seen on a chapter 9 save: that
    // first activation runs before the characters are ready and spawns nobody. A second pass later respawns the
    // villains with repeatable spawners, but most cells are spawn-once and stay empty for the visit. A spawner the
    // script already activated (so its villain is locked up) that still has no pawn is fired again, once other
    // cells are filled to show the GCPD has finished loading.

    private const string CellSequence = "Lockup_B1.TheWorld:PersistentLevel:Sequence_112:";

    // The cells RSeqAct_SwitchFlags_0 starts from each villain's locked-up flag. Other sub-sequences here, such as
    // the Joker hallucinations, spawn people who are meant to leave again, so they are never touched.
    private static readonly HashSet<string> Cells = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        "Blackfire", "firefly", "penguin", "Pyg", "Riddler", "TwoFace", "Azrael", "ManBat", "FireCrew", "Deathstroke",
    };
    private const string CellSwitch = CellSequence + "RSeqAct_SwitchFlags_0";
    private const float CellCheckSeconds = 2f;
    private const float CellFindSeconds = 10f;
    private const float CellWindowSeconds = 120f;
    private const int CellTries = 2;

    private Every _cellCheck;
    private Every _cellFind;
    private RSeqAct_SwitchFlags? _cellSwitch;
    private List<RBmPawnSpawner> _cells = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<nint, int> _cellTries = new();
    private readonly HashSet<nint> _cellsSeenFilled = new();

    /// <summary>The GCPD's cell switch while the cell block is loaded. Outside it, one cheap lookup every 10 s.</summary>
    private bool CellBlockLoaded()
    {
        if (_cellSwitch is { IsValid: true })
            return true;

        _cellSwitch = null;
        _cells.Clear();
        if (!_cellFind.Elapsed(CellFindSeconds))
            return false;

        _cellSwitch = World.All<RSeqAct_SwitchFlags>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.GetPathName(null) == CellSwitch);
        if (_cellSwitch == null)
            return false;

        _cells = World.All<RBmPawnSpawner>()
            .Where(s => s.GetPathName(null) is { } path && path.StartsWith(CellSequence, StringComparison.Ordinal)
                && path.Substring(CellSequence.Length).Split(':') is { Length: 2 } parts && Cells.Contains(parts[0]))
            .ToList();
        return true;
    }

    private void RefillCells()
    {
        if (!CellBlockLoaded() || World.Info is not { } game)
            return;

        List<RBmPawnSpawner> cells = _cells.Where(c => c.IsValid).ToList();
        foreach (RBmPawnSpawner cell in cells.Where(Filled))
            _cellsSeenFilled.Add(cell.Ptr);
        if (!cells.Any(Filled))
            return;

        float now = game.WorldInfo.TimeSeconds;
        foreach (RBmPawnSpawner cell in cells)
        {
            // Only a cell the game started recently that never had anyone in it this visit: a villain the story
            // removed on purpose has been seen filled, and an old activation is not this arrival.
            if (Filled(cell) || cell.bActive || _cellsSeenFilled.Contains(cell.Ptr)
                || cell.LatentActivationTime <= 0f || now - cell.LatentActivationTime > CellWindowSeconds)
                continue;

            _cellTries.TryGetValue(cell.Ptr, out int tries);
            if (tries >= CellTries)
                continue;

            _cellTries[cell.Ptr] = tries + 1;
            string name = cell.GetPathName(null).Substring(CellSequence.Length);
            cell.bSpawned = false;
            if (tries == 0)
            {
                Log.Info("GCPD cells: " + name + " was activated but never spawned, firing it again.");
                cell.ForceActivateInput(0);
            }
            else
            {
                Log.Info("GCPD cells: " + name + " still empty, calling its SpawnPawn directly.");
                cell.SpawnPawn();
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool Filled(RBmPawnSpawner s) => s.SpawnedPawn is { IsValid: true } p && !p.bDeleteMe;

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        _cellTries.Clear();
        _cellsSeenFilled.Clear();
        _cellSwitch = null;
        _cells.Clear();
        if (_finale.Count > 0)
            Log.Info("Riddler finale: the world changed with " + _finale.Count + " steps left; run SKIP TO RIDDLER FINALE again.");
        _finale.Clear();
    }

    private static int Count(RGameInfo game, ERiddlerState from, ERiddlerState to) =>
        game.RiddlerPuzzleGetPieceStateCount(from, to, ERiddlerCategory.RiddlerCategory_Unknown, ERiddlerPiece.RiddlerPiece_None, AnyPuzzle);

    private static RFlagManager Flags(RGameInfo game)
    {
        RFlagManager? flags = (game.WorldInfo.GRI as RGameRI)?.FlagManager;
        return flags is { IsValid: true } ? flags : throw new InvalidOperationException("no flag manager");
    }

    /// <summary>Finishes all 243 items. Already-collected ones are skipped, so running it again is harmless.</summary>
    private static void CollectEverything()
    {
        if (!World.InGame)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("load into the game first");

        RPlayerController pc = World.Pc ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("no player");
        RGameInfo game = World.Info ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("no game info");
        RPersistentShared? shared = game.PersistentShared;
        if (shared is not { IsValid: true })
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no persistent data");
        RFlagManager flags = Flags(game);

        // Riddler's story checks refuse to run until this is on.
        World.RequireCheats().UnlockRiddlerScreen();

        var rows = MapPlaces.RiddlerRows();
        rows.Add((Riddle, BatmobileRiddle));

        int finished = 0;
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach ((string type, string key) in rows)
        {
            if (!seen.Add(key))
                continue;

            FString pickedUp = new(PickedUpPrefix + key);
            if (flags.GetGlobalFlag(pickedUp) || !Finish(game, shared, pc, type, key))
                continue;

            FString revealed = new(RevealedPrefix + key);
            flags.SetGlobalFlag(revealed, true);
            shared.SetSharedFlag(revealed, true);
            flags.SetGlobalFlag(pickedUp, true);
            shared.SetSharedFlag(pickedUp, true);
            finished++;
        }

        SolveWholeGrid(game);

        RemoveLoadedPickups();

        int solved = Count(game, ERiddlerState.RiddlerState_Solved, ERiddlerState.RiddlerState_Complete);
        int left = Count(game, ERiddlerState.RiddlerState_Unknown, ERiddlerState.RiddlerState_Normal);
        Log.Info("Riddler: finished " + finished + " items, grid now " + solved + " solved, " + left + " left.");
        pc.RiddlerProgressAdvanced();
    }

    /// <summary>Records one item in the grid and the game's counters. Returns false if its name can't be read.</summary>
    private static bool Finish(RGameInfo game, RPersistentShared shared, RPlayerController pc, string type, string key)
    {
        string[] parts = key.Split('_');
        if (parts.Length != 3 || !Zones.TryGetValue(parts[0], out ERiddlerLocationName zone) || !byte.TryParse(parts[2], out byte id))
        {
            Log.Info("Riddler: skipped unknown item " + key + ".");
            return false;
        }

        ERiddlerCategory category = game.RiddlerZoneToCategory(zone);
        switch (type)
        {
            case Trophy when id >= FirstAlternateId:
                break;

            case Trophy:
                game.RiddlerPuzzleSolve(category, ERiddlerPiece.RiddlerPiece_Trophy, id, ERiddlerCollection.RiddlerCollection_Pickups);
                shared.IncreasePickupCount(zone);
                break;

            case Bomb:
                game.RiddlerPuzzleSolve(category, ERiddlerPiece.RiddlerPiece_Bomb, id, ERiddlerCollection.RiddlerCollection_Pickups);
                shared.IncreasePickupCount(zone);
                break;

            case Riddle:
                game.RiddlerPuzzleSolve(category, ERiddlerPiece.RiddlerPiece_Cameo, id, ERiddlerCollection.RiddlerCollection_Cameos);
                pc.UnlockCityStory(id, true);
                break;

            case Breakable:
                if (!Collections.TryGetValue(parts[1], out ERiddlerCollection collection))
                {
                    Log.Info("Riddler: skipped unknown breakable " + key + ".");
                    return false;
                }

                game.RiddlerPuzzleCollect(category, collection, 1);
                break;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Catches any piece an older save left unsolved although its item is already flagged.</summary>
    private static void SolveWholeGrid(RGameInfo game)
    {
        int puzzles = game.RiddlerPuzzles.Count;
        for (int i = 0; i < puzzles; i++)
            game.RiddlerPuzzleSetPieceStateByIndex((byte)i, AllPieces, ERiddlerState.RiddlerState_Solved, true);
    }

    /// <summary>Loaded pickups only check their flag when they spawn, so ask again to clear the ones around the player.</summary>
    private static void RemoveLoadedPickups()
    {
        foreach (RPickupBase pickup in World.All<RPickupBase>().ToList())
        {
            if (!pickup.bDeleteMe && pickup.EarlyDestroy())
                pickup.InitialFlagCheck();
        }
    }
}
```
