```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// PLAYER > STATUS beyond god mode: how much damage you take, not dying, health regeneration, armour, hit
/// reactions and stuns, and an on-screen status readout.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Status : Module
{
    public static readonly Status I = new();

    private const float RegenDelay = 3f;

    // The redirects can run before Build, so these may still be null.
    private Slider? _damageTaken;
    private Toggle? _cantDie;
    private Toggle? _noStagger;
    private Toggle? _noStuns;

    private Slider _regen = null!;
    private Toggle _fullArmour = null!;
    private Toggle _readout = null!;

    private readonly bool[] _grantedArmour = new bool[2];
    private nint _regenPawn;
    private int _regenLastHealth;
    private float _regenCalm;
    private float _regenPool;

    public override bool HasHud => _readout.On && World.Pawn is RPawnPlayer;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _cantDie = AddToggle("cant_die", "CAN'T DIE", "You get hurt as normal, but a blow that would finish you leaves you on 1 health instead. Falling out of the world still counts.");
        _damageTaken = AddSlider("damage_taken", "DAMAGE TAKEN", "Scales every hit you take, from a tenth up to five times as much.", 1f, 0.1f, 5f, 0.05f, 0.5f, Fmt.Times);
        _regen = AddSlider("health_regen", "HEALTH REGEN", "Heals you by this share of your health every second, once you have gone 3 seconds without being hurt.", 0f, 0f, 0.25f, 0.01f, 0.05f, PerSecond);

        _fullArmour = AddToggle("full_armour", "UNBREAKABLE ARMOUR", "Keeps your melee and ballistic armour full. Without armour upgrades you get 100 of each while this is on.", ApplyArmour);
        _fullArmour.Maintain(() => ApplyArmour(true));
        AddCommand("restore_armour", "RESTORE ARMOUR", "Refills your melee and ballistic armour right now.", RestoreArmour);

        _noStagger = AddToggle("no_stagger", "NO HIT REACTIONS", "Hits still hurt, but they no longer knock you back or interrupt what you are doing.");
        _noStuns = AddToggle("no_stuns", "NO STUNS", "Stun batons, electric attacks and laser grids no longer leave you dazed, shocked or slowed.");

        _readout = AddToggle("status_readout", "STATUS READOUT", "Shows your health, armour, experience and upgrade points on screen while you are on foot.");
    }

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        Array.Clear(_grantedArmour);
        _regenPawn = 0;
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        if (_fullArmour.On)
            Safe.Run("armour restore", () => ApplyArmour(false));
    }

    private static string PerSecond(float v) => v <= 0f ? "OFF" : Fmt.Percent(v) + " / S";

    private static bool IsYou(RPawnPlayer pawn) => World.Player is { } p && p.Ptr == pawn.Ptr;

    // ---- damage

    // RPawnPlayer.TakeDamage is where every hit on the player lands: combat (RPawnPlayerCombat.ApplyDamage), guns,
    // explosions and hazards. It takes resistance and armour off, then the Pawn base lowers Health. Scaling and
    // capping the damage before any of that leaves the rest of the game's rules in place. Kill volumes
    // (RDmgType_KillZone, out of the world) are left alone so Batman can't get stuck below the map.
    private int Adjust(RPawnPlayer self, int damage, Class? type)
    {
        if (damage <= 0 || !IsYou(self) || type is { IsValid: true } && (type.Name.ToString() ?? "").Contains("KillZone", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return damage;

        float scale = _damageTaken?.Value ?? 1f;
        if (MathF.Abs(scale - 1f) > 0.001f)
            damage = Math.Max(1, (int)MathF.Round(damage * scale));

        if (_cantDie is { On: true } && damage >= self.Health)
            damage = Math.Max(0, self.Health - 1);

        return damage;
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RPawnPlayer), nameof(RPawnPlayer.TakeDamage))]
    private static void TakeDamageRedirect(RPawnPlayer self, int damage, Controller instigatedBy, Vector3 hitLocation, Vector3 momentum, Class damageType, Actor.FTraceHitInfo hitInfo, Actor damageCauser)
    {
        int adjusted = damage;
        Safe.Run("damage taken", () => adjusted = I.Adjust(self, damage, damageType));
        self.TakeDamage(adjusted, instigatedBy, hitLocation, momentum, damageType, hitInfo, damageCauser);
    }

    // ---- hit reactions and stuns

    // RPawnPlayerCombat.DamagedBy skips the RCombatMove_BatmanHit stagger (and TakeDamage the flinch overlay) when
    // RPlayerController.IgnoreHitReaction says so, which the game does itself while you are crouched in a vent.
    // Damage types marked bCantIgnoreHitReaction still play theirs.
    [Redirect(typeof(RPlayerController), nameof(RPlayerController.IgnoreHitReaction))]
    private static bool IgnoreHitReactionRedirect(RPlayerController self) =>
        (I._noStagger is { On: true } && IsYours(self)) || self.IgnoreHitReaction();

    private static bool NoStuns(RPlayerControllerCombat self) => I._noStuns is { On: true } && IsYours(self);

    private static bool IsYours(RPlayerController pc) => World.Pc is { } you && you.Ptr == pc.Ptr;

    // Damage types with bStunOnHit, bZapOnHit or bLaserOnHit call these on the controller, which turn on the dazed
    // post process and timers. Skipping them leaves the hit itself alone.
    [Redirect(typeof(RPlayerControllerCombat), nameof(RPlayerControllerCombat.Stunned))]
    private static void StunnedRedirect(RPlayerControllerCombat self, bool dontPlaySfx)
    {
        if (!NoStuns(self))
            self.Stunned(dontPlaySfx);
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RPlayerControllerCombat), nameof(RPlayerControllerCombat.Zapped))]
    private static void ZappedRedirect(RPlayerControllerCombat self)
    {
        if (!NoStuns(self))
            self.Zapped();
    }

    [Redirect(typeof(RPlayerControllerCombat), nameof(RPlayerControllerCombat.Lasered))]
    private static void LaseredRedirect(RPlayerControllerCombat self)
    {
        if (!NoStuns(self))
            self.Lasered();
    }

    // ---- regeneration

    // The game's own replenish (RPawnPlayer.UpdateReplenishingHealth behind bReplenishHealth) is challenge-map only
    // and adds one point at a time, so Oracle heals on its own clock. Writing Health then calling HealthUpdated is
    // what the game's healing does: it updates the bar and the saved health.
    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (_regen.Value <= 0f || World.Player is not { } p)
            return;

        int health = p.Health;
        int max = p.MaxHealth;
        if (p.Ptr != _regenPawn || health < _regenLastHealth)
        {
            _regenPawn = p.Ptr;
            _regenCalm = 0f;
            _regenPool = 0f;
        }

        _regenLastHealth = health;
        if (health <= 0 || max <= 0 || health >= max)
            return;

        _regenCalm += dt;
        if (_regenCalm < RegenDelay)
            return;

        _regenPool += dt * _regen.Value * max;
        int add = (int)_regenPool;
        if (add <= 0)
            return;

        _regenPool -= add;
        p.Health = Math.Min(max, health + add);
        _regenLastHealth = p.Health;
        p.HealthUpdated();
    }

    // ---- armour

    // Armour is two pools on RPawnPlayer (melee, ballistic) that ApplyArmour drains before health. Maxima come from
    // the armour upgrades and are -1 without any. SetArmourCurrent clamps to the maximum, updates the HUD bar and
    // keeps the saved armour in step. UpdateMaximumHealthAndArmour is the game's own recount from the upgrades, so
    // it puts back maxima Oracle granted.
    private static readonly RPawnPlayer.EArmourType[] ArmourTypes = { RPawnPlayer.EArmourType.EA_ArmourMelee, RPawnPlayer.EArmourType.EA_ArmourBallistic };

    private void ApplyArmour(bool on)
    {
        if (World.Player is not { } p || p.Health <= 0)
            return;

        if (!on)
        {
            if (_grantedArmour[0] || _grantedArmour[1])
                p.UpdateMaximumHealthAndArmour(false, false);
            Array.Clear(_grantedArmour);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < ArmourTypes.Length; i++)
        {
            if (p.GetArmourMaximum(ArmourTypes[i]) <= 0)
            {
                p.SetArmourMaximum(ArmourTypes[i], 100);
                _grantedArmour[i] = true;
            }
        }

        if (!p.IsFullArmour())
            FillArmour(p);
    }

    private static void RestoreArmour()
    {
        RPawnPlayer p = World.Player ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        if (p.GetArmourMaximum(ArmourTypes[0]) <= 0 && p.GetArmourMaximum(ArmourTypes[1]) <= 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("you have no armour upgrades");
        FillArmour(p);
    }

    private static void FillArmour(RPawnPlayer p)
    {
        foreach (RPawnPlayer.EArmourType t in ArmourTypes)
        {
            int max = p.GetArmourMaximum(t);
            if (max > 0)
                p.SetArmourCurrent(t, max);
        }
    }

    // ---- readout

    public override void Draw(Canvas c)
    {
        if (World.Pawn is not RPawnPlayer p)
            return;

        int melee = p.GetArmourMaximum(ArmourTypes[0]);
        int ballistic = p.GetArmourMaximum(ArmourTypes[1]);
        bool armour = melee > 0 || ballistic > 0;
        RPersistentShared? shared = World.Info?.PersistentShared is { IsValid: true } ps ? ps : null;

        const float width = 220f;
        float height = 76f + (armour ? 28f : 0f) + (shared != null ? 28f : 0f);
        float x = Gfx.W - Gfx.S(width) - Gfx.S(28f);
        float y = Gfx.H - Gfx.S(height) - Gfx.S(48f);
        Gfx.Panel(x, y, Gfx.S(width), Gfx.S(height));

        float left = x + Gfx.S(14f);
        float right = x + Gfx.S(width - 14f);
        float barW = Gfx.S(width - 28f);
        Gfx.Text(left, y + Gfx.S(9f), Flags(), Theme.Mid, 0.6f);

        float row = y + Gfx.S(30f);
        Meter(left, right, row, barW, "HEALTH", p.Health, p.MaxHealth);
        row += Gfx.S(28f);

        if (armour)
        {
            float half = (barW - Gfx.S(10f)) * 0.5f;
            Meter(left, left + half, row, half, "MELEE", Armour(p, 0), melee);
            Meter(left + half + Gfx.S(10f), right, row, half, "BALLISTIC", Armour(p, 1), ballistic);
            row += Gfx.S(28f);
        }

        if (shared != null)
        {
            float span = shared.XpForNextUpgrade - shared.XpForPrevUpgrade;
            float into = shared.Xp - shared.XpForPrevUpgrade;
            Gfx.Text(left, row, "XP", Theme.Mid, 0.56f);
            Gfx.TextRight(right, row + Gfx.S(5f), Whole(into) + " / " + Whole(span) + "   POINTS " + shared.UpgradePointsAvailable, Theme.Hi, 0.56f);
            Bar(left, row + Gfx.S(14f), barW, span > 0f ? into / span : 0f);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The status cheats that are on, as a header line.</summary>
    private string Flags()
    {
        var on = new List<string>(4);
        if (Player.I.God.On)
            on.Add("GOD");
        if (_cantDie is { On: true })
            on.Add("CAN'T DIE");
        if (_damageTaken is { } d && !d.IsDefault)
            on.Add("DMG " + d.State);
        if (_regen.Value > 0f)
            on.Add("REGEN");
        return on.Count == 0 ? "STATUS" : string.Join("  ", on);
    }

    // The game has no getter for the current armour, only the CurrentArmourLevels array it indexes by type.
    private static int Armour(RPawnPlayer p, int slot)
    {
        try
        {
            TArray<int> levels = p.CurrentArmourLevels;
            return slot < levels.Count ? levels[slot] : 0;
        }
        catch
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    private static void Meter(float left, float right, float y, float w, string label, int value, int max)
    {
        Gfx.Text(left, y, label, Theme.Mid, 0.56f);
        Gfx.TextRight(right, y + Gfx.S(5f), max > 0 ? Math.Max(0, value) + " / " + max : "-", Theme.Hi, 0.56f);
        Bar(left, y + Gfx.S(14f), w, max > 0 ? (float)value / max : 0f);
    }

    private static void Bar(float x, float y, float w, float fraction)
    {
        float h = Gfx.S(4f);
        Gfx.Rect(x, y, w, h, Theme.Mid, 0.25f);
        fraction = float.IsNaN(fraction) ? 0f : Math.Clamp(fraction, 0f, 1f);
        Gfx.Rect(x, y, w * fraction, h, Theme.Accent, 0.95f);
    }

    private static string Whole(float v) => MathF.Round(v).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Saves/SaveFiles.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using BmSDK;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Arkham Knight's save files on disk. Each slot has three files in Steam's remote folder,
/// BAK1Save{slot}x{n}.sgd, which the game writes in turn and loads the newest of. Steamworks also copies every
/// write into Documents\WB Games\Batman Arkham Knight\{SteamID64}\SaveData\backup as
/// BAK1Save{slot}x{n}.sgd_{yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss}, and no menu in the game shows those. Oracle's own copies use the
/// backup naming in the mod's saves folder, so one reader handles all three places.
/// </summary>
internal static class SaveFiles
{
    public enum Kind { Current, Backup, Kept }

    /// <summary>One save file. <see cref="When"/> is the time stored in the save, or the file's time if unreadable.</summary>
    public sealed record Entry(string Path, Kind Kind, int Slot, int XId, DateTime When, int LocationId, string Difficulty, int Percent, bool Valid)
    {
        /// <summary>The save's own timestamp as a FILETIME, 0 when the header couldn't be read. Same save = same stamp.</summary>
        public long Stamp { get; init; }

        /// <summary>Main story and New Game + progress as the main menu shows them before DLC bonuses, -1 if unread.</summary>
        public float Story { get; init; } = -1f;
        public float StoryPlus { get; init; } = -1f;

        /// <summary>True when the save holds a New Game + run (its progress only grows once one has started).</summary>
        public bool HasPlus => StoryPlus > 0f;
    }

    private const string AppId = "208650";
    private const long SteamId64Base = 76561197960265728L;
    private const int SaveVersion = 6;
    private const int ScanBytes = 256 * 1024;
    private const string FileStamp = "yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss";

    private static readonly Regex FileName = new(@"^BAK1Save(\d)x(\d)\.sgd(?:_\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d_\d\d-\d\d-\d\d)?$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
    private static readonly long MinStamp = new DateTime(2015, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).ToFileTimeUtc();
    private static readonly long MaxStamp = new DateTime(2100, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc).ToFileTimeUtc();

    // Reading a header costs 64 KB, and the backup folder keeps dozens, so each is read once per change.
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, (DateTime Written, long Size, Entry Entry)> _cache = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public static string RemoteDir { get; private set; } = "";
    public static string BackupDir { get; private set; } = "";
    public static string KeptDir => System.IO.Path.Combine(App.Dir, "saves");

    /// <summary>Finds the logged-in Steam user's save folders. Missing folders stay empty and list nothing.</summary>
    public static void Locate()
    {
        string steam = (Registry.GetValue(@"HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Valve\Steam", "SteamPath", null) as string)?.Replace('/', '\\')
            ?? @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam";
        int user = Registry.GetValue(@"HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Valve\Steam\ActiveProcess", "ActiveUser", 0) is int u ? u : 0;

        string userdata = System.IO.Path.Combine(steam, "userdata");
        string mine = System.IO.Path.Combine(userdata, user.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), AppId, "remote");
        RemoteDir = user != 0 && Directory.Exists(mine) ? mine
            : Newest(Directory.Exists(userdata) ? Directory.GetDirectories(userdata).Select(d => System.IO.Path.Combine(d, AppId, "remote")) : Enumerable.Empty<string>());

        // The backup folder is named by SteamID64; the remote folder by the 32-bit account id inside it.
        string wb = System.IO.Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyDocuments), "WB Games", "Batman Arkham Knight");
        string? account = RemoteDir.Length > 0 ? System.IO.Path.GetFileName(System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(RemoteDir))) : null;
        string ours = long.TryParse(account, out long id) ? System.IO.Path.Combine(wb, (SteamId64Base + id).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "SaveData", "backup") : "";
        BackupDir = ours.Length > 0 && Directory.Exists(ours) ? ours
            : Newest(Directory.Exists(wb) ? Directory.GetDirectories(wb).Select(d => System.IO.Path.Combine(d, "SaveData", "backup")) : Enumerable.Empty<string>());

        Log.Info("Saves: game files in " + Shown(RemoteDir) + ", game backups in " + Shown(BackupDir) + ", kept copies in " + KeptDir + ".");
    }

    private static string Shown(string dir) => dir.Length > 0 ? dir : "(not found)";

    private static string Newest(IEnumerable<string> dirs) =>
        dirs.Where(Directory.Exists).OrderByDescending(Directory.GetLastWriteTimeUtc).FirstOrDefault() ?? "";

    /// <summary>Every save in the three places, newest first. A game backup that matches a file still in use is left out.</summary>
    public static List<Entry> Scan()
    {
        var list = new List<Entry>();
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        Collect(list, seen, RemoteDir, Kind.Current);
        Collect(list, seen, KeptDir, Kind.Kept);
        Collect(list, seen, BackupDir, Kind.Backup);

        foreach (string gone in _cache.Keys.Where(k => !seen.Contains(k)).ToList())
            _cache.Remove(gone);

        // The game backs up every write, so its newest backups are the very files still in the remote folder.
        var inUse = new HashSet<(int, long)>(list.Where(e => e.Kind != Kind.Backup && e.Stamp != 0).Select(e => (e.Slot, e.Stamp)));
        list.RemoveAll(e => e.Kind == Kind.Backup && inUse.Contains((e.Slot, e.Stamp)));
        list.Sort((a, b) => b.When.CompareTo(a.When));
        return list;
    }

    private static void Collect(List<Entry> list, HashSet<string> seen, string dir, Kind kind)
    {
        if (dir.Length == 0 || !Directory.Exists(dir))
            return;

        foreach (string path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(dir, "BAK1Save*"))
        {
            Match m = FileName.Match(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path));
            if (!m.Success)
                continue;

            seen.Add(path);
            try
            {
                var info = new FileInfo(path);
                if (_cache.TryGetValue(path, out var hit) && hit.Written == info.LastWriteTimeUtc && hit.Size == info.Length)
                {
                    list.Add(hit.Entry);
                    continue;
                }

                Entry e = Read(path, kind, m.Groups[1].Value[0] - '0', m.Groups[2].Value[0] - '0', info.LastWriteTime);
                _cache[path] = (info.LastWriteTimeUtc, info.Length, e);
                list.Add(e);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Throttled("save read " + path, "Saves: could not read " + path + ": " + ex.Message);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Reads the summary the game's slot screen shows. The file starts with version 6, and the options block holds,
    /// in a row: the save time as a FILETIME, day, month, year, location id, the difficulty as a length-prefixed
    /// string ("Hard"), then the completion percentage. What comes before it varies in length (unlocked
    /// showcase names), so it is found by that shape rather than at a fixed offset.
    /// </summary>
    private static Entry Read(string path, Kind kind, int slot, int xid, DateTime written)
    {
        byte[] head = new byte[ScanBytes];
        int n;
        using (var fs = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete))
            n = fs.ReadAtLeast(head, head.Length, throwOnEndOfStream: false);

        if (n < 8 || BitConverter.ToInt32(head, 0) != SaveVersion)
            return new Entry(path, kind, slot, xid, written, -1, "", -1, false);

        int I(int at) => BitConverter.ToInt32(head, at);
        for (int o = 8; o + 32 <= n; o++)
        {
            long stamp = BitConverter.ToInt64(head, o);
            if (stamp < MinStamp || stamp > MaxStamp)
                continue;

            int day = I(o + 8), month = I(o + 12), year = I(o + 16), location = I(o + 20), len = I(o + 24);
            if (day is < 1 or > 31 || month is < 1 or > 12 || year is < 2015 or > 2100 || location is < 0 or > 4096 || len is < 2 or > 32)
                continue;
            if (o + 28 + len + 4 > n || head[o + 28 + len - 1] != 0)
                continue;

            string difficulty = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(head, o + 28, len - 1);
            if (!difficulty.All(char.IsLetterOrDigit))
                continue;

            DateTime when = DateTime.FromFileTimeUtc(stamp).ToLocalTime();
            (float story, float plus) = StoryPercents(head, o + 28 + len, n);
            return new Entry(path, kind, slot, xid, when, location, difficulty, Percent(head, o + 28 + len, n), true) { Stamp = stamp, Story = story, StoryPlus = plus };
        }

        return new Entry(path, kind, slot, xid, written, -1, "", -1, true);
    }

    private static readonly Regex Tally = new(@"^\d{1,3}/\d{1,3}$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    /// <summary>
    /// The completion percentage the slot screen shows (122% is possible). Later in the options block it sits just
    /// before a list of four progress strings ("6/243", "259/286"...): percent, count 4, then length-prefixed
    /// strings. Checked against the slot screen on 2026-11-05: 25% and 122% read correctly. -1 if not found.
    /// </summary>
    private static int Percent(byte[] head, int from, int n)
    {
        for (int o = Math.Max(from, 4); o + 12 <= n; o++)
        {
            if (BitConverter.ToInt32(head, o) != 4)
                continue;

            int len = BitConverter.ToInt32(head, o + 4);
            if (len is < 4 or > 8 || o + 8 + len > n || head[o + 8 + len - 1] != 0)
                continue;
            if (!Tally.IsMatch(Encoding.ASCII.GetString(head, o + 8, len - 1)))
                continue;

            int percent = BitConverter.ToInt32(head, o - 4);
            return percent is >= 0 and <= 999 ? percent : -1;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// RPersistentShared.StoryOverAllPercent, one float per story slot (main, temp, New Game +), which the main menu
    /// shows as CONTINUE STORY and CONTINUE STORY+ (plus 5% per finished DLC Most Wanted). Stored as count 3 then
    /// the floats, with no name before it, so it is found by shape: the first such array after the options block
    /// with main progress above zero and the temp slot at exactly 0. Checked on 2026-11-05 against 26 saves: slot 1
    /// read 25.4 / 0, slot 3 read 100 / 2.72 (menu: 120% and 2%). A later stray 1.0 / 0 also fits, hence the first.
    /// </summary>
    private static (float Story, float Plus) StoryPercents(byte[] head, int from, int n)
    {
        for (int o = from; o + 16 <= n; o++)
        {
            if (BitConverter.ToInt32(head, o) != 3)
                continue;

            float story = BitConverter.ToSingle(head, o + 4), temp = BitConverter.ToSingle(head, o + 8), plus = BitConverter.ToSingle(head, o + 12);
            if (story is > 0.01f and <= 100f && temp == 0f && plus is >= 0f and <= 100f)
                return (story, plus);
        }

        return (-1f, -1f);
    }

    /// <summary>The whole file, as the game's slot screen hands it over, even while Steam has it open.</summary>
    public static byte[] ReadAll(string path)
    {
        using var fs = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete);
        var data = new byte[fs.Length];
        fs.ReadExactly(data);
        return data;
    }

    /// <summary>Copies a save into the kept folder. Returns false if that exact save is already kept.</summary>
    public static bool Keep(Entry e, out string dest)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(KeptDir);
        dest = System.IO.Path.Combine(KeptDir, "BAK1Save" + e.Slot + "x" + e.XId + ".sgd_" + e.When.ToString(FileStamp, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        if (File.Exists(dest))
            return false;

        // Through a temp name, so a half-written copy never shows up in the list.
        string temp = dest + ".tmp";
        File.WriteAllBytes(temp, ReadAll(e.Path));
        File.Move(temp, dest);
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The bytes in a game-owned array, for natives that take array&lt;byte&gt;. The constructor allocates with the
    /// game's allocator; the data is copied straight in and the count set in the header (data, count, capacity),
    /// as Push would do one element at a time for 2.4 MB.
    /// </summary>
    public static TArray<byte> ToGameArray(byte[] data)
    {
        var arr = new TArray<byte>(data.Length);
        try
        {
            nint dst = Marshal.ReadIntPtr(arr.Ptr);
            if (arr.Capacity >= data.Length && dst != 0)
            {
                Marshal.Copy(data, 0, dst, data.Length);
                Marshal.WriteInt32(arr.Ptr + 8, data.Length);
            }
            else
            {
                arr.Push(data);
            }

            if (arr.Count != data.Length)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the save didn't fit in the game's buffer");
            return arr;
        }
        catch
        {
            arr.Dispose();
            throw;
        }
    }
}

```

`scripts/Modules/Saves/Saves.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// SYSTEM > SAVES: browse every save on disk (the slot's three rotating files, the game's hidden backups and
/// Oracle's kept copies), load any of them in game, and keep copies the game will never rotate away.
///
/// Loading works the way the game's own slot screen does it: the file's bytes go to
/// RPlayerController.SetupActiveSave(slot, file number, data), which makes them the active save, and the pause
/// menu's restart (RGameInfo.Game_Restart, a "LoadGame" console command) then loads the active save.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Saves : Module
{
    public static readonly Saves I = new();

    private const string SlotKey = "SaveSlot";
    private const float KeepWait = 30f;
    private const float KeepPoll = 0.5f;
    private static readonly CultureInfo Inv = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

    private const string PickHelp = "Every save Oracle can find, newest first. Hold left or right to scroll. Details of the selected save show here.";

    private Choice _show = null!;
    private Choice _story = null!;
    private int _listStory;
    private Choice _pick = null!;
    private List<SaveFiles.Entry> _all = new();
    private List<SaveFiles.Entry> _shown = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, string> _places = new();
    private Dictionary<string, string>? _placeNames;
    private bool _slotLogged;

    // SAVE NOW AND KEEP A COPY: waiting for the autosave to land on disk.
    private float _keepLeft;
    private float _keepPoll;
    private DateTime _keepAfterUtc;
    private long _keepSize = -1;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _show = AddChoice("save_show", "SHOW", "THIS SLOT lists the slot you're playing (or last played), SLOT 1, SLOT 2... list one slot each, ALL SLOTS lists every slot and KEPT COPIES only the copies Oracle has kept.",
            new[] { "slot", "all", "kept" }, new[] { "THIS SLOT", "ALL SLOTS", "KEPT COPIES" }, _ => Filter()).Setting();
        _story = AddChoice("save_story", "STORY",
            "Every save holds the main story and any New Game + run, as the main menu's CONTINUE STORY and CONTINUE STORY+ show. This picks which one LOAD THIS SAVE resumes. CURRENT keeps the one you're playing; NEW GAME + lists only saves that have a New Game + run.",
            new[] { "current", "main", "plus" }, new[] { "CURRENT", "MAIN STORY", "NEW GAME +" }, _ => Filter()).Setting();
        _pick = AddChoice("save_pick", "SAVE", PickHelp, new[] { "" }, new[] { "OPEN THE MENU TO LIST" }, _ => Describe()).Setting().Unsaved();
        _pick.HoldToScroll = true;
        AddCommand("save_refresh", "REFRESH LIST", "Reads the save folders again. The list also refreshes every time the menu opens.", Refresh).Setting();

        Command load = AddCommand("save_load", "LOAD THIS SAVE",
            "Restarts from the selected save, as the pause menu restarts from a checkpoint. The save you're leaving is kept first, so nothing is lost. The game carries on saving into the save's slot.",
            Load).Setting().Confirmed();
        load.ConfirmPrompt = () => Selected is { } e ? "LOAD " + Short(e) + (TargetStory() == PlusStory ? " IN NEW GAME +" : "") + "?" : "LOAD THIS SAVE?";
        AddCommand("save_keep", "KEEP A COPY", "Copies the selected save into Oracle's saves folder. The game never rotates or deletes those, so it stays loadable for good.", KeepSelected).Setting();
        Command delete = AddCommand("save_delete", "DELETE KEPT COPY", "Deletes the selected save if it's one of Oracle's kept copies. The game's own files and backups are never deleted.", DeleteSelected)
            .Setting().Confirmed();
        delete.ConfirmPrompt = () => Selected is { } e ? "DELETE KEPT " + Short(e) + "?" : "DELETE KEPT COPY?";

        AddCommand("save_now_keep", "SAVE NOW AND KEEP A COPY",
            "Autosaves right now, then keeps a copy of that save once the game has written it: a save you can always come back to. Batman reloads at the nearest start point.",
            SaveAndKeep);
        AddCommand("save_restart", "RESTART FROM CHECKPOINT", "Reloads the last save, as the pause menu's restart does. Handy on a hotkey.", Restart);

        AddCommand("save_open_kept", "OPEN KEPT COPIES FOLDER", "Opens Oracle's saves folder in Windows Explorer.", () => OpenFolder(SaveFiles.KeptDir)).Setting();
        AddCommand("save_open_backups", "OPEN GAME BACKUPS FOLDER", "Opens the folder where the game backs up each save, in Documents\\WB Games.", () => OpenFolder(SaveFiles.BackupDir)).Setting();
    }

    public override void Started() => Safe.Run("save folders", SaveFiles.Locate);

    public override void MenuOpening() => Refresh();

    public override void WorldChanged() => _slotLogged = false;

    // Quitting or loading abandons any autosave still being waited on, so stop waiting rather than report a failure later.
    public override void LeftGame() => _keepLeft = 0f;

    /// <summary>True while SAVE NOW AND KEEP A COPY waits for its autosave to land.</summary>
    public bool Saving => _keepLeft > 0f;

    private SaveFiles.Entry? Selected
    {
        get
        {
            string key = _pick.CurrentKey;
            return key.Length == 0 ? null : _shown.Find(e => e.Path == key);
        }
    }

    // ---- the list

    private void Refresh()
    {
        _all = SaveFiles.Scan();
        ShowOptions();
        Filter();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// THIS SLOT, then one option per slot that has a save ("slot1" is the game's slot 0), then ALL SLOTS and
    /// KEPT COPIES. A saved pick of a slot with no files falls back to THIS SLOT but is kept for when it returns.
    /// </summary>
    private void ShowOptions()
    {
        int active = ActiveSlot();
        var keys = new List<string> { "slot" };
        var labels = new List<string> { active >= 0 ? "THIS SLOT (" + (active + 1) + ")" : "THIS SLOT" };
        foreach (int slot in _all.Select(e => e.Slot).Distinct().Order())
        {
            // The slot's newest save gives its completion, as the game's slot screen shows it.
            SaveFiles.Entry newest = _all.Find(e => e.Slot == slot)!;
            keys.Add("slot" + (slot + 1));
            labels.Add("SLOT " + (slot + 1) + (newest.Percent >= 0 ? ", " + newest.Percent + "%" : ""));
        }

        keys.Add("all");
        labels.Add("ALL SLOTS");
        keys.Add("kept");
        labels.Add("KEPT COPIES");
        _show.SetOptions(keys.ToArray(), labels.ToArray());

        int current = CurrentStory();
        string now = current == PlusStory ? "CURRENT (NEW GAME +)" : current == MainStory ? "CURRENT (MAIN STORY)" : "CURRENT";
        _story.SetOptions(_story.Keys, new[] { now, "MAIN STORY", "NEW GAME +" }, _story.Index);
    }

    // RSaveGameManager.StorySlots: the main story is 0, New Game + is 2 (3 to 8 are the Arkham Episodes).
    private const int MainStory = 0;
    private const int PlusStory = 2;

    /// <summary>The story being played, or -1 outside a game.</summary>
    private static int CurrentStory()
    {
        int id = -1;
        Safe.Run("story slot", () =>
        {
            if (World.InGame && World.Ri?.SaveGameManager is { IsValid: true } sgm)
                id = (int)sgm.GetActiveStorySlotID();
        });
        return id;
    }

    /// <summary>The story a load resumes: the STORY pick, or the one being played.</summary>
    private int TargetStory() => _story.CurrentKey switch
    {
        "main" => MainStory,
        "plus" => PlusStory,
        _ => CurrentStory(),
    };

    private void Filter()
    {
        string show = _show.CurrentKey;
        int slot = show == "slot" ? ActiveSlot() : show.StartsWith("slot", StringComparison.Ordinal) && int.TryParse(show.AsSpan(4), out int n) ? n - 1 : -1;
        _shown = show switch
        {
            "kept" => _all.FindAll(e => e.Kind == SaveFiles.Kind.Kept),
            _ when slot >= 0 => _all.FindAll(e => e.Slot == slot),
            _ => new List<SaveFiles.Entry>(_all),
        };

        _listStory = TargetStory();
        if (_listStory == PlusStory)
            _shown.RemoveAll(e => !e.HasPlus);

        string was = _pick.CurrentKey;
        if (_shown.Count == 0)
        {
            _pick.SetOptions(new[] { "" }, new[] { _listStory == PlusStory ? "NO SAVES WITH NEW GAME +" : _show.CurrentKey == "kept" ? "NO KEPT COPIES YET" : "NO SAVES FOUND" });
        }
        else
        {
            _pick.Saved = was;
            _pick.SetOptions(_shown.Select(e => e.Path).ToArray(), _shown.Select(Label).ToArray());
        }

        Describe();
    }

    /// <summary>"5 NOV 20:08, SLOT 1, 87%, LATEST": when first, so the list reads as a timeline.</summary>
    private string Label(SaveFiles.Entry e)
    {
        string text = Date(e.When) + ", SLOT " + (e.Slot + 1);
        if (_listStory == PlusStory)
            text += ", NG+ " + (int)e.StoryPlus + "%";
        else if (e.Percent >= 0)
            text += ", " + e.Percent + "%";
        return text + ", " + Tag(e);
    }

    private string Tag(SaveFiles.Entry e) => e.Kind switch
    {
        SaveFiles.Kind.Kept => "KEPT",
        SaveFiles.Kind.Backup => "BACKUP",
        _ => IsLatest(e) ? "LATEST" : "OLDER",
    };

    private bool IsLatest(SaveFiles.Entry e) =>
        e.Kind == SaveFiles.Kind.Current && !_all.Exists(o => o.Kind == SaveFiles.Kind.Current && o.Slot == e.Slot && o.When > e.When);

    private static string Date(DateTime t) =>
        t.ToString(t.Year == DateTime.Now.Year ? "d MMM HH:mm" : "d MMM yyyy HH:mm", Inv).ToUpperInvariant();

    private static string Short(SaveFiles.Entry e) => "SLOT " + (e.Slot + 1) + " FROM " + Date(e.When);

    /// <summary>Puts the selected save's details in the row's help, which the menu shows under the list.</summary>
    private void Describe()
    {
        if (Selected is not { } e)
        {
            _pick.Help = PickHelp;
            return;
        }

        if (!e.Valid)
        {
            _pick.Help = "This file isn't a save this version of the game can read, so it can't be loaded.";
            return;
        }

        var what = new List<string> { e.When.ToString("dddd d MMMM yyyy, HH:mm:ss", Inv) };
        string place = PlaceName(e.LocationId);
        if (place.Length > 0)
            what.Add(place);
        if (e.Difficulty.Length > 0)
            what.Add(e.Difficulty.ToUpperInvariant());
        if (e.Percent >= 0)
            what.Add(e.Percent + "% COMPLETE");
        if (e.HasPlus)
            what.Add("NEW GAME + " + (int)e.StoryPlus + "%");

        string origin = e.Kind switch
        {
            SaveFiles.Kind.Kept => "A copy Oracle kept. ",
            SaveFiles.Kind.Backup => "A backup the game made of file " + (e.XId + 1) + ". ",
            _ => IsLatest(e) ? "The slot's newest file: loading it is the same as restarting from the checkpoint. " : "One of the three files the game rotates through, older than the slot's newest. ",
        };

        _pick.Help = "SLOT " + (e.Slot + 1) + ", saved " + string.Join(", ", what) + ". " + origin + "Hold left or right to scroll.";
    }

    /// <summary>The location the game's slot screen shows, through its own id table and the GFxUI [Map] text.</summary>
    private string PlaceName(int id)
    {
        if (id < 0)
            return "";
        if (_places.TryGetValue(id, out string? known))
            return known;

        string name = "";
        Safe.Run("save location", () =>
        {
            RSaveGameManager? sgm = World.Ri?.SaveGameManager;
            if (sgm is not { IsValid: true })
                return;

            string key = sgm.GetStringForLocationID(id).ToString() ?? "";
            if (key.Length == 0)
                return;

            _placeNames ??= MapPlaces.Names(Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(App.Dir, "..", "..", "Localization", "INT", "GFxUI.int")), "Map");
            name = _placeNames.TryGetValue(key, out string? text) ? text : key.ToUpperInvariant();
            _places[id] = name;
        });
        return name;
    }

    // ---- which slot is in play

    /// <summary>
    /// The slot being played. The live options carry the loaded save's timestamp (the slot screen reads it from
    /// there), so the file with the same stamp is the one in play. Otherwise the slot Oracle last loaded, otherwise
    /// the slot with the newest file. -1 when there are no saves.
    /// </summary>
    private int ActiveSlot()
    {
        long live = 0;
        Safe.Run("save stamp", () =>
        {
            if (World.InGame && World.Ri?.PersistentOptions is { IsValid: true } po)
                live = (long)po.TimeStamp.Uid;
        });

        SaveFiles.Entry? match = live != 0 ? _all.Find(e => e.Stamp == live) : null;
        if (match != null)
        {
            Shared.Set(SlotKey, match.Slot);
            LogMatch(match);
            return match.Slot;
        }

        if (World.InGame && !_slotLogged && _all.Count > 0)
        {
            _slotLogged = true;
            Safe.Run("save check", () =>
            {
                RPersistentOptions? po = World.Ri?.PersistentOptions;
                Log.Detail("Saves: no file matches the game's save stamp " + live + (live != 0 ? " (" + DateTime.FromFileTimeUtc(live).ToLocalTime().ToString("u", Inv) + ")" : "")
                    + "; options " + (po is { IsValid: true } ? po.PercentageCompleted + "%, location " + po.LocationID + ", " + po.Day + "/" + po.Month + "/" + po.Year : "unavailable")
                    + ". Newest file: " + Path.GetFileName(_all[0].Path) + " stamp " + _all[0].Stamp + ".");
            });
        }

        int remembered = Shared.GetValue(SlotKey, -1);
        if (remembered >= 0)
            return remembered;

        return _all.Find(e => e.Kind == SaveFiles.Kind.Current)?.Slot ?? -1;
    }

    // Once per world: checks the header reading against what the game itself holds for the loaded save.
    private void LogMatch(SaveFiles.Entry e)
    {
        if (_slotLogged)
            return;
        _slotLogged = true;

        Safe.Run("save check", () =>
        {
            if (World.Ri?.PersistentOptions is not { IsValid: true } po)
                return;
            Log.Detail("Saves: playing slot " + (e.Slot + 1) + " (" + Path.GetFileName(e.Path) + "). File says " + e.Percent + "%, location " + e.LocationId + ", " + e.Difficulty
                + "; the game says " + po.PercentageCompleted + "%, location " + po.LocationID + ", " + po.DifficultyString + ".");
        });
    }

    // ---- commands

    private void Load()
    {
        SaveFiles.Entry e = Selected ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("pick a save first");
        if (!e.Valid)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("that file isn't a readable save");
        if (!World.InGame)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("load into the game first, then pick the save");

        RPlayerController pc = World.Pc ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        RGameInfo game = World.Info ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        if (game.GetIsSaveInProgress() || Saving)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is saving, try again in a moment");
        if (Characters.I.PlayingOther || Characters.I.Busy)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("switch back to Batman first");

        int story = TargetStory(), now = CurrentStory();
        if (story == PlusStory && !e.HasPlus)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("this save has no New Game + run");
        RSaveGameManager sgm = World.Ri?.SaveGameManager is { IsValid: true } m ? m : throw new InvalidOperationException("the save system isn't ready");

        byte[] data = SaveFiles.ReadAll(e.Path);
        KeepCurrentSlot("before loading");

        TArray<byte> arr = SaveFiles.ToGameArray(data);
        try
        {
            pc.SetupActiveSave(e.Slot, e.XId, arr);
        }
        finally
        {
            arr.Dispose();
        }

        // Switching story is what the main menu's CONTINUE STORY / CONTINUE STORY+ do before loading
        // (RGFxMovieUI_MainMenu.GotoContinue2 / GotoContinuePlus2): pick the story slot, then unpack the save for it.
        // Staying in the same story keeps the plain path, which works as it is.
        if (story >= 0 && story != now)
        {
            sgm.SetActiveStorySlotID((RSaveGameManager.StorySlots)story);
            sgm.DecompressSavedGame(false);
        }

        Shared.Set(SlotKey, e.Slot);
        Log.Info("Saves: loading " + e.Path + " (" + data.Length + " bytes) as slot " + (e.Slot + 1) + " file " + (e.XId + 1) + ", story " + story + (story != now ? " (was " + now + ")" : "")
            + ", saved " + e.When.ToString("u", Inv) + ".");
        Menu.Close();
        game.Game_Restart();
    }

    /// <summary>Keeps the newest file of the slot being left, so loading an older save can't cost any progress.</summary>
    /// <summary>
    /// Keeps the newest file of the slot in play, so a load or a New Game + start can't cost any progress. Reads
    /// the folders first, since the list is only filled when the menu opens. Never throws.
    /// </summary>
    public void KeepCurrentSlot(string why)
    {
        Safe.Run("keep " + why, () =>
        {
            _all = SaveFiles.Scan();
            int slot = ActiveSlot();
            SaveFiles.Entry? newest = _all.Find(o => o.Kind == SaveFiles.Kind.Current && o.Slot == slot && o.Valid);
            if (newest != null && SaveFiles.Keep(newest, out string dest))
                Log.Info("Saves: kept " + dest + " " + why + ".");
        });
    }

    private void KeepSelected()
    {
        SaveFiles.Entry e = Selected ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("pick a save first");
        if (e.Kind == SaveFiles.Kind.Kept)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("that save is already a kept copy");

        bool made = SaveFiles.Keep(e, out string dest);
        Log.Info("Saves: " + (made ? "kept " : "already kept ") + dest + ".");
        Overlay.Notice("KEEP A COPY", made ? "KEPT " + Short(e) : "ALREADY KEPT", true);
        Refresh();
    }

    private void DeleteSelected()
    {
        SaveFiles.Entry e = Selected ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("pick a save first");
        if (e.Kind != SaveFiles.Kind.Kept)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("only Oracle's kept copies can be deleted here");

        File.Delete(e.Path);
        Log.Info("Saves: deleted " + e.Path + ".");
        Refresh();
    }

    private static void Restart()
    {
        RGameInfo game = World.Info ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("load into the game first");
        if (game.GetIsSaveInProgress() || I.Saving)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is saving, try again in a moment");
        Menu.Close();
        game.Game_Restart();
    }

    private void SaveAndKeep()
    {
        if (_keepLeft > 0f)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("still waiting for the last save");
        if (SaveFiles.RemoteDir.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the game's save folder wasn't found");

        RGameInfo game = World.Info ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("load into the game first");
        if (game.GetIsSaveInProgress())
            throw new InvalidOperationException("a save is already in progress");

        // File times are only as fine as the file system's, so allow a second's slack.
        _keepAfterUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(-1);
        _keepLeft = KeepWait;
        _keepPoll = KeepPoll;
        _keepSize = -1;
        World.RequireCheats().AutoSaveGame();
        Log.Info("Saves: autosaving, a copy is kept once it's written.");
    }

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (_keepLeft <= 0f)
            return;

        _keepLeft -= dt;
        _keepPoll -= dt;
        if (_keepPoll > 0f && _keepLeft > 0f)
            return;
        _keepPoll = KeepPoll;

        FileInfo? written = NewWrite();
        if (written != null && World.Info is { } game && !game.GetIsSaveInProgress())
        {
            // Copy only once the size holds still across two polls, so a file mid-write isn't kept.
            if (written.Length == _keepSize)
            {
                _keepLeft = 0f;
                Refresh();
                SaveFiles.Entry? e = _all.Find(o => o.Path.Equals(written.FullName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                if (e is { Valid: true } && SaveFiles.Keep(e, out string dest))
                {
                    Log.Info("Saves: kept " + dest + ".");
                    Overlay.Notice("SAVE NOW AND KEEP A COPY", "KEPT " + Short(e), true);
                    Refresh();
                }
                else
                {
                    Overlay.Notice("SAVE NOW AND KEEP A COPY", "SAVED, BUT THE COPY FAILED", false);
                }

                return;
            }

            _keepSize = written.Length;
        }

        if (_keepLeft <= 0f)
        {
            Log.Info("Saves: no save was written within " + KeepWait + " s, nothing kept.");
            Overlay.Notice("SAVE NOW AND KEEP A COPY", "THE GAME DIDN'T SAVE", false);
        }
    }

    private FileInfo? NewWrite()
    {
        try
        {
            return new DirectoryInfo(SaveFiles.RemoteDir).EnumerateFiles("BAK1Save*.sgd")
                .Where(f => f.LastWriteTimeUtc >= _keepAfterUtc)
                .OrderByDescending(f => f.LastWriteTimeUtc)
                .FirstOrDefault();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled("save watch", "Saves: could not read the save folder: " + ex.Message);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void OpenFolder(string dir)
    {
        if (dir.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("folder not found");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
        System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo("explorer.exe", "\"" + dir + "\"") { UseShellExecute = true });
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Showcase.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using Stopwatch = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>The game's Showcase: the unlockable skins both skin pickers list, named and gated the way it does.</summary>
internal static class Showcase
{
    private const string PlayablePrefix = "Playable_";

    /// <summary>A skin name without its "Playable_" prefix: "Playable_Batman_Std" and "Batman_Std" are the same skin.</summary>
    public static string Unprefixed(string? skin)
    {
        skin ??= "";
        return skin.StartsWith(PlayablePrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? skin.Substring(PlayablePrefix.Length) : skin;
    }

    /// <summary>Same rule as RGameInfo.ShowcaseGetTotalCollected.</summary>
    public static bool IsUnlocked(RPersistentOptions options, RGameInfo.FShowcaseItem item, string key)
    {
        if (item.Unlocked)
            return true;

        string prerequisite = item.Prerequisite.ToString() ?? "";
        return options.IsOptionsFlagSet(new FString(prerequisite.Length == 0 ? "Showcase_" + key + "_Unlocked" : prerequisite));
    }

    /// <summary>An item's name as the Showcase shows it, or one made from its skin when the game has none.</summary>
    public static string Label(string key, string skin)
    {
        string label = GameObject.GetLocalisedString(new FString("GFxUI"), new FString("Showcase"), new FString(key), false).ToString() ?? "";
        if (label.Length == 0 || label.StartsWith('?'))
            label = Unprefixed(skin).Replace('_', ' ');
        return label.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    /// <summary>Reads one of RGameRI's loaded-player slots, which throws while nothing is loaded there.</summary>
    public static bool TryRead<T>(Func<T> read, out T value)
    {
        try
        {
            value = read();
            return true;
        }
        catch
        {
            value = default!;
            return false;
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// A skin change that waits on the game: the pick is saved at once, then put on over the following ticks. The suit
/// and Batmobile skin pickers share this and differ only in what they wait for.
/// </summary>
internal abstract class SkinSwap : Module
{
    private const double LoadTimeout = 20.0;

    protected readonly Stopwatch Timer = new();
    protected string Pending = "";

    /// <summary>Title of its notices, like "SUIT".</summary>
    protected abstract string Title { get; }

    /// <summary>Start of its log lines, like "Suit".</summary>
    protected abstract string LogName { get; }

    /// <summary>Added to the cancel log line, to say whether the pick is still saved.</summary>
    protected virtual string CancelNote => "";

    /// <summary>True while a change is waiting or loading.</summary>
    protected abstract bool Busy { get; }

    protected bool TimedOut => Timer.Elapsed.TotalSeconds > LoadTimeout;

    /// <summary>Fills the picker with what this save has unlocked.</summary>
    protected abstract void RefreshChoices(RGameInfo info, RGameRI game, RPersistentOptions options);

    /// <summary>Moves a waiting change on by one tick.</summary>
    protected abstract void Step();

    public override void WorldChanged() => Reset();

    public override void Shutdown() => Reset();

    public override void MenuOpening()
    {
        if (World.InGame && World.Info is { } info && World.Ri is { PersistentOptions: { IsValid: true } options } game)
            RefreshChoices(info, game, options);
    }

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (!Busy)
            return;

        try
        {
            Step();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // A throwing tick would repeat every frame, so fail the change once instead.
            Fail("unexpected error: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    protected void Notice(string state, bool ok = true) => Overlay.Notice(Title, state, ok);

    protected void Note(string text) => Log.Info(LogName + ": " + text);

    protected void CancelPending()
    {
        if (!Busy)
        {
            Notice("NOTHING PENDING");
            return;
        }

        Note("change to " + Pending + " cancelled" + CancelNote + ".");
        Reset();
        Notice("CHANGE CANCELLED");
    }

    protected void Fail(string reason)
    {
        Note(reason + ".");
        Reset();
        Notice("CHANGE FAILED - SEE LOG", false);
    }

    protected virtual void Reset()
    {
        Pending = "";
        Timer.Stop();
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Teleport/Districts.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The city's streaming districts, read from the game's own district volumes, which are always loaded. The
/// flight asks which district a point is in to enter each one as it crosses the line, and the DISTRICT page
/// lists them with their bounds.
/// </summary>
internal static class Districts
{
    public readonly record struct Cell(string Name, Vector3 Min, Vector3 Max);

    private const double RefreshSeconds = 2.0;

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, Cell> _all = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private static readonly List<RLevelVolumeOW> _volumes = new();
    private static Every _refresh;

    /// <summary>Every city district by name, with the bounds of its volume.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Cell> All
    {
        get
        {
            Refresh();
            return _all;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The district volume a point is inside, by the game's own priority, or null outside the city.</summary>
    public static string? At(Vector3 point)
    {
        Refresh();
        RLevelVolumeOW? best = null;
        foreach (RLevelVolumeOW v in _volumes)
        {
            if (v is { IsValid: true } && v.EncompassesPoint(point) && (best == null || v.Priority > best.Priority))
                best = v;
        }

        return best?.Level.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>The volume of a named district, if the game has one loaded.</summary>
    public static RLevelVolumeOW? Volume(string level)
    {
        Refresh();
        foreach (RLevelVolumeOW v in _volumes)
        {
            if (v is { IsValid: true } && v.Level.ToString().Equals(level, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return v;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>A new world is loading: every volume is about to go stale.</summary>
    public static void Forget()
    {
        _all.Clear();
        _volumes.Clear();
        _refresh.Force();
    }

    private static void Refresh()
    {
        if (!_refresh.Elapsed(RefreshSeconds))
            return;

        try
        {
            _volumes.Clear();
            foreach (RLevelVolumeOW v in World.All<RLevelVolumeOW>())
            {
                string name = v.Level.ToString();
                if (name.Length == 0 || name == "None" || !name.StartsWith("City", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;

                _volumes.Add(v);
                if (_all.ContainsKey(name))
                    continue;

                v.GetComponentsBoundingBox(out GameObject.FBox box);
                if (box.IsValid != 0)
                    _all[name] = new Cell(name, box.Min, box.Max);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled("districts", "Districts: couldn't read the city's volumes: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Teleport/MapPlaces.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Every place on the game's world map. BmGame.ini lists them all in world coordinates, and the game's
/// localization files name them, so this works from the first load with nothing to discover.
/// </summary>
internal static class MapPlaces
{
    public sealed record Place(string Key, string Label, Vector3 At, bool Surface);

    /// <summary>One category. With a Word, entries are numbered ("MIAGANI TROPHY 12"); without one they use the game's name.</summary>
    public sealed record Group(string Key, string Label, string? Word, bool Surface, params string[] Types)
    {
        public List<Place> Items { get; } = new();
    }

    private const string MostWantedType = "MostWanted";
    private const string RadiusSuffix = "Radius";
    private const string FrontendSection = "LevelDesc";
    private const string UnusedText = "ENTER BUG";

    private static readonly string[] CityMaps = { "Batentry", "Cityx", "Cityy", "Cityz" };

    private static readonly Regex Row = new(
        @"^\s*\.?MapElementItemList=\(MapName=""([^""]*)"", ItemType=""([^""]*)"", ItemName=""([^""]*)"", X=(-?\d+), Y=(-?\d+), Z=(-?\d+)",
        RegexOptions.Multiline);

    private static readonly Regex Number = new(@"\d+$");

    public static readonly List<Group> Groups = new()
    {
        new("landmarks", "LANDMARKS", null, true, "LabelTextBigArea", "LabelTextArea", "LabelTextFeature1", "BuildingMarker"),
        new("trophies", "RIDDLER TROPHIES", "TROPHY", false, "RiddlerPickup"),
        new("breakables", "RIDDLER BREAKABLES", "BREAKABLE", false, "RiddlerBreakable"),
        new("riddles", "RIDDLES", "RIDDLE", false, "RiddlerCameo"),
        new("bombs", "RIDDLER BOMBS", "BOMB", false, "RiddlerBomb"),
        new("races", "RIDDLER RACES", "RACE", false, "NigmaRace"),
        new("ar", "AR CHALLENGES", "AR CHALLENGE", false, "ARChallenge"),
        new("most_wanted", "MOST WANTED", null, false),
    };

    private static bool _loaded;

    public static void Ensure()
    {
        if (_loaded)
            return;

        _loaded = true;
        try
        {
            string game = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(App.Dir, "..", ".."));
            string localization = Path.Combine(game, "Localization", "INT");
            Dictionary<string, string> frontend = Names(Path.Combine(localization, "FRONTEND.int"), FrontendSection);
            Dictionary<string, string> interfaceText = Names(Path.Combine(localization, "GFxUI.int"), null);
            Read(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(game, "Config", "BmGame.ini")), frontend, interfaceText);
            Log.Info("Teleport: map places: " + string.Join(", ", Groups.Select(g => g.Label + " " + g.Items.Count)) + ".");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Could not read the map places: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Every Riddler item on any map, interiors included, as listed: repeats are possible.</summary>
    public static List<(string Type, string Key)> RiddlerRows()
    {
        string ini = File.ReadAllText(Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(App.Dir, "..", "..", "Config", "BmGame.ini")));
        return Row.Matches(ini)
            .Where(m => m.Groups[2].Value.StartsWith("Riddler", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .Select(m => (m.Groups[2].Value, m.Groups[3].Value))
            .ToList();
    }

    private static void Read(string ini, Dictionary<string, string> frontend, Dictionary<string, string> interfaceText)
    {
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (Match m in Row.Matches(ini))
        {
            string map = m.Groups[1].Value;
            string type = m.Groups[2].Value;
            string key = m.Groups[3].Value;
            if (!Array.Exists(CityMaps, c => c.Equals(map, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) || key.EndsWith(RadiusSuffix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                continue;

            Group? group = GroupOf(type);
            if (group == null || !seen.Add(key))
                continue;

            string label = group.Word != null ? Numbered(group.Word, key) : Named(key, frontend, interfaceText);
            group.Items.Add(new Place(key, label, new Vector3(int.Parse(m.Groups[4].Value), int.Parse(m.Groups[5].Value), int.Parse(m.Groups[6].Value)), group.Surface));
        }

        foreach (Group group in Groups)
            Finish(group);
    }

    private static Group? GroupOf(string type)
    {
        foreach (Group group in Groups)
        {
            if (Array.IndexOf(group.Types, type) >= 0)
                return group;
        }

        // Plain "MostWanted" is only Riot_Tutorial, which has no real place behind it.
        return type.StartsWith(MostWantedType, StringComparison.Ordinal) && type != MostWantedType ? Groups[^1] : null;
    }

    private static string Island(string key)
    {
        if (key.StartsWith("CityX", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "MIAGANI ";
        if (key.StartsWith("CityY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            return "FOUNDERS ";
        return key.StartsWith("CityZ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "BLEAKE " : "";
    }

    private static string Numbered(string word, string key) => Island(key) + word + " " + key.Substring(key.LastIndexOf('_') + 1).ToUpperInvariant();

    private static string Named(string key, Dictionary<string, string> frontend, Dictionary<string, string> interfaceText)
    {
        if (frontend.TryGetValue(key, out string? name) || interfaceText.TryGetValue(key, out name))
            return name;

        return key.Replace("SS_", "", StringComparison.Ordinal).Replace('_', ' ').ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    /// <summary>Sorts a category by name then number, and numbers any names the game uses more than once.</summary>
    private static void Finish(Group group)
    {
        List<Place> sorted = group.Items
            .OrderBy(p => Number.Replace(p.Label, ""), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ThenBy(p => int.TryParse(Number.Match(p.Label).Value, out int n) ? n : 0)
            .ToList();

        var counts = sorted.GroupBy(p => p.Label).Where(g => g.Count() > 1).ToDictionary(g => g.Key, _ => 0);
        group.Items.Clear();
        foreach (Place place in sorted)
        {
            if (!counts.TryGetValue(place.Label, out int used))
            {
                group.Items.Add(place);
                continue;
            }

            counts[place.Label] = used + 1;
            group.Items.Add(place with { Label = place.Label + " " + (used + 1) });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Reads key=value text from a localization file, from one section or from all of them.</summary>
    internal static Dictionary<string, string> Names(string path, string? section)
    {
        var names = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        string current = "";
        foreach (string line in File.ReadAllLines(path))
        {
            if (line.StartsWith('['))
            {
                current = line.Trim().Trim('[', ']');
                continue;
            }

            int gap = line.IndexOf('=');
            if (gap <= 0 || (section != null && current != section))
                continue;

            string text = line.Substring(gap + 1).Trim().Trim('"').Replace('’', '\'').ToUpperInvariant();
            if (text.Length > 0 && !text.Contains(UnusedText, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                names.TryAdd(line.Substring(0, gap).Trim(), text);
        }

        return names;
    }

    /// <summary>The closest landmark, or null when none is within range.</summary>
    public static string? Near(Vector3 at, float range)
    {
        Ensure();
        return Closest(Groups[0], at, range)?.Label;
    }

    /// <summary>The closest place in a category, or null when none is within range.</summary>
    public static Place? Closest(Group group, Vector3 at, float range = float.MaxValue)
    {
        Place? best = null;
        float bestDistance = range == float.MaxValue ? range : range * range;
        foreach (Place place in group.Items)
        {
            float distance = Geo.DistXYSq(place.At, at);
            if (distance < bestDistance)
            {
                bestDistance = distance;
                best = place;
            }
        }

        return best;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/Teleport/SavedSpots.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>The player's saved locations, kept in their own file because settings.toml only holds feature values.</summary>
internal static class SavedSpots
{
    public const int Slots = 8;

    public sealed record Entry(string Map, Vector3 At, float Yaw, string Name);

    private const string FileName = "saved_spots.txt";
    private const char Gap = '|';

    private static readonly Entry?[] _entries = new Entry?[Slots];

    private static string SavePath => Path.Combine(App.Dir, FileName);

    public static Entry? Get(int slot) => _entries[slot];

    public static void Set(int slot, Entry? entry)
    {
        _entries[slot] = entry;
        Save();
    }

    public static void Load()
    {
        try
        {
            if (!File.Exists(SavePath))
                return;

            foreach (string line in File.ReadAllLines(SavePath))
            {
                string[] p = line.Split(Gap);
                if (p.Length != 7 || !int.TryParse(p[0], out int slot) || slot < 0 || slot >= Slots)
                    continue;

                float F(int i) => float.Parse(p[i], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                _entries[slot] = new Entry(p[1], new Vector3(F(2), F(3), F(4)), F(5), p[6]);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Could not read " + FileName + ": " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private static void Save()
    {
        try
        {
            var lines = new List<string>();
            for (int i = 0; i < Slots; i++)
            {
                if (_entries[i] is { } e)
                {
                    lines.Add(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{1}{0}{2}{0}{3:0.#}{0}{4:0.#}{0}{5:0.#}{0}{6:0.#}{0}{7}",
                        Gap, i, e.Map, e.At.X, e.At.Y, e.At.Z, e.Yaw, e.Name));
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllLines(SavePath, lines);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Could not write " + FileName + ": " + ex.Message);
        }
    }
}
```
