`scripts/Modules/World/Population.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using EDistrict = BmSDK.BmGame.RGameInfo.EDistrict;
using EThreatType = BmSDK.BmGame.RPopulationManager.EThreatType;
using EVehicleCombatEncounterType = BmSDK.BmGame.RVehicleNPC.EVehicleCombatEncounterType;
using VehicleScenarioType = BmSDK.BmGame.RGameInfo.VehicleScenarioType;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The open-world population: an empty city, the game's own APC, mob and getaway-car spawners, and a readout
/// of the militia still holding your district. Everything goes through RPopulationManager's script entry
/// points; the per-district arrays are left alone because their structs may not match the native layout.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Population : Module
{
    public static readonly Population I = new();

    private const string NoticeTitle = "CITY";
    private const double ReadoutSeconds = 1.0;

    private static readonly (EThreatType Type, string Label)[] Threats =
    {
        (EThreatType.ETHREAT_Watchtower, "WATCHTOWERS"),
        (EThreatType.ETHREAT_CheckPoint, "CHECKPOINTS"),
        (EThreatType.ETHREAT_Beacons, "BEACONS"),
        (EThreatType.ETHREAT_AerialDrone, "AIR DRONES"),
        (EThreatType.ETHREAT_LightDrone, "DRONE TANKS"),
        (EThreatType.ETHREAT_HeavyDrone, "HEAVY TANKS"),
        (EThreatType.ETHREAT_Humvee, "HUMVEES"),
    };

    private readonly Held<RPopulationManager, bool> _disabled = new("population disable", p => p.bForceDisable, (p, v) => p.bForceDisable = v);
    private Toggle _empty = null!;
    private Toggle _readout = null!;
    private nint _clearedIn;
    private Every _refresh;
    private string _island = "";
    private string _cell = "";
    private string _threats = "";
    private string _threats2 = "";

    public override bool HasHud => _readout.On && World.InGame;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _empty = AddToggle("city_empty", "EMPTY STREETS", "Clears the roaming thugs, rioters, militia patrols and drones off the streets and stops new ones arriving, so the city is quiet. Mission enemies and militia bases stay. Switch it off and the city fills up again.",
            on => { if (!on) Release(); }).Maintain(KeepEmpty);

        AddCommand("city_apc", "SPAWN APC", "Sends one of the militia's armoured APCs out into your district, the ones you chase down with the Batmobile, and marks it. Only works once the APC hunt has started in the story.", SpawnApc);
        AddCommand("city_batmobile_mob", "THUG MOB ON BATMOBILE", "A gang of thugs comes out of the streets around the Batmobile and goes for it, as they do when you leave it parked. Use the Batmobile's thug zapper or fight them off.", MobBatmobile);
        AddCommand("city_getaway_car", "SPAWN GETAWAY CAR", "Starts a car chase near you on the roads: police after a fleeing car if the district has one, else a thug car. Chase it down.", SpawnGetaway);

        _readout = AddToggle("city_threats", "SHOW DISTRICT THREATS", "Shows which island you're on and how many watchtowers, checkpoints, drones and tanks the militia still has there.").Pref();
    }

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        _clearedIn = 0;
        _refresh.Force();
    }

    public override void Shutdown() => Safe.Run("population restore", Release);

    private static RPopulationManager? Manager()
    {
        RPopulationManager? pm = World.Info?.PopulationManager;
        return pm is { IsValid: true } ? pm : null;
    }

    private static RPopulationManager RequireManager()
    {
        Transition.RequireIdle();
        if (World.Info is { } gi && gi.IsChallengeMode())
            throw new InvalidOperationException("not in AR challenges");
        return Manager() ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("there's no city population here");
    }

    // ---- empty streets

    private void KeepEmpty()
    {
        if (Manager() is not { } pm)
            return;

        _disabled.Set(pm, true);
        if (_clearedIn == pm.Ptr)
            return;

        // The game's own deferred clear-out: what it does when an AR challenge or Most Wanted mission starts.
        _clearedIn = pm.Ptr;
        pm.bRemovePopulationOnNextTick = true;
        Log.Info("Empty streets: population cleared.");
    }

    private void Release()
    {
        _disabled.Restore();
        _clearedIn = 0;
    }

    // ---- spawns

    /// <summary>
    /// The game's own APC hunt. ForceSpawnAPC gives nothing when the native CanSpawnAPC refuses, and it only picks
    /// a district that still has APCs, so the refusal says which of those it is. This is story state: it isn't forced.
    /// </summary>
    private static void SpawnApc()
    {
        RPopulationManager pm = RequireManager();
        EDistrict where = pm.ForceSpawnAPC();
        if (where != EDistrict.EDISTRICT_None)
        {
            Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, "APC OUT IN " + Island(where), true);
            return;
        }

        // One already out: mark it instead of refusing, the way ForceSpawnAPC itself marks one it finds.
        if (pm.GetCurrentAPC() is { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false } apc)
        {
            Track(apc);
            Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, "AN APC IS ALREADY OUT, MARKED " + (int)(DistanceTo(apc) / 100f) + " M AWAY", true);
            return;
        }

        int left = 0;
        for (int d = 1; d <= 3; d++)
            left += Math.Max(0, pm.GetAPCThreatForDistrictID(d, (EDistrict)d));

        if (!pm.APCSideStoryEnabled())
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the APC hunt isn't open in your story");
        if (left == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the militia has no APCs left");
        throw new InvalidOperationException("the game isn't ready to send the next APC yet");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The mob itself, without TrySpawnBatmobileMob's waiting (it retries until the Batmobile is out of sight, you're
    /// away from it, riots aren't paused and the area is past the gas). 3 or 4 thugs come from street-level ground
    /// 6 to 10 m around the car, taunting and then going for it.
    /// </summary>
    private void MobBatmobile()
    {
        RPopulationManager pm = RequireManager();
        if (_empty.On)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("EMPTY STREETS is on");

        // The live car, found the way the Batmobile page finds it. The first RVehicleBatmobileBase in memory can be the
        // template the game spawns from, at the origin with no street around it: that was every "no street" so far.
        RVehicleBatmobileBase? car = Batmobile.I.Car() is { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false } live ? live : null;
        if (car == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the Batmobile isn't nearby");

        // Each thug gets 10 random tries at a street-level spot 6 to 10 m out, and a narrow street misses most of
        // them, so one call often brings nobody (2026-11-05: "no street" with streets all around). Keep asking until
        // a proper mob has turned up, counting only real thugs (an empty pool adds None).
        // As the game's TrySpawnBatmobileMob does: the car counts as long parked. IsCombatThreat calls a Batmobile
        // that moved in the last 20 s a threat, and threatened thugs retreat from it (they all ran, 2026-11-05).
        car.LastMobileTime = -100f;

        var known = new HashSet<nint>();
        var list = pm.CurrentBatmobileMobThugs;
        for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
        {
            if (list[i] is { IsValid: true } t)
                known.Add(t.Ptr);
        }

        int before = LiveMobThugs(pm);
        int came = 0;
        int tries = 0;
        for (; tries < MobAttempts && came < MobWanted; tries++)
        {
            pm.SpawnBatmobileMob(car);
            came = LiveMobThugs(pm) - before;
        }

        // The game's ForceIntoCombat does this too: they hold their ground even with Batman at the wheel or close by.
        list = pm.CurrentBatmobileMobThugs;
        for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
        {
            if (list[i] is RPawnVillain { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false } thug && !known.Contains(thug.Ptr))
            {
                thug.bIgnoreBatmobileThreat = true;
                if (thug.AIController is { IsValid: true } ai && ai.RiotBrain is { IsValid: true } brain)
                {
                    brain.bRiotWantsToFight = true;
                    brain.bRiotHiding = false;
                    brain.bForcedToFleeByKismet = false;
                }
            }
        }

        Log.Detail("Batmobile mob: " + car.GetPathName(null) + " at " + Fmt.Position(car.Location) + ", " + came + " thugs after " + tries + " tries, "
            + pm.CurrentBatmobileMobThugs.Count + " in the mob list, thug pool " + (pm.ThugPool is { IsValid: true } pool ? pool.InactivePawns.Count + " free" : "missing") + ".");

        if (came <= 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("no free street right around the Batmobile for thugs to come from");

        car.MakeReadyForThugZapper();
        if (World.WorldInfo is { } wi)
            pm.LastBatmobileMobTime = wi.TimeSeconds;
        Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, Fmt.Plural(came, "THUG") + " GOING FOR THE BATMOBILE", true);
    }

    private const int MobAttempts = 8;
    private const int MobWanted = 3;

    private static int LiveMobThugs(RPopulationManager pm)
    {
        var mob = pm.CurrentBatmobileMobThugs;
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < mob.Count; i++)
        {
            if (mob[i] is { IsValid: true, bDeleteMe: false })
                n++;
        }

        return n;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The game's road-aware vehicle spawner first: a cop chase (police after a fleeing car), else a thug car. Both
    /// come from the district's own scenarios on the roads near you. Failing those, the debug chase car straight
    /// ahead, which needs 15 m of clear space in front of you.
    /// </summary>
    private static void SpawnGetaway()
    {
        RPopulationManager pm = RequireManager();
        EVehicleCombatEncounterType encounter = World.Info?.VehicleCombatManager is { IsValid: true } vcm
            ? vcm.GetCurrentEncounterType() : EVehicleCombatEncounterType.EVCE_NoEncounter;

        foreach ((VehicleScenarioType type, string what) in new[] { (VehicleScenarioType.VehicleScenario_CopChase, "COP CHASE"), (VehicleScenarioType.VehicleScenario_Thug, "THUG CAR") })
        {
            var before = new HashSet<nint>(World.All<RVehicleNPC>().Select(v => v.Ptr));
            pm.SpawnVehicleScenario(type, encounter, false);
            var fresh = World.All<RVehicleNPC>().Where(v => !v.bDeleteMe && !before.Contains(v.Ptr)).ToList();
            foreach (RVehicleNPC v in fresh)
                Log.Detail("Getaway: " + what + " brought " + v.Class.Name + " " + v.GetPathName(null) + ", " + (int)(DistanceTo(v) / 100f) + " m away.");

            // The car to chase: an ordinary car among what arrived (the cop chase also brings the police).
            RVehicleCar? car = fresh.OfType<RVehicleCar>().Where(c => c.Wheels.Count <= 4).OrderBy(DistanceTo).FirstOrDefault();
            if (car == null)
                continue;

            Track(car);
            Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, what + " " + (int)(DistanceTo(car) / 100f) + " M AWAY, MARKED", true);
            return;
        }

        RPawnPlayer me = World.Player ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the game is still loading");
        GameObject arch = CarArchetype(me) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("the district has no car to send and none is loaded nearby");
        if (me.SpawnChaseCar(arch) is not { IsValid: true } chase)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("the district has no car to send and there's no room ahead of you");

        Track(chase);
        Overlay.Notice(NoticeTitle, "GETAWAY CAR SPOTTED, MARKED", true);
    }

    private static float DistanceTo(Actor a) => World.Pawn is { } me ? Vector3.Distance(me.Location, a.Location) : 0f;

    /// <summary>
    /// The Batmobile's vehicle tracker on it: the marker and through-wall outline the game puts on an APC. Every
    /// argument is passed, because BmSDK fills a missing one with 0, not the script's default (these mirror
    /// ForceSpawnAPC's call). The signal drops after 60 s out of range.
    /// </summary>
    private static void Track(RVehicle v)
    {
        if (World.Pc?.CurrentForensicsDevice is { IsValid: true } device)
            device.TrackVehicle(v, true, true, 3000f, false, new FString(""), 60f);
    }

    /// <summary>The game's chase car if it has one, else the template of an ordinary car already in the world (not an APC).</summary>
    private static GameObject? CarArchetype(RPawnPlayer me)
    {
        if (me.ChaseVehicleArchetype is { IsValid: true } set)
            return set;

        foreach (RVehicleCar car in World.All<RVehicleCar>())
        {
            if (car.bDeleteMe || car.Wheels.Count > 4)
                continue;
            if (car.ObjectArchetype is RVehicleCar { IsValid: true, IsClassDefaultObject: false } template)
                return template;
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ---- readout

    private static string Island(EDistrict d) => d switch
    {
        EDistrict.EDISTRICT_CityX => "MIAGANI",
        EDistrict.EDISTRICT_CityY => "FOUNDERS",
        EDistrict.EDISTRICT_CityZ => "BLEAKE",
        _ => "GOTHAM",
    };

    private void Refresh()
    {
        if (Manager() is not { } pm || World.Pawn is not { } me)
        {
            _island = "";
            return;
        }

        Vector3 at = me.Location;
        EDistrict d = pm.GetDistrictForLocation(at);
        _island = d == EDistrict.EDISTRICT_None ? "OFF THE MAP" : Island(d) + " ISLAND";
        _cell = Districts.At(at) ?? "";
        if (d == EDistrict.EDISTRICT_None)
        {
            _threats = _threats2 = "";
            return;
        }

        var parts = new List<string>();
        foreach ((EThreatType type, string label) in Threats)
        {
            int n = pm.GetThreatLevel(d, type, false);
            if (n > 0)
                parts.Add(label + " " + n);
        }

        if (parts.Count == 0)
        {
            _threats = "MILITIA CLEARED";
            _threats2 = "";
            return;
        }

        int half = (parts.Count + 1) / 2;
        _threats = string.Join("   ", parts.Take(half));
        _threats2 = string.Join("   ", parts.Skip(half));
    }

    public override void Draw(Canvas c)
    {
        if (_refresh.Elapsed(ReadoutSeconds))
            Safe.Run("district readout", Refresh);
        if (_island.Length == 0)
            return;

        float x = Gfx.S(28f);
        float y = Gfx.S(290f);
        float width = Math.Max(250f, 28f + Math.Max(Gfx.TextW(_threats, 0.6f), Gfx.TextW(_threats2, 0.6f)) / Math.Max(Gfx.Scale, 0.01f));
        float height = _threats2.Length > 0 ? 68f : 50f;
        Gfx.Panel(x, y, Gfx.S(width), Gfx.S(height));
        Gfx.Text(x + Gfx.S(14f), y + Gfx.S(9f), _island + (_cell.Length > 0 ? "  /  " + _cell.ToUpperInvariant() : ""), Theme.Hi, 0.66f);
        Gfx.Text(x + Gfx.S(14f), y + Gfx.S(27f), _threats, Theme.Mid, 0.6f);
        if (_threats2.Length > 0)
            Gfx.Text(x + Gfx.S(14f), y + Gfx.S(45f), _threats2, Theme.Mid, 0.6f);
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/World/PostFx.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using PPSettings = BmSDK.Engine.PostProcessVolume.FPostProcessSettings;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Exposure, bloom, lens effects and fog placement, written into every post process volume and the world's
/// default settings. Atmosphere owns the colour and density fields of the same structs; these are separate
/// fields, so the two never write the same value. Values are written whether or not a volume overrides them:
/// one that doesn't override ignores it, and the world default it falls back to gets the same change.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class PostFx : Module
{
    public static readonly PostFx I = new();

    private const string OriginalsKey = "PostFxFields";
    private const string DefaultSettingsKey = "__WorldDefault__";
    private const double ScanSeconds = 1.0;
    private const float DefaultAperture = 8f;

    private enum F
    {
        Exposure, BloomOn, Bloom, BlurOn, Blur, Grain, DofOn, Focus, Aperture, D1Start, D1End, D2Start, D2End, H1Pos, H2Pos, Count,
    }

    private Slider _exposure = null!;
    private Slider _bloom = null!;
    private Slider _blur = null!;
    private Slider _grain = null!;
    private Slider _focus = null!;
    private Slider _dofBlur = null!;
    private Slider _fogDistance = null!;
    private Slider _fogHeight = null!;
    private Every _scan;
    private bool _dirty;
    private bool _reported;

    // Plain doubles so the originals outlive a hot reload, which would orphan any type of ours.
    private static Dictionary<string, double[]> Originals => Shared.Keep(OriginalsKey, () => new Dictionary<string, double[]>());

    public bool Wanted => !Vanilla;

    private bool Vanilla => _exposure.IsDefault && _bloom.IsDefault && _blur.IsDefault && _grain.IsDefault && _focus.IsDefault && _dofBlur.IsDefault
        && _fogDistance.IsDefault && _fogHeight.IsDefault;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _exposure = Add(AddSlider("fx_exposure", "EXPOSURE", "Brightens or darkens the whole picture, in camera stops.", 0f, -3f, 3f, 0.25f, 1f, Stops));
        _bloom = Add(AddSlider("fx_bloom", "BLOOM", "The glow around neon signs, lamps and bright lights. OFF removes it.", 1f, 0f, 3f, 0.25f, 2f, OffOr(Fmt.Times)));
        _blur = Add(AddSlider("fx_motion_blur", "MOTION BLUR", "The smear when the camera or Batman moves fast. OFF gives a sharp picture.", 1f, 0f, 3f, 0.25f, 0f, OffOr(Fmt.Times)));
        _grain = Add(AddSlider("fx_grain", "FILM GRAIN", "Adds film grain to the picture. GAME leaves the game's own.", 0f, 0f, 1f, 0.05f, 0.4f, v => v <= 0f ? "GAME" : Fmt.Percent(v)));
        _focus = Add(AddSlider("fx_dof_focus", "DEPTH OF FIELD", "Keeps things this far from the camera sharp and blurs what's nearer and further, like a photo lens. OFF leaves the game's own.",
            0f, 0f, 100f, 2f, 10f, v => v <= 0f ? "OFF" : Fmt.Metres(v)));
        _dofBlur = Add(AddSlider("fx_dof_blur", "DEPTH OF FIELD BLUR", "How strongly the depth of field blurs what's out of focus.", 1f, 0.25f, 4f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times));
        _fogDistance = Add(AddSlider("fx_fog_distance", "FOG DISTANCE", "Moves where the fog starts and how far off it thickens. Higher keeps the streets around you clear and pushes the fog to the skyline.",
            1f, 0.25f, 4f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Times));
        _fogHeight = Add(AddSlider("fx_fog_height", "FOG HEIGHT", "Raises or lowers the layer of low fog that hangs over the streets.", 0f, -100f, 100f, 5f, 30f, v => MathF.Abs(v) < 0.01f ? "DEFAULT" : (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + Fmt.Metres(v)));
    }

    private Slider Add(Slider s)
    {
        s.Changed = _ => _dirty = true;
        return s;
    }

    private static Func<float, string> OffOr(Func<float, string> fmt) => v => v <= 0f ? "OFF" : fmt(v);

    private static string Stops(float v) =>
        MathF.Abs(v) < 0.01f ? "DEFAULT" : (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + v.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " STOPS";

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        _dirty = true;
        _reported = false;
        _scan.Force();
    }

    public override void Shutdown() => Safe.Run("post fx restore", () => WriteAll(restore: true));

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        bool vanilla = Vanilla;
        if (vanilla && Originals.Count == 0)
            return;

        if (!_dirty && !_scan.Elapsed(ScanSeconds))
            return;

        _dirty = false;
        WriteAll(restore: vanilla);
    }

    private void WriteAll(bool restore)
    {
        Dictionary<string, double[]> originals = Originals;
        foreach (PostProcessVolume v in World.All<PostProcessVolume>())
            Apply(ref v.Settings, v.GetPathName(null), originals, restore);

        if (World.WorldInfo is { } wi)
            Apply(ref wi.DefaultPostProcessSettings, DefaultSettingsKey, originals, restore);

        if (restore)
            originals.Clear();
    }

    private void Apply(ref PPSettings st, string key, Dictionary<string, double[]> originals, bool restore)
    {
        if (restore)
        {
            if (originals.TryGetValue(key, out double[]? back))
                Write(ref st, back);
            return;
        }

        if (!originals.TryGetValue(key, out double[]? o))
        {
            o = Read(ref st);
            originals[key] = o;
            if (!_reported && key == DefaultSettingsKey)
            {
                _reported = true;
                Log.Info("PostFx: world defaults " + string.Join(", ", Enumerable.Range(0, (int)F.Count).Select(i => (F)i + "=" + o[i].ToString("0.###", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))) + ".");
            }
        }

        double[] n = (double[])o.Clone();
        n[(int)F.Exposure] = o[(int)F.Exposure] + _exposure.Value;

        float bloom = _bloom.Value;
        n[(int)F.BloomOn] = bloom <= 0f ? 0 : o[(int)F.BloomOn];
        n[(int)F.Bloom] = o[(int)F.Bloom] * Math.Max(bloom, 0f);

        float blur = _blur.Value;
        if (blur <= 0f)
        {
            n[(int)F.BlurOn] = 0;
        }
        else if (!_blur.IsDefault)
        {
            n[(int)F.BlurOn] = 1;
            n[(int)F.Blur] = (o[(int)F.Blur] > 0.001 ? o[(int)F.Blur] : 1.0) * blur;
        }

        if (_grain.Value > 0f)
            n[(int)F.Grain] = _grain.Value;

        if (_focus.Value > 0f)
        {
            n[(int)F.DofOn] = 1;
            n[(int)F.Focus] = _focus.Value * 100.0;
        }

        if (!_dofBlur.IsDefault)
            n[(int)F.Aperture] = (o[(int)F.Aperture] > 0.001 ? o[(int)F.Aperture] : DefaultAperture) / _dofBlur.Value;

        float d = _fogDistance.Value;
        foreach (F f in new[] { F.D1Start, F.D1End, F.D2Start, F.D2End })
            n[(int)f] = o[(int)f] * d;

        double lift = _fogHeight.Value * 100.0;
        n[(int)F.H1Pos] = o[(int)F.H1Pos] + lift;
        n[(int)F.H2Pos] = o[(int)F.H2Pos] + lift;

        Write(ref st, n);
    }

    private static double[] Read(ref PPSettings st)
    {
        var a = new double[(int)F.Count];
        a[(int)F.Exposure] = st.ExposureBaseOffset;
        a[(int)F.BloomOn] = st.bEnableBloom ? 1 : 0;
        a[(int)F.Bloom] = st.BloomOverload;
        a[(int)F.BlurOn] = st.bEnableMotionBlur ? 1 : 0;
        a[(int)F.Blur] = st.MotionBlur_Amount;
        a[(int)F.Grain] = st.Scene_ImageGrainScale;
        a[(int)F.DofOn] = st.bEnableDOF ? 1 : 0;
        a[(int)F.Focus] = st.DOF_FocusDistance;
        a[(int)F.Aperture] = st.DOF_ApertureStop;
        a[(int)F.D1Start] = st.AtmosD1_DistanceStart;
        a[(int)F.D1End] = st.AtmosD1_DistanceEnd;
        a[(int)F.D2Start] = st.AtmosD2_DistanceStart;
        a[(int)F.D2End] = st.AtmosD2_DistanceEnd;
        a[(int)F.H1Pos] = st.AtmosH1_GradientPosition;
        a[(int)F.H2Pos] = st.AtmosH2_GradientPosition;
        return a;
    }

    private static void Write(ref PPSettings st, double[] a)
    {
        st.ExposureBaseOffset = (float)a[(int)F.Exposure];
        st.bEnableBloom = a[(int)F.BloomOn] > 0.5;
        st.BloomOverload = (float)a[(int)F.Bloom];
        st.bEnableMotionBlur = a[(int)F.BlurOn] > 0.5;
        st.MotionBlur_Amount = (float)a[(int)F.Blur];
        st.Scene_ImageGrainScale = (float)a[(int)F.Grain];
        st.bEnableDOF = a[(int)F.DofOn] > 0.5;
        st.DOF_FocusDistance = (float)a[(int)F.Focus];
        st.DOF_ApertureStop = (float)a[(int)F.Aperture];
        st.AtmosD1_DistanceStart = (float)a[(int)F.D1Start];
        st.AtmosD1_DistanceEnd = (float)a[(int)F.D1End];
        st.AtmosD2_DistanceStart = (float)a[(int)F.D2Start];
        st.AtmosD2_DistanceEnd = (float)a[(int)F.D2End];
        st.AtmosH1_GradientPosition = (float)a[(int)F.H1Pos];
        st.AtmosH2_GradientPosition = (float)a[(int)F.H2Pos];
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/World/Rain.cs`:

```cs
using System.Reflection;
using BmSDK.AkAudio;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using FLinearColor = BmSDK.GameObject.FLinearColor;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal sealed class Rain : Module
{
    public static readonly Rain I = new();

    private const double RefreshSeconds = 2.0;
    private const string DensityParam = "Ww_Parameters.RainDensity";

    private sealed record Look(string Key, string Label, float Density, float Width, float Wet, bool Sound);

    private static readonly Look[] Looks =
    {
        new("vanilla", "VANILLA", 1f, 1f, 1f, true),
        new("off", "NO RAIN", 0f, 1f, 0f, false),
        new("drizzle", "DRIZZLE", 0.3f, 0.8f, 0.7f, true),
        new("heavy", "HEAVY", 1.9f, 1.15f, 1.3f, true),
        new("storm", "STORM", 3.2f, 1.4f, 1.6f, true),
    };

    /// <summary>Every value Oracle writes on one rain volume, compared whole to tell its own writes from the game's.</summary>
    private readonly record struct Values(float Density, float Width, float Box, float Wet, float Damp, float Dark, float Wake,
        float Gas, FLinearColor Sludge, float Spatter, bool FarRain, bool FarHidden, float Puddle, float DampTh);

    private readonly record struct State(Values V, AkEvent? Bed);

    private static Values Read(RainVolume v, RRainComponent rc, RainMapComponent map)
    {
        ref RRainComponent.FRockRainSettings s = ref rc.RainSettings;
        bool hasMap = map is { IsValid: true };
        StaticMeshComponent far = v.FarRainMesh;
        return new Values(s.Density, s.Width, rc.BoxSize,
            hasMap ? map.WetnessGlobalScale : 1f, hasMap ? map.MinimumDampAmount : 0f, hasMap ? map.Darkening : 0f, hasMap ? map.RainWakeAmount : 0f,
            s.FearGasAmount, s.FearGasSludgeColor, v.RainCameraSpatter, v.bDrawFarRainMesh, far is { IsValid: true } && far.HiddenGame, hasMap ? map.PuddleThreshold : 0f,
            hasMap ? map.DampThreshold : 0f);
    }

    private static void Write(RainVolume v, RRainComponent rc, RainMapComponent map, Values n)
    {
        ref RRainComponent.FRockRainSettings s = ref rc.RainSettings;
        s.Density = n.Density;
        s.Width = n.Width;
        rc.BoxSize = n.Box;
        s.FearGasAmount = n.Gas;
        s.FearGasSludgeColor = n.Sludge;
        v.RainCameraSpatter = n.Spatter;
        v.bDrawFarRainMesh = n.FarRain;
        if (v.FarRainMesh is { IsValid: true } far && far.HiddenGame != n.FarHidden)
            far.SetHidden(n.FarHidden);
        if (map is { IsValid: true })
        {
            map.WetnessGlobalScale = n.Wet;
            map.MinimumDampAmount = n.Damp;
            map.Darkening = n.Dark;
            map.RainWakeAmount = n.Wake;
            map.PuddleThreshold = n.Puddle;
            map.DampThreshold = n.DampTh;
            // The rain map's values reach the renderer when the component is rebuilt.
            map.QueueReattach(false);
        }
    }

    private static FLinearColor Tint(Toxin t, FLinearColor game) => new() { R = t.R, G = t.G, B = t.B, A = game.A <= 0f ? 1f : game.A };

    private sealed record Toxin(string Key, string Label, float R, float G, float B);

    private static readonly Toxin[] Toxins =
    {
        new("game", "GAME", 0f, 0f, 0f),
        new("green", "FEAR GREEN", 0.25f, 1f, 0.1f),
        new("yellow", "SICKLY YELLOW", 1f, 0.85f, 0.1f),
        new("orange", "ORANGE", 1f, 0.42f, 0.05f),
        new("red", "BLOOD RED", 1f, 0.05f, 0.03f),
        new("purple", "JOKER PURPLE", 0.6f, 0.12f, 1f),
        new("blue", "COLD BLUE", 0.15f, 0.5f, 1f),
    };

    private static readonly PropertyInfo[] SurfaceSounds = typeof(PhysicalMaterial).GetProperties()
        .Where(p => p.Name.StartsWith("SurfaceRainSound", StringComparison.Ordinal) && p.PropertyType == typeof(AkEvent) && p.CanWrite)
        .ToArray();

    private readonly Dictionary<string, State> _originals = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Values> _written = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly HashSet<string> _muted = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, AkEvent?[]> _surfaces = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly HashSet<string> _emitters = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private AkParameterName? _param;
    private bool _paramSet;
    private float _resyncLeft = -1f;
    private readonly HashSet<string> _mistOff = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private int _look;
    private float _wet = 1f;
    private float _box = 1f;
    private float _toxin;
    private int _toxinColour;
    private float _puddles = 1f;
    private bool _noMist;
    private bool _noFarRain;
    private bool _reported;
    private Every _refresh;
    private bool _dirty;

    private bool Vanilla => _look == 0 && MathF.Abs(_wet - 1f) < 0.001f && MathF.Abs(_box - 1f) < 0.001f && _toxin <= 0f && _toxinColour == 0
        && MathF.Abs(_puddles - 1f) < 0.001f && !_noMist && !_noFarRain;

    private bool Changed => _originals.Count > 0 || _surfaces.Count > 0 || _emitters.Count > 0 || _paramSet;

    public override void Build()
    {
        AddChoice("rain", "RAIN", "Changes the rain: none, a drizzle, heavy rain or a storm. NO RAIN also dries the streets and silences the rain. Works together with the sky & fog looks and post processing.",
            Looks.Select(l => l.Key).ToArray(), Looks.Select(l => l.Label).ToArray(), i => { _look = Math.Clamp(i, 0, Looks.Length - 1); _dirty = true; });
        AddSlider("rain_wetness", "WET STREETS", "How wet and shiny the streets, rooftops and suits look. 0% = completely dry.", 1f, 0f, 2f, 0.1f, 1.6f, Fmt.Percent, v => { _wet = v; _dirty = true; });
        AddSlider("rain_area", "RAIN AREA", "Size of the rain box around you. Smaller packs the drops close around the camera, bigger spreads them further out and thinner.", 1f, 0.25f, 3f, 0.25f, 2f, Fmt.Percent, v => { _box = v; _dirty = true; });

        AddSlider("rain_toxin", "TOXIN RAIN", "Mixes Scarecrow's fear toxin into the rain, the sludgy coloured rain from under the toxin cloud. Only shows while the toxin cloud hangs over the city. 0% = clean rain.", 0f, 0f, 1f, 0.1f, 0.8f, Fmt.Percent,
            v => { _toxin = v; _dirty = true; WarnNoCloud(v); });
        Choice colour = AddChoice("rain_toxin_colour", "TOXIN COLOUR", "Colour of the toxin in the rain. GAME keeps the game's own.",
            Toxins.Select(t => t.Key).ToArray(), Toxins.Select(t => t.Label).ToArray(), i => { _toxinColour = Math.Clamp(i, 0, Toxins.Length - 1); _dirty = true; });
        colour.Swatch = i => i <= 0 ? Rgba.From(0.35f, 0.8f, 0.25f) : Rgba.From(Toxins[i].R, Toxins[i].G, Toxins[i].B);

        AddSlider("rain_puddles", "PUDDLES", "How readily puddles form on wet ground. 0% = none at all.", 1f, 0f, 2f, 0.1f, 1.8f, Fmt.Percent, v => { _puddles = v; _dirty = true; });
        AddToggle("rain_no_mist", "NO RAIN MIST", "Removes the spray of mist that hangs around you in the rain.", on => { _noMist = on; _dirty = true; });
        AddToggle("rain_no_far", "NO DISTANT RAIN", "Removes the sheets of rain drawn far off across the city, so the skyline stays sharp.", on => { _noFarRain = on; _dirty = true; });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The puddle and damp thresholds as wetness levels: the game's are 1 (2026-11-05 log), the top. The first
    /// version could only go drier from there, so below 100% did nothing; now 0% raises it past the top and 200%
    /// drops it to nothing.
    /// </summary>
    private static float Puddle(float o, float v)
    {
        float top = Math.Max(o, 1f);
        return v <= 1f ? o + (top * 2f - o) * (1f - v) : o * (2f - v);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Uses the script function IsGasActive (the story's toxin side chapter, or the GasActiveInOverworld flag), an
    /// ordinary call on the game info. Never the static natives IsFearGasActive/IsLocationInFearGas/
    /// GetFearGasHeightAtLocation: BmSDK calls a static native with no object behind it, and IsFearGasActive
    /// crashed the game in coreclr twice on 2026-11-05, which no try/catch can stop.
    /// </summary>
    private static void WarnNoCloud(float v)
    {
        if (v <= 0f || World.Info is not { } gi)
            return;

        bool cloud = Safe.Try("gas check", () => gi.IsGasActive());
        Log.Detail("Toxin rain: fear gas " + (cloud ? "active" : "not active") + ".");
        if (!cloud)
            Overlay.Notice("TOXIN RAIN", "NEEDS SCARECROW'S TOXIN CLOUD", false);
    }

    public override void WorldChanged() => Forget();

    public override void LeftGame()
    {
        if (Changed)
            Forget();
    }

    public override void Shutdown() => Safe.Run("rain restore", Restore);

    private void Forget()
    {
        Safe.Run("rain audio restore", () =>
        {
            if (_paramSet || _surfaces.Count > 0)
            {
                _emitters.Clear();
                RestoreAudio();
            }
        });

        _originals.Clear();
        _written.Clear();
        _muted.Clear();
        _mistOff.Clear();
        _surfaces.Clear();
        _emitters.Clear();
        _param = null;
        _paramSet = false;
        _reported = false;
        _dirty = true;
    }

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (_resyncLeft >= 0f)
        {
            _resyncLeft -= dt;
            if (_resyncLeft < 0f)
                ResyncParam();
        }

        if (Vanilla)
        {
            if (Changed)
                Restore();
            return;
        }

        if (!_dirty && !_refresh.Elapsed(RefreshSeconds))
            return;

        _dirty = false;
        Look look = Looks[_look];
        float wet = look.Wet * _wet;
        float damp = Math.Min(wet, 1f);

        foreach (RainVolume v in World.All<RainVolume>())
        {
            RRainComponent rc = v.RainComponent;
            RainMapComponent map = v.RainMap;
            if (rc is not { IsValid: true })
                continue;

            string key = v.GetPathName(null);
            ref RRainComponent.FRockRainSettings s = ref rc.RainSettings;
            Values live = Read(v, rc, map);

            // Anything Oracle didn't write is the game's own change (a story weather beat), so follow it.
            bool known = _originals.TryGetValue(key, out State o);
            if (!known || !_written.TryGetValue(key, out Values w) || live != w)
            {
                AkEvent? bed = s.RainSoundBed is { IsValid: true } b ? b : known ? o.Bed : null;
                if (known)
                    Log.Detail("Rain: the game changed " + key + ", following it.");
                o = new State(live, bed);
                _originals[key] = o;
                if (!_reported)
                {
                    _reported = true;
                    Log.Info("Rain: game values density " + live.Density + ", toxin " + live.Gas + ", sludge " + live.Sludge.R + "/" + live.Sludge.G + "/" + live.Sludge.B
                        + ", spatter " + live.Spatter + ", puddle threshold " + live.Puddle + ", wake " + live.Wake + ".");
                }
            }

            Values g = o.V;
            Values want = g with
            {
                Density = g.Density * look.Density,
                Width = g.Width * look.Width,
                Box = g.Box * _box,
                Wet = g.Wet * wet,
                Damp = g.Damp * damp,
                Dark = g.Dark * damp,
                Wake = g.Wake * Math.Min(look.Density, 1f),
                Puddle = Puddle(g.Puddle, _puddles),
                DampTh = Puddle(g.DampTh, _puddles),
                Gas = Math.Max(g.Gas, _toxin),
                Sludge = _toxinColour > 0 ? Tint(Toxins[_toxinColour], g.Sludge) : g.Sludge,
                FarRain = g.FarRain && !_noFarRain,
                FarHidden = g.FarHidden || _noFarRain,
            };

            bool changed = want != live;
            if (changed)
                Write(v, rc, map, want);

            SetMist(v, key, _noMist);

            bool muted = _muted.Contains(key);
            if (!look.Sound && !muted)
            {
                rc.DisableRainSound();
                s.RainSoundBed = null!;
                _muted.Add(key);
                changed = true;
            }
            else if (look.Sound && muted)
            {
                s.RainSoundBed = o.Bed!;
                rc.EnableRainSound();
                _muted.Remove(key);
                changed = true;
            }

            if (changed)
                v.SetRainSettings();

            // Read back rather than trusting what was written, in case the native side clamps a value.
            _written[key] = Read(v, rc, map);
        }

        if (look.Sound)
            RestoreAudio();
        else
            MuteAudio();

        if (wet < 0.001f)
            DryPawns();
    }

    private void MuteAudio()
    {
        _param ??= Game.FindObject<AkParameterName>(DensityParam);
        if (_param is { IsValid: true })
        {
            AkWwise.SetGlobalAudioParameter(_param, 0f);
            _paramSet = true;
        }

        foreach (PhysicalMaterial m in World.All<PhysicalMaterial>())
        {
            string key = m.GetPathName(null);
            if (_surfaces.ContainsKey(key))
                continue;

            var saved = new AkEvent?[SurfaceSounds.Length];
            bool any = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < SurfaceSounds.Length; i++)
            {
                saved[i] = SurfaceSounds[i].GetValue(m) as AkEvent;
                if (saved[i] == null)
                    continue;

                any = true;
                SurfaceSounds[i].SetValue(m, null);
            }

            if (any)
                _surfaces[key] = saved;
        }

        foreach (AkEmitter e in World.All<AkEmitter>())
        {
            if (!e.bEmitterEnabled || !PlaysRain(e))
                continue;

            e.DisableEmitter();
            _emitters.Add(e.GetPathName(null));
        }
    }

    private void ResyncParam()
    {
        if (_paramSet || Looks[_look].Density <= 0f)
            return;

        _param ??= Game.FindObject<AkParameterName>(DensityParam);
        if (_param is { IsValid: true })
            AkWwise.SetGlobalAudioParameter(_param, AkSoundDirector.LocationRainDensity(AkWwise.GetActiveListenerPosition()));
    }

    private static bool PlaysRain(AkEmitter e)
    {
        var events = e.EmitterEvents;
        for (int i = 0; i < events.Count; i++)
        {
            AkEvent ev = events[i];
            if (ev is { IsValid: true } && ev.Name.ToString().Contains("Rain", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private void RestoreAudio()
    {
        if (_paramSet)
        {
            _paramSet = false;
            _resyncLeft = 1f;
        }

        if (_surfaces.Count > 0)
        {
            foreach (PhysicalMaterial m in World.All<PhysicalMaterial>())
            {
                if (!_surfaces.TryGetValue(m.GetPathName(null), out AkEvent?[]? saved))
                    continue;

                for (int i = 0; i < SurfaceSounds.Length; i++)
                {
                    if (saved[i] is { IsValid: true })
                        SurfaceSounds[i].SetValue(m, saved[i]);
                }
            }

            _surfaces.Clear();
        }

        if (_emitters.Count > 0)
        {
            foreach (AkEmitter e in World.All<AkEmitter>())
            {
                if (!e.bEmitterEnabled && _emitters.Contains(e.GetPathName(null)))
                    e.EnableEmitter();
            }

            _emitters.Clear();
        }
    }

    private static void DryPawns()
    {
        foreach (RPawnCharacter p in World.All<RPawnCharacter>())
        {
            if (p.WetnessAccumulationAlpha > 0f)
                p.WetnessAccumulationAlpha = 0f;
            if (p.RainAccumulationAlpha > 0f)
                p.RainAccumulationAlpha = 0f;
        }

        if (World.Pawn is RVehicle car)
        {
            car.WetnessAccumulationAlpha = 0f;
            car.RainAccumulationAlpha = 0f;
        }
    }

    private void Restore()
    {
        foreach (RainVolume v in World.All<RainVolume>())
        {
            string key = v.GetPathName(null);
            RRainComponent rc = v.RainComponent;
            if (!_originals.TryGetValue(key, out State o) || rc is not { IsValid: true })
                continue;

            // Only put back what is still Oracle's: if the game has changed the volume since, its values stand.
            ref RRainComponent.FRockRainSettings s = ref rc.RainSettings;
            RainMapComponent map = v.RainMap;
            if (!_written.TryGetValue(key, out Values w) || Read(v, rc, map) == w)
                Write(v, rc, map, o.V);
            SetMist(v, key, false);

            if (_muted.Remove(key))
            {
                s.RainSoundBed = o.Bed!;
                rc.EnableRainSound();
            }

            v.SetRainSettings();
        }

        RestoreAudio();
        _originals.Clear();
        _written.Clear();
        _muted.Clear();
        _mistOff.Clear();
    }

    /// <summary>Stops or restarts the mist that follows the camera, remembering which ones Oracle stopped.</summary>
    private void SetMist(RainVolume v, string key, bool off)
    {
        ParticleSystemComponent mist = v.NearMist;
        if (mist is not { IsValid: true })
            return;

        if (off && !_mistOff.Contains(key))
        {
            if (!mist.bIsActive)
                return;

            mist.DeactivateSystem();
            mist.SetHidden(true);
            _mistOff.Add(key);
        }
        else if (!off && _mistOff.Remove(key))
        {
            mist.SetHidden(false);
            mist.ActivateSystem(false, false);
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/World/Screen.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Post processing presets. Works with <see cref="Atmosphere"/>, which needs parts of it left on.</summary>
internal sealed class Screen : Module
{
    public static readonly Screen I = new();

    private const double RefreshSeconds = 2.0;

    private readonly record struct EffectState(bool UseWorld, bool LightingOnly);

    private readonly Dictionary<string, EffectState> _effects = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, bool> _volumes = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private Choice _choice = null!;
    private int _mode;
    private bool _withAtmo;
    private Every _refresh;

    /// <summary>A sky look or a PostFx row needs the world's settings, so REDUCED and OFF keep them with the grading neutralised.</summary>
    private static bool WorldLook => Atmosphere.I.Wanted || PostFx.I.Wanted;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _choice = AddChoice("post_process", "POST PROCESSING", "REDUCED strips the colour grading. OFF also flattens the lighting. Both work together with the sky & fog looks.",
            new[] { "vanilla", "reduced", "off" }, new[] { "VANILLA", "REDUCED", "OFF" }, Apply);
    }

    public override void LeftGame()
    {
        if (_effects.Count == 0 && _volumes.Count == 0)
            return;

        _mode = 0;
        Restore();
    }

    public override void Shutdown()
    {
        _mode = 0;
        Safe.Run("post process restore", Restore);
    }

    public override void Tick(float dt)
    {
        if (_choice.Index != 0 && _withAtmo != WorldLook)
            Apply(_choice.Index);

        if (_mode != 0 && _refresh.Elapsed(RefreshSeconds))
            Write();
    }

    private void Apply(int mode)
    {
        _mode = Math.Clamp(mode, 0, 2);
        _withAtmo = _mode != 0 && WorldLook;
        Atmosphere.I.SetGradeOff(_withAtmo);
        Write();
    }

    private void Write()
    {
        if (_mode == 0)
        {
            Restore();
            return;
        }

        // Only the grading, bloom and lighting chain (RockOn, RockAtmos, Uber and the DOF/bloom effects). The
        // material slots are the game's overlays (damage, stun, detective mode, menu blur) and the game shows and
        // hides ambient occlusion itself for detective vision, so those are never touched, and nothing is forced visible.
        bool lightingOnly = _mode == 2;
        foreach (PostProcessEffect e in World.All<PostProcessEffect>())
        {
            if (e is not DOFEffect)
                continue;

            string key = e.GetPathName(null);
            if (!_effects.ContainsKey(key))
                _effects[key] = new EffectState(e.bUseWorldSettings, e.bAffectsLightingOnly);

            bool rock = e is RockAtmos || e is RockOn;
            bool useWorld = _withAtmo && (rock || e is UberPostProcessEffect);
            bool light = lightingOnly && !(_withAtmo && rock);
            if (e.bUseWorldSettings != useWorld)
                e.bUseWorldSettings = useWorld;
            if (e.bAffectsLightingOnly != light)
                e.bAffectsLightingOnly = light;
        }

        foreach (PostProcessVolume v in World.All<PostProcessVolume>())
        {
            string key = v.GetPathName(null);
            if (!_volumes.ContainsKey(key))
                _volumes[key] = v.bEnabled;
            if (v.bEnabled != _withAtmo)
                v.bEnabled = _withAtmo;
        }
    }

    private void Restore()
    {
        if (_effects.Count == 0 && _volumes.Count == 0)
            return;

        foreach (PostProcessEffect e in World.All<PostProcessEffect>())
        {
            if (!_effects.TryGetValue(e.GetPathName(null), out EffectState o))
                continue;

            e.bUseWorldSettings = o.UseWorld;
            e.bAffectsLightingOnly = o.LightingOnly;
        }

        foreach (PostProcessVolume v in World.All<PostProcessVolume>())
        {
            if (_volumes.TryGetValue(v.GetPathName(null), out bool on))
                v.bEnabled = on;
        }

        _effects.Clear();
        _volumes.Clear();
    }
}
```

```cs
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal sealed class TimeControl : Module
{
    public static readonly TimeControl I = new();

    public override void Build()
    {
        Slider speed = AddSlider("game_speed", "GAME SPEED", "Speeds up or slows down the whole game.", 1f, 0.2f, 2f, 0.05f, 0.5f, Fmt.Times, Apply);
        speed.Maintain(() => Apply(speed.Value));
    }

    public override void Shutdown() => Safe.Run("game speed restore", () => Apply(1f));

    private static void Apply(float v)
    {
        RGameInfo? g = World.Info;
        if (g != null && MathF.Abs(g.DebugGameSpeed - v) > 0.001f)
            g.SetDebugGameSpeed(v);
    }
}
```

`scripts/Modules/World/Wind.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK.BmGame;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Catalog;
using WindConfig = BmSDK.BmGame.RGameInfo.FRWindConfig;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The city's wind: the global config RGameInfo ticks natively (cape, debris, flags) and the local wind volumes.
/// The game rewrites the global config from Kismet (RSeqAct_ChangeWind), so any value Oracle didn't write is
/// taken as the game's new original and the override is worked out from that.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class Wind : Module
{
    public static readonly Wind I = new();

    // Used when the game's wind is still: a direction and speed to scale from. Calibrate from the log.
    private const float BaseSpeed = 600f;
    private const float BaseGust = 300f;

    private sealed class Slot
    {
        public WindConfig Original;
        public WindConfig Written;
        public bool Holding;
    }

    private readonly Slot _global = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Slot> _volumes = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, (float S1, float S2, float W1, float W2)> _sources = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private Slider _strength = null!;
    private Slider _direction = null!;
    private Slider _gusts = null!;
    private bool _reported;

    private bool Vanilla => _strength.IsDefault && _direction.IsDefault && _gusts.IsDefault;

    public override void Build()
    {
        _strength = AddSlider("wind_strength", "WIND STRENGTH", "How hard the wind blows: Batman's cape, loose paper, flags and debris. CALM stops it.",
            1f, 0f, 5f, 0.25f, 3f, v => v <= 0f ? "CALM" : Fmt.Times(v), _ => Apply());
        _strength.Maintain(Apply);
        _direction = AddSlider("wind_direction", "WIND DIRECTION", "Turns the wind away from the way the game has it blowing.",
            0f, -180f, 180f, 15f, 180f, v => MathF.Abs(v) < 0.01f ? "DEFAULT" : (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + Fmt.Degrees(v), _ => Apply());
        _direction.Maintain(Apply);
        _gusts = AddSlider("wind_gusts", "GUSTS", "How much the wind changes and gusts around its usual strength.", 1f, 0f, 5f, 0.25f, 3f, Fmt.Times, _ => Apply());
        _gusts.Maintain(Apply);
    }

    public override void WorldChanged()
    {
        _volumes.Clear();
        _sources.Clear();
        _global.Holding = false;
        _reported = false;
    }

    public override void Shutdown() => Safe.Run("wind restore", Restore);

    private void Apply()
    {
        if (Vanilla)
        {
            Restore();
            return;
        }

        if (World.Info is { } gi)
        {
            if (!_reported)
            {
                _reported = true;
                WindConfig c = gi.CurrentWindConfig;
                Log.Info("Wind: game config apply " + c.IsApplyWind + ", centre " + c.WindVelocityCentre + ", radius " + c.WindVelocityRadius + ", accel radius " + c.MaxWindAccelerationRadius + ".");
            }

            Override(_global, ref gi.CurrentWindConfig);
        }

        foreach (RWindVolume v in World.All<RWindVolume>())
        {
            string key = v.GetPathName(null);
            if (!_volumes.TryGetValue(key, out Slot? slot))
                _volumes[key] = slot = new Slot();
            Override(slot, ref v.GeneratedWindConfig);
        }

        // The cape follows these: confirmed in game 2026-11-05. The global config above was zero on that save.
        ScaleSources();
    }

    /// <summary>The engine's directional wind sources (foliage, cloth, particles), scaled by WIND STRENGTH and put back after.</summary>
    private void ScaleSources()
    {
        float k = Math.Max(0f, _strength.Value);
        foreach (WindDirectionalSourceComponent w in World.All<WindDirectionalSourceComponent>())
        {
            string key = w.GetPathName(null);
            if (!_sources.TryGetValue(key, out (float S1, float S2, float W1, float W2) o) || (w.Wind1Strength != o.W1 || w.Wind2Strength != o.W2))
            {
                // A value Oracle didn't write is the game's own: take it as the new original.
                o = (w.Wind1Strength, w.Wind2Strength, 0f, 0f);
            }

            float s1 = o.S1 * k, s2 = o.S2 * k;
            if (w.Wind1Strength != s1)
                w.Wind1Strength = s1;
            if (w.Wind2Strength != s2)
                w.Wind2Strength = s2;
            _sources[key] = (o.S1, o.S2, s1, s2);
        }

    }

    private void RestoreSources()
    {
        if (_sources.Count == 0)
            return;

        foreach (WindDirectionalSourceComponent w in World.All<WindDirectionalSourceComponent>())
        {
            if (!_sources.TryGetValue(w.GetPathName(null), out (float S1, float S2, float W1, float W2) o))
                continue;
            if (w.Wind1Strength == o.W1)
                w.Wind1Strength = o.S1;
            if (w.Wind2Strength == o.W2)
                w.Wind2Strength = o.S2;
        }

        _sources.Clear();
    }

    private void Override(Slot slot, ref WindConfig live)
    {
        if (!slot.Holding || !live.Equals(slot.Written))
            slot.Original = live;

        WindConfig want = Transform(slot.Original);
        if (!live.Equals(want))
            live = want;

        slot.Written = want;
        slot.Holding = true;
    }

    private WindConfig Transform(WindConfig o)
    {
        WindConfig n = o;
        float strength = _strength.Value;
        if (strength <= 0f)
        {
            n.IsApplyWind = false;
            n.WindVelocityCentre = Vector3.Zero;
            n.WindVelocityRadius = 0f;
            n.MaxWindAccelerationRadius = 0f;
            return n;
        }

        Vector3 centre = o.WindVelocityCentre;
        float speed = centre.Length();

        // A still night stays still unless the strength is raised: turning or gusting no wind is nothing.
        if (speed < 1f && strength <= 1f)
            return o;

        Vector3 dir = speed < 1f ? Vector3.UnitX : centre / speed;
        if (speed < 1f)
        {
            speed = BaseSpeed;
            strength -= 1f;
        }

        float turn = _direction.Value * MathF.PI / 180f;
        float c = MathF.Cos(turn), s = MathF.Sin(turn);
        dir = new Vector3(dir.X * c - dir.Y * s, dir.X * s + dir.Y * c, dir.Z);

        float gusts = _gusts.Value;
        n.IsApplyWind = true;
        n.WindVelocityCentre = dir * speed * strength;
        n.WindVelocityRadius = (o.WindVelocityRadius < 1f ? BaseGust : o.WindVelocityRadius) * gusts * MathF.Sqrt(strength);
        n.MaxWindAccelerationRadius = (o.MaxWindAccelerationRadius < 1f ? BaseGust : o.MaxWindAccelerationRadius) * gusts * MathF.Sqrt(strength);
        return n;
    }

    private void Restore()
    {
        RestoreSources();
        if (_global.Holding && World.Info is { } gi)
        {
            ref WindConfig live = ref gi.CurrentWindConfig;
            if (live.Equals(_global.Written))
                live = _global.Original;
        }

        _global.Holding = false;

        if (_volumes.Count == 0)
            return;

        foreach (RWindVolume v in World.All<RWindVolume>())
        {
            if (!_volumes.TryGetValue(v.GetPathName(null), out Slot? slot) || !slot.Holding)
                continue;

            ref WindConfig live = ref v.GeneratedWindConfig;
            if (live.Equals(slot.Written))
                live = slot.Original;
        }

        _volumes.Clear();
    }
}
```

`scripts/Ui/Fader.cs`:

```cs
namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Screen fades shared by anything that moves the player out of sight.</summary>
internal static class Fader
{
    private enum Mode
    {
        Clear,
        Out,
        Dark,
        In,
    }

    private static Mode _mode;
    private static float _time;
    private static float _length;
    private static bool _gentle;
    private static string _title = "";
    private static string _result = "";
    private static bool _ok;

    public static float Level { get; private set; }

    public static string Caption { get; private set; } = "";

    public static bool IsDark => _mode == Mode.Dark;

    public static bool IsClear => _mode == Mode.Clear;

    /// <summary>Fades to black. <paramref name="gentle"/> eases in slowly instead of a quick smooth cut.</summary>
    public static void Out(float seconds, bool gentle, string caption)
    {
        _mode = Mode.Out;
        _time = 0f;
        _length = seconds;
        _gentle = gentle;
        Caption = caption;
    }

    /// <summary>Goes black at once, for paths that must hide the screen immediately.</summary>
    public static void Cut(string caption)
    {
        _mode = Mode.Dark;
        Level = 1f;
        Caption = caption;
    }

    /// <summary>Fades back in, then shows the given result as a toast.</summary>
    public static void In(float seconds, string title = "", string result = "", bool ok = true)
    {
        _mode = Mode.In;
        _time = 0f;
        _length = seconds;
        _title = title;
        _result = result;
        _ok = ok;
    }

    public static void Clear()
    {
        _mode = Mode.Clear;
        Level = 0f;
        Caption = "";
    }

    public static void Advance(float dt)
    {
        switch (_mode)
        {
            case Mode.Out:
                _time += dt;
                Level = _gentle ? Ease.In(_time / _length) : Ease.Smooth(_time / _length);
                if (_time >= _length)
                {
                    Level = 1f;
                    _mode = Mode.Dark;
                }

                break;

            case Mode.In:
                _time += dt;
                Level = 1f - Ease.Smooth(_time / _length);
                if (_time >= _length)
                {
                    Clear();
                    if (_result.Length > 0)
                        Overlay.Toast(_title, _result, _ok);
                }

                break;
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/Ui/Gfx.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.Engine;
using FLinearColor = BmSDK.GameObject.FLinearColor;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Immediate-mode drawing on the game's Canvas, scaled from a 1080p layout. Every Canvas call is a full
/// UnrealScript function call, so text is drawn as whole strings and sizes are cached; per-letter spacing
/// is kept for the few places it's worth the cost.
/// </summary>
internal static class Gfx
{
    private const int MaxCachedWidths = 4096;

    private static readonly float[] Linear = BuildLinear();
    private static readonly Dictionary<(string, float), float> _widths = new();
    private static readonly Dictionary<float, float> _heights = new();
    private static readonly Dictionary<int, float> _anim = new();
    private static Texture2D? _white;
    private static Font? _font;
    private static Font? _engineFont;

    /// <summary>The menu font everything falls back to, and the one other fonts are sized to match.</summary>
    public const string DefaultFont = "BmFonts.EngineSmallFont";

    private static string _fontPath = DefaultFont;
    private static float _fontNorm = 1f;
    private static bool _measureFont = true;
    private static double _fontRetry;

    public static Canvas C = null!;
    public static float Scale = 1f;
    public static float Alpha = 1f;
    public static float Dt;
    public static double Time;

    public static float W => C.ClipX;

    public static float H => C.ClipY;

    public static float S(float v) => v * Scale;

    /// <summary>The plain white texture every rectangle and shape is drawn with. Null until it has loaded.</summary>
    public static Texture2D? WhiteTexture => _white is { IsValid: true } ? _white : null;

    /// <summary>Selects the canvas for this frame. Returns false until the drawing resources have loaded.</summary>
    public static bool Begin(Canvas canvas, out Font? previous)
    {
        previous = null;
        if (_white is not { IsValid: true })
            _white = Game.FindObject<Texture2D>("EngineResources.WhiteSquareTexture");
        if (_engineFont is not { IsValid: true })
            _engineFont = Game.FindObject<Font>(DefaultFont);
        if (_font is not { IsValid: true } && Time >= _fontRetry)
            FindFont();
        if (_white == null)
            return false;

        C = canvas;
        Scale = Math.Clamp(canvas.ClipY / 1080f, 0.75f, 2.5f);
        Alpha = 1f;
        previous = canvas.Font;
        Font? font = _font is { IsValid: true } ? _font : _engineFont;
        if (font != null)
        {
            if (_measureFont)
                MeasureFont(canvas, font);
            canvas.Font = font;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Switches the menu font by its object path. A font that isn't loaded falls back to the engine font.</summary>
    public static void UseFont(string path)
    {
        _fontPath = path.Length == 0 ? DefaultFont : path;
        _font = null;
        _fontRetry = 0;
        _measureFont = true;
    }

    private static void FindFont()
    {
        Font? found = _fontPath == DefaultFont ? null : Game.FindObject<Font>(_fontPath);
        if (found == null)
            _fontRetry = Time + 2.0;   // not loaded (yet); the engine font stands in, and this is tried again
        if (found != _font)
        {
            _font = found;
            _measureFont = true;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Fonts come in very different sizes, so each one is scaled to draw as tall as the engine font at the same
    /// scale. Every cached width and height is for the old font, so they go too.
    /// </summary>
    private static void MeasureFont(Canvas canvas, Font font)
    {
        _measureFont = false;
        _widths.Clear();
        _heights.Clear();
        _fontNorm = 1f;
        if (_engineFont == null || font == _engineFont)
            return;

        canvas.Font = _engineFont;
        canvas.TextSize("AQ", out _, out float reference, 1f, 1f);
        canvas.Font = font;
        canvas.TextSize("AQ", out _, out float height, 1f, 1f);
        if (reference > 0f && height > 0f)
            _fontNorm = Math.Clamp(reference / height, 0.05f, 20f);
    }

    public static void Rect(float x, float y, float w, float h, Rgba col, float alpha = 1f)
    {
        if (w <= 0f || h <= 0f)
            return;

        C.SetPos(MathF.Round(x), MathF.Round(y), 0f);
        var color = new FLinearColor { R = Linear[col.R], G = Linear[col.G], B = Linear[col.B], A = col.A / 255f * alpha * Alpha };
        C.DrawTile(_white!, MathF.Round(w), MathF.Round(h), 0f, 0f, 32f, 32f, color, false, EngineTypes.EBlendMode.BLEND_Translucent);
    }

    /// <summary>Draws a whole texture into a box, untinted.</summary>
    public static void Image(Texture2D tex, float x, float y, float w, float h, float alpha = 1f) =>
        Sprite(tex, x, y, w, h, 0f, 0f, tex.SizeX, tex.SizeY, Theme.White, alpha);

    /// <summary>Draws part of a texture (u, v, width, height in texels) into a box, tinted.</summary>
    public static void Sprite(Texture2D tex, float x, float y, float w, float h, float u, float v, float ul, float vl, Rgba tint, float alpha = 1f)
    {
        if (w <= 0f || h <= 0f)
            return;

        C.SetPos(MathF.Round(x), MathF.Round(y), 0f);
        var color = new FLinearColor { R = Linear[tint.R], G = Linear[tint.G], B = Linear[tint.B], A = tint.A / 255f * alpha * Alpha };
        C.DrawTile(tex, MathF.Round(w), MathF.Round(h), u, v, ul, vl, color, false, EngineTypes.EBlendMode.BLEND_Translucent);
    }

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, (Texture2D? Tex, double Retry)> _textures = new();

    /// <summary>
    /// A game texture by path, cached. Null while it isn't loaded; looked up again every few seconds, so a
    /// texture that streams in later still turns up.
    /// </summary>
    public static Texture2D? Find(string path)
    {
        if (_textures.TryGetValue(path, out var entry) && (entry.Tex is { IsValid: true } || Time < entry.Retry))
            return entry.Tex is { IsValid: true } ? entry.Tex : null;

        Texture2D? tex = null;
        try
        {
            tex = Game.FindObject<Texture2D>(path);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
        }

        _textures[path] = (tex, Time + 3.0);
        return tex;
    }

    /// <summary>A HUD box: the dark backing with an accent bar down its left edge.</summary>
    public static void Panel(float x, float y, float w, float h, float alpha = 0.8f, float bar = 3f)
    {
        Rect(x, y, w, h, Theme.Panel, alpha);
        Rect(x, y, S(bar), h, Theme.Accent, alpha + 0.15f);
    }

    public static void GradientX(float x, float y, float w, float h, Rgba col, float from, float to)
    {
        int slices = Theme.LowEnd ? 4 : 12;
        for (int i = 0; i < slices; i++)
        {
            float x0 = MathF.Round(x + w * i / slices);
            float x1 = MathF.Round(x + w * (i + 1) / slices);
            Rect(x0, y, x1 - x0, h, col, from + (to - from) * ((i + 0.5f) / slices));
        }
    }

    public static float TextW(string text, float scale)
    {
        if (_widths.Count >= MaxCachedWidths)
            _widths.Clear();

        float size = scale * Scale * _fontNorm;
        if (_widths.TryGetValue((text, size), out float w))
            return w;

        C.TextSize(text, out w, out _, size, size);
        _widths[(text, size)] = w;
        return w;
    }

    public static float TextH(float scale)
    {
        float size = scale * Scale * _fontNorm;
        if (_heights.TryGetValue(size, out float h))
            return h;

        C.TextSize("AQ", out _, out h, size, size);
        _heights[size] = h;
        return h;
    }

    public static float Text(float x, float y, string text, Rgba col, float scale, float alpha = 1f)
    {
        C.SetDrawColor(col.R, col.G, col.B, (byte)Math.Clamp(col.A * alpha * Alpha, 0f, 255f));
        C.SetPos(MathF.Round(x), MathF.Round(y), 0f);
        float size = scale * Scale * _fontNorm;
        C.DrawText(text, false, size, size, out _);
        return TextW(text, scale);
    }

    /// <summary>Draws text vertically centred on <paramref name="cy"/>.</summary>
    public static float TextMid(float x, float cy, string text, Rgba col, float scale, float alpha = 1f) =>
        Text(x, cy - TextH(scale) * 0.5f, text, col, scale, alpha);

    public static float TextRight(float right, float cy, string text, Rgba col, float scale, float alpha = 1f)
    {
        float w = TextW(text, scale);
        TextMid(right - w, cy, text, col, scale, alpha);
        return w;
    }

    public static void TextCentre(float cx, float y, string text, Rgba col, float scale, float alpha = 1f) =>
        Text(cx - TextW(text, scale) * 0.5f, y, text, col, scale, alpha);

    public static float Spaced(float x, float y, string text, Rgba col, float scale, float spacing, float alpha = 1f)
    {
        float start = x;
        foreach (char ch in text)
            x += Text(x, y, ch.ToString(), col, scale, alpha) + S(spacing);
        return x - start - S(spacing);
    }

    /// <summary>Splits off as many words as fit the width. Returns the remainder, empty when all of it fit.</summary>
    public static string FitLine(string text, float width, float scale, out string line)
    {
        if (TextW(text, scale) <= width)
        {
            line = text;
            return "";
        }

        int cut = text.Length;
        while (cut > 0)
        {
            int space = text.LastIndexOf(' ', cut - 1);
            if (space <= 0)
                break;

            cut = space;
            if (TextW(text.Substring(0, cut), scale) <= width)
                break;
        }

        line = text.Substring(0, cut);
        return text.Substring(cut).TrimStart();
    }

    /// <summary>Eases a value toward a target, independent of frame rate. Below 0 means unset, so it jumps straight there.</summary>
    public static float Follow(float value, float target, float rate) =>
        value < 0f ? target : value + (target - value) * Ease.Follow(rate, Dt);

    /// <summary>Eases a keyed value toward a target, independent of frame rate.</summary>
    public static float Approach(int key, float target, float rate)
    {
        if (!_anim.TryGetValue(key, out float v))
            v = target;

        v += (target - v) * Ease.Follow(rate, Dt);
        if (MathF.Abs(target - v) < 0.001f)
            v = target;
        _anim[key] = v;
        return v;
    }

    private static float[] BuildLinear()
    {
        var table = new float[256];
        for (int i = 0; i < table.Length; i++)
            table[i] = MathF.Pow(i / 255f, 2.2f);
        return table;
    }
}
```
