`scripts/Ui/Overlay.cs`:

```cs
using BmSDK.Engine;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Gfx;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>Everything drawn over the game, in order: fades, HUD elements, the running list, the menu, toasts.</summary>
internal static class Overlay
{
    private const float ToastSeconds = 1.8f;
    private const float NoticeSeconds = 3f;

    private const float MaxFrame = 0.1f;

    private static FrameTimer _frame;
    private static double _noticeDue;
    private static float _menuAnim;
    private static float _radialAnim;
    private static float _toastLeft;
    private static float _toastLength = 1f;
    private static string _toastTitle = "";
    private static string _toastState = "";
    private static bool _toastOn;

    public static bool ShowRunningList;

    /// <summary>Set while a shared hotkey tries a command that may fail quietly, because another one follows it.</summary>
    public static bool Muted;

    /// <summary>Brief feedback for a hotkey. Hidden while the menu or radial is open, which show the change themselves, and under a notice.</summary>
    public static void Toast(string title, string state, bool on)
    {
        if (!Muted && !Menu.IsOpen && !Radial.IsLive && _noticeDue <= Clock.Now)
            Show(title, state, on, ToastSeconds);
    }

    /// <summary>A message the player must see, even over the menu. A hotkey's own DONE or FAILED won't replace it.</summary>
    public static void Notice(string title, string state, bool on)
    {
        if (Muted)
            return;

        _noticeDue = Clock.Now + NoticeSeconds;
        Show(title, state, on, NoticeSeconds);
    }

    private static void Show(string title, string state, bool on, float seconds)
    {
        _toastTitle = title;
        _toastState = state;
        _toastOn = on;
        _toastLeft = seconds;
        _toastLength = seconds;
    }

    public static void Draw(Canvas? canvas)
    {
        bool paused = World.Paused;
        if (Menu.IsOpen && (paused || !Menu.OwnsScreen))
        {
            Menu.Close();
            _menuAnim = 0f;
        }

        if (Radial.IsLive && paused)
        {
            Radial.Close();
            _radialAnim = 0f;
        }

        Dt = _frame.Step(MaxFrame);
        Time += Dt;

        Theme.Update(Dt);
        Fader.Advance(Dt);
        Menu.FlashLeft = Math.Max(0f, Menu.FlashLeft - Dt);
        _toastLeft = Math.Max(0f, _toastLeft - Dt);

        float target = Menu.IsOpen ? 1f : 0f;
        float speed = Menu.IsOpen ? 5f : 7f;
        _menuAnim = _menuAnim < target ? Math.Min(target, _menuAnim + Dt * speed) : Math.Max(target, _menuAnim - Dt * speed);

        // The radial snaps open faster than the menu, since it's held for a moment at a time, and leaves faster still.
        float radialTarget = Radial.Visible ? 1f : 0f;
        float radialSpeed = Radial.Visible ? 8f : 10f;
        _radialAnim = _radialAnim < radialTarget ? Math.Min(radialTarget, _radialAnim + Dt * radialSpeed) : Math.Max(radialTarget, _radialAnim - Dt * radialSpeed);

        bool list = ShowRunningList && _menuAnim <= 0f && _radialAnim <= 0f && !paused && Catalog.Ready && Catalog.ActiveCount > 0;
        bool hud = !paused && Fader.IsClear && Catalog.Ready && AnyHud();
        if (canvas == null || (_menuAnim <= 0f && _radialAnim <= 0f && _toastLeft <= 0f && !list && !hud && Fader.Level <= 0f))
            return;

        if (!Begin(canvas, out Font? font))
            return;

        try
        {
            if (Fader.Level > 0f)
                DrawFade();

            if (hud)
                DrawHud(canvas);

            if (list)
                DrawRunningList();

            if (_menuAnim > 0f)
                MenuView.Draw(_menuAnim);

            if (_radialAnim > 0f)
                RadialView.Draw(_radialAnim);

            if (_toastLeft > 0f)
                DrawToast();
        }
        finally
        {
            canvas.Font = font;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Most HUDs give way to the menu as it opens; a few are what the menu is working on, so they stay.</summary>
    private static bool Shows(Module m) => m.HasHud && (_menuAnim <= 0f || m.HudWithMenu);

    private static bool AnyHud()
    {
        foreach (Module m in App.Modules)
        {
            if (Shows(m))
                return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    private static void DrawHud(Canvas canvas)
    {
        foreach (Module m in App.Modules)
        {
            if (!Shows(m))
                continue;

            Alpha = 1f;
            try
            {
                m.Draw(canvas);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Log.Throttled("hud " + m.Name, m.Name + " HUD failed: " + Log.Why(ex));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void DrawFade()
    {
        float level = Math.Clamp(Fader.Level, 0f, 1f);
        Alpha = 1f;
        Rect(0f, 0f, Gfx.W, Gfx.H, Theme.Black, level);
        if (Fader.Caption.Length == 0)
            return;

        float cx = Gfx.W * 0.5f;
        float cy = Gfx.H * 0.5f;
        DrawSpinner(cx, cy - S(74), level);
        TextCentre(cx, cy - S(18), Fader.Caption, Theme.Accent, 0.86f, level);

        float bw = S(220);
        float bx = cx - bw * 0.5f;
        float by = cy + S(14);
        Rect(bx, by, bw, S(2), Theme.White, 0.08f * level);
        float seg = bw * 0.28f;
        float p = (float)(Time * 0.9 % 1.0);
        float sx = bx + (bw + seg) * p - seg;
        float x0 = Math.Max(bx, sx);
        float x1 = Math.Min(bx + bw, sx + seg);
        if (x1 > x0)
            Rect(x0, by, x1 - x0, S(2), Theme.Accent, 0.9f * level);
    }

    /// <summary>The game's own spinning bat symbol, a strip of square frames, tinted with the menu colour.</summary>
    private const string SpinnerTexture = "BmFonts.Loading_DVDIcon";
    private const float SpinnerFps = 14f;

    /// <summary>Draws the spinner centred on a point; <paramref name="size"/> is in unscaled pixels.</summary>
    public static void DrawSpinner(float cx, float cy, float level, float size = 64f)
    {
        if (Find(SpinnerTexture) is not { } strip || strip.SizeY <= 0)
            return;

        int frames = Math.Max(1, strip.SizeX / strip.SizeY);
        int frame = (int)(Time * SpinnerFps) % frames;
        size = S(size);
        Rgba tint = Rgba.Mix(Theme.Accent, Theme.White, 0.3f);
        Sprite(strip, cx - size * 0.5f, cy - size * 0.5f, size, size, frame * strip.SizeY, 0f, strip.SizeY, strip.SizeY, tint, level);
    }

    private static void DrawRunningList()
    {
        Alpha = 1f;
        const float scale = 0.72f;
        float lh = S(21);
        var names = new List<string>();
        float w = TextW("ORACLE", scale) + S(30);
        foreach (Feature f in Catalog.All)
        {
            if (!f.Active)
                continue;

            string name = f is Toggle ? f.Label : f.Label + "  " + f.State;
            names.Add(name);
            w = Math.Max(w, TextW(name, scale) + S(34));
        }

        float x = Gfx.W - w - S(24);
        float y = S(150);
        float h = S(32) + names.Count * lh + S(8);
        Rect(x, y, w, h, Theme.Panel, 0.75f);
        Rect(x + w - S(2), y, S(2), h, Theme.Accent, 0.9f);
        Text(x + S(12), y + S(9), "ORACLE", Theme.Accent, scale);
        float ly = y + S(32);
        foreach (string n in names)
        {
            Rect(x + S(12), ly + lh * 0.5f - S(2), S(4), S(4), Theme.Accent, 0.8f);
            TextMid(x + S(22), ly + lh * 0.5f, n, Theme.Mid, scale);
            ly += lh;
        }
    }

    private static void DrawToast()
    {
        Alpha = Ease.Out(Math.Min(1f, _toastLeft / 0.3f) * Math.Min(1f, (_toastLength - _toastLeft) / 0.15f));

        const float scale = 0.9f;
        Rgba col = _toastOn ? Theme.Accent : Theme.Low;
        float tw = TextW(_toastTitle, scale);
        float sw = TextW(_toastState, scale);
        float w = tw + sw + S(64);
        float h = S(40);
        float x = (Gfx.W - w) * 0.5f;
        float y = S(150) - S(10) * (1f - Alpha);

        Rect(x + S(4), y + S(5), w, h, Theme.Black, 0.3f);
        Rect(x, y, w, h, Theme.Panel);
        Rect(x, y, S(3), h, col);
        Rect(x, y, w, S(1), col, 0.5f);
        TextMid(x + S(22), y + h * 0.5f, _toastTitle, Theme.Hi, scale);
        TextMid(x + S(22) + tw + S(20), y + h * 0.5f, _toastState, col, scale);
    }
}

/// <summary>Drives the per-frame update from the viewport, which keeps running when game ticks stop.</summary>
internal static class RenderHook
{
    [Redirect(typeof(GameViewportClient), "PostRender")]
    private static void PostRender(GameViewportClient self, Canvas canvas)
    {
        self.PostRender(canvas);
        Safe.Run("frame", () => App.Frame(canvas));
    }
}
```

`scripts/Ui/Radial.cs`:

```cs
namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The favourites radial: a wheel of features held open with one key or button. Point at a slot with the mouse,
/// a stick, WASD or the arrows, then let go to use it. Number keys use a slot at once, and Q / E (LB / RB) turn
/// to the next page of favourites.
///
/// Opened from the menu instead (HOME on a row, or ARRANGE RADIAL), the same wheel is the editor: place a feature
/// in any slot on any page, pick one up and move it, or take it off.
///
/// A used slot does exactly what its hotkey would: a switch flips, a slider jumps to its preset and back, a
/// choice moves on, a command runs. Rows that change the save can't go on the radial, as they can't be hotkeys.
/// </summary>
internal static class Radial
{
    public enum Source
    {
        Keyboard,
        Pad,
    }

    /// <summary>How far from the centre (0 to 1 of the ring) the pointer must be before it picks a slot.</summary>
    private const float Deadzone = 0.3f;

    /// <summary>1080p pixels of mouse travel from the centre to the rim at MOUSE SPEED 1.</summary>
    private const float MouseReach = 160f;

    /// <summary>A stick must lean this far (0 to 1) to point.</summary>
    private const float StickLean = 0.5f;

    /// <summary>How long a slot placed from a menu row stays on screen before the editor hands back to the menu.</summary>
    private const float PlacedHold = 0.5f;

    // ---- settings (SYSTEM > RADIAL) ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    public static bool Enabled = true;

    /// <summary>RADIAL MODE: HOLD uses the slot under the pointer when the key is let go; TAP keeps the wheel open until the key is pressed again.</summary>
    public static bool HoldMode = true;

    public static float MouseSpeed = 1f;

    /// <summary>RADIAL SIZE, on top of the screen's own scale.</summary>
    public static float Size = 1f;

    /// <summary>RADIAL BUTTON on a controller, as a button name for <see cref="Pad"/>: "rs", "ls", "lb+rb" or "off".</summary>
    public static string PadButton = "rs";

    public static readonly string[] PadIds = { "rs", "ls", "lb+rb", "off" };
    public static readonly string[] PadNames = { "R3 (RIGHT STICK)", "L3 (LEFT STICK)", "LB + RB", "OFF" };

    /// <summary>RADIAL KEY options; the first is the default. MOUSE 4 leads because the game uses the middle button.</summary>
    public static readonly string[] KeyIds = { "xbutton1", "xbutton2", "mbutton", "z", "m", "capital" };
    public static readonly string[] KeyNames = { "MOUSE 4", "MOUSE 5", "MIDDLE MOUSE", "Z", "M", "CAPS LOCK" };
    private static readonly Keys[] KeyCodes = { Keys.XButton1, Keys.XButton2, Keys.MButton, Keys.Z, Keys.M, Keys.Capital };

    public static Keys Key { get; private set; } = Keys.XButton1;

    /// <summary>The radial key's name for on-screen hints.</summary>
    public static string KeyLabel { get; private set; } = "MOUSE 4";

    public static void SetKey(int index)
    {
        index = Math.Clamp(index, 0, KeyCodes.Length - 1);
        Key = KeyCodes[index];
        KeyLabel = KeyNames[index];
    }

    /// <summary>Keys the open radial listens to, for the fallback that reads the keyboard itself.</summary>
    public static readonly Keys[] WatchKeys = BuildWatch();

    // ---- state ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>Open over the game, held or tapped open.</summary>
    public static bool IsLive { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Open over the menu as the editor.</summary>
    public static bool Arranging { get; private set; }

    public static bool Visible => IsLive || Arranging;

    public static Source OpenedBy { get; private set; }

    public static int Page { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>The slot on this page under the pointer, or -1.</summary>
    public static int Hover { get; private set; } = -1;

    /// <summary>The pointer, from the centre: 1 is the ring's edge. Screen directions, so +Y is down.</summary>
    public static float PointX { get; private set; }

    public static float PointY { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>Which way the last page turn went, for the wheel's spin.</summary>
    public static int PageDir { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>In the editor: the feature being placed or moved.</summary>
    public static string? Hand { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>In the editor: the slot the feature in hand was lifted from, or -1 when it came from a menu row.</summary>
    public static int HandFrom { get; private set; } = -1;

    /// <summary>The last slot used or placed, by its index across all pages, when, and whether it worked.</summary>
    public static int Flashed { get; private set; } = -1;

    public static double FlashedAt { get; private set; } = -10.0;

    public static bool FlashOk { get; private set; }

    public static int Slots => Favourites.PerPage;

    /// <summary>Pages on the wheel. The editor shows one blank page past the last used one, to start a new page on.</summary>
    public static int Pages => Arranging && Favourites.Count > 0 ? Math.Min(Favourites.MaxPages, Favourites.UsedPages + 1) : Favourites.UsedPages;

    public static Feature? HoverFeature => Hover < 0 ? null : Favourites.At(Page, Hover);

    public static double OpenedAt { get; private set; }

    private static bool _keyWas;
    private static bool _leftWas;
    private static bool _rightWas;
    private static bool _mouseArmed;
    private static int _centreX;
    private static int _centreY;
    private static int _usedSlot = -1;
    private static bool _fromRow;
    private static double _closeAt = -1.0;

    // ESC closes the radial, so the game's ESC stays muted until the key is back up: the game may handle the same
    // press after Oracle does, and would open the pause menu.
    private static bool _releaseLater;
    private static bool _reholdLater;

    // ---- geometry ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>The centre angle of a slot in screen degrees: slot 0 points straight up and the rest follow clockwise.</summary>
    public static float SlotAngle(int slot, int slots) => -90f + slot * 360f / slots;

    private static int SlotAt(float x, float y, int slots)
    {
        float degrees = MathF.Atan2(y, x) * 180f / MathF.PI + 90f;
        float step = 360f / slots;
        int slot = (int)MathF.Floor((degrees + step * 0.5f) / step);
        return ((slot % slots) + slots) % slots;
    }

    // ---- live wheel -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>Whether the wheel may open over the game right now.</summary>
    public static bool CanOpen() =>
        Enabled && !IsLive && !Arranging && !Menu.IsOpen && World.InGame && !World.Paused && !Transition.Busy && Fader.IsClear && Shared.MenuOwner == null;

    /// <summary>Runs every rendered frame: watches the radial key, the pointer and the mouse buttons.</summary>
    public static void Frame()
    {
        HandBackEscape();

        bool front = Native.GameInFront();
        bool key = front && Enabled && Native.Down(Key);
        bool pressed = key && !_keyWas;
        _keyWas = key;

        if (Arranging)
        {
            if (!Menu.IsOpen || (_closeAt >= 0.0 && Gfx.Time >= _closeAt))
                EndArrange();
            else if (Page >= Pages)
                Page = Pages - 1;
            return;
        }

        if (!IsLive)
        {
            if (pressed && CanOpen())
                Open(Source.Keyboard);
            return;
        }

        if (World.Paused || !World.InGame || Menu.IsOpen || Transition.Busy || Shared.MenuOwner != Menu.OwnerName)
        {
            Close();
            return;
        }

        if (Page >= Pages)
            Page = Pages - 1;

        // Switching away from the game isn't letting go of the key: close without using anything.
        if (!front)
        {
            if (OpenedBy == Source.Keyboard)
                Close();
            return;
        }

        if (OpenedBy == Source.Keyboard)
        {
            if (HoldMode && !key)
            {
                Release();
                return;
            }

            if (!HoldMode && pressed)
            {
                Close();
                return;
            }
        }

        // The mouse is read even while WASD points, so its movement meanwhile is thrown away rather than saved up.
        bool keys = PollDirectionKeys();
        PollMouse(apply: !keys);

        bool left = Native.Down(Keys.LButton);
        if (left && !_leftWas)
            Use();
        _leftWas = left;

        bool right = Native.Down(Keys.RButton);
        if (right && !_rightWas)
            Close();
        _rightWas = right;
    }

    public static void Open(Source source)
    {
        if (!CanOpen())
            return;

        IsLive = true;
        _releaseLater = false;
        OpenedBy = source;
        OpenedAt = Gfx.Time;
        Hover = -1;
        PointX = 0f;
        PointY = 0f;
        PageDir = 0;
        _usedSlot = -1;
        if (Page >= Pages)
            Page = 0;

        _leftWas = Native.Down(Keys.LButton);
        _rightWas = Native.Down(Keys.RButton);
        _mouseArmed = false;
        ArmMouse();

        Shared.MenuOwner = Menu.OwnerName;
        Menu.HoldInput(pointer: true, escape: true);
        RadialView.Opened();
    }

    /// <summary>Closes the live wheel without using anything.</summary>
    public static void Close()
    {
        if (!IsLive)
            return;

        IsLive = false;
        if (!Menu.IsOpen && Shared.MenuOwner == Menu.OwnerName)
            Shared.MenuOwner = null;

        if (Native.Down(Keys.Escape))
            _releaseLater = true;
        else
            Menu.ReleaseMovement();
        Pad.MenuClosed();
    }

    /// <summary>Gives the game its keys back once ESC is up, after the radial or editor closed on an ESC press.</summary>
    private static void HandBackEscape()
    {
        if ((!_releaseLater && !_reholdLater) || Native.Down(Keys.Escape))
            return;

        if (_releaseLater && !IsLive && !Menu.IsOpen)
            Menu.ReleaseMovement();
        if (_reholdLater && Menu.IsOpen && !Arranging)
            Menu.HoldInput();
        _releaseLater = false;
        _reholdLater = false;
    }

    /// <summary>The radial key or button was let go: use the slot under the pointer, unless it was just clicked, and close.</summary>
    public static void Release()
    {
        Feature? f = HoverFeature;
        bool use = f != null && Hover != _usedSlot;
        int flat = Page * Slots + Hover;
        Close();
        if (use)
            Run(f!, flat);
    }

    /// <summary>Uses the slot under the pointer and keeps the wheel open, for switching several things in a row.</summary>
    public static void Use()
    {
        if (!IsLive || HoverFeature is not { } f)
            return;

        _usedSlot = Hover;
        Run(f, Page * Slots + Hover);
    }

    public static void TurnPage(int dir)
    {
        int pages = Pages;
        if (pages <= 1)
            return;

        Page = (Page + dir + pages) % pages;
        PageDir = dir;
        _usedSlot = -1;
        RadialView.PageTurned();
    }

    /// <summary>A key while the live wheel is open. Everything is swallowed, so nothing on the keyboard runs a hotkey meanwhile.</summary>
    public static void Press(Keys key)
    {
        if (!IsLive)
            return;

        int digit = Digit(key);
        if (digit >= 0)
        {
            if (digit < Slots)
            {
                Aim(digit);
                Use();
            }

            return;
        }

        switch (key)
        {
            case Keys.Q:
            case Keys.PageUp:
                TurnPage(-1);
                break;
            case Keys.E:
            case Keys.Tab:
            case Keys.PageDown:
                TurnPage(1);
                break;
            case Keys.Enter:
            case Keys.Space:
                Use();
                break;
            case Keys.Escape:
            case Keys.Back:
                Close();
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A controller stick, in screen directions (+Y down). Leaning far enough points; letting go keeps the slot.</summary>
    public static void PointStick(float x, float y)
    {
        float lean = MathF.Sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        if (lean < StickLean)
            return;

        Point(x / lean, y / lean, mouse: false);
    }

    /// <summary>A switch flips, a slider jumps, a choice moves on, a command runs: what the feature's hotkey does.</summary>
    private static void Run(Feature f, int flat)
    {
        if (!f.Bindable)
            return;

        Flashed = flat;
        FlashedAt = Gfx.Time;
        if (f is Command c)
        {
            FlashOk = Catalog.Run(c);
            Overlay.Toast(f.Label, FlashOk ? "DONE" : "FAILED", FlashOk);
            return;
        }

        f.Hotkey();
        Catalog.Commit(f, "radial");
        FlashOk = true;
        Overlay.Toast(f.Label, f.State, !f.IsDefault);
    }

    private static void Aim(int slot)
    {
        float a = SlotAngle(slot, Slots) * MathF.PI / 180f;
        Point(MathF.Cos(a), MathF.Sin(a), mouse: false);
        Hover = slot;
    }

    private static void Point(float x, float y, bool mouse)
    {
        float len = MathF.Sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        if (len > 1f)
        {
            x /= len;
            y /= len;
            len = 1f;
        }

        PointX = x;
        PointY = y;

        // Back in the middle with the mouse means "none of them", so letting go there uses nothing.
        int slot = len < Deadzone ? (mouse ? -1 : Hover) : SlotAt(x, y, Slots);
        if (slot != Hover)
        {
            Hover = slot;
            _usedSlot = -1;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>WASD and the arrows point in eight directions. Returns true while any of them is held.</summary>
    private static bool PollDirectionKeys()
    {
        int dx = (Native.Down(Keys.D) || Native.Down(Keys.Right) ? 1 : 0) - (Native.Down(Keys.A) || Native.Down(Keys.Left) ? 1 : 0);
        int dy = (Native.Down(Keys.S) || Native.Down(Keys.Down) ? 1 : 0) - (Native.Down(Keys.W) || Native.Down(Keys.Up) ? 1 : 0);
        if (dx == 0 && dy == 0)
            return false;

        float len = MathF.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        Point(dx / len, dy / len, mouse: false);
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The mouse moves a pointer inside the wheel. The game hides the cursor, so it's read and put back in the
    /// middle of the window each frame, and the game's own mouse look is muted while the wheel is open.
    /// </summary>
    private static void PollMouse(bool apply)
    {
        if (!_mouseArmed)
        {
            ArmMouse();
            return;
        }

        if (!Native.CursorAt(out int x, out int y))
            return;

        int dx = x - _centreX;
        int dy = y - _centreY;
        if (dx == 0 && dy == 0)
            return;

        Native.MoveCursor(_centreX, _centreY);

        // A one-pixel step is jitter, or a game that centres the cursor a pixel off ours; either way not a move.
        if (!apply || (Math.Abs(dx) <= 1 && Math.Abs(dy) <= 1))
            return;

        float reach = MouseReach * Math.Max(0.5f, Gfx.Scale) / Math.Max(0.1f, MouseSpeed);
        Point(PointX + dx / reach, PointY + dy / reach, mouse: true);
    }

    private static void ArmMouse()
    {
        if (!Native.GameCentre(out _centreX, out _centreY))
            return;

        Native.MoveCursor(_centreX, _centreY);
        _mouseArmed = true;
    }

    // ---- editor -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>
    /// Opens the editor over the menu. With a feature, it's in hand: lifted from its slot if it's already on the
    /// radial, or ready to place in the first free slot if not. Without one, slots can be picked up and moved.
    /// </summary>
    public static void BeginArrange(Feature? f)
    {
        if (IsLive)
            Close();
        if (!Menu.IsOpen)
            Menu.Open();
        if (!Menu.IsOpen)
            return;

        Arranging = true;
        _reholdLater = false;
        Menu.HoldInput(escape: true);   // ESC finishes arranging; it mustn't also pause the game
        _fromRow = f != null;
        _closeAt = -1.0;
        Hand = f?.Id;
        HandFrom = f == null ? -1 : Favourites.IndexOf(f.Id);
        PageDir = 0;

        int at = HandFrom >= 0 ? HandFrom : f != null ? Favourites.FirstFree() : -1;
        if (at < 0)
            at = Math.Clamp(Page, 0, Pages - 1) * Slots;

        Page = at / Slots;
        Aim(at % Slots);
        RadialView.Opened();
    }

    public static void EndArrange()
    {
        if (!Arranging)
            return;

        Arranging = false;
        Hand = null;
        HandFrom = -1;
        _closeAt = -1.0;

        // Back to the menu's usual keys, ESC live again so the pause menu still opens from the menu.
        if (Menu.IsOpen)
        {
            if (Native.Down(Keys.Escape))
                _reholdLater = true;
            else
                Menu.HoldInput();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A menu key while the editor is open. The editor takes every key until it closes.</summary>
    public static bool EditorPress(Keys key, bool repeat)
    {
        if (_closeAt >= 0.0)
        {
            if (key is Keys.Escape or Keys.Back)
                EndArrange();
            return true;
        }

        int digit = Digit(key);
        if (digit >= 0)
        {
            if (!repeat && digit < Slots)
                Aim(digit);
            return true;
        }

        switch (key)
        {
            case Keys.Left:
            case Keys.Up:
                Aim((Math.Max(Hover, 0) - 1 + Slots) % Slots);
                break;
            case Keys.Right:
            case Keys.Down:
                Aim((Hover + 1) % Slots);
                break;
            case Keys.PageUp:
            case Keys.Q:
                if (!repeat)
                    TurnPage(-1);
                break;
            case Keys.PageDown:
            case Keys.Tab:
            case Keys.E:
                if (!repeat)
                    TurnPage(1);
                break;
            case Keys.Enter:
            case Keys.Space:
                if (!repeat)
                    Place();
                break;
            case Keys.Delete:
            case Keys.X:
                if (!repeat)
                    Remove();
                break;
            case Keys.Escape:
            case Keys.Back:
            case Menu.FavouriteKey:
                if (!repeat)
                    EndArrange();
                break;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// ENTER in the editor: with something in hand, puts it in the slot (an occupant swaps places with a moved
    /// favourite, or is replaced by a new one); with nothing in hand, picks up the slot's favourite.
    /// </summary>
    private static void Place()
    {
        if (Hover < 0)
            return;

        int target = Page * Slots + Hover;
        if (Hand == null)
        {
            if (Favourites.At(target) is { } f)
            {
                Hand = f.Id;
                HandFrom = target;
            }

            return;
        }

        if (HandFrom >= 0)
            Favourites.Swap(HandFrom, target);
        else
            Favourites.Put(target, Hand);

        Hand = null;
        HandFrom = -1;
        Flash(target, true);
        if (_fromRow)
            _closeAt = Gfx.Time + PlacedHold;
    }

    /// <summary>DELETE in the editor: takes the favourite in hand (or under the pointer) off the radial.</summary>
    private static void Remove()
    {
        if (Hand != null)
        {
            if (HandFrom >= 0)
            {
                Favourites.Empty(HandFrom);
                Flash(HandFrom, false);
            }

            Hand = null;
            HandFrom = -1;
            if (_fromRow)
                _closeAt = Gfx.Time + PlacedHold;
            return;
        }

        int target = Page * Slots + Hover;
        if (Hover >= 0 && Favourites.At(target) != null)
        {
            Favourites.Empty(target);
            Flash(target, false);
        }
    }

    private static void Flash(int flat, bool ok)
    {
        Flashed = flat;
        FlashedAt = Gfx.Time;
        FlashOk = ok;
    }

    public static void Shutdown()
    {
        Close();
        EndArrange();
    }

    // ---- keys -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>1 to 9 then 0 for slots 1 to 10, from either row of number keys. -1 for any other key.</summary>
    private static int Digit(Keys key)
    {
        int n = key >= Keys.D0 && key <= Keys.D9 ? key - Keys.D0 : key >= Keys.NumPad0 && key <= Keys.NumPad9 ? key - Keys.NumPad0 : -1;
        return n < 0 ? -1 : n == 0 ? 9 : n - 1;
    }

    private static Keys[] BuildWatch()
    {
        var keys = new List<Keys> { Keys.Q, Keys.E, Keys.Tab, Keys.Enter, Keys.Space, Keys.Escape, Keys.Back, Keys.PageUp, Keys.PageDown };
        for (Keys k = Keys.D0; k <= Keys.D9; k++)
            keys.Add(k);
        for (Keys k = Keys.NumPad0; k <= Keys.NumPad9; k++)
            keys.Add(k);
        return keys.ToArray();
    }
}

```

`scripts/Ui/RadialView.cs`:

```cs
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Gfx;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Draws the favourites radial in the menu's style: dark glass, the accent colour, corner brackets, decoding
/// text and a light that sweeps the edges. Slots are segments of a ring around a hub that reads out the slot
/// under the pointer. The highlight glides between slots, slots cascade in when the wheel opens and spin in when
/// the page turns, and a used slot flashes and sends a ripple out from the hub.
/// </summary>
internal static class RadialView
{
    // Geometry in 1080p pixels at RADIAL SIZE 100%.
    private const float HubR = 90f;
    private const float RingIn = 118f;
    private const float RingOut = 256f;
    private const float Lift = 12f;
    private const float GapPx = 6f;
    private const float NumberR = 268f;
    private const float TickIn = 280f;
    private const float TickOut = 287f;
    private const float RailR = 296f;
    private const float HaloR = 314f;

    private const float LabelScale = 0.6f;
    private const float StateScale = 0.54f;
    private const float TagScale = 0.5f;
    private const float HubTitleScale = 0.95f;
    private const float HubLabelScale = 0.74f;
    private const float HubStateScale = 1.1f;
    private const float ChipScale = 0.54f;
    private const float HintScale = 0.6f;
    private const float HintH = 26f;

    private const float FlashSeconds = 0.55f;
    private const float SpinSeconds = 0.32f;
    private const int AnimKey = 0x5AD1A100;
    private const float Rad = MathF.PI / 180f;

    private static readonly Dictionary<(string, int, float), string[]> _lines = new();
    private static readonly List<(string Key, string Label)> _hints = new();
    private static Dictionary<Feature, string>? _paths;

    private static float _openAge;
    private static float _pageAge = 10f;
    private static float _hoverAge;
    private static int _lastHover = -2;
    private static float _hoverAngle = float.NaN;
    private static float _hoverShow;
    private static float _pip = -1f;
    private static float _zoom = 1f;

    // Each slot's drawn angle, lift and fade this frame, kept for the number pass drawn over the highlight.
    private static readonly float[] _numMid = new float[Favourites.MaxPerPage];
    private static readonly float[] _numLift = new float[Favourites.MaxPerPage];
    private static readonly float[] _numAlpha = new float[Favourites.MaxPerPage];

    // The wheel's solid surfaces. DrawTris draws solid in AK, so every translucent touch is mixed against the
    // surface beneath it (Shapes.Under): the halo behind everything, a slot's glass, an empty slot, the hub.
    private static Rgba _halo;
    private static Rgba _glass;
    private static Rgba _bare;
    private static Rgba _hubFill;

    public static void Opened()
    {
        _openAge = 0f;
        _pageAge = 10f;
        _hoverShow = 0f;
        _hoverAngle = float.NaN;
        _lastHover = -2;
        _pip = -1f;
    }

    public static void PageTurned() => _pageAge = 0f;

    private static bool Effects => MenuView.Effects;

    private static float Pulse => Effects ? 0.82f + 0.18f * MathF.Sin((float)Time * 3.2f) : 1f;

    /// <summary>0 to 1 as the n-th piece eases in after <paramref name="age"/> starts counting.</summary>
    private static float Cascade(float age, int n, float delay) =>
        Effects ? Ease.Out(Math.Clamp((age - n * delay) / 0.22f, 0f, 1f)) : 1f;

    /// <summary>A distance on the wheel: scaled to the screen and RADIAL SIZE, and by the open zoom.</summary>
    private static float R(float v) => S(v) * _zoom;

    private static float Wrap(float degrees) => ((degrees % 360f) + 540f) % 360f - 180f;

    public static void Draw(float anim)
    {
        float screenScale = Scale;
        Scale *= Radial.Size;
        try
        {
            DrawWheel(anim);
        }
        finally
        {
            Scale = screenScale;
            Shapes.Under = Theme.Panel;
        }
    }

    private static void DrawWheel(float anim)
    {
        float e = Ease.Out(anim);
        Alpha = e;
        _zoom = 0.8f + 0.2f * e;
        _openAge += Dt;
        _pageAge += Dt;
        _hoverAge += Dt;

        Rgba accent = Theme.Accent;
        _halo = Rgba.Mix(Theme.Black, Theme.Panel, 0.55f);
        _glass = Rgba.Mix(Theme.Panel, accent, 0.05f);
        _bare = Rgba.Mix(_halo, Theme.Panel, 0.5f);
        _hubFill = Rgba.Mix(_halo, Theme.Panel, 0.4f);
        int slots = Radial.Slots;
        int pages = Radial.Pages;
        int page = Math.Clamp(Radial.Page, 0, pages - 1);
        float step = 360f / slots;
        float cx = Gfx.W * 0.5f;
        float cy = Gfx.H * 0.5f;

        int hover = Radial.Hover;
        if (hover != _lastHover)
        {
            _hoverAge = 0f;
            _lastHover = hover;
        }

        // The highlight glides the short way round to the slot under the pointer, and fades when there's none.
        if (hover >= 0)
        {
            float want = Radial.SlotAngle(hover, slots);
            _hoverAngle = float.IsNaN(_hoverAngle) || _hoverShow <= 0.01f ? want : _hoverAngle + Wrap(want - _hoverAngle) * Ease.Follow(22f, Dt);
        }

        _hoverShow = Math.Clamp(_hoverShow + (hover >= 0 ? Dt : -Dt) * 8f, 0f, 1f);

        // Backdrop: the game dims, and more over the menu, so the editor reads clearly on top of it.
        Rect(0f, 0f, Gfx.W, Gfx.H, Theme.Black, Radial.Arranging ? 0.6f : 0.38f);

        DrawFrame(cx, cy, slots, step, accent);

        // A page turn spins the ring in from the side it turned toward.
        float spin = Effects ? -Radial.PageDir * 26f * (1f - Ease.Out(Math.Clamp(_pageAge / SpinSeconds, 0f, 1f))) : 0f;
        float gap = GapPx / ((RingIn + RingOut) * 0.5f) / Rad;
        for (int i = 0; i < slots; i++)
        {
            float appear = Math.Min(Cascade(_openAge, i, 0.03f), Cascade(_pageAge, i, 0.018f));
            float outer = Alpha;
            Alpha *= appear;
            DrawSlot(cx, cy, page, i, slots, Radial.SlotAngle(i, slots) + spin * (1.6f - appear * 0.6f), step, gap, hover, accent);
            Alpha = outer;
        }

        DrawHighlight(cx, cy, step, gap, accent);
        DrawNumbers(cx, cy, slots, hover, accent);
        DrawHub(cx, cy, page, pages, slots, accent);
        DrawRipple(cx, cy, accent);

        float below = cy + R(HaloR) + S(18);
        below = DrawPages(cx, below, page, pages, accent);
        DrawHints(cx, below + S(10));
    }

    // ---- frame around the ring --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private static void DrawFrame(float cx, float cy, int slots, float step, Rgba accent)
    {
        float halo = R(HaloR);
        Shapes.Under = Theme.Black;
        Shapes.Disc(cx, cy, halo, _halo, 1f);
        Shapes.Under = _halo;
        Shapes.Ring(cx, cy, halo - S(1), halo, accent, 0.3f);

        if (!Theme.LowEnd)
        {
            // Faint guide lines through the centre and a mid ring, like the layout grid on the menu's panels.
            Shapes.Line(cx - halo + S(8), cy, cx + halo - S(8), cy, S(1), accent, 0.04f);
            Shapes.Line(cx, cy - halo + S(8), cx, cy + halo - S(8), S(1), accent, 0.04f);
            Shapes.Ring(cx, cy, R(RingIn - 12f), R(RingIn - 11f), accent, 0.06f);
        }

        // A slowly turning scale of fine ticks, and fixed longer ticks at every slot boundary.
        float turn = Effects ? (float)(Time * 5.0 % 360.0) : 0f;
        Shapes.Ticks(cx, cy, R(TickIn), R(TickOut), Theme.LowEnd ? 36 : 90, turn, S(1.2f), accent, 0.2f);
        Shapes.Ticks(cx, cy, R(TickIn - 4f), R(TickOut + 4f), slots, -90f - step * 0.5f, S(2f), accent, 0.55f);

        // The outer rail, with a light running round it.
        float rail = R(RailR);
        Shapes.Ring(cx, cy, rail, rail + S(1.5f), accent, 0.2f);
        if (Effects && !Theme.LowEnd)
        {
            float head = (float)(Time * 80.0 % 360.0);
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
                Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, rail - S(0.5f), rail + S(2f), head - 14f * (k + 1), head - 14f * k, Rgba.Mix(accent, Theme.White, 0.3f - k * 0.07f), 0.7f * (1f - k / 4f));
        }
    }

    // ---- slots ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private static void DrawSlot(float cx, float cy, int page, int i, int slots, float mid, float step, float gap, int hover, Rgba accent)
    {
        int flat = page * slots + i;
        bool over = i == hover;
        float lift = Approach(AnimKey + i, over ? 1f : 0f, 16f);
        float a0 = mid - step * 0.5f + gap * 0.5f;
        float a1 = mid + step * 0.5f - gap * 0.5f;
        float r0 = R(RingIn) + S(3f) * lift;
        float r1 = R(RingOut) + S(Lift) * lift;

        Feature? f = Favourites.At(flat);
        bool arranging = Radial.Arranging;
        bool lifted = arranging && Radial.Hand != null && Radial.HandFrom == flat;
        Feature? hand = arranging && over && Radial.Hand != null && Catalog.ById.TryGetValue(Radial.Hand, out Feature? h) ? h : null;
        bool dropping = hand != null;

        _numMid[i] = mid;
        _numLift[i] = lift;
        _numAlpha[i] = Alpha;

        if (f == null && hand == null)
        {
            DrawEmpty(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1, mid, over, lift, accent);
            DrawFlash(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1, flat);
            Shapes.Under = _halo;
            return;
        }

        float body = lifted && !over ? 0.4f : 1f;
        float outer = Alpha;
        Alpha *= body;

        // Glass, then an accent wash that deepens toward the rim, so a lit slot glows from its edge in. It stays
        // dark enough under the label for white text to read.
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1, _glass, 1f);
        Shapes.Under = _glass;
        float wash = dropping ? 0.2f * Pulse : 0.03f + 0.13f * lift;
        Shapes.FadeArc(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1, accent, wash * 0.3f, wash * 1.6f, 4);

        // The rim: a bright lip along the outer edge, thicker and whiter on the slot under the pointer.
        Rgba rim = over ? Rgba.Mix(accent, Theme.White, 0.3f * Pulse) : accent;
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, r1 - S(2.5f + 2f * lift), r1, a0, a1, rim, 0.35f + 0.65f * lift);
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, r0, r0 + S(1f), a0, a1, Theme.White, 0.08f);

        // Running: the inner edge lights up, like the tick a running row gets in the menu.
        float arm = Math.Min(6f, (a1 - a0) * 0.22f);
        if (f is { Active: true } && !dropping)
            Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, r0, r0 + S(4f), a0 + arm * 0.5f, a1 - arm * 0.5f, accent, 0.9f);

        DrawFlash(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1, flat);

        // Corner brackets, as on every menu panel: short arcs off the outer corners and strokes down the sides.
        // They sit on the halo, outside the glass.
        Shapes.Under = _halo;
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, r1 + S(3f), r1 + S(5f), a0, a0 + arm, accent, 0.9f);
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, r1 + S(3f), r1 + S(5f), a1 - arm, a1, accent, 0.9f);
        Spoke(cx, cy, a0, r1 - S(14f), r1 + S(5f), S(2f), accent, 0.9f);
        Spoke(cx, cy, a1, r1 - S(14f), r1 + S(5f), S(2f), accent, 0.9f);

        if (dropping)
            Shapes.Dashes(cx, cy, r0 - S(5f), r0 - S(3f), a0, a1, 4f, 3f, Theme.White, 0.5f * Pulse);

        Feature shown = dropping ? hand! : f!;
        (string state, Rgba stateCol) = SlotState(shown, dropping ? f : null, dropping, lifted, accent);
        DrawContent(cx, cy, r0, r1, mid, step, over, shown.Label, state, stateCol);
        Alpha = outer;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The line under a slot's label. In the editor it says what ENTER would do there; on the live wheel it's the
    /// feature's state, or DONE / FAILED just after a command ran.
    /// </summary>
    private static (string, Rgba) SlotState(Feature f, Feature? occupant, bool dropping, bool lifted, Rgba accent)
    {
        if (Radial.Arranging)
        {
            if (dropping && lifted)
                return ("PUT BACK", accent);
            if (dropping && occupant == null)
                return ("PLACE HERE", accent);
            if (dropping)
                return Radial.HandFrom >= 0 ? ("SWAP", accent) : ("REPLACE", Theme.Warn);
            if (lifted)
                return ("MOVING", accent);
            return (StateText(f), f.Active ? accent : Theme.Low);
        }

        bool flashing = f is Command && Favourites.At(Radial.Flashed) == f && Time - Radial.FlashedAt < 1.2;
        if (flashing)
            return Radial.FlashOk ? ("DONE", accent) : ("FAILED", Theme.Warn);
        return (StateText(f), f.Active ? accent : Theme.Low);
    }

    private static void DrawEmpty(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, float a0, float a1, float mid, bool over, float lift, Rgba accent)
    {
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1, _bare, 1f);
        Shapes.Under = _bare;
        if (lift > 0.01f)
            Shapes.FadeArc(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1, accent, 0.02f * lift, 0.12f * lift, 3);

        float edge = over ? 0.5f : 0.16f;
        Shapes.Dashes(cx, cy, r1 - S(1.5f), r1, a0, a1, 3f, 2.5f, over ? accent : Theme.White, edge);
        Shapes.Dashes(cx, cy, r0, r0 + S(1.5f), a0, a1, 3f, 2.5f, Theme.White, edge * 0.6f);

        float rm = (r0 + r1) * 0.5f;
        float tx = cx + MathF.Cos(mid * Rad) * rm;
        float ty = cy + MathF.Sin(mid * Rad) * rm;
        string text = Radial.Arranging ? "+" : "EMPTY";
        float scale = Radial.Arranging ? 1.1f : TagScale;
        TextCentre(tx, ty - TextH(scale) * 0.5f, text, over ? Theme.Mid : Theme.Low, scale, Radial.Arranging ? 0.6f + 0.4f * lift : 1f);
    }

    /// <summary>A used or placed slot flashes white (or the warning colour if it failed or was taken off).</summary>
    private static void DrawFlash(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, float a0, float a1, int flat)
    {
        if (flat != Radial.Flashed)
            return;

        float t = (float)(Time - Radial.FlashedAt) / FlashSeconds;
        if (t is >= 0f and < 1f)
            Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1, Radial.FlashOk ? Theme.White : Theme.Warn, 0.5f * (1f - t) * (1f - t));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Each slot's number key, in the gap between the ring and the outer ticks. Drawn after the highlight, so the
    /// hovered slot's number (pushed out with its slot) stays on top, on a small dark plate over the ticks and glow.
    /// </summary>
    private static void DrawNumbers(float cx, float cy, int slots, int hover, Rgba accent)
    {
        float outer = Alpha;
        float th = TextH(TagScale);
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(slots, 10); i++)
        {
            Alpha = _numAlpha[i];
            string n = i == 9 ? "0" : (i + 1).ToString();
            float lift = _numLift[i];
            float r = R(NumberR) + S(Lift + 2f) * lift;
            float x = cx + MathF.Cos(_numMid[i] * Rad) * r;
            float y = cy + MathF.Sin(_numMid[i] * Rad) * r;
            if (lift > 0.01f)
            {
                float w = TextW(n, TagScale) + S(10f);
                float h = th + S(4f);
                Rect(x - w * 0.5f, y - h * 0.5f, w, h, _halo, 0.95f * lift);
                Rect(x - w * 0.5f, y + h * 0.5f - S(1f), w, S(1f), accent, 0.8f * lift);
            }

            TextCentre(x, y - th * 0.5f, n, i == hover ? accent : Theme.Low, TagScale);
        }

        Alpha = outer;
    }

    /// <summary>The label (two lines at most) and the state line beneath it, centred in the slot.</summary>
    private static void DrawContent(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, float mid, float step, bool over, string label, string state, Rgba stateCol)
    {
        float rm = (r0 + r1) * 0.5f;
        float tx = cx + MathF.Cos(mid * Rad) * rm;
        float ty = cy + MathF.Sin(mid * Rad) * rm;
        float room = Math.Min(S(150f), 2f * rm * MathF.Sin(Math.Min(step, 120f) * 0.5f * Rad) * 0.8f);

        string[] lines = Lines(label, room, LabelScale);
        state = Clip(state, room, StateScale);
        float lh = TextH(LabelScale);
        float sh = TextH(StateScale);
        float total = lh * lines.Length + S(4f) + sh;
        float y = ty - total * 0.5f;
        Rgba labelCol = over ? Theme.Hi : Theme.Mid;
        foreach (string line in lines)
        {
            Shadowed(tx, y, line, labelCol, LabelScale);
            y += lh;
        }

        Shadowed(tx, y + S(4f), state, stateCol, StateScale);
    }

    /// <summary>Centred text with a dark shadow a pixel down and right, so it reads on a lit slot.</summary>
    private static void Shadowed(float cx, float y, string text, Rgba col, float scale)
    {
        float o = Math.Max(1f, MathF.Round(S(1.2f)));
        TextCentre(cx + o, y + o, text, Theme.Black, scale, 0.75f);
        TextCentre(cx, y, text, col, scale);
    }

    private static string StateText(Feature f) => f switch
    {
        Toggle t => t.On ? "ON" : "OFF",
        Command => "RUN",
        _ => f.State,
    };

    /// <summary>What letting go (or clicking) does to a feature, for the hub.</summary>
    private static string Verb(Feature f) => f switch
    {
        Toggle t => t.On ? "TURN OFF" : "TURN ON",
        Slider s => s.IsDefault ? "SET " + s.Format(s.HotValue) : "RESET",
        Choice => "NEXT OPTION",
        _ => "RUN",
    };

    /// <summary>A short radial stroke at an angle, between two radii.</summary>
    private static void Spoke(float cx, float cy, float degrees, float r0, float r1, float thick, Rgba col, float alpha)
    {
        float c = MathF.Cos(degrees * Rad);
        float s = MathF.Sin(degrees * Rad);
        Shapes.Line(cx + c * r0, cy + s * r0, cx + c * r1, cy + s * r1, thick, col, alpha);
    }

    // ---- highlight, hub and ripple ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>The highlight that glides between slots: a bright segment on the outer rail and a notch by the hub.</summary>
    private static void DrawHighlight(float cx, float cy, float step, float gap, Rgba accent)
    {
        if (_hoverShow <= 0f || float.IsNaN(_hoverAngle))
            return;

        float outer = Alpha;
        Alpha *= Ease.Out(_hoverShow);
        float a0 = _hoverAngle - step * 0.5f + gap;
        float a1 = _hoverAngle + step * 0.5f - gap;
        float rail = R(RailR);
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, rail - S(2f), rail + S(3.5f), a0, a1, accent, 0.95f * Pulse);
        Shapes.FadeArc(cx, cy, rail - S(16f), rail - S(2f), a0, a1, accent, 0f, 0.14f, 3);

        // A small chevron on the rail, pointing out of the wheel.
        float c = MathF.Cos(_hoverAngle * Rad);
        float s = MathF.Sin(_hoverAngle * Rad);
        float tip = rail + S(14f);
        float baseR = rail + S(6f);
        float half = S(6f);
        Shapes.Triangle(cx + c * tip, cy + s * tip, cx + c * baseR - s * half, cy + s * baseR + c * half, cx + c * baseR + s * half, cy + s * baseR - c * half, accent, 0.95f);
        Alpha = outer;
    }

    private static void DrawHub(float cx, float cy, int page, int pages, int slots, Rgba accent)
    {
        float hub = R(HubR);
        Shapes.Disc(cx, cy, hub, _hubFill, 1f);
        Shapes.Under = _hubFill;
        Shapes.Ring(cx, cy, hub - S(1.5f), hub, accent, 0.55f);
        if (!Theme.LowEnd)
            Shapes.Ring(cx, cy, hub - S(9f), hub - S(8f), Theme.White, 0.05f);
        Shapes.Under = _halo;

        // Two arcs circling the hub one way and a thinner one the other, like Oracle's scanning displays.
        float turn = Effects ? (float)(Time * 48.0 % 360.0) : 0f;
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, hub + S(5f), hub + S(8f), turn, turn + 70f, accent, 0.7f);
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, hub + S(5f), hub + S(8f), turn + 180f, turn + 250f, accent, 0.7f);
        if (!Theme.LowEnd)
            Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, hub + S(12f), hub + S(13.5f), -turn * 0.6f, -turn * 0.6f + 120f, accent, 0.3f);

        DrawPointer(cx, cy, hub, accent);
        DrawReadout(cx, cy, hub, page, pages, slots, accent);
    }

    /// <summary>Where the pointer leans: a lit notch on the hub's edge and an arrow just outside it.</summary>
    private static void DrawPointer(float cx, float cy, float hub, Rgba accent)
    {
        float x = Radial.PointX;
        float y = Radial.PointY;
        float lean = Math.Min(1f, MathF.Sqrt(x * x + y * y));
        if (lean < 0.05f)
            return;

        float a = MathF.Atan2(y, x) / Rad;
        Shapes.Under = _hubFill;
        Shapes.Arc(cx, cy, hub - S(4f), hub + S(1f), a - 16f, a + 16f, Rgba.Mix(accent, Theme.White, 0.25f), 0.9f * lean);
        Shapes.Under = _halo;

        float c = MathF.Cos(a * Rad);
        float s = MathF.Sin(a * Rad);
        float tip = hub + S(4f) + R(RingIn - HubR - 6f) * Math.Max(0.35f, lean);
        float baseR = hub + S(3f);
        float half = S(6f);
        Shapes.Triangle(cx + c * tip, cy + s * tip, cx + c * baseR - s * half, cy + s * baseR + c * half, cx + c * baseR + s * half, cy + s * baseR - c * half, accent, 0.85f * lean);
    }

    /// <summary>The hub's text: the slot under the pointer, or the wheel's own title and page.</summary>
    private static void DrawReadout(float cx, float cy, float hub, int page, int pages, int slots, Rgba accent)
    {
        float room = hub * 1.6f;
        Feature? f = Radial.HoverFeature;

        if (Radial.Arranging)
        {
            Feature? hand = Radial.Hand != null && Catalog.ById.TryGetValue(Radial.Hand, out Feature? h) ? h : null;
            string doing = hand == null ? "PICK A SLOT" : Radial.HandFrom >= 0 ? "MOVING" : "PLACING";
            string what = hand?.Label ?? (f != null ? f.Label : "EMPTY SLOT");
            Stack(cx, cy, room, MenuView.Decode("ARRANGE", _openAge), doing, what,
                "SLOT " + (Radial.Hover + 1) + "  PAGE " + (page + 1) + " / " + pages, accent, hand != null ? accent : Theme.Mid);
            return;
        }

        if (Favourites.Count == 0)
        {
            Stack(cx, cy, room, "RADIAL", "NO FAVOURITES YET", "", Pad.InUse ? "PRESS Y ON A MENU ROW" : "PRESS HOME ON A MENU ROW", accent, Theme.Low);
            return;
        }

        if (f != null)
        {
            string path = PathOf(f);
            string value = f is Toggle t ? (t.On ? "ON" : "OFF") : f is Command ? "" : f.State;
            float lineH = TextH(HubLabelScale);
            string[] label = Lines(f.Label, room, HubLabelScale);
            float valueH = value.Length > 0 ? TextH(HubStateScale) + S(2f) : 0f;
            float tagH = TextH(TagScale);
            float total = tagH + S(6f) + lineH * label.Length + S(4f) + valueH + S(4f) + tagH;
            float y = cy - total * 0.5f;
            TextCentre(cx, y, Clip(path, room, TagScale), Theme.Low, TagScale);
            y += tagH + S(6f);
            foreach (string line in label)
            {
                TextCentre(cx, y, MenuView.Decode(line, _hoverAge), Theme.Hi, HubLabelScale);
                y += lineH;
            }

            y += S(4f);
            if (value.Length > 0)
            {
                TextCentre(cx, y, Clip(value, room, HubStateScale), f.Active ? accent : Theme.Mid, HubStateScale);
                y += valueH;
            }

            string hint = (Radial.HoldMode && Radial.IsLive ? "LET GO TO " : "CLICK TO ") + Verb(f);
            TextCentre(cx, y + S(4f), Clip(hint, room, TagScale), accent, TagScale);
            return;
        }

        string title = MenuView.Decode("ORACLE", _openAge);
        string sub = Radial.Hover >= 0 ? "EMPTY SLOT" : "FAVOURITES";
        Stack(cx, cy, room, title, sub, "", "PAGE " + (page + 1) + " / " + pages, accent, Theme.Mid);
    }

    /// <summary>A centred block: a letter-spaced title, an accent tag, an optional line, and a quiet footnote.</summary>
    private static void Stack(float cx, float cy, float room, string title, string tag, string line, string foot, Rgba accent, Rgba lineCol)
    {
        float titleH = TextH(HubTitleScale);
        float tagH = TextH(TagScale);
        float lineH = TextH(StateScale);
        string[] lines = line.Length > 0 ? Lines(line, room, StateScale) : Array.Empty<string>();
        float total = titleH + (tag.Length > 0 ? S(4f) + tagH : 0f) + (lines.Length > 0 ? S(8f) + lineH * lines.Length : 0f) + (foot.Length > 0 ? S(8f) + tagH : 0f);
        float y = cy - total * 0.5f;

        float spacing = 3f;
        float tw = Theme.LowEnd ? TextW(title, HubTitleScale) : SpacedWidth(title, HubTitleScale, spacing);
        if (Theme.LowEnd)
            Text(cx - tw * 0.5f, y, title, Theme.Hi, HubTitleScale);
        else
            Spaced(cx - tw * 0.5f, y, title, Theme.Hi, HubTitleScale, spacing);
        y += titleH;

        if (tag.Length > 0)
        {
            TextCentre(cx, y + S(4f), Clip(tag, room, TagScale), accent, TagScale);
            y += S(4f) + tagH;
        }

        if (lines.Length > 0)
        {
            y += S(8f);
            foreach (string l in lines)
            {
                TextCentre(cx, y, l, lineCol, StateScale);
                y += lineH;
            }
        }

        if (foot.Length > 0)
            TextCentre(cx, y + S(8f), Clip(foot, room * 1.1f, TagScale), Theme.Low, TagScale);
    }

    private static float SpacedWidth(string text, float scale, float spacing)
    {
        float w = 0f;
        foreach (char ch in text)
            w += TextW(ch.ToString(), scale) + S(spacing);
        return Math.Max(0f, w - S(spacing));
    }

    /// <summary>A ring that races out from the hub when a slot is used: the accent colour, or the warning colour on a failure.</summary>
    private static void DrawRipple(float cx, float cy, Rgba accent)
    {
        float t = (float)(Time - Radial.FlashedAt) / FlashSeconds;
        if (!Effects || t is < 0f or >= 1f || Radial.Arranging)
            return;

        float r = R(HubR) + (R(RailR) - R(HubR)) * Ease.Out(t);
        Shapes.Ring(cx, cy, r, r + S(1f) + S(3f) * (1f - t), Radial.FlashOk ? accent : Theme.Warn, 0.6f * (1f - t));
    }

    // ---- pages and key strip ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>One segment per page under the wheel, the current one lit, with the page keys either side. Returns where it ends.</summary>
    private static float DrawPages(float cx, float y, int page, int pages, Rgba accent)
    {
        if (pages <= 1 && !Radial.Arranging)
            return y;

        float w = S(28f);
        float gap = S(6f);
        float h = S(4f);
        float total = pages * w + (pages - 1) * gap;
        float x0 = cx - total * 0.5f;
        float tagH = TextH(TagScale);
        TextCentre(cx, y, "PAGE " + (page + 1) + " / " + pages, Theme.Mid, TagScale);
        float by = y + tagH + S(7f);

        for (int p = 0; p < pages; p++)
        {
            bool spare = Radial.Arranging && p == pages - 1 && p >= Favourites.UsedPages;
            Rect(x0 + p * (w + gap), by, w, h, Theme.White, spare ? 0.05f : 0.14f);
        }

        _pip = Follow(_pip, page, 18f);
        Rect(x0 + _pip * (w + gap), by, w, h, accent, 0.95f);

        bool pad = Pad.InUse;
        float cyKeys = by + h * 0.5f;
        string back = pad ? "LB" : "Q";
        string next = pad ? "RB" : "E";
        float bw = Chip(0f, 0f, back, Theme.Hi, 0f, measure: true);
        Chip(x0 - S(12f) - bw, cyKeys, back, Theme.Hi, 0.1f);
        Chip(x0 + total + S(12f), cyKeys, next, Theme.Hi, 0.1f);
        return by + h + S(8f);
    }

    /// <summary>The key strip under the wheel, in the menu's style. It changes with how the wheel was opened and what's in hand.</summary>
    private static void DrawHints(float cx, float y)
    {
        BuildHints();
        float pad = S(10f);
        float space = S(16f);
        float w = pad * 2f - space;
        foreach ((string key, string label) in _hints)
            w += Chip(0f, 0f, key, Theme.Hi, 0f, measure: true) + S(6f) + TextW(label, HintScale) + space;

        float h = S(HintH);
        float x = cx - w * 0.5f;
        float mid = y + h * 0.5f;
        Rect(x, y, w, h, Theme.Panel, 0.86f);
        Rect(x, y, w, S(1f), Theme.Accent, 0.5f);

        float hx = x + pad;
        foreach ((string key, string label) in _hints)
        {
            hx += Chip(hx, mid, key, Theme.Hi, 0.1f) + S(6f);
            hx += TextMid(hx, mid, label, Theme.Mid, HintScale) + space;
        }
    }

    private static void BuildHints()
    {
        _hints.Clear();
        bool pad = Pad.InUse;
        int slots = Radial.Slots;
        string digits = slots >= 10 ? "1-0" : "1-" + slots;

        if (Radial.Arranging)
        {
            string act = Radial.Hand != null ? "PLACE" : "PICK UP";
            if (pad)
            {
                _hints.Add(("STICK", "SLOT"));
                _hints.Add(("A", act));
                _hints.Add(("X", "REMOVE"));
                _hints.Add(("B", "DONE"));
            }
            else
            {
                _hints.Add(("< >", "SLOT"));
                _hints.Add(("ENTER", act));
                _hints.Add(("DEL", "REMOVE"));
                _hints.Add(("TAB", "PAGE"));
                _hints.Add(("ESC", "DONE"));
            }

            return;
        }

        bool hold = Radial.HoldMode;
        if (pad && Radial.OpenedBy == Radial.Source.Pad)
        {
            _hints.Add(("STICK", "POINT"));
            if (hold)
                _hints.Add(("RELEASE", "USE"));
            _hints.Add(("A", hold ? "USE, STAY" : "USE"));
            _hints.Add(("B", "CANCEL"));
            return;
        }

        _hints.Add(("MOUSE", "POINT"));
        if (hold)
            _hints.Add(("LET GO", "USE"));
        _hints.Add(("CLICK", hold ? "USE, STAY" : "USE"));
        _hints.Add((digits, "QUICK USE"));
        _hints.Add(("RMB", "CANCEL"));
    }

    /// <summary>A small boxed key name, vertically centred on <paramref name="cy"/>. Returns its width; with measure, draws nothing.</summary>
    private static float Chip(float x, float cy, string text, Rgba col, float fill, bool measure = false)
    {
        float w = TextW(text, ChipScale) + S(9f);
        if (measure)
            return w;

        float h = TextH(ChipScale) + S(2f);
        float y = cy - h * 0.5f;
        Rect(x, y, w, h, col, fill);
        if (!Theme.LowEnd)
        {
            float t = Math.Max(1f, MathF.Round(S(1f)));
            Rect(x, y, w, t, col, 0.4f);
            Rect(x, y + h - t, w, t, col, 0.4f);
            Rect(x, y + t, t, h - t * 2f, col, 0.4f);
            Rect(x + w - t, y + t, t, h - t * 2f, col, 0.4f);
        }

        TextMid(x + S(4.5f), cy, text, col, ChipScale);
        return w;
    }

    // ---- text helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>Wraps text to at most two lines that fit, the second cut short with ".." if it runs over. Cached.</summary>
    private static string[] Lines(string text, float room, float scale)
    {
        var key = (text, (int)room, scale * Scale);
        if (_lines.TryGetValue(key, out string[]? lines))
            return lines;
        if (_lines.Count > 512)
            _lines.Clear();

        string rest = FitLine(text, room, scale, out string first);
        if (first.Length == 0 || TextW(first, scale) > room)
        {
            first = Clip(text, room, scale);
            rest = "";
        }

        lines = rest.Length == 0 ? new[] { first } : new[] { first, Clip(rest, room, scale) };
        _lines[key] = lines;
        return lines;
    }

    private static string Clip(string text, float room, float scale)
    {
        if (TextW(text, scale) <= room)
            return text;

        int len = text.Length;
        while (len > 1 && TextW(text.Substring(0, len).TrimEnd() + "..", scale) > room)
            len--;
        return text.Substring(0, len).TrimEnd() + "..";
    }

    /// <summary>Where a feature lives in the menu, like "PLAYER / COMBAT", for the hub.</summary>
    private static string PathOf(Feature f)
    {
        if (_paths == null)
        {
            _paths = new Dictionary<Feature, string>();
            foreach (MenuPage page in Catalog.Pages)
            {
                foreach (MenuRow row in page.Rows)
                {
                    if (row.Item != null)
                        _paths.TryAdd(row.Item, page.Title);
                }

                foreach (MenuPage child in page.Children)
                {
                    foreach (MenuRow row in child.Rows)
                    {
                        if (row.Item != null)
                            _paths.TryAdd(row.Item, page.Title + " / " + child.Title);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return _paths.GetValueOrDefault(f, "");
    }
}
```

```cs
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.Engine;
using FColor = BmSDK.GameObject.FColor;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Gfx;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// Filled shapes the Canvas has no call for: arcs, rings, discs and slanted quads. Each shape is built from
/// quads and sent to the game in one Canvas.DrawTris call, so a whole ring costs one script call, not one per
/// segment. Angles are in degrees on screen: 0 points right and they run clockwise, because screen y runs down.
/// </summary>
internal static unsafe class Shapes
{
    /// <summary>Floats per triangle: three corners of x, y, u, v, the native FCanvasUVTri layout (48 bytes).</summary>
    private const int TriFloats = 12;

    /// <summary>The longest an arc segment's outer edge may be, in 1080p pixels, before the arc gets another.</summary>
    private const float SegmentPx = 7f;

    private const float Rad = MathF.PI / 180f;

    private static TArray<Canvas.FCanvasUVTri>? _tris;
    private static float[] _buf = new float[TriFloats * 512];
    private static int _count;
    private static bool _broken;

    /// <summary>
    /// The colour under the shapes being drawn. AK's DrawTris ignores alpha and always draws solid (seen in game,
    /// 2026-11-05), so a translucent shape is drawn as the solid colour it would blend to over this. Callers set it
    /// to whatever they've drawn beneath; the global <see cref="Gfx.Alpha"/> fades shapes toward it too.
    /// </summary>
    public static Rgba Under = new(6, 13, 20);

    /// <summary>
    /// True once DrawTris has failed. Shapes then fall back to one rotated tile per quad: rougher edges and more
    /// calls, but the radial still draws.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool Broken => _broken;

    /// <summary>Frees the triangle buffer. Called when the mod unloads.</summary>
    public static void Release()
    {
        TArray<Canvas.FCanvasUVTri>? tris = _tris;
        _tris = null;
        try
        {
            tris?.Dispose();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Info("Shapes: could not free the triangle buffer: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }

    // ---- shapes -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// <summary>A band between two radii from angle <paramref name="a0"/> to <paramref name="a1"/>. An inner radius of 0 fills to the centre.</summary>
    public static void Arc(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, float a0, float a1, Rgba col, float alpha)
    {
        if (r1 <= r0 || a1 <= a0 || !Visible(col, alpha))
            return;

        AddArc(cx, cy, r0, r1, a0, a1);
        Flush(col, alpha);
    }

    public static void Ring(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, Rgba col, float alpha) =>
        Arc(cx, cy, r0, r1, 0f, 360f, col, alpha);

    public static void Disc(float cx, float cy, float r, Rgba col, float alpha) =>
        Arc(cx, cy, 0f, r, 0f, 360f, col, alpha);

    /// <summary>
    /// An arc whose brightness fades across its width: <paramref name="bands"/> thin arcs from
    /// <paramref name="inner"/> alpha at r0 to <paramref name="outer"/> alpha at r1.
    /// </summary>
    public static void FadeArc(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, float a0, float a1, Rgba col, float inner, float outer, int bands)
    {
        bands = Theme.LowEnd ? Math.Min(bands, 3) : bands;
        float step = (r1 - r0) / bands;
        for (int i = 0; i < bands; i++)
            Arc(cx, cy, r0 + step * i, r0 + step * (i + 1), a0, a1, col, inner + (outer - inner) * ((i + 0.5f) / bands));
    }

    /// <summary>A straight bar from one point to another, <paramref name="thick"/> wide.</summary>
    public static void Line(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float thick, Rgba col, float alpha)
    {
        if (!Visible(col, alpha))
            return;

        AddLine(x0, y0, x1, y1, thick);
        Flush(col, alpha);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Adds a bar to a batch that <see cref="FlushLines"/> draws in one call, for many lines of one colour (the
    /// editor's boxes). Nothing else may be drawn with Shapes between the two.
    /// </summary>
    public static void QueueLine(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float thick) => AddLine(x0, y0, x1, y1, thick);

    /// <summary>Draws every queued line, solid. Lines over the game world have no known colour under them to blend with.</summary>
    public static void FlushLines(Rgba col)
    {
        if (_count > 0)
            Flush(col with { A = 255 }, 1f);
    }

    /// <summary>A solid triangle.</summary>
    public static void Triangle(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, Rgba col, float alpha)
    {
        if (!Visible(col, alpha))
            return;

        AddQuad(x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, x2, y2);
        Flush(col, alpha);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Short radial strokes around a circle, all in one call: <paramref name="count"/> ticks spaced evenly from
    /// <paramref name="start"/>, each <paramref name="width"/> pixels wide.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Ticks(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, int count, float start, float width, Rgba col, float alpha)
    {
        if (count <= 0 || !Visible(col, alpha))
            return;

        float step = 360f / count;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            float a = (start + step * i) * Rad;
            float c = MathF.Cos(a);
            float s = MathF.Sin(a);
            AddLine(cx + c * r0, cy + s * r0, cx + c * r1, cy + s * r1, width);
        }

        Flush(col, alpha);
    }

    /// <summary>A dashed arc: dashes of <paramref name="dash"/> degrees with <paramref name="gap"/> degrees between, in one call.</summary>
    public static void Dashes(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, float a0, float a1, float dash, float gap, Rgba col, float alpha)
    {
        if (!Visible(col, alpha) || dash <= 0f)
            return;

        for (float a = a0; a < a1; a += dash + gap)
            AddArc(cx, cy, r0, r1, a, Math.Min(a1, a + dash));
        Flush(col, alpha);
    }

    // ---- building ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private static bool Visible(Rgba col, float alpha) => col.A * alpha * Gfx.Alpha >= 0.5f;

    private static void AddArc(float cx, float cy, float r0, float r1, float a0, float a1)
    {
        float seg = S(Theme.LowEnd ? SegmentPx * 2f : SegmentPx);
        int n = Math.Clamp((int)MathF.Ceiling((a1 - a0) * Rad * r1 / Math.Max(1f, seg)), 1, 180);
        float step = (a1 - a0) / n;
        float c0 = MathF.Cos(a0 * Rad);
        float s0 = MathF.Sin(a0 * Rad);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        {
            float a = (a0 + step * i) * Rad;
            float c1 = MathF.Cos(a);
            float s1 = MathF.Sin(a);
            AddQuad(cx + c0 * r0, cy + s0 * r0, cx + c0 * r1, cy + s0 * r1, cx + c1 * r1, cy + s1 * r1, cx + c1 * r0, cy + s1 * r0);
            c0 = c1;
            s0 = s1;
        }
    }

    private static void AddLine(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float thick)
    {
        float dx = x1 - x0;
        float dy = y1 - y0;
        float len = MathF.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (len <= 0.001f)
            return;

        float nx = -dy / len * thick * 0.5f;
        float ny = dx / len * thick * 0.5f;

        // Corners go across the bar first (a to b), then along it (b to c), the same order an arc segment uses.
        AddQuad(x0 - nx, y0 - ny, x0 + nx, y0 + ny, x1 + nx, y1 + ny, x1 - nx, y1 - ny);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Queues a quad as two triangles. Corners run a, b, c, d around it: a to b crosses the shape (an arc
    /// segment's inner to outer edge) and b to c runs along it. The rotated-tile fallback depends on that order.
    /// </summary>
    private static void AddQuad(float ax, float ay, float bx, float by, float cx, float cy, float dx, float dy)
    {
        int need = (_count + 2) * TriFloats;
        if (need > _buf.Length)
            Array.Resize(ref _buf, Math.Max(need, _buf.Length * 2));

        int i = _count * TriFloats;
        Corner(i, ax, ay);
        Corner(i + 4, bx, by);
        Corner(i + 8, cx, cy);
        Corner(i + 12, ax, ay);
        Corner(i + 16, cx, cy);
        Corner(i + 20, dx, dy);
        _count += 2;
    }

    private static void Corner(int i, float x, float y)
    {
        _buf[i] = x;
        _buf[i + 1] = y;
        _buf[i + 2] = 0.5f;
        _buf[i + 3] = 0.5f;
    }

    // ---- drawing ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private static void Flush(Rgba col, float alpha)
    {
        int n = _count;
        _count = 0;
        if (n == 0 || WhiteTexture is not { } white)
            return;

        float t = Math.Clamp(col.A / 255f * alpha * Gfx.Alpha, 0f, 1f);
        var solid = new Rgba((byte)(Under.R + (col.R - Under.R) * t), (byte)(Under.G + (col.G - Under.G) * t), (byte)(Under.B + (col.B - Under.B) * t));
        const byte a = 255;
        col = solid;
        if (_broken)
        {
            DrawTiles(white, n, col, a);
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            _tris ??= new TArray<Canvas.FCanvasUVTri>(Math.Max(512, n));

            // The array only ever grows: Push blank triangles once when it's too small, then set the count in its
            // header (data pointer, count, capacity) for each shape, which costs nothing per triangle.
            if (_tris.Capacity < n)
                _tris.Push(new Canvas.FCanvasUVTri[n - _tris.Count]);
            if (_tris.Capacity < n)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the triangle buffer didn't grow");

            *(int*)(_tris.Ptr + 8) = n;
            float* dst = *(float**)_tris.Ptr;
            if (dst == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("the triangle buffer has no memory");

            fixed (float* src = _buf)
                Buffer.MemoryCopy(src, dst, (long)n * TriFloats * sizeof(float), (long)n * TriFloats * sizeof(float));

            C.DrawTris(white, _tris, new FColor { R = col.R, G = col.G, B = col.B, A = a });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _broken = true;
            Log.Info("Shapes: DrawTris failed (" + ex.Message + "), drawing the radial with rotated tiles instead.");
            DrawTiles(white, n, col, a);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The fallback: each queued quad as one tile rotated to match it, sized from the averages of its opposite
    /// edges. Exact for rectangles and close for the thin segments arcs are made of.
    /// </summary>
    private static void DrawTiles(Texture2D white, int triangles, Rgba col, byte a)
    {
        try
        {
            C.SetDrawColor(col.R, col.G, col.B, a);
            for (int q = 0; q + 1 < triangles; q += 2)
            {
                int i = q * TriFloats;
                float ax = _buf[i], ay = _buf[i + 1];
                float bx = _buf[i + 4], by = _buf[i + 5];
                float cx = _buf[i + 8], cy = _buf[i + 9];
                float dx = _buf[i + 20], dy = _buf[i + 21];

                // Along the shape: a to d and b to c. Across it: a to b and d to c.
                float ux = (dx - ax + cx - bx) * 0.5f;
                float uy = (dy - ay + cy - by) * 0.5f;
                float vx = (bx - ax + cx - dx) * 0.5f;
                float vy = (by - ay + cy - dy) * 0.5f;
                float len = MathF.Sqrt(ux * ux + uy * uy);
                float thick = MathF.Sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
                if (len < 0.5f || thick < 0.5f)
                    continue;

                float mx = (ax + bx + cx + dx) * 0.25f;
                float my = (ay + by + cy + dy) * 0.25f;
                float yaw = MathF.Atan2(uy, ux) / Rad;
                C.SetPos(mx - len * 0.5f, my - thick * 0.5f, 0f);
                C.DrawRotatedTile(white, Rotator.FromRuu(0, (int)(yaw * 65536f / 360f), 0), len + 0.5f, thick, 0f, 0f, 32f, 32f, 0.5f, 0.5f);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log.Throttled("shapes tiles", "Shapes: rotated tiles failed too: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }
}
```
