`scripts/Ui/Theme.cs`:

```cs
namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

internal readonly record struct Rgba(byte R, byte G, byte B, byte A = 255)
{
    public static Rgba Mix(Rgba a, Rgba b, float t)
    {
        t = Math.Clamp(t, 0f, 1f);
        return new Rgba((byte)(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * t), (byte)(a.G + (b.G - a.G) * t), (byte)(a.B + (b.B - a.B) * t), (byte)(a.A + (b.A - a.A) * t));
    }

    /// <summary>A colour of a hue in degrees at full brightness, as 0..1 channels. Saturation 1 is pure colour.</summary>
    public static (float R, float G, float B) Hue(float degrees, float saturation)
    {
        float h = ((degrees % 360f) + 360f) % 360f / 60f;
        float f = h - MathF.Floor(h);
        float p = 1f - saturation;
        float q = 1f - saturation * f;
        float t = 1f - saturation * (1f - f);
        return ((int)MathF.Floor(h) % 6) switch
        {
            0 => (1f, t, p),
            1 => (q, 1f, p),
            2 => (p, 1f, t),
            3 => (p, q, 1f),
            4 => (t, p, 1f),
            _ => (1f, p, q),
        };
    }

    public static Rgba From(float r, float g, float b) =>
        new((byte)(Math.Clamp(r, 0f, 1f) * 255f), (byte)(Math.Clamp(g, 0f, 1f) * 255f), (byte)(Math.Clamp(b, 0f, 1f) * 255f));
}

/// <summary>The palette and the selected accent colour.</summary>
internal static class Theme
{
    /// <summary>The panel backing: a near-black tinted faintly toward the accent, like the glass of Oracle's screens.</summary>
    public static Rgba Panel { get; private set; } = new(6, 13, 20, 240);

    /// <summary>
    /// A second, warm highlight for small markers (running rows, the LIVE light), after the orange dashes on
    /// Oracle's displays. It turns cyan when the accent itself is warm, so the two always contrast.
    /// </summary>
    public static Rgba Signal { get; private set; } = new(255, 152, 54);

    private static readonly Rgba PanelBase = new(6, 9, 13, 240);
    private static readonly Rgba Orange = new(255, 152, 54);
    private static readonly Rgba Cyan = new(96, 204, 244);
    private const float PanelTint = 0.08f;

    public static readonly Rgba Hi = new(240, 246, 244);
    public static readonly Rgba Mid = new(176, 192, 188);
    public static readonly Rgba Low = new(112, 128, 126);
    public static readonly Rgba White = new(255, 255, 255);
    public static readonly Rgba Black = new(0, 0, 0);
    public static readonly Rgba Off = new(46, 56, 58);
    public static readonly Rgba Warn = new(255, 96, 82);

    /// <summary>ORACLE, the default, is the cyan of Oracle's own screens. Saved picks are stored by key, so reordering is safe.</summary>
    public static readonly string[] Keys = { "oracle", "emerald", "cyan", "blue", "violet", "magenta", "red", "orange", "gold", "white", "rainbow" };
    public static readonly string[] Names = { "ORACLE", "EMERALD", "CYAN", "BLUE", "VIOLET", "MAGENTA", "RED", "ORANGE", "GOLD", "WHITE", "RAINBOW" };

    private static readonly Rgba[] Colors =
    {
        new(96, 204, 244), new(54, 232, 162), new(64, 206, 255), new(84, 140, 255), new(158, 112, 255), new(240, 92, 220),
        new(255, 76, 76), new(255, 146, 48), new(255, 204, 64), new(226, 234, 238),
    };

    /// <summary>Accents warm enough that the orange signal colour would blend in: RED, ORANGE, GOLD.</summary>
    private static readonly int[] Warm = { 6, 7, 8 };

    private const int Rainbow = 10;
    private const float RainbowPeriod = 9f;
    private const float LowEndStep = 1f / 15f;
    private const float WheelSaturation = 0.73f;

    public static int Index;
    public static float RainbowSpeed = 1f;
    public static float MenuSize = 0.75f;
    public static bool LowEnd;

    private static float _hue;
    private static float _stepLeft;
    private static Rgba[]? _wheel;

    public static Rgba Accent { get; private set; } = Colors[0];

    public static void Update(float dt)
    {
        if (Index != Rainbow)
        {
            Accent = Colors[Math.Clamp(Index, 0, Colors.Length - 1)];
            Tint(Array.IndexOf(Warm, Index) >= 0);
            return;
        }

        _hue = (_hue + dt * RainbowSpeed / RainbowPeriod) % 1f;
        if (LowEnd)
        {
            _stepLeft -= dt;
            if (_stepLeft > 0f)
                return;
            _stepLeft = LowEndStep;
        }

        Accent = Wheel(_hue);
        Tint(_hue < 0.17f || _hue > 0.93f);
    }

    /// <summary>Follows the accent: the panel glass picks up a trace of it, and the signal colour keeps its contrast.</summary>
    private static void Tint(bool warm)
    {
        Rgba glass = Rgba.Mix(PanelBase, Accent, PanelTint);
        Panel = glass with { A = PanelBase.A };
        Signal = warm ? Cyan : Orange;
    }

    public static Rgba Swatch(int pick) => pick == Rainbow ? Wheel((float)(Gfx.Time / 9.0 % 1.0)) : Colors[Math.Clamp(pick, 0, Colors.Length - 1)];

    private static Rgba Wheel(float hue)
    {
        _wheel ??= BuildWheel();
        return _wheel[(int)(hue * _wheel.Length) % _wheel.Length];
    }

    private static Rgba[] BuildWheel()
    {
        var wheel = new Rgba[360];
        for (int i = 0; i < wheel.Length; i++)
        {
            (float r, float g, float b) = Rgba.Hue(i, WheelSaturation);
            wheel[i] = Rgba.From(r, g, b);
        }

        return wheel;
    }
}
```

`scripts/Ui/Uplink.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using static CeZeY.Oracle.Gfx;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// The ORACLE UPLINK readout in the empty lower half of the page list: a live signal trace and a few facts about
/// where Batman is. Game values are read twice a second, never while drawing, and every read is guarded.
/// </summary>
internal static class Uplink
{
    private const float RefreshSeconds = 0.5f;
    private const float TagScale = 0.5f;
    private const float ValueScale = 0.62f;
    private const float LineH = 15f;

    private static Every _refresh;
    private static bool _signal;
    private static string _near = "";
    private static string _range = "";
    private static string _clock = "";
    private static string _session = "";

    /// <summary>
    /// Draws into the band between the page rows and the search field. Skips itself when there's no room.
    /// <paramref name="appear"/> runs 0 to 1 as it arrives (and back as it leaves): it rises into place and its
    /// trace grows. <paramref name="decodeAge"/> drives the readout values decoding in, or scrambling out.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Draw(float x, float top, float w, float bottom, Rgba accent, bool effects, float appear, float decodeAge)
    {
        if (bottom - top < S(96))
            return;

        Refresh();

        float left = x + S(13);
        float right = x + w - S(13);
        float y = top + S(14) * (1f - appear);

        // Header: the tag and a blinking LIVE light.
        Rect(left, y, right - left, S(1), Theme.White, 0.06f);
        y += S(10);
        float tagH = TextH(TagScale);
        Text(left, y, "ORACLE UPLINK", accent, TagScale);
        string state = _signal ? "LIVE" : "NO SIGNAL";
        float sw = TextW(state, TagScale);
        Text(right - sw, y, state, _signal ? Theme.Mid : Theme.Warn, TagScale);
        bool lit = !_signal || !effects || Time * 1.6 % 1.0 < 0.6;
        if (lit)
            Rect(right - sw - S(9), y + tagH * 0.5f - S(2), S(4), S(4), _signal ? Theme.Signal : Theme.Warn);
        y += tagH + S(10);

        // The signal trace: mirrored bars that roll with time and jump when something is switched.
        float traceH = Math.Min(S(44), (bottom - y) * 0.4f);
        DrawTrace(left, y, right - left, traceH, accent, effects, appear);
        y += traceH + S(12);

        // Big readouts, like the numerals on Oracle's right-hand screen, when there's room for them and two lines.
        float bigH = TextH(BigScale) + S(5) + TextH(TagScale) + S(12);
        bool big = bottom - y >= bigH + S(LineH) * 2f;
        if (big)
        {
            float colW = (right - left) * 0.5f;
            Numeral(left, y, colW, MenuView.Decode(_clock, decodeAge - 0.1f), "LOCAL TIME", accent);
            Numeral(left + colW, y, colW, MenuView.Decode(Catalog.ActiveCount.ToString("00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), decodeAge - 0.16f), "RUNNING", accent);
            y += bigH;
        }

        // Readout lines, as many as fit.
        Line(ref y, bottom, left, right, "NEAREST", MenuView.Decode(_near, decodeAge - 0.22f));
        Line(ref y, bottom, left, right, "DISTANCE", MenuView.Decode(_range, decodeAge - 0.28f));
        if (!big)
            Line(ref y, bottom, left, right, "LOCAL TIME", MenuView.Decode(_clock, decodeAge - 0.34f));
        Line(ref y, bottom, left, right, "SESSION", MenuView.Decode(_session, decodeAge - 0.4f));
    }

    private const float BigScale = 1.3f;

    /// <summary>A large figure with a short accent bar and its label beneath.</summary>
    private static void Numeral(float x, float y, float w, string value, string label, Rgba accent)
    {
        float vh = TextH(BigScale);
        Text(x, y, value, Theme.Hi, BigScale);
        float by = y + vh + S(2);
        Rect(x, by, Math.Min(w - S(10), S(22)), S(2), accent, 0.9f);
        Text(x, by + S(4), label, Theme.Low, TagScale);
    }

    private static void Line(ref float y, float bottom, float left, float right, string label, string value)
    {
        if (value.Length == 0 || y + S(LineH) > bottom)
            return;

        float cy = y + S(LineH) * 0.5f;
        float lw = TextMid(left, cy, label, Theme.Low, TagScale);
        string shown = Fit(value, right - left - lw - S(10));
        TextRight(right, cy, shown, Theme.Mid, ValueScale);
        y += S(LineH);
    }

    private static string Fit(string text, float room)
    {
        if (TextW(text, ValueScale) <= room)
            return text;
        while (text.Length > 2 && TextW(text + "..", ValueScale) > room)
            text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1).TrimEnd();
        return text + "..";
    }

    private static void DrawTrace(float x, float y, float w, float h, Rgba accent, bool effects, float appear)
    {
        int bars = Theme.LowEnd ? 12 : 26;
        float gap = S(2);
        float bw = (w - gap * (bars - 1)) / bars;
        float mid = y + h * 0.5f;
        Rect(x, mid, w, S(1), accent, 0.18f);

        float t = effects ? (float)Time : 0f;
        float kick = Menu.Changed != null ? Math.Clamp(1f - (float)(Time - Menu.ChangedAt) / 0.6f, 0f, 1f) : 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < bars; i++)
        {
            float v;
            if (!_signal)
                v = 0.05f;
            else
            {
                v = 0.45f + 0.3f * MathF.Sin(t * 2.3f + i * 0.55f) + 0.2f * MathF.Sin(t * 4.1f - i * 1.3f) + 0.1f * MathF.Sin(t * 7.7f + i * 2.9f);
                v = Math.Clamp(v + kick * 0.6f * MathF.Sin(i * 0.9f + t * 12f), 0.08f, 1f);
            }

            // The bars grow out of the centre line from left to right as the readout arrives.
            v *= Math.Clamp(appear * 1.5f - i / (float)bars * 0.5f, 0f, 1f);
            float bh = Math.Max(S(1), h * 0.5f * v);
            Rect(x + i * (bw + gap), mid - bh, bw, bh * 2f, Rgba.Mix(accent, Theme.Hi, v * 0.35f), 0.25f + 0.6f * v);
        }
    }

    private static void Refresh()
    {
        if (!_refresh.Elapsed(RefreshSeconds))
            return;

        _clock = DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        var session = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Time);
        _session = session.TotalHours >= 1 ? ((int)session.TotalHours) + session.ToString("\\:mm\\:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : session.ToString("m\\:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        _signal = false;
        _near = "";
        _range = "";
        Safe.Run("uplink", () =>
        {
            if (!World.InGame || World.Pawn is not { } pawn)
                return;

            _signal = true;
            var at = pawn.Location;
            if (MapPlaces.Closest(MapPlaces.Groups[0], at) is { } place)
            {
                _near = place.Label;
                _range = Fmt.Metres(Geo.DistXY(place.At, at) / 100f);
            }
        });
    }
}

```

`scripts/Ui/WorldView.cs`:

```cs
using System.Numerics;
using BmSDK;
using BmSDK.Engine;

namespace CeZeY.Oracle;

/// <summary>
/// World-to-screen projection for drawing over the game world. The camera comes from GetPlayerViewPoint once a
/// frame and every point is projected here in C#, so a box's eight corners cost nothing. The scale is calibrated
/// each frame from one Canvas.Project call on a probe point, so it follows the game's real field of view and
/// aspect; if that call ever gives nonsense, the camera's FOV angle stands in.
/// </summary>
internal static class WorldView
{
    private const float ProbeAhead = 1000f;
    private const float ProbeSide = 250f;
    private const float NearPlane = 10f;

    private static float _cx, _cy, _kx, _ky;
    private static bool _reported;

    /// <summary>True once this frame's camera is known. Stays true (with last frame's camera) between frames.</summary>
    public static bool Ready { get; private set; }

    public static Vector3 Eye { get; private set; }
    public static Vector3 Forward { get; private set; }
    public static Vector3 Right { get; private set; }
    public static Vector3 Up { get; private set; }
    public static Rotator Rotation { get; private set; }

    public static float Width => _cx * 2f;
    public static float Height => _cy * 2f;

    /// <summary>Reads the camera for this frame. Call once at the start of drawing.</summary>
    public static void Begin(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Ready = false;
        if (World.Pc is not { } pc)
            return;

        if (!ReadCamera(pc))
            return;

        _cx = canvas.ClipX * 0.5f;
        _cy = canvas.ClipY * 0.5f;
        if (_cx <= 0f || _cy <= 0f)
            return;

        // The probe sits ahead of the camera, a quarter of the way out to the right and up, so its screen offset
        // from the centre is the projection scale times 0.25 on each axis.
        float ratio = ProbeSide / ProbeAhead;
        Vector3 s = canvas.Project(Eye + Forward * ProbeAhead + Right * ProbeSide + Up * ProbeSide);
        float kx = (s.X - _cx) / ratio;
        float ky = (_cy - s.Y) / ratio;
        if (float.IsFinite(kx) && float.IsFinite(ky) && kx > 1f && ky > 1f && kx < _cx * 50f && ky < _cx * 50f)
        {
            _kx = kx;
            _ky = ky;
        }
        else
        {
            float fov = Math.Clamp(pc.GetFOVAngle(), 5f, 170f);
            _kx = _ky = _cx / MathF.Tan(fov * 0.5f * MathF.PI / 180f);
            if (!_reported)
            {
                _reported = true;
                Log.Info("WorldView: Canvas.Project gave " + s + ", projecting from the FOV (" + fov + ") instead.");
            }
        }

        Ready = true;
    }

    /// <summary>The camera, outside drawing (commands and ticks). Returns false while there is no player.</summary>
    public static bool ReadCamera() => World.Pc is { } pc && ReadCamera(pc);

    private static bool ReadCamera(PlayerController pc)
    {
        pc.GetPlayerViewPoint(out Vector3 eye, out Rotator rot);
        Eye = eye;
        Rotation = rot;

        // UE3's FRotationMatrix axes: X forward, Y right, Z up.
        float d = MathF.PI / 180f;
        float sp = MathF.Sin(rot.Pitch * d), cp = MathF.Cos(rot.Pitch * d);
        float sy = MathF.Sin(rot.Yaw * d), cy = MathF.Cos(rot.Yaw * d);
        float sr = MathF.Sin(rot.Roll * d), cr = MathF.Cos(rot.Roll * d);
        Forward = new Vector3(cp * cy, cp * sy, sp);
        Right = new Vector3(sr * sp * cy - cr * sy, sr * sp * sy + cr * cy, -sr * cp);
        Up = new Vector3(-(cr * sp * cy + sr * sy), cy * sr - cr * sp * sy, cr * cp);
        return float.IsFinite(Forward.X);
    }

    /// <summary>Projects a world point. False when it's behind the camera; the point may still be off screen.</summary>
    public static bool ToScreen(Vector3 world, out Vector2 screen)
    {
        Vector3 v = world - Eye;
        float z = Vector3.Dot(v, Forward);
        if (!Ready || z < NearPlane)
        {
            screen = default;
            return false;
        }

        screen = new Vector2(_cx + _kx * Vector3.Dot(v, Right) / z, _cy - _ky * Vector3.Dot(v, Up) / z);
        return true;
    }

    public static bool OnScreen(Vector2 p, float margin = 0f) =>
        p.X >= -margin && p.Y >= -margin && p.X <= Width + margin && p.Y <= Height + margin;

    /// <summary>The eight corners of a world box, projected. False if any corner is behind the camera.</summary>
    public static bool Corners(Vector3 min, Vector3 max, Span<Vector2> eight)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            var c = new Vector3((i & 1) == 0 ? min.X : max.X, (i & 2) == 0 ? min.Y : max.Y, (i & 4) == 0 ? min.Z : max.Z);
            if (!ToScreen(c, out eight[i]))
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>The screen rectangle around a world box. False if it's behind the camera or entirely off screen.</summary>
    public static bool Bounds(Vector3 min, Vector3 max, out float x0, out float y0, out float x1, out float y1)
    {
        Span<Vector2> c = stackalloc Vector2[8];
        x0 = y0 = float.MaxValue;
        x1 = y1 = float.MinValue;
        if (!Corners(min, max, c))
            return false;

        foreach (Vector2 p in c)
        {
            x0 = MathF.Min(x0, p.X);
            y0 = MathF.Min(y0, p.Y);
            x1 = MathF.Max(x1, p.X);
            y1 = MathF.Max(y1, p.Y);
        }

        return x1 >= 0f && y1 >= 0f && x0 <= Width && y0 <= Height;
    }

    /// <summary>The angle in degrees between the view direction and a point, for picking what the crosshair is on.</summary>
    public static float AngleTo(Vector3 world)
    {
        Vector3 v = world - Eye;
        float len = v.Length();
        if (len < 1f)
            return 0f;

        float cos = Math.Clamp(Vector3.Dot(v / len, Forward), -1f, 1f);
        return MathF.Acos(cos) * 180f / MathF.PI;
    }
}
```
